Job Description & Summary

The Opportunity

Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

As an Oracle EPM Associate you will support consulting services for Oracle Enterprise Performance Management solutions, helping clients improve budgeting, forecasting, financial consolidation, and reporting processes. As an Associate you will contribute to client projects, learn from experienced team members, adapt to a range of client needs, and build your technical skills while delivering dependable work in a fast-paced environment. In this role at PwC, you will help assess performance management needs, support implementation and configuration activities, and provide training and support for Oracle EPM tools within our Advisory practice.

As a member of PwC Acceleration Center India, you will be part of a delivery environment that supports business application consulting for Oracle technologies and enterprise performance management work. You will develop commercial awareness, gather information from multiple sources, ask questions to deepen understanding, and take ownership for your development while contributing to client-facing work that helps improve financial planning and analysis processes.

Responsibilities

- Supporting Oracle Enterprise Performance Management implementations and configuration activities for planning, budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, and reporting processes
- Assisting with client requirement gathering and translating business needs into Oracle EPM functional and technical tasks
- Contributing to the design, build, and testing of financial planning solutions, including account structures, business rules, and reporting outputs
- Performing data loading, validation, and reconciliation activities to support accurate planning and financial performance data
- Helping prepare documentation for solution design, system setup, testing results, and end-user guidance
- Participating in issue analysis and resolution for application defects, data inconsistencies, and process breaks
- Using Oracle EPM tools and reporting capabilities to support analysis of budgets, forecasts, and financial results
- Learning and applying professional standards, project methods, and Oracle delivery approaches while supporting team objectives

What You Must Have

- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 1 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart

- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Accounting, Accounting & Finance, Finance, Management Information Systems, Economics, Business Administration/Management
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in Enterprise Performance Management or related Oracle EPM Cloud applications
- Experience applying Oracle EPM tools in planning and forecasting environments
- Developing financial analysis, budgeting, or variance reporting skills in client settings
- Gathering data from multiple sources and identifying trends and patterns
- Adapting quickly across teams, clients, and changing project priorities

Travel Requirements

Not Specified

title: Vehicles Operations Supervisor
description:
The Vehicle Operations Supervisor manages the site Vehicle Operations Program including the Vehicle Control Program, Vehicle Operator Licensing, Training and Evaluation, liaises between Vehicle Maintenance and users for scheduled and unscheduled maintenance services, and manages the GPMS AF-registered in-use vehicle program. Carries out all duties in accordance with USAF mandatory requirements. Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS).


Principal Accountabilities


  • Manages the site VCO, CFV program, Fleet Management duties.
  • Provide periodic VCO training, conducts safety meetings and briefings.
  • Conducts Vehicle Operator Licensing and Training.
  • Maintains vehicle operator licensing/training database.
  • Provide driver's training and evaluation.
  • Manage monthly operator forms, manages periodic VCO inspections.
  • Attends/participates in the site accident investigation board when convened.
  • Manages site level AF-registered In-use vehicle authorization requests within the Vehicle Technical Exhibit.
  • Provides initial and recurring training for personnel appointed to Vehicle Control Officer positions.
  • Coordinates with using organizations to ensure timely repair of assigned vehicles.
  • Participates in vehicle utilization boards.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods.

Minimum Requirements


  • Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum Power Point, Excel and Word programs.
  • Will have good organizational and communication skills, particularly in dealings with subordinates.
  • Must possess a valid home country driver's license and ability to obtain host nation driver's license.
  • May be required to operate material handling equipment.
  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Minimum three years military experience in Vehicle Operations, Licensing and Training required.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain facility credentials/authorization. Note: US Citizenship is required for facility credentials/authorization at this work location.
  • May be exposed to extreme noise from operating equipment.
  • Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed.
  • Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Knowledge of DPAS, Fleet Management, maintenance data collection and reporting procedures, small computer operations preferred.
  • Experience in Fleet management, Vehicle Management & Analysis, data collection and reporting procedures, small computer operations preferred.
  • Four years' experience in a supervisory capacity preferred.

title: Night Supervisor
description:
Be Yourself – Be a Bold Team Player – Be Leonardo
Once you’re part of the team, you’re part of the Leonardo community of over 55 hotels across the UK & Ireland!

Night Supervisor – Leonardo Royal Hotel Bristol

As a Night Supervisor, you'll play a key role in ensuring the smooth and efficient running of our hotel overnight. Working closely with the Night Manager and Front Office Management team, you'll help maintain exceptional guest service, operational standards and the safety and security of our guests and colleagues.

This is a varied and rewarding role where no two nights are the same! We're looking for someone who is confident, organised, hands-on and able to take ownership of the operation while creating a welcoming environment for our guests.

  • Ensure a thorough handover to the morning team, highlighting important information and outstanding matters.

What we're looking for:

  • Strong communication, organisational and problem-solving skills.

We’re committed to creating a workplace where every individual—regardless of background, identity, or lived experience—is welcomed, valued, and respected for who they are. Belonging means embracing our differences and ensuring everyone feels seen, heard, and empowered.

Why come join us as a Night Supervisor?


We look after our colleagues just as well as we look after our guests. Our regular Learning Bites, “Come Join Us Guest Care” training and Wellbeing webinars all help your progress with us. With support on tap, top-notch practical training and clear progression you’ll be on track for a brilliant future in Hospitality!

title: Butikssäljare till julhandeln 2026 på Hasselgrens
description:
Är du en person som brinner för försäljning och service? Är du intresserad av inredning och design? Trivs du med att arbeta högt tempo, är ordningsam och alltid sätter kunden i centrum? Då kan du vara den vi söker till den absolut roligaste perioden på året – julhanden!

Vi erbjuder dig att arbeta i en väletablerad och inarbetad butik i centrala Lund med ett stort sortiment av inredning, designartiklar och köksprodukter. Hasselgrens öppnade redan 1898 och har under alla år för många varit det självklara valet vid inköp av köksartiklar. Vi är återförsäljare för i stort sett alla stora varumärken i branschen som Iittala, Rörstrand, Global, Le Creuset, Orrefors, Kosta Boda, Scanpan och Zwilling.

Arbetet kan tidvis bli stressigt och innebär framförallt försäljning och kundkontakt. Uppackning av varor samt andra sedvanligt förekommande uppgifter i butik förekommer också.

Just nu söker vi en person som kan förstärka vårt team i butiken under julhanden. Tjänstens omfattning är i genomsnitt 20 timmar i veckan V48 - V52 med en intensifiering ju närmre jul vi kommer. (ca 50% anställningsgrad)

Många pass är förlagda vardagar klockan 12-18. Helgarbete förekommer.

Kvalifikationer: Vi söker dig som erfarenhet från detaljhandel. Du behöver kunna arbeta vardagar och helger under december.

Meriterande: Erfarenhet och/eller ett intresse för design och köksprodukter är en stor fördel.

Personliga egenskaper: Vi söker en serviceinriktad person som verkligen gillar kundkontakt och trivs med att ta eget ansvar. Du har lätt för att samarbeta men kan också arbeta självständigt och ta egna initiativ. Urval sker löpande vilket innebär att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag så tveka inte utan skicka in din ansökan redan idag.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan! Har du frågor? Ring Niklas Bauer på 0736262911

enligt kollektivavtal

E-posta din ansökan till niklas@hasselgrens.se

title: Transformation & Advisory Director (Operating Model)
description:
Join Kainos and Shape the Future

At Kainos, we’re problem solvers, innovators, and collaborators - driven by a shared mission to create real impact. Whether we’re transforming digital services for millions, delivering cutting-edge Workday solutions, or pushing the boundaries of technology, we do it together.


We believe in a people-first culture, where your ideas are valued, your growth is supported, and your contributions truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be part of a diverse, ambitious team that celebrates creativity and collaboration.


Ready to make your mark? Join us and be part of something bigger.

The problem we collectively solve for customers


Organisations invest in Workday to transform how they run their People, Finance and Planning services – yet most fail to realise the value they set out to achieve. Programmes drift from the business case, legacy operating models and fragmented processes are simply re-platformed, and people are not ready, willing or able to work differently at go-live. The result is a modern platform sitting on top of yesterday’s organisation, with value eroding in the months after deployment.


Kainos Transformation & Advisory exists to close that gap. Working alongside C-suite sponsors from vision and business case through to measured outcomes, our three specialisms act as one team: we define and protect the value case and programme governance, design the target operating model and harmonised processes Workday will enable, and ensure the organisation’s leaders and people are ready to adopt and sustain the change. Together we help customers deliver the transformation they intended – easier, smarter and faster – and have the evidence to prove it.


Main purpose of the role


Lead Kainos’ operating model advisory, helping customers redesign how People, Finance and Planning services are organised and delivered. Ensure Workday enables a simpler, standardised and scalable model rather than replicating legacy complexity.


Core responsibilities


  • Advise C-suite and functional leaders (CHRO, CFO, COO, Shared Services leaders) on future-state target operating models, service delivery and organisation design, securing executive alignment on difficult design choices.
  • Lead process harmonisation and standardisation in a billable capacity across countries, business units and acquisitions – challenging local variation and defining global process standards and design principles aligned to Workday best practice.
  • Translate strategy into design: service catalogues, roles and responsibilities, governance, shared services / centre-of-excellence models and the data and controls needed to operate Workday at scale.
  • Originate and lead operating model and process advisory engagements, Phase 0 / Pathfinder assessments and proposals, growing the T&A pipeline.
  • Build and lead the specialism – methods, reference models and accelerators, thought leadership and a high-performing team – working closely with Workday solution architects and delivery leadership.

Essential criteria


  • 10+ years in consultancy or industry operating model / shared services transformation, with significant time at Director level or similar.
  • Proven experience designing and implementing target operating models for HR, Finance or Payroll functions.
  • Track record of leading global process harmonisation or standardisation within an ERP Cloud programme.
  • Credibility to challenge and influence C-suite and senior functional leaders.
  • Strong commercial and business development experience.
  • Excellent structured problem-solving, facilitation and communication skills.

Desirable criteria


  • Workday HCM, Financials or Planning knowledge (certification an advantage).
  • Shared services / GBS design or M&A integration experience.
  • Process methodology (Lean, Six Sigma, APQC) or organisation design qualification.
  • Big 4 / tier-1 consultancy background

Embracing our differences

At Kainos, we believe in the power of diversity, equity and inclusion. We are committed to building a team that is as diverse as the world we live in, where everyone is valued, respected, and given an equal chance to thrive. We actively seek out talented people from all backgrounds, regardless of age, race, ethnicity, gender, sexual orientation, religion, disability, or any other characteristic that makes them who they are. We also believe every candidate deserves a level playing field.

Our friendly talent acquisition team is here to support you every step of the way, so if you require any accommodations or adjustments, we encourage you to reach out.

We understand that everyone's journey is different, and by having a private conversation we can ensure that our recruitment process is tailored to your needs.

title: Technician 3, Facilities Technician
description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

Primary Function:

Responsible for the operation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of facility systems and building infrastructure to ensure safe, reliable, and uninterrupted support for manufacturing, office, and site operations. Performs preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance activities while ensuring compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.

  • Associate degree or bachelor’s degree in a related engineering discipline is an advantage.

Experience:

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in facilities operation and maintenance in a manufacturing, semiconductor, industrial, or commercial environment.
  • TESDA NC II certification or relevant trade certifications are preferred.

Knowledge, skill and abilities:

  • Knowledge of HVAC and ventilation systems.
  • Knowledge of electrical distribution systems, MCCs, transformers, UPS, generators, lighting, and power quality.
  • Familiarity with compressed air, water systems, pumps, plumbing, and other building utilities.
  • Ability to read and interpret electrical and mechanical drawings and schematics.

  • Good troubleshooting and analytical skills.

  • Knowledge of operation and maintenance of building utilities and support systems.
  • Knowledge of facilities equipment preventive and corrective maintenance practices.
  • Knowledge of handling contractors and maintenance vendors.
  • Knowledge of data analysis, technical report creation and presentation

Major Duties & Responsibilities:

  • Perform preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance of facility equipment and utility systems.
  • Monitor and maintain HVAC, electrical, plumbing, compressed air, fire protection, and other building systems to ensure operational reliability.
  • Conduct routine inspections and equipment condition monitoring, including thermal scanning, vibration monitoring, and performance checks.

  • Execute work orders and maintenance activities through the CMMS system and ensure timely completion.

  • Ensure compliance with company safety, environmental, health, and quality requirements, including permit-to-work and lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspection reports, equipment history, and technical documentation.
  • Support energy conservation, cost reduction, sustainability, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Participate in emergency response activities and provide support during utility interruptions or equipment failures.
  • Assist in audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance requirements related to facility operations.

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. title: FDE - Lead Data Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Your role At Kyndryl, Forward Deployed Engineers work where enterprise AI becomes real. This is not a traditional consulting role or a back office engineering position. Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with customers to design, build, and deploy AI solutions that operate in complex, regulated, production environments. As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you will own defined delivery workstreams within customer engagements—prototyping, deploying, and optimizing AI systems that create measurable business outcomes. You will operate with growing independence in customer environments, bridging deep engineering expertise with business context, and translating ambiguous problems into production ready solutions. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, consulting, and delivery accountability. You will use modern AI development tools to accelerate solution design, code generation, testing, and deployment, while building the customer trust that sustains long term impact and referenceable success. What you will do •Customer Engagement & Solution Integrity: Partner with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into high‑quality, fit‑for‑purpose technical solutions, prioritising the right outcome over the fastest one •Rapid Prototyping: Build and iterate custom AI solutions tailored to customer needs, leveraging agentic AI frameworks •Ownership, Deployment & Partnership: Own delivery end to end, from scoping to production. Work as part of the customer team to engineer and deploy production‑ready solutions that drive adoption and measurable business outcomes. •Optimization: Troubleshoot and enhance system performance, scalability, and reliability •Field Intelligence: Systematically capture deployment learnings, document best practices, and proactively share insights to inform enhancements to Kyndryl’s core platforms and frameworks •Continuous Learning: Adapt quickly to emerging technologies and evolving customer requirements by engaging in ongoing professional development •Platform Contribution: Actively contribute to the evolution of Kyndryl’s AI platforms through feedback, code contributions, and collaboration with product teams


Who You Are

Required skills and experience •Programming Proficiency: Demonstrable expertise in Python, (or another modern language such as C#, Node.js or TypeScript); experience working with AI/ML frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch is a plus •Software Engineering: Solid grasp of the software delivery lifecycle, version control (Git & GitHub), and data engineering tools such as Pandas and Spark •Cloud & Distributed Systems: Experience with cloud AI platforms (AWS, Azure, Google AI) and distributed computing architectures Preferred skills and experience •Open-Source Ecosystems: Familiarity with community-driven AI tools and libraries, including Hugging Face and relevant repositories •T-shaped Profile: Deep technical expertise in one or two domains, with broad understanding across AI/ML, cloud, and consulting •Agentic AI Systems: Experience designing, building, or integrating multi-agent systems and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, Agent Framework, AutoGen, CrewAI), including the development of agent protocols and coordination mechanisms •Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Knowledge Systems: Practical knowledge of deploying RAG architectures and integrating structured and unstructured knowledge sources into AI solutions •Performance & Security: Knowledge of system-level optimisation and security best practices for scalable AI systems •Business Acumen: Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and communicate technical value to diverse stakeholders, including executive audiences •Flexibility: Willingness to travel and work on customer premises as required •Education: Degree-level qualification in Computer Science, Informatics, Data Science, Engineering, or a closely related discipline - or equivalent professional experience


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Project Lead
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position


Project Lead is accountable for driving the strategic execution, global rollout, and business impact of the Autonomous Remote L1 Support Program, redesigning Roche’s remote-support experience around an AI-first operating model. You will lead the implementation of an end-to-end, 24/7 support ecosystem across voice, chat, digital, and connected-service channels, delivering core AI capabilities (including Voicebot Case Creation, Predictive Routing, and First-Contact Resolution).


Will ensure seamless, zero-friction omnichannel context transfers, global workflow harmonization across priority focus regions, and robust change management using the ADKAR model. Aligned with Dia Service Strategy 2030+ governance, your role is pivotal in driving operational efficiency, scaling autonomous resolution, and unlocking significant long-term value and operational savings across Diagnostics Customer Support.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the strategic direction and global execution of the Autonomous Remote L1 Support Program to maximize customer adoption and positive business impact across regions, contact centers, and affiliates.
  • Drive the AI-first process redesign of L1 support workflows, harmonizing fragmented regional SME processes across focus affiliates into a single global blueprint.
  • Synchronize program execution and milestones with critical external dependencies, including the Contact Center as a Service (CCaaS) Hub rollout, core infrastructure, and GenAI frameworks.
  • Establish clear accountability frameworks, strict Definition of Done (DoD) phase-gate criteria, and benefit tracking mechanisms in close partnership with Global Service Finance and Service Insights workstreams.
  • Embed the ADKAR change management framework across all rollout phases to evaluate organizational readiness, overcome agent behavioral resistance, and drive active adoption of self-service tools and AI capabilities.
  • Establish, lead, and empower a multifunctional Project Core Team (PCT), creating a positive, high-urgency environment aligned with joint program ambitions.
  • Collaborate closely with Dia Service Strategy 2030+ execution workstreams (Finance, Service Insights, Change Management, Communications, Execution) and represent the program to the Steering Committee and senior management.
  • Manage ambiguous business situations, resolve stakeholder conflicts, and proactively address technical, regulatory, and scope constraints (e.g., local compliance, language capabilities, and legacy instrument decommissioning timelines).

Qualifications:

  • 5–7+ years of experience in project or program management leading complex cross-departmental or cross-site service transformation initiatives in Diagnostics or MedTech.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex AI, GenAI, Contact Center, or platform integration programs in a global, matrixed organization.
  • Proven track record in global process harmonization, with the ability to align disparate regional SME workflows into a unified operational model.
  • Extensive experience with project management methodologies in Agile environments and gate-based Project Frameworks.
  • Extensive change management experience across project styles, with practical knowledge of the ADKAR model (change management certification, e.g., Prosci, is an advantage).
  • Project management certification (e.g., IPMA, PMI, PRINCE2) is an advantage.
  • Strong financial literacy with experience tracking large-scale project budgets, managing business cases and tracking financial impact metrics.
  • Domain knowledge of Diagnostics Customer Support, L1 contact center processes, and enterprise IT architectures is a strong advantage.
  • Excellent interpersonal, leadership, collaboration, and conflict resolution skills to navigate schedule-sensitive and resource-constrained environments.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, including delivering effective presentations to senior management and executive steering committees.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimum or no supervision in a fast-changing international setting.
  • Fluency (spoken and written) in English is mandatory; additional languages are an asset.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25–30% of the time.


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Forskningsingenjör inom strukturbiologi
description:
Vi har kraften från över 50 000 studenter och medarbetare. Studenter som ger framtidshopp. Medarbetare som varje dag bidrar till att Linköpings universitet tar sig an samtidens utmaningar. Vår värdegrund vilar på trovärdighet, tillit och trygghet. Genom att vara modiga, tänka fritt och göra nytt skapar vi tillsammans, med stora och små handlingar, en bättre framtid. Välkommen att söka jobb hos oss!

Om jobbet

Som forskningsingenjör kommer du att utföra forskning med hjälp av NMR och biofysikaliska tekniker i Sunnerhagens forskargrupp i Strukturbiologi vid Linköpings universitet. Aktuella samarbeten med forskare vid University of Toronto och Universität Zürich ingår. Anställningen är tidsbegränsad men kan för rätt kandidat leda vidare till postdocmeritering i andra forskargrupper.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är väl insatt i att studera oordnade proteiner och deras dynamiska interaktioner på molekylär nivå med hjälp av NMR, HDX, SAXS samt övrig biofysik (ITC, SEC-MALS, nanoDSF, MST, aktivitetsassays) samt beräknings- och modelleringstekniker av sådana komplex.

Du ska ha:

  • Doktorsexamen inom proteinkemi med särskild inriktning mot NMR och biofysik

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Bedrivit och publicerat forskning inom området oordnade proteiners interaktioner
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att utvärdera dynamiska egenskaper på ps-ms nivå med hjälp av NMR. Här ingår att planera och sätta upp sådana NMR-experiment (snabb relaxation, CEST och CPMG) och utvärdera dessa i dynamisk detalj
  • Erfarenhet av att samutvärdera experimentella och beräkningsmässiga data inom strukturbiologi
  • Omfattande erfarenhet av proteinproduktion och goda kunskaper inom molekylärbiologi samt magnetisk märkning av dessa med kärnorna 2H, 15H och 13C

Din arbetsplats

Du kommer arbeta på Institutionen för fysik, kemi och biologi (IFM) vid Linköpings Universitet, i professor Maria Sunnerhagens grupp.

Läs mer om vår verksamhet här: https://liu.se/organisation/liu/ifm

Om anställningen

Visstidsanställning, 100% i 7 månader.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Lön och förmåner

Linköpings universitet tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning och sker i enlighet med gällande kollektivavtal (RALS/RALS-T) samt universitetets riktlinjer för lönebildning.

Vi erbjuder möjlighet till distansarbete viss del av din arbetstid när verksamhetens behov och arbetsuppgifterna medger detta.

Läs mer om förmåner för anställda https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/formaner.

Fackliga kontaktpersoner

Information om fackliga kontaktpersoner, se https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/hjalp-for-sokande.

Ansökan

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan med CV och ansökningsbrev senast den 24 november, 2026. Du söker denna anställning genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök" här nedan. Ansökan som inkommer efter sista ansökningsdag kommer inte att beaktas.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, det berikar och utvecklar vår verksamhet. För oss är det självklart att värna om allas lika värde, rättigheter och möjligheter. Läs om vårt arbete med https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linköpings universitet har upphandlade avtal och undanber oss direktkontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Värmland
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Värmland.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

title: 06bP - Network Services
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Do you want to be at the forefront of designing and implementing cutting-edge network solutions? Within our Network Services team at Kyndryl, you will be the go-to expert for providing top-of-the-line technical solutions throughout the entire solution lifecycle. You will be responsible for creating local and wide-area network solutions that utilize multiple platforms and protocols, ensuring that our customers have the best possible network infrastructure to support their business needs. Your skills in routers, networking controllers, bridges, and networking software will be essential as you troubleshoot network issues and coordinate with vendors to install the latest hardware and software, such as routers and switches. Not only will you help keep our customer’s networks running smoothly, but you will also work on project implementation, conduct project planning and cost analysis, and build proof-of-concept solutions with networking system technology. In this role, you will have the opportunity to review project requirements, communicate them accurately to the team, and ensure they are appropriately fulfilled. You will use your expertise to design and implement local and wide-area network solutions, including IP and VOIP, that address customer requirements. You will also provide high-quality technical solutions to our customers to prepare them for implementation, go-live, and maintenance. If you are excited about using your technical expertise to create innovative network solutions and provide outstanding customer service, then this is the role for you! Your Future at Kyndryl At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others. Required Technical and Professional Expertise •6+ years of experience focused on network support, configuration, and implementation •6+ years of experience in core switching, routing, MPLS, and firewalls •Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains •Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision Preferred Technical and Professional Experience •Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) deployment and data center experience •Experience with design and implementing Software Defined Network (SDN) and large complex networks •Experience with protocols and technologies such as, BDP, OSPF, MP-FBP EVPN, VXLAN, or VPC


Being You

Advanced Bachelor's degree in Pharma & Life Science.

  • Ability and mindset to adapt to new ways of working such as Agile

Better is out there. Better medications, better outcomes, better science. But progress doesn’t happen without people – people from different backgrounds, in different locations, doing different roles, all united by one thing: a desire to make miracles happen. So, let’s be those people.

title: Customer Advocacy Generalist
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.



Meet the team:

As a Customer Advocacy Generalist you will be reviewing and evaluating complaints as per Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and taking part in facilitating continuous quality and process improvements. This position is responsible for assisting with the maintenance and monitoring of a variety of cGMP documentation including complaint files, complaint processing system, Medical Device Reporting, corrective action, and preventive actions (CAPA), and maintenance of other related quality system records as required.

Where you come in:

  • Review and evaluate all required customer complaint related documentation in an accurate, professional and timely manner.
  • Document and maintain records of all complaint investigations in accordance with domestic and worldwide international regulations (e.g. 820, MDD, ISO, Canada, and other countries).
  • Assist with Medical Device Reporting and review investigation results of returned products.
  • Write Manufacturer Incident Reports (MIR) and submit to the necessary authorities.
  • Take initiative to identify and solve problems by participating in continuous improvement activities, processing standards and documentation enhancement, training and processing efficiency initiatives.
  • Support internal, external, and third-party audits.
  • Perform routine complaint system data entry, documentation, and administrative tasks.
  • Assume and perform other duties as assigned.

What makes you successful:


  • You are proficient in English.
  • You possess strong verbal, listening, and written communication skills.
  • You demonstrate analytical thinking skills, with the ability to define problems, collect and analyze data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • You are focused on consistently delivering high-quality results
  • You have the ability to work independently while also excelling in a collaborative team environment.
  • Previous experience in the medical or post-market surveillance field is highly advantageous.

What you’ll get:


  • A comprehensive onboarding and training on the job.
  • Opportunity to work in a diverse and inclusive environment with colleagues representing 45 different nationalities.
  • Hybrid working model, offering the flexibility to work both remotely and in a modern, well-equipped office space.
  • 5 additional vacation days, with potential for more for parents, students, and other cases with approval.
  • Opportunity to work from other countries for up to 30 days per year.
  • Health Insurance including reduced premiums available for dependents.
  • Life and Accident insurance coverage.
  • 3rd Pillar Private Pension plan.
  • Health and Wellness programs, including access to online coaching and therapy sessions
  • Fertility, Family forming, Menopause and Men’s health support services.
  • Regular team-building events that foster collaboration and connection.
  • Best-in-class training and career development programs.
  • Exclusive discounts on restaurants, spas, clothing, gyms, entertainment, and more.
  • Access to a fitness tracking app with rewards for staying active.
  • Free parking space at the city center office location.

Travel Required:


  • 0-5%


Experience and Education Requirements:


  • Typically requires a minimum of 2-4 years of related experience and a High School diploma/certificate or equivalent.

Flex Workplace:


  • Your primary location will be an office, based in Vilnius. You will not have an assigned workstation and will work with your manager to determine office visit needs. You must live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site.


To all Staffing and Recruiting Agencies: Our Careers Site is only for individuals seeking a job at Dexcom. Only authorized staffing and recruiting agencies may use this site or to submit profiles, applications or resumes on specific requisitions. Dexcom does not accept unsolicited resumes or applications from agencies. Please do not forward resumes to the Talent Acquisition team, Dexcom employees or any other company location. description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Technical Program Manager

About your role:

As a Technical Program Manager, you will lead complex product engineering programs across full stack customer-facing platforms, from service architecture through user experience delivery. You will partner with software engineering, product management, and business leadership teams to translate strategic goals into executable technical programs. Your work will help improve delivery predictability, align cross-functional priorities, and accelerate the launch of scalable, high-quality products in dynamic environments.

What you'll do:

  • Lead end-to-end technical programs across full stack product engineering environments, including customer-facing services, applications, and experience-focused delivery.
  • Bridge software engineering, product management, and business leadership teams to define program scope, execution plans, milestones, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Coordinate multi-team deliverables, manage dependencies, track critical paths, and drive release schedules across complex technical initiatives.
  • Translate broad business objectives and customer needs into actionable technical requirements, delivery plans, key performance indicators (KPIs), and service-level agreements (SLAs).
  • Partner with engineering and product teams to align design, development, testing, release, and operational readiness across distributed workstreams.
  • Drive program governance through regular status reviews, risk management, issue tracking, escalation planning, and stakeholder communication.
  • Communicate clearly with technical teams and non-executive leadership through structured updates, delivery dashboards, and risk reviews.
  • Support teams in navigating ambiguity, resolving blockers, and maintaining execution discipline in fast-moving, high-scale product environments.
  • Contribute to process improvements that strengthen release coordination, delivery transparency, and cross-team accountability.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering program delivery, or related roles in product engineering environments.
  • Experience leading technical programs across customer-facing, high-scale, dynamic application environments spanning services and user experience delivery.
  • Experience coordinating multi-team deliverables, dependency management, critical path tracking, and release scheduling across complex engineering initiatives.
  • Experience translating business goals and customer requirements into technical plans, KPIs, SLAs, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Experience communicating with technical teams and business stakeholders through regular status reviews, risk reviews, and structured program governance.
  • Experience supporting or delivering high-throughput, scalable distributed systems or large-scale consumer or enterprise products.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience in financial services, payments, or other high-availability product environments.
  • Experience working closely with software engineering teams in full stack delivery models.
  • Experience with Agile, Scrum, Kanban, or hybrid delivery frameworks in enterprise engineering programs.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP), Agile, Scrum, SAFe, or equivalent certification.

How you'll work:

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

title: Structural Technical Specialist II
description:
What You'll Be Doing

Job Summary: The Technical Specialist is generally responsible for providing technical direction over a team of designers when functioning as a lead designer. As lead designer, responsibilities will include total delivery of the civil/structural deliverables and services on time, within performance budget and meeting quality expectations. This level requires extensive progressive experience in civil/structural design and involves utilization of project controls for cost, schedule and quality of projects. This work will be performed under minimal supervision in our office in Nederland, TX.

Primary responsibilities will include but not be limited to:

  • Familiarity with and utilization of department design and drafting standards
  • Recognizing and communicating project scope, specifications and design criteria upon assignment to a project task team.
  • Reviewing and comprehending the latest information available regarding civil/structural calculations, equipment drawings and layouts or drawings from other disciplines before initiating design effort on specific drawings.
  • Drafting civil/structural plans under minimal supervision.
  • Knowledge of basic civil material specifications to the extent that all information required for material purchase, fabrication and construction is reflected on the finished drawings.
  • Recognizing and communicating scope and design changes promptly.
  • Performing field related work collecting design information and verifying designs for tie-ins, function and clearances to existing facility; on-site assistance during startup; performing field support activities, where assigned, for engineering support during construction; assisting engineers with cost and material estimates and preliminary design studies.
  • Checking the accuracy and quality of drawings developed by drafters, when assigned, based on information conveyed by engineering direction, equipment and discipline drawings; providing technical guidance to less experienced drafting personnel in the department.
  • Coordinating & delegating work activities with other teammates and the discipline leads.
  • Producing civil/structural construction scopes with engineering review and approval; able to serve in role as a mentor for entry level and new teammates.
  • Completing complex and difficult designs and layouts for complete systems and components of projects. Assignments typically involve design elements for which there may be no clearly established precedents and require anticipation of problems at the outset in order to provide appropriate solutions.
  • Performing front-end layout and design of complex systems and equipment.
  • Ensuring compliance with required specifications, tolerances, safety factors, and client requirements.
  • Performing specialized geometric design computations and analysis.
  • Performing interdisciplinary checks and providing coordination of data to ensure compatible designs.
  • Assisting in the establishment or revision of guidelines and standards.
  • Reviewing supplier data and supplier/manufacturer drawings, as required.
  • Checking orthographic (2D) and isometric (3D) drawings prepared by others. May provide direction to a team of checking personnel, ensuring the dimensional accuracy of the drawings produced.
  • Collaborating with Engineers and other engineering disciplines to ensure quality of design.
  • Providing training to less experienced designers.
  • Serving as Lead Designer on projects, ensuring compliance with industry codes, as well as project and company standards.
  • Preparing man-hour estimates as required.
  • Responsible for the quality and economy of deliverables, and efficiency of detailing.
  • As a lead designer, responsible for the design team meeting scope, schedule and budget.

This position offers a highly competitive compensation package, including paid time off, health insurance benefits, and matching retirement contributions.


Ideal Background

Education: Associate degree in Engineering Technology or Computer-Aided Drafting is preferred.

Experience: Requires 15+ years of relevant industrial experience in civil/structural drafting and design.


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Knowledge and application of AISC and ACI standard details.
  • Ability to produce drawings for concrete and structural steel, and/or civil disciplines.
  • Familiarity with specifications and installation details of construction bulk materials and equipment.
  • Knowledge and application of company engineering design and CAD drafting standards.

title: Computer Science | Data Science internship: failure pattern analysis
description:
Introduction

The Leveling department within Development and Engineering at ASML develops advanced wafer measurement solutions that support nanometer-level accuracy in semiconductor manufacturing. This internship focuses on improving the understanding of machine failures through data-driven analysis of event logs. You will help transform complex and noisy machine data into meaningful insights that support system reliability and performance. Your work will contribute to identifying recurring failure patterns and enabling more effective failure classification. This internship offers the opportunity to combine artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data mining in a highly innovative engineering environment.


Your assignment

During this internship, you will develop methods to analyze machine event logs and identify patterns related to machine failures. You will design and evaluate machine learning approaches that classify failure modes and uncover valuable insights from historical machine data. The results of your work may support engineers in understanding failure behaviour across multiple systems and improving future diagnostics.


Your main responsibilities will be:

  • Develop algorithms to clean, compress, and structure noisy machine event data.
  • Identify recurring failure signatures using data mining and machine learning techniques.
  • Build and evaluate supervised and unsupervised classification models.
  • Validate findings using historical data and expert feedback.
  • Investigate similarities and differences between failure patterns across machines.
  • Assess the practical value of the proposed solution for engineering use cases.
  • Present results and recommendations to engineers and researchers.

This is a master's thesis/non-thesis internship for a minimum of 6 months, 5 days per week (3 days on-site).

The start date of this internship is as of February 2027 or earlier, depending on your availability.


Your profile

To be suitable for the internship, you:

  • Are pursuing a master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Electrical Engineering, Systems & Control, or a related technical field.
  • Have experience with Python and machine learning techniques.
  • Have knowledge of data analysis, classification methods, feature engineering, and model evaluation.
  • Are analytical and enjoy solving complex technical challenges using data.
  • Are collaborative, proactive, and able to communicate technical findings clearly.

This internship is based in the Eindhoven region of the Netherlands. You will work closely with experienced engineers and researchers while contributing to meaningful challenges in the semiconductor industry. The assignment provides an opportunity to apply your academic knowledge to real-world engineering problems and gain hands-on experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, and data-driven decision-making. If you are excited about turning complex data into actionable insights, we encourage you to apply for this internship.


Other requirements you need to meet:

  • You are enrolled at an educational institute for the entire duration of the internship, and you are at least 18 years old at the start of the internship;
  • If you are a non-EU citizen, studying in the Netherlands, your university is willing to sign the documents relevant for doing an internship (i.e., Nuffic agreement);
  • You attach your cover letter with a clear motivation on why you are interested in this internship assignment in particular;
  • You need to be located in the Netherlands to be perform your internship. In case you are currently living/studying outside of the Netherlands, your application shows the willingness to relocate.


Inclusion and diversity

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

Lead and manage a team while performing the technical and trading responsibilities of a Senior Property Underwriter. Deliver agreed service and performance objectives through effective people management, workflow oversight, technical support and broker relationship management within a wholesale distribution model.


Role responsibilities


Team Leadership & Performance

• Set clear team objectives and priorities aligned to business requirements.

• Conduct regular one-to-ones, agree and follow up actions, provide constructive feedback and support development and career progression.

• Manage routine performance, attendance and wellbeing matters within delegated management responsibilities and company procedures, involving the Associate Director and HR where required.

• Coordinate onboarding and training, promote an inclusive team environment and address concerns constructively.

• Lead by example, setting the standard for behaviour, attendance and engagement, and hold the team to account.

• Provide cover for other Team Leaders and Associate Director (Operations) where required.


Service Delivery & Workload Management

• Take day-to-day responsibility for telephone service, timely and accurate document issuance, and performance measures appropriate to the team, such as agreed enquiry, quotation and referral turnaround times or renewal retention.Review queues, task lists, referrals and aged work throughout the day; allocate and redistribute work fairly according to capacity, competence, authority and priorities.

• Coordinate telephone cover, breaks and service commitments, prioritising urgent broker enquiries and time-sensitive cases.

• Monitor service shortfalls, take corrective action within the role’s remit and promptly escalate capacity, system, broker-service or conduct risks.

• Use service information and team feedback to investigate recurring operational issues, recommend improvements to workflows and systems, and support agreed changes.


Senior Underwriting & Technical Referrals

• Assess, negotiate and underwrite in accordance with documented underwriting authority, underwriting guides, insurer requirements and company procedures.

• Maintain an allocated personal underwriting workload, including complex cases.

• Act as the team’s first point of contact for technical underwriting queries, referring onwards where higher authority or specialist guidance is required.

• Identify recurring technical queries and share learning to support consistency and reduce avoidable repeat referrals.

Appointment as Team Leader does not create or extend underwriting authority. The holder must remain within documented authority and sign-off status and must not override insurer requirements.


Communication & Collaboration

· Act as the team’s operational contact, remain accessible during agreed working hours and communicate business updates clearly.

· Maintain effective internal stakeholder relationships and work with other Team Leaders to ensure consistent standards, clear work ownership and effective handovers. Agree cross-team cover with the Associate Director and escalate unresolved resource conflicts.


Trading & Distribution Channel Performance

• Agree appropriate performance measures with the Associated Director (Operations)

• Monitor performance and take improvement action where required.

• Review quote activity and conversion and / or renewal retention, , broker feedback and reasons for lost business; work with Business Development, underwriting management and support teams to increase business levels and address barriers.

• Proactively manage broker relationships within the allocated channel, addressing service concerns and supporting commercially sound decisions without compromising appetite, pricing discipline, underwriting quality or regulatory requirements.

• Undertake any other reasonable duties, appropriate to the level of the role, as required by the Associate Director (Operations).


Balance of responsibilities

Personal underwriting workloads and quotation targets will reflect the time required for leadership, people management, technical referrals and coaching, rather than assume the output of a full-time Senior Underwriter without these duties. Expectations will be reviewed as team size, referral demand and service requirements change.


Key requirements

• Minimum Cert CII; five years’ property underwriting experience or three years’ non-standard property underwriting experience.

• Established residential property underwriting expertise, including complex risks, technical referrals, authority controls and clear decision recording.

• Sound understanding of relevant insurance regulation, the responsibilities of a wholesale underwriter in supporting policyholder outcomes, and the systems, workflows and broker relationships of the relevant team.

• Experience leading, mentoring or coordinating colleagues, with the ability to conduct effective one-to-ones, coach and support development.

• Strong communication, relationship-building and prioritisation skills; ability to balance personal underwriting with team management.

• Ability to interpret service and conversion or retention information, investigate exceptions and take proportionate action.


Objectives and review

Objectives and numerical targets will be agreed separately and reviewed regularly, reflecting the balance of management and underwriting responsibilities.

Our core values dictate how we live and work. We’re a group with independence and people at its heart – and a home for talent with a unique culture: the biggest small company in the world.

Diversity and inclusion

description:
Job Purpose We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to lead the battery system development projects from concept through production launch. This role serves as the lead integrator across engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, customers, and suppliers to ensure successful project execution. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver safe, reliable, and high-performance battery systems.

Key Responsibilities


  • Lead battery system development projects from concept and design through validation, production launch, and post-launch support.
  • Own the integrated project plan, including scope, schedule, milestones, resources, deliverables, and project governance.
  • Serve as the lead integrator across engineering, quality, manufacturing, supply chain, customers, and suppliers to drive alignment and execution.
  • Direct technical development across battery cells, modules and packs, battery management systems, thermal management, mechanical structures, high-voltage electrical systems, embedded software, and controls.
  • Drive cross-functional decision-making, resolve technical and program issues, and ensure timely completion of critical deliverables.
  • Identify and manage project risks, dependencies, and changes; establish mitigation and recovery plans and escalate critical issues when needed.
  • Serve as the primary project interface for customers and key suppliers, ensuring requirements, commitments, technical decisions, and deliverables are clearly communicated and achieved.
  • Lead validation, certification, and product-release readiness, ensuring battery systems meet customer, regulatory, safety, quality, and performance requirements.
  • Drive prototype and production-launch readiness with manufacturing and quality teams, including issue resolution, corrective actions, and lessons learned.

What we are looking for

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering or a related technical field.
  • 5+ years of experience in engineering or technical product development, including at least 2 years leading cross-functional projects or major technical workstreams
  • Experience with battery systems, electrified vehicles, energy storage, or related technologies.
  • Strong project planning, scheduling, organization, and cross-functional coordination skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Excel, PowerPoint, and related project management tools.
  • Ability to travel internationally as required.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience with lithium-ion battery systems, BMS, or battery pack development.
  • Knowledge of battery validation, qualification testing, and applicable standards, including UL 1973, UL 9540/9540A, UN 38.3, IEC 62619, and ISO 26262.
  • Experience in customer-facing engineering or technical project management.
  • Familiarity with APQP, DFMEA, PFMEA, PPAP, and change management processes.

title: Know Your Customer (KYC) Team Lead/ SME
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To manage operations within a business area and maintain processes, risk management initiatives and compliance with relevant regulators.

  • Creation of a safe environment for colleagues to speak up, actively and regularly encourage and solicit feedback to ensure people agenda remains focused on the right areas.

Analyst Expectations

  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us at Barclays as a Know Your Customer (KYC) Team Lead/ SME. As a KYC Team Manager/ SME, you will be responsible for delivering high‑quality analytical work with a focus on KYC. To be successful as a KYC Team Lead/ SME, you should have experience with:

  • Barclaycard payments systems and process.

This role is based in Northampton.

title: VP, Senior Managing Counsel, Global Competition Law Compliance
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

VP, Senior Managing Counsel, Global Competition Law Compliance

Overview
As Mastercard’s VP, Senior Managing Counsel for Global Competition Law, Compliance and Policy, you will define, lead and oversee Mastercard’s global competition law and antitrust compliance policy. You will partner with all business lines to enable innovation and growth, whilst ensuring compliance in a rapidly evolving business and regulatory environment.

Role:
• Report to the General Counsel, Litigation and serve as a trusted advisor to senior business leaders and their teams.
• Define, lead and oversee Mastercard’s global competition law and antitrust compliance policy, by:
o Managing Mastercard’s Global Antitrust and Competition Law Policy to ensure that it reflects current developments in the law and the evolution of Mastercard’s business.
o Performing periodic global competition law compliance risk assessments and designing and implementing controls to mitigate the identified risks.
o Implementing a comprehensive monitoring and testing program to measure and ensure the effectiveness of the Policy.
o Partnering with compliance and HR training teams to design, develop and implement online training and conduct live training.
o Developing and implementing a communications plan to enhance awareness of the Policy and presenting reports to senior management, risk and compliance committees.
o Identifying opportunities to streamline processes and drive efficiencies; including through technology and AI.
o Working closely with compliance and the law department to oversee and manage regulatory investigations and inquiries related to competition law/antitrust matters.
o Partnering with business and legal colleagues to evaluate and assess products, services and technologies to ensure compliance with competition laws and regulations.

All About You:
• Antitrust and competition law experience both as an outside counsel and in-house counsel with a deep understanding of US and EU competition laws.
• Prior experience and responsibility for developing and implementing antitrust compliance programs as an in-house counsel on either a regional or global level.
• Strong project management, process improvement skills and communication skills.
• Excellent strategic judgment, business first mindset, and executive presence.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
