title: Training Delivery Senior Specialist - WebOps - Core Maintenance
description:
Join Us!

At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

We are looking for a Training Delivery Specialist who combines deep hands-on software development expertise with a passion for capability building and adult learning. In this role, you will bridge the gap between engineering and learning operations by assessing capability gaps, designing real-world technical curricula, and delivering high-impact training programs to our engineering and operations teams.


Responsibilities:

1. Technical Training Delivery & Enablement

  • Deliver engaging, hands-on technical training sessions, live coding bootcamps, workshops, and lab environments across classroom and virtual formats.
  • Demystify complex front-end and web networking concepts (e.g., state management, bundle optimization, DNS resolution workflows, SSL/TLS, 301/302 redirects, canonicalization, and edge caching).
  • Facilitate code walkthroughs, debug clinics, and architectural design reviews for learners.

2. Curriculum Design & Content Creation

  • Design, build, and continuously update end-to-end technical learning paths, hands-on lab exercises, and evaluation rubrics based on adult learning principles.
  • Create production-aligned coding exercises adhering to modern standards, clean code principles, testability, and responsive UI performance.
  • Partner with engineering leads to convert operational post-mortems and emerging tech updates into digestible training modules.

3. Capability Assessment & Learning Impact

  • Proactively assess current-state skills across teams within the Organization and build proactive development roadmaps.
  • Implement pre- and post-training assessments, practical coding benchmarks, and capstone project reviews to measure tangible skill acquisition.
  • Leverage data and metrics to track learner progress, evaluate business impact, and optimize learning interventions.

4. Stakeholder & Domain Collaboration

  • Partner with Senior Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, UX Designers, and training partners to keep training curricula aligned with current architecture and business needs.
  • Serve as the resident Subject Matter Expert on front-end best practices, browser performance, and web delivery ecosystems.

Technical Scope & Requirements

  • Front-End Architecture: Deep hands-on experience in HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Modern JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript. Strong working expertise in Angular (components, services, RxJS, lifecycle hooks, state management).
  • Web Networking & Traffic Routing: Strong practical understanding of DNS management (A/AAAA records, CNAME, ALIAS, MX, TXT), domain mapping, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, reverse proxies, and URL redirect handling (301, 302, server vs. client routing, regex rewrite rules, canonical tags).
  • Modern Tooling & Build Pipelines: Experience with build systems and bundlers (Webpack, Vite), package managers (npm/yarn), and version control (Git branching, code review workflows, and CI/CD basics).
  • CMS & Content Delivery: Practical understanding of traditional and Headless CMS architectures (e.g., Contentful, Adobe Experience Manager, Brightspot, or Drupal) and how front-end layers consume headless APIs.
  • Performance & Quality: Expertise in web performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code-splitting, caching strategies) and clean code standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience: 7–10+ years of total experience, including:
  • At least 4–5 years of hands-on software development experience with front-end / full-stack web applications.
  • At least 2–3 years in a role involving technical training delivery, bootcamps, developer enablement, or structured technical mentoring.
  • Instructional Competence: Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into structured, learner-friendly modules and hands-on coding labs.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with comfort leading live code sessions and presenting to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and serverless hosting/edge computing (Cloudflare, CloudFront, or Firebase Hosting).
  • Familiarity with backend integration patterns (RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Node.js).
  • Experience utilizing data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio) to present learning analytics.
  • LMS & Tools: Familiarity with modern Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital learning platforms, and lab sandboxes
  • Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Agile/Scrum) or Process Improvement (Six Sigma Green/Black Belt).

Benefits

  • We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage

  • We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums

  • Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

As we continue to scale, Identity & Access Management (IAM) is at the heart of our cybersecurity and business enablement strategy, ensuring seamless and secure access for employees, customers, and partners.

We are building a modern IAM framework that integrates across Entra ID, Entra B2C, SAP, and Workday, aligning with zero-trust principles, automation, and regulatory compliance.



Role Overview


  • The IAM Architect will lead the design, implementation, and optimization of enterprise identity and access solutions, ensuring seamless integration across cloud, SaaS, and on-prem systems.
  • This role will focus on Entra ID (Azure AD), Entra B2C, SAP, and Workday integrations, balancing security, user experience, and operational efficiency.
  • This is a hands-on technical leadership role, working closely with security engineers, infrastructure teams, and business application owners to drive a modern IAM strategy at Strada.


Key Responsibilities


  • Identity & Access Architecture Design and implement a scalable IAM architecture utilizing Microsoft Entra ID, Entra B2C, and other identity platforms.
  • Lead integration efforts across SAP, Workday, SaaS applications, and custom-built platforms.
  • Define IAM governance models, including role-based access control (RBAC), attribute-based access control (ABAC), and just-in-time (JIT) access.
  • Support the adoption of zero-trust identity principles, including MFA, conditional access, and passwordless authentication.
  • Identity Lifecycle & Automation
  • Architect identity lifecycle management solutions, automating provisioning/deprovisioning across HR, IT, and security systems.
  • Implement Identity Governance & Administration (IGA) best practices, ensuring least privilege access and role alignment.
  • Develop custom integrations and automation scripts (PowerShell, Python, API-based solutions) to enhance IAM workflows.
  • Collaborate with HR (Workday) and ERP (SAP) teams to synchronize identity management with workforce operations.
  • Security & Compliance Ensure regulatory compliance (GDPR, SOC 2, ISO 27001) by aligning IAM controls with security frameworks.
  • Design and enforce privileged access management (PAM) solutions, securing admin accounts and critical systems.
  • Support security audits and identity risk assessments, addressing access anomalies and reducing attack surfaces.
  • Enhance identity threat detection and response capabilities in collaboration with SOC and SIEM teams.


Required Qualifications


  • Experience 6+ years of hands-on IAM experience, with at least 2 years in an architect or senior engineering role.
  • Expertise in Entra ID (Azure AD), Entra B2C, and IAM-related Microsoft security tools.
  • Experience integrating IAM with SAP, Workday, and other enterprise applications.
  • Deep knowledge of SAML, OAuth, OpenID Connect, SCIM, and federation protocols.
  • Hands-on experience with identity automation, PowerShell scripting, and API-based integrations.
  • Strong understanding of zero-trust architecture, privileged access management (PAM), and adaptive authentication.
  • Ability to collaborate with IT, HR, DevOps, and security teams to align identity solutions with business needs.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator, CISSP, GIAC-GIAM, or Okta Certified Architect.
  • Experience with Azure AD Conditional Access, Defender for Identity, and Entra Permissions Management.
  • Knowledge of Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) platforms like SailPoint or Saviynt.
  • Familiarity with DevOps and cloud security best practices in AWS/Azure environments.


What We Offer


  • Opportunity to shape the architecture of mission-critical cloud applications.
  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.


At Strada, our values guide everything we do:


  • Anticipate Customer Needs – We stay ahead of trends so our customers can grow and succeed.
  • Own the Outcome – We take responsibility for delivering excellence and ensuring things get done right.
  • Challenge Ourselves to Work Smarter – We move faster than the world around us to drive change and accomplish more.
  • Empower Each Other to Solve Problems – We tackle challenges head on, ask tough questions, and collaborate to find the best solutions.
  • Care About Our Work – We understand that what we do impacts millions, and we have a responsibility to get it right.


Benefits


At Strada, we support your whole self—offering a range of benefits for your health, wellbeing, finances, and future. These include health coverage, wellbeing programs, paid leave (vacation, sick, parental), retirement plans, learning opportunities, and more.

All offers are contingent on successful completion of background checks, where permitted by law and as appropriate for the role. These may include identity, education, employment, and in some cases, criminal history verification, checks against global watchlists, credit reports, and/or drug testing. You’ll be informed of the specific checks applicable to your role and location during the recruitment process.



Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion


Strada is dedicated to fostering a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and supported. We believe that embracing differences strengthens our teams and drives innovation and success.



Diversity Policy Statement


Strada is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination based on legally protected characteristics. We provide reasonable accommodations for disabilities and religious practices. Applicants may request reasonable accommodation by contacting their recruiter.



Authorization to work in the Employing Country


To be considered, you must have current and future work authorization in the country where you're applying, without the need for visa sponsorship by Strada.

title: Global Reward & Performance Specialist
description:
Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we reserve the right to close this advertisement at any time.

Cochlear’s mission is to help people hear and be heard. As the global leader in implantable hearing solutions, Cochlear is dedicated to helping people with moderate to profound hearing loss experience a world full of sound. We aim to transform the way people understand and treat hearing loss and innovate to connect people with future technologies. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives. Learn and grow with us as we tackle the most complex challenges in helping more people to experience a lifetime of hearing.

The Opportunity.

We’re looking for a Global Reward & Performance Specialist to join Cochlear’s global People & Culture team in Sydney.


This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of people, data and systems and wants to build deeper expertise across Reward and Performance. You’ll work with large and complex datasets, support global remuneration and performance cycles, support the maintenance of our job architecture and delivering market benchmarking activities, and help us continue to improve how we use data, technology and automation.


Importantly, you don’t need to have spent your entire career in Reward. We’re interested in people with strong analytical capability and relevant experience across areas such as HR analytics, workforce reporting, reward, performance or broader People & Culture operations, combined with a genuine interest in developing their reward and performance expertise.


What you’ll be doing

Working as part of our Global Reward & Performance team, you’ll support the delivery of programs and frameworks that impact employees and leaders across Cochlear globally.


You’ll:

  • Support our annual performance and remuneration review cycles, including data preparation, validation, reconciliation, reporting and system administration.
  • Work with Regional Reward Managers to prepare data for Workday Advanced Compensation, supporting testing, validation and administration.
  • Maintain and improve Cochlear’s Global Job Framework, including job profiles, descriptors and job architecture data.
  • Support job evaluation activities and help maintain strong global data governance.
  • Manage annual market data survey submissions and support remuneration benchmarking and range reviews.
  • Analyse reward, workforce and performance data to provide meaningful insights for People & Culture teams and leaders.
  • Contribute to global Reward & Performance projects, system enhancements and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Explore opportunities to use AI, automation and technology to improve efficiency, data quality and the employee and manager experience.

What will help you succeed

You’re likely someone who genuinely enjoys getting into the detail. You enjoy Excel, and you’re comfortable working with large datasets, spotting inconsistencies and turning information into something useful and actionable.


Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • Around 2–4 years’ relevant experience across HR, Reward, Performance, Analytics, Workforce Reporting or a related discipline.
  • Advanced Excel capability, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, complex formulas, reconciliation and large dataset management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, coupled with excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience producing reports, analysis and insights from HR or business data.
  • Confidence working with employee and remuneration data where accuracy and integrity matter.
  • Strong organisation and the ability to balance multiple priorities and deadlines.
  • The ability to communicate effectively and work with stakeholders across functions, regions and time zones.
  • Experience using HR technology, ideally Workday.
  • Some experience or understanding of remuneration, reward and benefits.

Experience with job architecture, job evaluation, remuneration reviews, performance cycles, market benchmarking or Workday Compensation/Performance would be valuable, but you don’t necessarily need to bring everything on day one.


Why this role?

This role offers something a little different: the opportunity to develop expertise across both Reward and Performance, rather than specialising narrowly in one area.


You’ll gain exposure to global remuneration and performance processes while building capability across analytics, market benchmarking, job architecture and workforce reporting. You’ll also have the opportunity to contribute to broader global initiatives and explore how emerging technology can make our Reward & Performance processes smarter and more effective.

If you feel that you have the skills and experience to be successful in this role and take on new challenges to build your career with Cochlear, please start your application by clicking the apply button below.

How we recognise your contribution

At Cochlear we value and welcome the unique contributions, perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds of our employees and aim to build a culture that celebrates and leverages these differences, creating a sense of belonging and enabling our people to realise their full potential. Through our internal programs and employee benefits, we aim to create an environment where our people will feel value and supported. Whether your focus is on continuous learning, professional development or simply finding an environment which enables you to thrive whilst balancing family or personal life commitments, then we have several programs in place to support you.

title: Vi söker personal vid behov till Sefina Pantbank i Göteborg!
description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens pantbank?

Sefina Pantbank söker nu dig som vill vara med på vår spännande resa mot att bli bäst i Europa på schyssta och enkla pantlån. Vi erbjuder våra kunder hållbar belåning utan risk för att hamna i ekonomisk knipa, och vi ser att behovet av våra tjänster ökar i dessa tider. På Sefina värderar och belånar vi guld, klockor och värdeföremål varje dag. Därav att våra butiksmedarbetare har titeln pantlånare.

Varför välja Sefina Pantbank?

Som en del av vårt team får du möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för våra kunder samtidigt som du utvecklas i en dynamisk och positiv arbetsmiljö. Våra värdeord – samarbete, flexibilitet och ansvar – genomsyrar allt vi gör.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som pantlånare på Sefina kommer du att vara en viktig del av vårt team. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar värdering och belåning av värdeföremål (allt från guld till smycken och konst), kundservice, försäljning och administration. Därutöver arbetar du med att förbereda auktioner, göra inventeringar och deltar i utvecklingsprojekt.

Som pantlånare är du Sefinas ansikte utåt och möter dagligen ett stort antal kunder, i butik och digitalt. Du ansvarar för att kundernas värdeföremål värderas och belånas rätt samt lagras med största omsorg och säkerhet.

På Sefina Pantbank sätter vi alltid kunden i fokus och är medvetna om att våra kunder kan vara i känsliga situationer. Din förmåga att hantera varje interaktion med diskretion och respekt är avgörande för en bra kundupplevelse. Som pantlånare får du vara med och skapa nöjda kunder varje dag.

Vi söker dig som är

  • Kundfokuserad: Du brinner för att hjälpa andra och skapa långvariga relationer.
  • Samarbetsorienterad: Du trivs i team och bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö.
  • Flexibel: Du är anpassningsbar, lösningsorienterad och kan arbeta varierande arbetstider.
  • Ansvarstagande: Du är noggrann, strukturerad och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.

För att arbeta hos oss behöver du vara över 18 år och ha en avslutad gymnasieexamen. Då kundservice alltid står i fokus är det viktigt att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta i butik, reception, bank eller liknande roller, och brinner för att ge service utöver det vanliga. Det är en stor fördel om du har kassavana och har arbetat med de vanligaste värdeföremålen som förekommer i våra butiker. Det viktigaste är dock att du har stort intresse för t.ex. guld, smycken och klockor och vill lära dig mer.

För att snabbt komma in i arbetet är god datorvana, erfarenhet av Office-paketet och förmåga att lära sig nya saker viktigt. Du har god förståelse för ekonomi och siffror samt behärskar svenska och engelska obehindrat. Det är meriterande om du talar ytterligare språk.

Viktig information om rollen

Det här är en avtalad visstidsanställning med start så snart som möjligt och löpande vid behov, och butikerna är belagda i centrala Göteborg. Arbetstiden är förlagd utifrån butikernas öppettider och du behöver vara tillgänglig att arbeta såväl dagtid, kvällar och helger. I den här rollen ges du en timlön som delvis baseras på din erfarenhet och kompetens.

Vår rekryteringsprocess består av intervjuer, referenstagning och en eventuell bakgrundskontroll. Vi tycker det är viktigt att du får chans att visa vem du är under processen samtidigt som du lär känna oss på Sefina.

Vi erbjuder

Vi erbjuder dig en unik möjlighet att utvecklas i en dynamisk och positiv arbetsmiljö. Hos oss får du vara med och forma framtidens pantbank. Som en del av vårt team får du arbeta med unika föremål, utveckla dina kunskaper och bidra till en hållbar framtid. Vi erbjuder utbildning och karriärmöjligheter, bra förmåner och härliga kollegor.

Är du redo att bli en del av vårt team? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Senior Specialist, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance
description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Senior Specialist, Quality Assurance and Regulatory Compliance (QARC) is responsible for leading and coordinating global field action management across Leica Biosystems, including recalls, corrections, removals, Field Safety Corrective Actions (FSCAs), customer notifications and related post-market activities. As the global field action process owner and subject matter expert, you will drive consistent, compliant and effective execution across regions while supporting inspection readiness and continuous improvement.

This position reports to the Director II, Global Quality Management Programs and is part of the Global Quality Organization, located in Newcastle, UK, and will be an on-site role.


In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Lead and coordinate global field actions from initial assessment through implementation, effectiveness verification and closure, ensuring compliance with applicable regulatory requirements and internal procedures.
  • Serve as the global field action process owner and subject matter expert, maintaining global procedures and supporting alignment with EU IVDR, UK, FDA, Health Canada and ISO 13485 requirements.
  • Partner with Quality, Regulatory, Operations and Commercial teams to assess and escalate potential field actions, including investigations, risk assessments, vigilance and reportability assessments.
  • Coordinate field action strategy and execution, including regulatory notifications, customer communications, effectiveness checks, affected-product reconciliation and closure, escalating compliance risks or delays where required.
  • Lead global field action governance, inspection readiness and continuous improvement through KPI monitoring, trend and ageing reviews, audit and inspection support, training and cross-regional best-practice sharing.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, medical or technical field.
  • Demonstrated experience directly managing field actions, including recalls, Field Safety Corrective Actions (FSCAs), corrections or removals within the medical device or IVD industry.
  • Experience in quality assurance, regulatory compliance, technical quality or post-market activities within the medical device or IVD industry.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of applicable medical device and IVD post-market requirements, including EU IVDR, UK, FDA and Health Canada requirements and ISO 13485.
  • Experience interacting with competent authorities, notified bodies, regulatory agencies or inspectors and leading cross-functional activities across multiple regions.

Travel and Working Environment Requirements:

  • Travel expectations for this role are low (<10%). Overnight travel may be required.
  • The global nature of the role requires flexibility in working hours to collaborate across time zones, including participation in meetings outside standard local working hours as needed.

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • Proven experience discovering and meeting the needs of customers (either internal or external)
  • Managing field actions across multiple regions and regulatory jurisdictions.

#LI-Onsite

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

title: Konseptisuunnittelija, Kulttuurisisällöt-toimitus, Yle Kulttuuri
description:
Haistatko tulevat trendit? Haluatko olla kehittämässä kulttuurin uusia menestystuotteita, joista suomalaiset puhuvat? Uudistamme Ylen kulttuuritarjontaa nuorille aikuisille. Etsimme konseptisuunnittelijaa, joka osaa rakentaa sisältökokonaisuuksia, jotka puhuttelevat tavoiteltua yleisöä oikeassa kanavassa ja oikealla äänellä.



Mitä on luvassa?


Haemme Kulttuurisisällöt-toimitukseen konseptisuunnittelijaa tekemään kanssamme muutosta. Vastuullasi on, että Ylen omatuotantoiset digitaaliset kulttuurisisällöt (osallistavat kulttuuriteot, lyhytvideot, videopodcastit ja muut uudet kerrontamuodot) osuvat haluttuun yleisöön. Määrittelet konseptin kulmakivet: kenelle tehdään, miksi, millä äänensävyllä ja mitä kokemusta tavoitellaan.


Suunnittelet, ideoit ja kehität Yle Kulttuurin sisältökonsepteja yhdessä tuottajan ja tuotantotiimien kanssa. Teemme sisältöjä Ylen omille alustoille ja someen. Selvität kohderyhmän tarpeita, motiiveja ja arjen kiinnekohtia tutkimusten, käyttäjätestien ja somen käytön avulla. Yrität löytää vastauksen kysymykseen, minkä muutoksen sisältö voi tehdä maailmassa ja ihmisen elämässä.


Tunnet eri julkaisualustat ja osaat rakentaa niille sopivia kokonaisuuksia ja testaat ideoita rohkeasti kohderyhmällä. Seuraat dataa, kilpailukenttää ja yleisöpalautetta ja mietit askeleita jatkokehitykselle. Toimit koko prosessin ajan konseptin tukena työryhmälle.


Et vain kehitä vaan saat olla myös kädet savessa. Sinulla on mahdollisuus osallistua itse tuotantoon, somen tekemiseen, kuvauksiin ja editointiin.


Esihenkilösi on Kulttuurisisällöt-toimituksen tuottaja-esihenkilö. Työskentelet läheisessä yhteistyössä toimituksen tuottajien ja toimittajien kanssa. Lähitiimissäsi on myös AD ja sometoimittaja.


Tehtävä on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen. Työtehtävät sijoittuvat ensisijaisesti Pasilaan. Etätyö on mahdollista, mutta toiveena on, että työskentelisit vähintään puolet viikosta läsnätyössä.



Mitä odotamme sinulta?


Sinulla on jo kokemusta konseptisuunnittelusta, sisällöntuotannosta tai sisällönsuunnittelusta media-alalta. Tunnet nuorten aikuisten kohderyhmän ja some-alustat, joilla he sisältöjä kuluttavat. Sinulla on aito kiinnostus ihmisten tarpeiden tutkimiseen ja tiedät, mistä tätä tietoa voi etsiä. Osaat tiivistää moniulotteisen tarpeen tai idean selkeäksi ja toimivaksi konseptiksi.


Ajattelet yleisö edellä: sinulle tärkeintä on, että konsepti ja kerrontamuoto toimivat kohderyhmän näkökulmasta. Ymmärrät dramaturgian merkityksen ja sinua kiinnostavat eri kerrontamuodot sekä niiden mahdollisuudet eri alustoilla. Sinulla on rohkeutta testata keskeneräisiä ideoita ja taitoa reagoida palautteeseen joustavasti. Olet ratkaisukeskeinen ja hyvä tiimipelaaja, koska konsepti syntyy yhdessä muiden kanssa. Intoilet kulttuurista laaja-alaisesti.


Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen datan hyödyntämisestä sisällön kehittämisessä, näytöt onnistuneista konsepteista, joissa yleisö on ollut suunnittelun keskiössä, sekä kyvyn visualisoida ja esitellä konsepteja selkeästi eri sidosryhmille. Arvostamme myös kokemusta journalistisesta työstä.



Miksi meille?


Kulttuurisisällöt-toimituksen konseptisuunnittelijana teet merkityksellistä työtä Ylen kulttuuritehtävän ytimessä. Pääset kehittämään Ylen kulttuurikokonaisuutta osana tavoitteellista tiimiä, tukenasi sisältökehityksen ammattilaiset ja ajantasainen asiakkuusdata. Tavoitteena on löytää uutta yleisöä, ja painopiste on nuoremmissa kohderyhmissä. Kulttuuri on meille viihdyttävää ja vetävää, elämyksellistä ja tunteita herättävää.


Olet mukana tekemässä suomalaisten rakastamia sisältöjä. Tänä vuonna olemme tuottaneet mm. Muumit-lukumaratonin, ja somessa Yle Kulttuuri -tileiltä löydät viihdyttäviä ja uutta ajateltavaa tarjoilevia lyhytsarjoja. Pääset rakentamaan näiden konsepteja alusta loppuun.


Kulttuuri-osaston ilmapiiri on kannustava ja tarjoaa kehittymismahdollisuuksia. Meillä on mukavia työsuhde-etuja, kuten työterveyshuolto, oma kuntosali ja myös kulttuuri- ja liikuntaetu.



Kiinnostuitko?


Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, täytä oheinen hakemus ja liitä mukaan CV:si sekä hakemuskirjeesi viimeistään 16.11.2026. Käsittelemme hakemuksia heti niiden saapuessa ja saatamme pyytää hakijoita haastatteluun jo ennen hakuajan päättymistä.


Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:

Sari Siekkinen, tuottaja-esihenkilö, Kulttuurisisällöt, 040 7494585, soittoaika 6.11.2026 klo 11 - 12 ja 10.11.2026 klo 9 - 10.

title: Connected Lab Specialist
description:

Research & Technology Group


Job Description:

Connected Lab Specialist

At bp, we provide an excellent working environment and employee benefits such as an open and inclusive culture, a great work-life balance, tremendous learning and development opportunities to craft your career path, life and health insurance, medical care package and many others.

Job Purpose

The Connected Lab Specialist supports the deployment, configuration, integration and continuous improvement of Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS) and laboratory data management solutions across bp’s R&D laboratories, but with particular focus on setting up the new Bengaluru Technology Centre for Day 1 operations. Working as part of the Lab Automation, LIMS & Data Management team.

The role works closely with laboratory users, digital teams, data specialists, suppliers and project teams to ensure laboratory data is captured, structured, governed and accessible throughout its lifecycle. The analyst supports the implementation of LIMS, master data, workflows, integrations and data standards that improve laboratory efficiency, compliance, data quality and digital enablement.

Key Accountabilities

  • Facilitate requirements gathering activities through workshops, interviews, process mapping, and stakeholder engagement.
  • Engage with scientists, laboratory personnel, and domain experts (SMEs) to understand current laboratory workflows, sample management processes, data requirements, and operational challenges, to translate this into processes and workflows for the new site.
  • Identify and develop use cases for AI Innovation. Support development of reporting and analytics capabilities that improve decision making.
  • Support the definition of project scope, objectives, requirements, and success criteria for LIMS deployment. Document business, process, functional, integration, and reporting requirements using agreed standards and methodologies.
  • Develop and maintain current-state and future-state process maps covering laboratory operations and supporting digital workflows.
  • Analyse information gathered to find opportunities for standardisation, digitisation, process simplification, and operational efficiency.
  • Work closely with the Lab Automation Specialist and the Automation workstream to ensure LIMS, robotics, orchestration platforms, equipment integrations, and laboratory processes are designed and deployed as a connected end-to-end solution.
  • Collaborate with wider team including Data Management specialists, Digital Security, Digital Delivery, system integrators, and vendors to define integrated laboratory workflows and data flows.
  • Support solution configuration, testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), deployment, and operational handover activities. Support user adoption activities to drive successful implementation and sustainable business outcomes.
  • Maintain traceability of requirements, actions, risks, assumptions, and decisions throughout project delivery.
  • Support with the definition of the Data strategy for Downstream R&D and the new Technology Centre. Support implementation of data principles and data management best practices.
  • Work with wider team to understand current data challenges with particular focus on Digital Science and Modelling activities.
  • Support data governance and taxonomy activities to improve data quality, integrity, traceability and compliance.
  • Support integration between LIMS, laboratory instruments, automation platforms, ELN, ERP and other enterprise systems.
  • Assist with testing and validation of data interfaces and workflows, to ensure laboratory data is transferred accurately and reliably between systems.

Essential Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree as a minimum in science, engineering or a related discipline plus 7 years relevant experience.
  • Experience in laboratory operations, business analysis, digital transformation, informatics, or another technical environment.
  • Experience gathering, documenting, and managing business and user requirements.
  • Strong analytical, process mapping, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience working with stakeholders and facilitating discussions across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Project management experience
  • Experience working with scientific, laboratory or enterprise data.
  • Understanding of data quality, data governance and master data concepts.
  • Knowledge of laboratory data lifecycles and regulatory data requirements.

Desirable Education & Experience

  • Experience with Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS), ELN, SDMS, or other laboratory informatics platforms.
  • Understanding of laboratory workflows, sample lifecycle management, testing processes, and scientific data management.
  • Knowledge of laboratory automation, robotics, equipment integration, or orchestration platforms.
  • Experience supporting software implementation, testing, validation, or deployment activities.
  • Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid project delivery approaches.
  • Experience working with technology suppliers, vendors, or system integrators.
  • Experience with laboratory data management platforms, ELN or scientific informatics systems.
  • Knowledge of data governance frameworks and metadata management.
  • Experience with Power BI, SQL, Python or other data analysis tools.
  • Experience supporting AI, analytics or digital transformation initiatives through structured data management.


Leadership Expectations


  • Lives the bp values of Safety, Respect, Excellence, Courage, and One Team.
  • Establishes effective relationships and collaborates across disciplines, functions, and geographies.
  • Demonstrates curiosity, learning agility, and a continuous improvement attitude.
  • Delivers high-quality outcomes with solid attention to detail and customer focus.
  • Supports safe, reliable, and value-driven delivery of digital laboratory solutions.

title: Senior Pricing Analyst
description:
As a Senior Pricing Analyst, you'll combine quantitative analysis with the economics of pricing, translating supply, demand, and market signals into pricing decisions that balance unit margins and inventory turns. This will be a hybrid position, based out of our Chicago or Lincolnshire, IL office 3 days per week.


Job Responsibilities

  • Assist in building and refining the company’s overall pricing methodology.
  • Maintain dynamic pricing models that account for manufacturer MSRPs, freight costs, regional demand, seasonality, and unit aging to maximize both volume and gross margin.
  • Evaluate the impact of pricing actions and give management data-backed recommendations.
  • Proactively identify opportunities for markdown timing on aged inventory, and analyze price elasticity of products.
  • Monitor and review for daily pricing errors.

Education & Experience

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Statistics, Business Administration, or a related quantitative field.
  • 2+ years of experience in pricing strategy, revenue management, or financial modeling.

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with machine learning as applied to pricing, and with how MCPs can be leveraged.

Skills & Abilities

  • Proficiency in Excel (complex financial modeling, Power Query).
  • Familiarity with SQL for querying large relational databases to extract pricing and sales history.
  • Familiarity with pricing algorithms and price elasticity modeling.
  • Ability to distill data into simple, impactful stories for management.
  • Understanding of the balance between driving volume (market share) and holding gross margin.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Occasional travel required

title: Test, Calibration & Maintenance Engineering Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship 2027
description:
Test, Calibration & Maintenance Engineering Level 6 Degree Apprenticeship 2027


Salary: £23,000 plus a £3000 joining bonus.


Duration: 4.5 years


Work Location: Stevenage


Learning Provider Location: Anglia Ruskin University - Peterborough Campus


Due to the need to attend your MBDA site and the training provider as required for your apprenticeship, applicants need to ensure their home or rental location is appropriate, travel arrangements are manageable and travel time is minimised as required for your role.


The qualification: You'll study Electro-Mechanical Engineering at Anglia Ruskin University. Your final award will be a BEng honours degree in Electro-Mechanical Engineering, awarded by Anglia Ruskin University.


Find more details about the course here:


Security clearance: British Citizen or a Dual UK national with British citizenship.


Restrictions and/or limitations relating to nationality and/or rights to work may apply. As a minimum and after offer stage, all successful candidates will need to undergo HMG Basic Personnel Security Standard checks (BPSS), which are managed by the MBDA Personnel Security Team.


This role is scheduled to close for applications at midnight on Friday 22nd January 2027 but may close earlier depending on application volumes.


What we can offer you:


  • Fully funded qualification starting September 2027
  • Paid travel expenses to and from your place of study
  • Annual pay reviews
  • Healthcare Cash Plan: provides support with everyday health related costs – including medical, dental, optical, physio and health & wellbeing.
  • 25 days annual leave (plus holiday purchase) and up to 15 days flexi leave
  • Study leave during exam periods

Programme structure - your work at MBDA:


You will attend college one day per week during term time. In the college holidays you'll be onsite full time in your home function of Test Engineering and Calibration & Maintenance (TCM) at MBDA Stevenage.


A truly varied role covering different stages of the Manufacturing process!

Engineers in Manufacturing Test support the manufacturing, testing and programming of the whole build cycle, from circuit cards through to missiles and the platforms they're integrated onto. Calibration and Maintenance engineers provide a commissioning, calibration, maintenance and metrology service, and respond to faults and breakdowns across test and process equipment. In both these areas you’ll experience working with varied technologies such as electronics, mechatronics, optics and RF and utilise a mix of electronic, electrical and mechanical skills – a great way to start your engineering career!


All of our apprenticeships in MBDA involve placements to help you understand more about our business. This apprenticeship will involve placements that rotate around Test and Calibration & Maintenance and by the end of your apprenticeship you’ll be fully equipped to understand which of these areas you want to move your career into. Your final year will typically be spent developing in a single placement. This will allow you to gain a deeper understanding of the specific area including the ongoing projects and complex challenges within it.

In each placement you'll find yourself among a team of encouraging engineers who have varied experiences and expertise, working together to support a set of equipment. You’ll also be able to complete placements in areas of MBDA that are external to Engineering which will allow you to get insight in to new technologies, build your network across the business and bring back your learning to the manufacturing facility. Our Engineers work closely with several collaborative functions such as Product Design, Test Equipment Design, Manufacturing Engineering and Quality Assurance.

Placements in this programme could be in:

  • Circuit Card Assembly & Equipments
  • Missiles
  • Platforms & Industrial Validation
  • C&M Electrical Engineering
  • C&M Mechanical & Maintenance Engineering
  • C&M Environmental Engineering

Daily activities for an Engineer range from hands on experience with the equipment on the shop floor and in the lab, to working in the office on technical documentation. You could go from diagnosing issues and fault finding on a non-conforming piece of equipment one day, to introducing new innovative products and equipment into Manufacturing on another so you’ll truly develop that engineering mindset of problem solving, analytical and logical thinking and curiosity to get to the bottom of what is happening.


What we’re looking for from you:


This role has specific qualification and subject criteria so please make sure you carefully check your eligibility against this criteria before applying otherwise your application will not be considered. If you are currently studying and predicted to meet these requirements by the start date you are welcome to apply.


GCSEs:


A minimum of 5 GCSEs at minimum grade 4.


This must include:


  • English Language
  • Mathematics
  • Any Science or Technology subject

After GCSEs:


Following your GCSE's you must have completed one of the following qualification routes, equivalent to a minimum of 120 UCAS Tariff points:


  • A Levels: Three A levels totalling 120 UCAS Tariff points, including Maths and either a Science, Technology or Engineering subject, with no individual grade below C
  • BTECs: A single Level 3 Extended Diploma in an Engineering, Science or Technology based subject at a minimum grade of DDM, including a distinction in a Further Maths module.
  • T Levels: T Level in Engineering with a minimum Merit grade.

Please note: We look at entry criteria based on your top three full A Levels or equivalent qualifications (BTEC/T Level). We do not include UCAS points gained from an Extended Project Qualification. Additionally, as an employer we set our own entry criteria based on the requirements of this role. This means that the criteria above may differ from the university/college.

We are proud of our employee-led networks, examples include: Gender Equality, Pride, Menopause Matters, Parents and Carers, Armed Forces, Ethnic Diversity, Neurodiversity, Disability and more…

title: Deputy Manager - CPE
description:
KEY ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead end-to-end support for ECU products by investigating production, plant, customer, and warranty issues, performing failure analysis, identifying root causes, and driving effective containment, corrective, and preventive actions.
  • Serve as the primary technical interface between customers, manufacturing plants, suppliers, quality teams, and product development organizations for product quality concerns, field failures, warranty investigations, and escalation management.
  • Perform ECU-level and component-level troubleshooting, including analysis of electronic circuits, PCB assemblies, schematics, manufacturing data, and validation results to support timely issue resolution and continuous product improvement.
  • Provide day-to-day production support by resolving material, process, hardware, software, and manufacturing-related issues, while improving product quality, reliability, yield, and manufacturability.
  • Lead structured problem-solving activities using methodologies such as 8D, FMEA, 5-Why, Fishbone Analysis, and CAPA to prevent recurrence and improve customer satisfaction.
  • Prepare and communicate technical analysis reports, failure analysis reports, 8D reports, warranty investigation reports, and customer updates to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Evaluate and implement engineering changes, including ECRs, eSCRs, and customer change requests, while assessing impacts on product design, manufacturing, quality, cost, supply chain, and customer requirements.

title: Domänarkitekt med huvudinriktning IT-arbetsplats och infrastruktur
description:
Vill du vara med och forma framtidens IT-lösningar för Sveriges Riksbank i rollen som IT- domänarkitekt? Riksbanken är navet i Sveriges finansiella infrastruktur. Vår IT-miljö är omfattande och består av flera samhällskritiska system som ställer mycket höga krav på säkerhet. Vi är både en myndighet och ”bankernas bank” vilket ställer höga krav på stabilitet, långsiktighet och att vi ligger i framkant inom IT- och cybersäkerhetsfrågor.

VI ERBJUDER DIG

Hos oss får du ett stort handlingsutrymme, inflytande i strategiskt viktiga beslut och chansen att bidra direkt till ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag. Du är med och bygger robusta IT-lösningar, framtidens betalningssystem, löser komplexa problem och utvecklas i en prestigelös miljö som präglas av samarbete, nyfikenhet, lärande och mod.

DET HÄR GÖR DU HOS OSS

Hos Riksbanken är IT- och cybersäkerhet en prioriterad fråga. IT är verksamhetens strategiska partner och vi har höga ambitioner att ligga i framkant med kompetens, IT-stöd och cybersäkerhet. I rollen som Domänarkitekt får du en avgörande och ledande roll i att driva den tekniska transformationen genom ändamålsenlig målarkitektur och etablerande av nästa generationslösningar med mål att förbättra Riksbankens förmågor. Du kommer agera domänarkitekt för ett eller flera verksamhetsområden där du är med och driver förändringsarbete för att skapa Riksbankens framtida lösningar.

På Riksbanken arbetar du i en modern hybridmiljö som kombinerar on-premise och molntjänster. Bl.a. använder vi infrastruktur som kod, Kubernetes, och CI/CD för att drifta och vidareutveckla våra plattformar för data, integration, DevSecOps och AI. Vi är öppna för nya tekniska lösningar och strävar efter att snabbt kunna utveckla och lansera nya förmågor.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:

- Leda arbetet med att kontinuerligt vidareutveckla och implementera målarkitektur för område IT-arbetsplats och infrastruktur

- Arbeta nära verksamheten, användarna, utvecklingsteam, förvaltningsorganisation, IT-infrastruktur och driftleverantör för att vidareutveckla området med hög grad av självhjälp och automation

- Analysera organisationens behov och leda krav- och lösningsworkshoppar

- Kravställa, ta fram, utvärdera och dokumentera nya/förändrade lösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov

- Säkerställa att IT strategi, styrande principer och riktlinjer för IT-arkitektur efterlevs och kontinuerligt utvecklas

- Jobba på strategisk-, taktisk- och operativ nivå

- Omvärldsbevaka inom området vilket även kan innebära samverkan med andra myndigheter och deltagande i vissa internationella forum

I din roll bidrar du också till att ta fram strategier inom IT-arbetsplatsområdet. Du har förståelse för verksamhetens behov och bidrar med din erfarenhet och kunskap samt agerar expert och rådgivare inom området IT-arbetsplats och infrastruktur. Vid behov agerar du även som projekt-/aktivitetsledare.

MER OM DIG

Du har förmåga till helhetssyn och genuint intresse för hur IT kan användas för att stödja verksamhetsbehov samt är van att arbeta med lösningsalternativ. Du har erfarenhet av att omsätta kunskap till praktisk tillämpning med fokus på framdrift, realisering, återanvändbarhet och kostnadseffektivitet.

Krav

- Flera års praktisk erfarenhet av att designa och implementera lösningar inom området IT-arbetsplats och infrastruktur som exempelvis Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune och Windows-klientplattformar samt relaterade infrastrukturtjänster med både on-premise och moln som distributionsmodell

- Dokumenterad förmåga att omsätta verksamhets- och säkerhetskrav till hållbara, användarvänliga och säkra arbetsplatslösningar

- Erfarenhet av arkitektur- och designarbete inom ex. identitet, klienthantering, applikationsdistribution och modern digital arbetsplats

- Erfarenhet av arkitekturarbete i agil kontext såväl som i traditionella förändringsprojekt

- Bra svenska och engelska både i tal och skrift

- Universitets- eller högskoleutbildning inom datateknik, datavetenskap eller systemvetenskap alternativt annan relevant utbildning eller arbetserfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig

Meriterande

- Kompetens inom IT-infrastruktur, nätverk och operativsystem (Unix och Windows) samt server- och plattformsmiljöer

- Erfarenhet av AI-plattformar

- Erfarenhet av kravställning mot leverantörer

- Certifiering som lösningsarkitekt, domänarkitekt, verksamhetsarkitekt, IT-arkitekt eller motsvarande

- Erfarenhet av systemutveckling och programmering

- Arbete inom finansiell sektor, offentlig sektor, förvaltning och drift

Du är initiativtagande samt mål- och resultatinriktad. Du är positiv, drivande och strukturerad och bra på att lösa komplexa problem. Du är van att leda workshops, dokumentera och presentera. Du har en god samarbetsförmåga och trivs att arbeta tillsammans med andra mot ett gemensamt mål. Du har också en mycket god kommunikationsförmåga. Du kan diskutera tekniska frågeställningar och lösningar både med tekniska specialister och med personer utan teknisk kunskap.

MER OM TJÄNSTEN

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Anställningstyp: Tillsvidareanställning med provanställning

Placering: Kontor i centrala Stockholm

Arbetstid: Förtroendearbetstid

Möjlighet att jobba distans: 1 eller 2 dagar i veckan

Förmåner: Generösa semestervillkor, löneväxling till pension, subventionerad lunch, friskvårdsbidrag och tillgång till gym

Tjänsten kan komma att placeras i säkerhetsklass och en säkerhetsprövning innefattande registerkontroll, säkerhetsprövningssamtal och särskild personutredning görs då för slutkandidaten. För vissa tjänster ställs krav på svenskt medborgarskap.

ATT JOBBA PÅ RIKSBANKEN

Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på Riksbanken https://www.riksbank.se/sv/om-riksbanken/jobba-hos-oss/vi-erbjuder/.

ANSÖK

I denna rekrytering samarbetar Riksbanken med rekryteringsföretaget CS Recruitment. Deras rekryterare gör ett första urval i samråd med rekryterande chef samt utför intervjuer. De kandidater som går vidare träffar sedan rekryterande chef.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Site Reliability Engineer

The PTS-E SRE team is looking for a Site Reliability Engineer who can help us solve problems, build our CI/CD pipeline and lead Mastercard in DevOps automation and best practices.
- Are you a born problem solver who loves to figure out how something works?
- Are you a CI/CD geek who loves all things automation?
- Do you have a low tolerance for manual work and look to automate everything you can?
Business Operations is leading the DevOps transformation at Mastercard through our tooling and by being an advocate for change & standards throughout the development, quality, release, and product organizations. We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize needs and to build relationships is a must.
Mission
The role of business operations is to be the production readiness steward for the platform. This is accomplished by closely partnering with developers to design, build, implement, and support technology services. A business operations engineer will ensure operational criteria like system availability, capacity, performance, monitoring, self-healing, and deployment automation are implemented throughout the delivery process. Business Operations plays a key role in leading the DevOps transformation at Mastercard through our tooling and by being an advocate for change and standards throughout the development, quality, release, and product organizations.
We accomplish this transformation through supporting daily operations with a hyper focus on triage and then root cause by understanding the business impact of our products. The goal of every biz ops team is to shift left to be more proactive and upfront in the development process, and to proactively manage production and change activities to maximize customer experience, and increase the overall value of supported applications. Biz Ops teams also focus on risk management by tying all our activities together with an overarching responsibility for compliance and risk mitigation across all our environments. A biz ops focus is also on streamlining and standardizing traditional application specific support activities and centralizing points of interaction for both internal and external partners by communicating effectively with all key stakeholders.
Ultimately, the role of biz ops is to align Product and Customer Focused priorities with Operational needs. We regularly review our run state not only from an internal perspective, but also understanding and providing the feedback loop to our development partners on how we can improve the customer experience of our applications.
Responsibilities
For all team members:
•Engage in and improve the whole lifecycle of services—from inception and design, through deployment, operation and refinement.
•Analyze ITSM activities of the platform and provide feedback loop to development teams on operational gaps or resiliency concerns
•Support services before they go live through activities such as system design consulting, capacity planning and launch reviews.
•Maintain services once they are live by measuring and monitoring availability, latency and overall system health.
•Scale systems sustainably through mechanisms like automation, and evolve systems by pushing for changes that improve reliability and velocity.
•Support the application CI/CD pipeline for promoting software into higher environments through validation and operational gating, and lead Mastercard in DevOps automation and best practices.
•Practice sustainable incident response and blameless postmortems.
•Take a holistic approach to problem solving, by connecting the dots during a production event thru the various technology stack that makes up the platform, to optimize mean time to recover
•Work with a global team spread across tech hubs in multiple geographies and time zones
•Share knowledge and mentor junior resources For team members supporting the Dev Ops pipeline:
•Design, implement, and enhance our deployment automation based on Chef. We need proven experience writing chef recipes/cookbooks as well as designing and implementing an overall Chef based release and deployment process.
•Use Jenkins to orchestrate builds as well as link to Sonar, Chef, Maven, Artifactory, etc. to build out the CI/CD pipeline.
•Support deployments of code into multiple lower environments. Supporting current processes needed with an emphasis on automating everything as soon as possible.
•Design and implement a Git based code management strategy that will support multiple environment deployments in parallel. Experience with automation for branch management, code promotions, and version management is a plus.
Qualifications
•BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field involving coding (e.g., physics or mathematics), or equivalent practical experience.
•Experience with algorithms, data structures, scripting, pipeline management, and software design.
•Systematic problem-solving approach, coupled with strong communication skills and a sense of ownership and drive.
•Ability to help debug and optimize code and automate routine tasks.
•We support many different stakeholders. Experience in dealing with difficult situations and making decisions with a sense of urgency is needed.
•Experience in one or more of the following is preferred: C, C++, Java, Python, Go, Perl or Ruby.
•Interest in designing, analyzing and troubleshooting large-scale distributed systems.
•We need team members with an appetite for change and pushing the boundaries of what can be done with automation. Experience in working across development, operations, and product teams to prioritize needs and to build relationships is a must.
•For work on our dev ops team, engineer with experience in industry standard CI/CDtools like Git/BitBucket, Jenkins, Maven, Artifactory, and Chef. Experience designing and implementing an effective and efficient CI/CD flow that gets code from dev to prod with high quality and minimal manual effort is required
Job Profile Summary
Provide technical support for MasterCard’s operations environment. Analyze information to determine MasterCard system performance and areas of improvement.
• Assurance of high availability for administered systems on the defined level
• Full knowledge and understanding of administered systems
• Knowledge of all products and services of administered applications
• Creation and maintenance of production procedures
• Administering of production environments – monitoring, process and procedures optimization,
• Optimization of production systems – designing and automation of production processes,
• Designing and assurance for running all cycling administration tasks in production systems
• Proactive actions assuring highest possible availability of production systems
• Solving all problems identified in production systems
• Solving all problems raised by clients
• Cooperation with internal and external support
• Ongoing control of suppliers
• Support for projects driven by organization
• Cooperation with infrastructure team in order to fully optimize and plan all upgrades and patches for production systems
• Ongoing self-development
• Sharing knowledge and experience across the team
• Capacity control for production systems
• Periodic measurements and reporting of availability for production system

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Advisor, Software Development Engineering
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Advisor, Software Development Engineering

About your role:

As Advisor - Software Engineering, you will lead the design and delivery of scalable, highly available software solutions while remaining hands-on across architecture, coding, and production support. You will work with engineering teams and technical leaders to solve complex problems, improve delivery quality, and accelerate business outcomes. Your work will help strengthen engineering standards, improve customer-focused execution, and enable reliable high-scale platforms across diverse technology stacks.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, and launch high-scale, highly available software services that support critical business and customer needs.
  • Work across multiple technology stacks such as Java, .NET, or similar platforms, applying strong engineering fundamentals and technology-agnostic problem solving.
  • Lead hands-on architecture, design, and implementation efforts for complex systems, ensuring scalability, resilience, performance, and maintainability.
  • Apply deep knowledge of data structures, algorithms, and distributed system design to solve complex technical and production challenges.
  • Drive a high bar for engineering quality through design reviews, code reviews, technical guidance, and practical improvement of development standards.
  • Leverage appropriate AI-assisted engineering tools to improve developer productivity, delivery speed, and measurable execution outcomes.
  • Work backward from customer needs to define technical solutions that improve user experience, reliability, and business value with strong end-to-end ownership.
  • Provide principal engineer or architect-level technical guidance while remaining a hands-on builder who supports team delivery at scale.
  • Partner with engineering teams to improve cloud-native development patterns, architecture decisions, and operational readiness across services.
  • Lead deep-dive troubleshooting and resolution of complex production issues, helping teams restore service and improve long-term system reliability.
  • Inspire engineering teams through practical execution, strong technical judgment, and a bias for action in solving meaningful customer and platform challenges.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 7+ years of experience in software engineering, systems engineering, or related technical disciplines building and supporting enterprise-scale applications or services.
  • 7+ years of experience designing, developing, and launching high-scale, highly available services in production environments.
  • Experience working across multiple technology stacks such as Java, .NET, or similar platforms with strong command of software engineering fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms.
  • Experience with system architecture, distributed systems design, cloud-native development, and resilient service design in modern cloud environments.
  • Experience conducting architecture reviews, design reviews, and code reviews that improve engineering quality, scalability, and maintainability.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex production issues and leading technical deep dives that improve service reliability and customer outcomes.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, development quality, or delivery speed.
  • Experience guiding engineering teams as a principal engineer, architect, or technical lead without direct people management responsibility.
  • Experience in financial services, payments, or other high-availability regulated environments.
  • Experience mentoring engineers on design quality, operational excellence, and customer-focused delivery.

How you'll work:

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Our commitment to Diversity and Inclusion:

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.

Note to agencies:

Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

description:
För en av våra uppdragsgivare i centrala Hörby söker vi nu personliga assistenter som kan arbeta vid behov.

Vår uppdragsgivare är en positiv kvinna som på grund efter en hjärnskada, behöver assistans dygnet runt med sovande jour. Kvinnan behöver hjälp med det mesta i sin vardag, såsom att ta av och ta på sig kläder personlig hygien, hjälp med att kommunicera, laga mat, ta hand om hemmet, delta i aktiviteter, promenader, förflyttningar etc. Kvinnan använder rullstol och behöver hjälp med alla förflyttningar. Samtliga förflyttningar sker med lift. Uppdragsgivaren har en liten hund och du kan därför inte vara allergisk.

Du som söker tjänsten ska vara ansvarsfull, positiv, ha ett genuint intresse av att hjälpa andra människor samt behärska det engelska språket. Som personlig assistent måste du vara flexibel, eftersom arbetet betyder att du hjälper en annan människa att leva sitt liv på sitt eget sätt.

Din arbetsplats är där uppdragsgivaren befinner sig, vilket betyder att vid eventuella besök till släkt och vänner, promenader, handling och andra aktiviteter blir vistelsestället din arbetsplats för stunden.

Schematiderna är förlaga till dygnspass med sovande jour. Du börjar kl. 09.00 och slutar kl. 09.00 nästkommande dag. Du som behovsvikarie kommer in och arbetar vid ordinarie personals frånvaro.

Rekrytering sker löpande.

Företagsinformation

Sydassistans AB har sedan starten 1994 anordnat personlig assistans åt personer med funktionsnedsättning i södra Sverige. En av våra uppgifter som assistansanordnare är att vara arbetsgivare åt våra uppdragsgivares personliga assistenter. Med ledorden Trygghet, Respekt och Livskvalitet arbetar vi för att våra uppdragsgivare, trots en funktionsnedsättning, ska kunna leva ett så normalt liv som möjligt. I dagsläget sysselsätter vi ungefär 350 personliga assistenter.

Sydassistans söker en personlig assistent som tycker om att arbeta med människor och kan sätta sig in vad det innebär att leva med en eller flera funktionsnedsättningar, därför få du gärna ha arbetat som personlig assistent innan.

title: Consultant, Hospitality Service Quality & Regulation
description:
We don’t just talk, we do. Lead the change with us.

At the Tony Blair Institute for Global Change, we work with political leaders around the world to drive change. We help governments turn bold ideas into reality so they can deliver for their people. We do it by advising on strategy, policy and delivery, unlocking the power of technology across all three. And by sharing what we learn on the ground, so everyone can benefit. We do it to build more open, inclusive and prosperous countries for people everywhere.


We are a global not-for-profit organisation, operating in more than 40 countries across five continents. Our teams include political strategists, policy experts, delivery practitioners, technology specialists and more. We speak more than 45 languages and are working on over 100 projects, tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. We’re all here at TBI to make a difference.


In a world of ever more complex challenges, we believe diversity of background and perspective is a strength. We pride ourselves on a culture that values and nurtures difference. We are dedicated to unlocking potential, not only for the countries we work in but also for each of our team members. No matter where you’re from or who you are, if you’re passionate about the transformative power of progressive politics, we invite you to build a better future with us.


Role Summary


Role Summary


The Tony Blair Institute, in partnership with the Rwanda Development Board (RDB), is seeking an experienced Short-Term Consultant – Hospitality Service Quality & Regulation to support Rwanda’s ambition to deliver a consistently high-quality visitor experience that matches its positioning as a premium tourism destination.


Working closely with RDB’s Tourism Office and hospitality regulation and inspection teams, the Consultant will help RDB strengthen how hospitality service quality is defined, inspected, and enforced, so that standards are clear to operators, applied consistently by inspectors, and credible to both the industry and visitors.


This is a deliverables-based assignment of up to 50 billable days over approximately four months. The Consultant will produce a defined package: a rapid diagnostic, a tiered service quality standards framework, practical inspection and compliance tools, an inspection operations guide, and a short-term enforcement improvement roadmap. Each deliverable will be handed over to named RDB counterparts through a working session and a pilot, so that RDB can use the tools independently once the assignment ends.


We are looking for a hospitality quality professional: someone who has run or audited hotel operations, managed quality assurance or brand standards, or worked within a tourism grading, classification, or licensing body, and who can translate that hands-on knowledge into practical systems that a public regulator can own and run.


The Consultant will report to TBI’s Senior Manager – Country Program & Delivery and will coordinate with a parallel TBI consultancy on tourism product development and investment facilitation.


Location: Kigali, Rwanda, with in-person presence required for interviews, inspections, the validation workshop, the pilot, and handover; other work may be completed remotely

Scope of Work & Deliverables


1. Inception Note & Workplan

  • Agree scope, methodology, stakeholder list, and timeline with TBI and RDB, and identify the RDB counterpart who will own each deliverable after handover
  • Collect and review existing standards, classification criteria, inspection records, and relevant legal and regulatory instruments

2. Rapid Diagnostic & Benchmarking

  • Assess current hospitality licensing, classification, inspection, and enforcement practices through document review, stakeholder interviews, and observation of a sample of inspections
  • Identify key gaps, bottlenecks, and root causes, including institutional capacity and industry readiness constraints
  • Benchmark Rwanda’s approach against the EAC common classification criteria and two to three comparator national grading schemes
  • Output: a concise diagnostic report with prioritized recommendations for RDB leadership

3. Tiered Service Quality Standards Framework

  • Design a tiered hospitality service quality standards framework covering facilities, service delivery, staff conduct, and guest experience, building on the EAC criteria where appropriate
  • Define clear, measurable, and objectively verifiable criteria and a scoring approach for each tier
  • Facilitate one validation workshop with industry associations, operators, and government counterparts, and finalize the framework

4. Inspection & Compliance Tools

  • Develop standardized inspection checklists, scoring sheets, and reporting templates that serve as an objective benchmark for inspectors
  • Develop an operator self-assessment checklist and short guidance note setting out what is required at each tier

5. Inspection Operations Guide

  • Develop a practical guide setting out how inspections should be planned, risk-prioritized, conducted, scored, documented, escalated, and followed up
  • Include standard templates and escalation protocols for corrective action and follow-up

6. Short-Term Enforcement Improvement Roadmap

  • Identify quick wins and set out a prioritized 12-month roadmap to strengthen inspection consistency and enforcement credibility

  • Experience working with or within government, a regulator, or a public agency; experience in Africa, or comparable emerging premium tourism destinations, is highly advantageous
  • Excellent writing, facilitation, and communication skills, with the credibility to engage both hotel general managers and senior government officials
  • No ownership of, or employment with, a hospitality establishment operating in Rwanda, to avoid any conflict of interest

Capabilities and Ways of Working


Agility & Comfort with Ambiguity

  • Works independently with minimal supervision and manages own time against agreed deliverables
  • Adapts quickly to shifting priorities while keeping to the agreed scope and timeline

Builds & Broadens

  • Builds strong working relationships quickly across government, industry associations, and operators
  • Shares knowledge so that counterparts can use the tools independently
  • Brings insight into hospitality quality standards and regulatory practice from other markets

Collaboration, Integrity & Trust

  • Builds credibility with senior stakeholders and industry, and operates with sound judgement and impartiality
  • Navigates complex stakeholder environments with professionalism and discretion
  • Communicates clearly and influences effectively across levels

Drive & Delivery

  • Maintains a strong focus on tangible outcomes and results
  • Delivers high-quality outputs on time and within the agreed level of effort
  • Demonstrates persistence in overcoming barriers and moving outputs through to approval


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear diagnosis and priorities agreed: RDB leadership has endorsed the diagnostic and its prioritized recommendations
  • Standards framework ready for adoption: A validated tiered service quality standards framework with objective criteria has been submitted to RDB for adoption
  • Inspection practice ready to be more consistent: Inspection tools, an operator self-assessment checklist, and an inspection operations guide have been piloted, refined, and handed over to RDB
