title: Engineering Manager
description:
Organization- At CommBank, we never lose sight of the role we play in delivering a brighter future for our customers and supporting our communities. Our focus is to help customers and communities move forward to progress. To make the right financial decisions and achieve their dreams, targets and aspirations. Regardless of where you work within our organization, your initiative, talent, ideas and energy all contribute to the impact that we can make with our work. Together we can build tomorrow’s bank today.

Role Title – Engineering Manager

Business Unit– Corp Tech

Location- Bangalore- Manyata tech Park


Impact and Contributions: This role sits within the Document Retention & Archiving (DRA) Crew in COO Transformation Technology, where our squads design, build and operate secure, scalable and resilient content platforms for the enterprise. You will help shape the future of our cloud-first platforms and services, ensuring they meet business needs while aligning with modern engineering principles, secure-by-design practices and operational excellence standards.

As a hands-on people leader, you will lead the Software Engineering Chapter and work across DRA squads and crews to build shared capability, guide technical direction and enable consistent engineering outcomes. You will partner with Product Owners, Staff Engineers, architects and other chapter leads to strengthen delivery, platform evolution and run excellence across DRA.


Key Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate a strong risk mindset by proactively identifying, discussing and acting on current and emerging engineering, operational, security and compliance risks.
  • Build, lead and inspire an inclusive, engaged team of engineers, setting clear expectations and creating an environment of psychological safety, constructive challenge and accountability.
  • Coach and develop engineers through regular feedback, career planning, mentoring and succession development, while raising engineering capability across the chapter and broader practice.
  • Translate business and technology strategy into an executable engineering roadmap, quarterly priorities and a well-managed backlog.
  • Provide technical leadership across squads and influence architecture, design and engineering outcomes without becoming a delivery bottleneck.
  • Establish consistent engineering standards, reusable platform patterns, automation frameworks and guardrails aligned with enterprise practices.
  • Champion cloud-native, platform engineering and secure-by-design practices across software delivery and operations.
  • Build a best-in-class run capability, with clear ownership of reliability, resilience, observability, incident learning, disaster recovery and continuous improvement.
  • Partner effectively with product, architecture, cyber security, risk and operations stakeholders to manage complex dependencies and deliver sustainable outcomes.
  • Promote engineering productivity through CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, GitOps, automated testing and self-service capabilities.
  • Balance customer outcomes, delivery pace, technical debt, operational risk, sustainability and cloud cost when making investment decisions.
  • Guide the responsible evaluation and adoption of emerging technologies, including AI-enabled solutions and intelligent automation.

Requirement-

We use a broad range of tools, languages and frameworks. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every technology; however, you will need sufficient breadth and depth to set direction, challenge designs, manage technical risk and coach engineers across the following areas:

  • Engineering leadership: Significant enterprise software engineering experience, including a proven record of leading high-performing teams and influencing outcomes across multiple squads.
  • Software engineering: Strong working knowledge of modern application development using C#/.NET, Java/J2EE with Spring Boot, Python or comparable languages, together with design patterns, secure coding and automated testing strategies.
  • APIs and integration: Experience governing API design and lifecycle practices, including OpenAPI, REST and SOAP, microservices, event-driven architectures and integration technologies such as Kafka, MQ, Apache Camel, Temporal or MuleSoft.
  • Cloud architecture: Strong experience leading cloud migration and modernisation, with depth in AWS, networking, identity, load balancing, storage, compute, managed databases and highly available architecture patterns.
  • Kubernetes and platform engineering: Practical understanding of Kubernetes and managed platforms such as EKS or AKS, containerised workloads, Helm, ingress, networking, reusable platform patterns and self-service engineering capabilities.
  • DevSecOps and automation: Experience establishing CI/CD, GitOps and Infrastructure as Code practices using technologies such as GitHub Actions, Argo CD, CloudFormation or equivalent tooling, with appropriate software supply-chain controls.
  • Reliability and operations: Demonstrated leadership in observability, monitoring, alerting, incident management, reliability engineering, resilience, disaster recovery and business continuity for mission-critical services.
  • Security and risk: Strong knowledge of defence in depth, secure-by-design approaches, IAM, encryption, secrets management, public cloud obligations, compliance controls and engineering governance.
  • Data platforms: Understanding of relational and NoSQL technologies such as PostgreSQL, Oracle and MongoDB, plus data architecture, integration, real-time processing and scalable API-based data services.
  • Cost and performance: Ability to guide cloud cost optimisation, capacity and performance decisions using FinOps practices and tools such as Apptio Cloudability or equivalents.
  • AI and emerging technology: Awareness of AI-enabled solutions, Retrieval-Augmented Generation, agent-based workflows and machine learning integration, with the judgement to assess value, risk and operational readiness.
  • Communication and delivery: Excellent stakeholder communication, architectural decision-making and experience working with Agile delivery methods in complex enterprise environments.

Education Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

title: First line support engineer
description:
Introduction to the role

As a First Line Support Engineer, you play an important role in keeping ASML’s manufacturing operations running smoothly. You will help resolve technical production issues, support continuous improvement, and contribute to the reliable delivery of technologies that enable the world’s most advanced microchips.

You will join the Motion Factory within ASML’s TWINSCAN Factory in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. This team produces performance-critical actuators, coil assemblies, and magnet components used in ASML systems. As a First Line Support Engineer, you will work close to production teams, helping to solve technical challenges while driving long-term improvements that support ASML’s mission of advancing semiconductor technology.


Roles and responsibilities

As a First Line Support Engineer, you spend much of your time on the production floor, working directly with products, equipment, and manufacturing processes. You investigate technical disturbances through hands-on analysis, inspections, testing, and collaboration with operators and engineers. Alongside resolving immediate issues, you identify opportunities to improve product quality, process stability, and operational efficiency.


  • Investigate technical production issues by working directly with products, tools, and manufacturing equipment.
  • Perform hands-on inspections and tests, such as leak testing, visual quality checks, and defect analysis.
  • Diagnose product and process deviations, determine root causes, and support corrective actions.
  • Work closely with operators to restore production flow while maintaining quality and safety standards.
  • Lead and coordinate escalations for complex technical challenges requiring cross-functional support.
  • Coach colleagues in troubleshooting techniques and structured problem solving.
  • Identify recurring issues and drive continuous improvement initiatives to prevent future disturbances.

Education and experience

  • Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, mechatronics, electrical engineering, applied physics, aerospace engineering, or a related technical field.
  • 2-5 years of experience in a technical support production environment
  • Experience troubleshooting complex technical issues and performing root cause analysis.
  • Knowledge of continuous improvement and quality management methodologies.

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you’ll always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way to do that. You won’t work in a silo. Instead, you’ll be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you’ll collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You’ll have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.


To thrive in this job, you’ll need the following skills:

  • Apply analytical thinking to diagnose issues and identify effective solutions.
  • Collaborate effectively with colleagues across manufacturing and engineering teams.
  • Communicate clearly with different stakeholders in a production environment.
  • Take ownership of challenges and proactively drive improvements.
  • Balance hands-on technical work with a structured approach to problem solving.
  • Prioritize quality, safety, and continuous improvement in daily activities.
  • Adapt quickly to changing priorities and production needs.

Other information


Please include your recent CV and a motivation letter with your application. In your motivation letter, we would like to understand why you are interested in joining the Motion Factory as a First Line Support Engineer.


This is a full-time position (40 hours per week) based in Veldhoven, the Netherlands. The role follows a day-shift schedule aligned with production operating hours (07:30-16:00).

For this position, the indicative (fixed) annual salary range is between 58,900 euro and 73,500 euro. This range comprises vacation allowance and a 13th-month payment. Company profit sharing is not included in this range.

The actual compensation offered will depend on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to: job-related skills, relevant education and (work) experience, certifications, demonstrated abilities of the candidate, pay relative to other team members. This information is provided for transparency and guidance purposes only, and no rights can be derived from this salary indication.


ASML invests in employee development through training, mentoring, and continuous learning opportunities. You will work in an international environment and have opportunities to collaborate with colleagues and stakeholders across global locations while contributing to the development of world-leading semiconductor technology.

This position requires access to controlled technology, as defined in the United States Export Administration Regulations (15 C.F.R. § 730, et seq.). Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to access such controlled technology prior to beginning work. Business demands may require ASML to proceed with candidates who are immediately eligible to access controlled technology.

Inclusion and diversity

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

title: Senior CX/UX Researcher
description:
About Wolters Kluwer

For 180 years, Wolters Kluwer has been dedicated to supporting and facilitating the work processes of experts and businesses with innovative solutions. To achieve our vision, we rely on our more than 20,000 colleagues worldwide. We are a technology-oriented international company specializing in professional information, software, and services. Our success is built on intelligent thinking and attentive listening.


The Role

As a Senior CX/UX Researcher supporting Enablon, you will help product teams make informed decisions about complex enterprise products and the operational and safety workflows they support.

This role combines hands-on research with enabling others to learn directly from customers and users. You will personally lead and execute studies while helping Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers develop the skills and confidence to contribute to research and apply evidence responsibly.

You will combine customer site visits, remote and online research, and quantitative evidence from product telemetry. Working with product teams, you will establish regular learning cycles that inform discovery, design, and improvements to live products.


Responsibilities

Enable better product decisions

  • Translate research into clear recommendations on customer value, usability, and adoption, connecting these findings to wider product and business decisions.
  • Help teams prioritize problems, test assumptions, and make timely, evidence-based trade-offs under uncertainty.
  • Work with Product and Engineering to assess the business and technical implications of customer and user needs.

Drive continuous and targeted research

  • Own research end to end, from problem framing and participant recruitment to data collection, analysis, and recommendations.
  • Conduct customer site visits, contextual interviews, and observation to understand real work, including frontline users, working conditions, and operational constraints.
  • Conduct remote and online interviews, usability studies, and surveys; select methods and depth to suit the question, decision, and risk.

Use telemetry to understand behavior and measure outcomes

  • Use product telemetry to investigate adoption, task completion, workflow friction, and differences between user groups; combine observed behavior with what people report.
  • Partner with Product, Engineering, and analytics colleagues to define useful research questions, events, and measures, and identify gaps in instrumentation or data quality.
  • Use quantitative evidence to prioritize further research and evaluate changes after release, accounting for data limitations and avoiding unsupported causal conclusions.

Operate as a strategic research partner

  • Align with Product, Design, and Engineering on priority questions, research scope, and the decisions evidence needs to support.
  • Embed regular customer contact and focused learning cycles into product work, from early discovery through post-release evaluation.
  • Help teams evaluate product opportunities and distinguish the needs of buyers, administrators, and end users.

Enable teams to learn from customers

  • Help Product Managers, Designers, and Engineers participate in site visits, interviews, usability studies, and synthesis.
  • Develop practical research skills through joint studies, feedback, workshops, and reusable guides, helping teams choose methods and interpret findings responsibly.
  • Help teams conduct appropriate studies independently, with proportionate support and review; lead research that requires specialist expertise or addresses greater uncertainty.

Strengthen research systems and ways of working

  • Establish practical approaches to recruitment, synthesis, and knowledge sharing, including access to participants beyond office-based roles.
  • Work with customer-facing colleagues to sustain customer relationships, research panels, and feedback loops.
  • Maintain appropriate standards for research quality, consent, privacy, and responsible handling of customer and user data.

Synthesize and communicate effectively

  • Connect qualitative findings, telemetry, and support data into clear recommendations, explaining limitations and conflicting signals.
  • Share findings throughout research so teams can act on emerging evidence and understand what remains uncertain.
  • Keep evidence accessible and reusable, and help teams record how findings inform priorities and product changes.

Use AI and emerging technologies responsibly

  • Use AI and other tools to improve research preparation, analysis, synthesis, and knowledge retrieval while maintaining confidentiality and rigor.
  • Validate outputs against source evidence and help colleagues apply these tools responsibly.

Requirements

  • A degree in a relevant field or equivalent practical experience.
  • At least five years of relevant research experience in a product or innovation environment, with evidence of independently leading studies.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required, including the ability to conduct research, facilitate discussions, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Strong exploratory and evaluative research skills, including qualitative data collection, observation, interviews, and usability testing in person and remotely.
  • Ability to translate research into recommendations that influence product decisions and customer or user outcomes.
  • Experience working closely with Product, Design, and Engineering in iterative product development.
  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, including practical experience interpreting product telemetry and combining quantitative and qualitative evidence.
  • Professional proficiency in written and spoken English is required, including the ability to conduct research, facilitate discussions, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Clear communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills, including experience helping colleagues develop research skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously, prioritize research, and build trusted relationships across teams and with customers.
  • Travel is required as part of this role, including occasional visits to customer sites for research and to company offices for larger team meetings and collaboration.

Additional Qualifications (Preferred)

  • Experience researching B2B or enterprise software, particularly industrial, operational, or regulated environments.
  • Experience working with product analytics tools and defining instrumentation requirements with engineering or analytics colleagues.
  • Experience researching products incorporating AI or advanced automation.
  • Experience establishing continuous discovery practices across multiple product teams.
  • Ability to quickly develop an understanding of complex domains and the needs of different user groups.

What Success Looks Like

  • Product decisions and priorities are visibly informed by customer and user evidence.
  • Teams maintain regular customer contact through site visits and remote research, with learning integrated into product work.
  • Colleagues develop the skills to conduct appropriate research and apply findings with increasing independence.
  • Qualitative research and telemetry together guide improvements and help teams evaluate their effects.
  • Teams can explain how research informed changes and what evidence indicates better customer or user outcomes.

Diversity Matters

Wolters Kluwer strives for an inclusive company culture in which we attract, develop, and retain diverse talent to achieve our strategy.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: General Manager (Waterford, MI)
description:
About Ace Retail Group

Ace Retail Group (ARG), is a division of Ace Hardware Corporation that owns and operates several Ace brands, including Westlake Ace, Great Lakes Ace, Buikema’s Ace, Outer Banks Ace, Dennis Company, and Breed & Company. ARG is one of the largest hardware retailers in the United States and has two headquarters located in Lenexa, KS and Farmington Hills, MI. ARG’s origins date back over a century and operates over 250 neighborhood stores located throughout the United States. Great people make ARG stand out in our industry, and we are looking for individuals who strive for personal and professional growth, and who want to work with a company founded on (and still led by) our solid Core Values of: Winning, Excellence, Love, Integrity, Gratitude, Humility and Teamwork.

General Summary

The General Manager is responsible for ensuring superior customer service in their store. They must develop associates at all levels, drive sales and profitability, and maintain effective expense and payroll budget management. They will also ensure compliance with effective inventory management and merchandising practices and all Westlake policies and procedures.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Customer Service

  • Provide positive representation of Westlake Ace Hardware.
  • Proactively assist customers in solving problems.
  • Greet customers entering and throughout the store. Thank customers when finished and when they are leaving the store.
  • Provide a friendly, outgoing demeanor; work well with customers as well as associates.
  • Ensure all calls and pages are answered promptly, courteously and effectively.
  • Handle customer complaints. Work to resolve problems with the customer and have Westlake’s best interest taken into consideration.
  • Possess excellent product knowledge and knowledge of store layout and location of products.

Store Operations

  • Ensure a positive, professional and safe work environment for all associates.
  • Supervise the “general operations” of the entire store.
  • Responsible for ordering and maintaining desirable product inventory levels to ensure store profitability in compliance with corporate objectives.
  • Ensure compliance with all practices, policies and procedures necessary to manage inventory shrink. Monitor shrink numbers and take corrective actions.
  • Manage and direct preventative maintenance and repairs in order to maximize and protect all physical assets (i.e. building, fixtures and equipment).
  • Ensure receiving, checking in, stocking of merchandise for the store is being done completely.
  • Responsible for maintenance of back stock levels.
  • Oversee and assist with the daily maintenance, orderliness and cleanliness of the sales floor, stock room and outdoor merchandise areas.
  • Provide assistance in the overall general maintenance of the store.
  • Ensure forklift operations and receiving is completed in a safe and efficient way.
  • Ensure weekly price changes are being completed.
  • Ensure monthly cycle counts and negative on hand reports are being completed.
  • Ensure signage is current in the entire store.
  • Provide a clean and orderly sales floor, including end caps and ad goods merchandised.
  • Ensure special orders and rain-checks are being completed properly.
  • Ensure ad signage and products are ready for the customers.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Store Support Operations

  • Responsible for the P & L and other corresponding reports.
  • Assist District Manager with the budget process for sales and expenses.
  • Manage payroll and other controllable expenses.
  • Responsible for the implementation of Store Support programs.
  • Attend trade shows and seminars with company guidance.
  • Responsible for successful Loss Prevention, Safety and Internal Audits.
  • Assist with special projects within the district as set forth by the District Manager.

Hiring and Training of Associates

  • Conduct weekly management staff meetings.
  • Ensure effective training and development of all associates.
  • Recruit prospective associates for possible management positions throughout Westlake Ace Hardware.
  • Manage and support the hiring, scheduling, reviewing, rewarding and coaching of all store associates including management.
  • Actively recruit and promote the advancement of Westlake associates.

Leadership

  • Become an integral part of the community in which you live and work through civic organizations and being community minded.
  • Challenge all associates to think of ways to better merchandise product, control expenses and increase sales.
  • Lead by example; be approachable by all associates and customers.

Other Essential Requirements

Ability to exhibit and incorporate our Core Values into daily decisions and interactions with others:

  • WINNING – In business, money is the score. To win, we must perform, compete, and have fun. At Ace, we win through people- our strength is being helpful.

  • EXCELLENCE – Excellence honors God and inspires people. We aspire to be the best, to continuously improve and to inspire others by giving the team our very best.

  • LOVE – Love the people, love the work and love the results.

  • INTEGRITY – For Ace to win, we need to be able to trust each other. And trust will require us to be honest, reliable, caring, of high character and of unquestioned ethics.

  • GRATITUDE – We recognize that we are blessed to be in the business of serving others.

  • HUMILITY – We strive for greatness with a humble, modest and respectful attitude.

  • TEAMWORK – We will fight the natural tendency for control and credit in favor of collaboration and mutual success, recognizing that…Together, we are Ace.

Minimum Skills, Requirements and Qualifications

  • High School or GED equivalent.
  • Must have previous retail management experience. Hardware experience preferred.
  • Standing, walking, lifting (up to 25lbs) and climbing.

Starting at $55,000 per year

title: Technical Data Analyst - Wiring
description:
Job Description:

There is an opportunity in Airbus Customer Services to join the Operational Unit "Technical Data Support and Services", which works towards developing and delivering aircraft maintenance documentation, to enable the safe and efficient accomplishment of maintenance operations by the customers (airlines, MRO, lessors).The products developed are AWM (Aircraft Wiring Manual) ASM (Aircraft Schematic Manual) AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual), TSM (Troubleshooting Manual), IPC (Illustrated Part Catalogue).


To deliver the complete documentation at aircraft entry into service and to maintain it throughout the aircraft life cycle is our main mission, and is part of the airworthiness requirements. The main challenge is to define precisely the consequences of the design changes on the already published documentation and to understand the immediate impact on Customers operations, with the objective to provide customised documentation in accordance with aircraft configuration.


Experience Level needed: 4~8 years, with preferably 2+ years in the activity lead position


The jobholder will be responsible for Wiring activities for all aircraft programs across Aircraft Systems Perimeter, working in close collaboration with our Tech Data Wiring teams in Europe and will be responsible for the following activities:


Main Responsibilities


  • Able to perform PreAnalysis Round Table for wiring - Assessment of aircraft design inputs (Mod & Mod Proposal, Service Bulletin, …) that drive aircraft evolution in order to detect the impacts in the technical documentation.
  • Source Data Request (SDR) analysis for all programs when getting a new SDR.
  • Able to work on AWL and AWL2 manuals by performing a minimum level of authoring.
  • Writing of Technical Data Authoring activities of a Manual (AWL/AWL2) in accordance with specifications and quality standards, contractual commitments, configuration management rules, approved schedules, quality standards.
  • Be open to proposing ideas & adapting digital evolutions in the Technical Data Wiring domain. Active contribution to Digitization is expected.
  • Answer to customer questions for complex queries relative to his/her scope of activities. The jobholder will be responsible for providing efficient support to the customer, sometimes under high time pressure (following AOG…). He/she will guarantee accurate and on time correction of Technical Data deliverables.
  • Ensure and maintain compliance with EASA/FAA regulations (ICA process) and EN9100 for their own technical scope and perimeter of responsibility.
  • Manage all potential impacts of a criteria under the responsibility of ATA Systems
  • Technical Steering and Monitoring with Design Office(DO) for SDR’s and DO Contributions
  • Responsible to ensure the delivery of manual content in accordance with specifications on time, on quality and within budget objectives
  • Proactive identification, mitigation and follow up of blocking points as well as constant assessment of your manual content in terms of quality assurance
  • Act as an interface between technical data, the airline customers and all the other Airbus internal contributors (Design Office, Programs, Delivery Center, other Customer Services units, etc.)
  • Working with and supporting other local line teams.



Values

  • Develop and maintain a collaborative working environment across organisation, by fostering engagement, active listening, developing team spirit, establishing feedback culture, establishing a trustful environment and Speak-up culture
  • Propose and develop innovation and digitalisation initiatives with respect to the interests of the Company
  • Develop and maintain a Quality First Mindset
  • Support a value driven organisation by creating/increasing the awareness level of personal values, Airbus values and policies

Safety

  • Report any (potential) safety issue or (potential) safety event that is detected in the frame of the day to day activity
  • Contribute, on request of their safety representatives, in any safety enhancement initiative as part of Safety management activity (PSP, SMS), eg, in the analysis and follow up of reported events, identification and analysis of hazards and risk assessment in their own domain of activity
  • Promote a safety culture

Qualifications

Aircraft Maintenance Engineering (AME) degree or Aeronautical / other Engineering Degree with knowledge/exposure to Aircraft Maintenance domain. 4~8 years experience in the Technical Data Wiring domain.


For this position the following skills are requested

- Basic knowledge of Aircraft and Aeronautics

- Knowledge of Aircraft Wiring

- Knowledge of Aircraft Systems

- Aircraft maintenance

- Knowledge of Technical Data authoring in AWL/AWL2.

- Technical Data & Publication Rules

- Aircraft configuration Management

- Project Management

- Proactive, good team player and good organisational skills.

- Communication skills and assertiveness.

- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvement.

- English Advanced level is mandatory

- Safety and quality knowledge.

title: Clinical Educator
description:
About The Team


The Chiropractic program sits within Murdoch University’s School of Allied Health and is a leader in evidence-based chiropractic education in Western Australia. Combining theoretical learning with extensive hands-on clinical experience, the program prepares students for contemporary professional practice.


A key part of the program is the on-campus Murdoch University Chiropractic Clinic (MUCC), where students work with real patients under the supervision and guidance of qualified clinicians. Students also gain experience through outreach programs supporting rural and remote communities.


The Chiropractic team is committed to providing a supportive, practical learning environment, with a strong focus on clinical education, professionalism, ethics and culturally competent care.


Your New Role!


As the Clinical Educator, you will be responsible for the clinical operation of the diagnostic imaging service within the Murdoch University Chiropractic Clinic (MUCC), while providing clinical education and supervision to student clinicians.

You will perform and/or supervise diagnostic imaging examinations and support students to develop their clinical skills and competence. Working closely with academic staff, you will also contribute to the broader teaching activities of the Chiropractic program and help ensure clinical education aligns with program learning outcomes and professional standards.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Providing academic guidance, clinical education and mentorship to student clinicians.
  • Performing and/or supervising diagnostic imaging examinations in accordance with radiation safety requirements, professional standards and clinic protocols.
  • Educating and supervising students in radiographic technique, radiation safety, positioning and image interpretation.
  • Assessing and verifying students’ clinical competence and supporting the development of their practical skills.
  • Collaborating with academic staff to maintain consistency in teaching standards and clinical practices.

The position may be filled by either a registered Medical Radiation Practitioner (Radiographer) or a Chiropractor holding a radiography licence.

Please refer to the Position Description for further details.


What We Offer You!


This Continuous| Part time (9 hours per week) attracts a remuneration of $115K – $136K (pro rata) plus 17% employer superannuation contributions.

You’ll join a dynamic and talented team where diversity and innovation thrive. Our Silver-tier status in the Australian Workplace Equality Index (AWEI), awarded in 2025, reflects our commitment to LGBTIQA+ inclusion, equity, and creating a safe, welcoming environment for all. We strive to be the university of choice for First Nations peoples, honouring Indigenous knowledge. Sustainability is central to our community and guided by clear, confident leadership, we are working toward an ambitious future with goals of net zero emissions and zero waste by 2030.

As well as the flexibility to maintain a work life balance, our staff enjoy a vibrant, natural campus with world-class facilities, along with a variety of benefits, including:

  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Cultural Load and allowance - providing up to $8,944 per year to First Nations employees who are contributing cultural knowledge and perspectives beyond the scope of their role
  • Indigenous Language Allowance
  • Salary packaging options – such as purchasing leave, gym membership, car parking permit
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • On-campus services and facilities, such as a Childcare Centre, Gym, Vet Hospital, and Chiropractic Clinic

For further information, check out our benefits and services page!

Join us!

Please apply online via the Apply Now button, along with submitting the following documents to support your application -


  • A cover letter including a statement addressing the selection criteria (with reference to the Position Description)
  • Your most recent resume (CV)

What you’ll bring to the role:


  • Hold and maintain current AHPRA registration as either a Medical Radiation Practitioner (Radiographer) or a Chiropractor with a radiography licence, with the ability to practise without limitation in Western Australia and supervise students undertaking clinical placements in the relevant discipline.
  • At least three years’ clinical experience as a qualified radiographer or chiropractor.
  • Strong interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Excellent organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise tasks and manage competing demands.

title: SENIOR BEHAVIOR SPECIALIST
description:
Department

Department of Behavioral Healthcare, Developmental Disabilities & Hospitals

Division

Social/Human Services

Job Profile

JC-02151400-5 - Senior Behavior Specialist (C94 L1293 BHDDH Developmental Disabilities)

Scheduled Work Days & Work Hours

11:30am - 7:00pm; Monday through Friday; Flexibility will be required to include evenings and weekends.


Non-Standard/Non-Exempt, 35.0

Job Requisition Number

JR104074 SENIOR BEHAVIOR SPECIALIST (Open)

Pay Grade

C00322 A

Classification

Senior Behavior Specialist

Class Definition

GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES: To assist a Clinical Psychologist in the design and writing of individualized behavior plans and intervention strategies that apply behavior modification techniques in working with individuals with mental illness and/or behavior issues in a hospital setting; to monitor and document progress in behavior modification efforts by collecting and charting clinical data as defined by care plans; and to do related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Works under the supervision of a Supervising Clinical Psychologist from whom specific instructions are received; work is reviewed for technical competence and conformance to instructions, program plans and established policies and procedures.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Generally none, but in some cases may supervise Behavior Specialists.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • To assist a Clinical Psychologist in the design and writing of individualized behavior plans and intervention strategies that apply behavior modification techniques in working with individuals with mental illness and/or behavior issues in a hospital setting; to monitor and document progress in behavior modification efforts by collecting and charting clinical data as defined by care plans; and to do related work as required.
  • To perform behavior analysis in terms of triggers of target behaviors to make educated recommendations for individualized behavior modification interventions.
  • To engage individual patients or small groups of patients in therapeutic activities.
  • To provide direct behavioral treatment to high-risk clients in various settings.
  • To run and facilitate patient groups focused on therapeutic activities (i.e., peer support, social skills, anger management, computer skills, horticulture, etc.).
  • As required, to attend treatment team meetings and report on patients' progress.
  • To document patients' progress based on collected data and clinical observations.
  • To assist in providing in-service training related to behavior modification techniques.
  • As required, to attend training sessions on mental health issues and behavior modification techniques.
  • To do related work as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT:

KNOWLEDGE SKILLS AND CAPACITIES: A working knowledge of the principles, practices and techniques of learning theory, abnormal psychology, developmental psychology and data collection procedures; the ability to implement specific and detailed behavior treatment plans; the ability to make accurate observations; the ability to communicate clearly both verbally and in writing; the ability to accurately and timely document in the medical record; the ability to record and represent data in statistical forms; and related capacities and abilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Possession of a Bachelor's Degree, from a college of recognized standing, in Psychology, Applied Behavior Analysis, or a closely related field with emphasis in Clinical, Abnormal or Behavioral Psychology, Behavior Treatment or Applied Learning Theory; and

Experience: A minimum of three year's clinical experience working with mental health and/or developmental disability populations,

Or. any combination of education and experience that shall be substantially equivalent to the above education and experience.

Supplemental Information

Assist with the development, implementation and maintenance of Behavior Support Plans for RICLAS residents.
Proficient in the development and implementation of behavior modification strategies to include observation, modeling, staff training, utilization of best practice treatment modalities, and clinical interventions with the ability to modify behavior plans as appropriate.
Demonstrated proficiency with data collection, data interpretation and data reporting. Ability to collaborate across an interdisciplinary team comprised of both internal and external stakeholders.
Certification in de-escalation and/or Safety Care and willingness to become a certified de-escalation and/or Safety Care trainer preferred – the role of the trainer is to assist with training all RICLAS employees.
Demonstrated experience supporting individuals with Intellectual and Developmental Disabilities with co-occurring diagnoses.
Knowledge of CMS Home and Community Based Services Final Rule, The Olmstead Decision and Division initiatives. State-wide travel to all residential sites, off-site meetings, and training as needed.

Preferred skills: Extensive work experience within the developmental disabilities field, residential settings, vocational rehabilitation, person-centered planning, and systems-change preferred. Strong communication skills, including both written and oral communication. Proficient with Microsoft Office with advanced PowerPoint and Excel skills required.

Who we are

Reed in Partnership's Employability Division aims to positively transform lives by helping individuals who are unemployed, economically inactive, or facing challenges such as health conditions, disabilities, or caring responsibilities to find sustainable employment. Through a wide range of tailored support services including one-to-one careers guidance, CV writing, interview preparation, and skills training, we have supported over 250,000 people on their journey into work.

Our Connect to Work programme, funded by East Midlands Combined Authority, focuses specifically on supporting unemployed participants with complex barriers to employment, including those with a disability or health condition. We provide them with up to 12 months of personalised support to enter or re-enter the workforce.


What is the role about?

Employment Specialists are the front line of Reed in Partnership, directly contributing to our mission by supporting jobseekers (our participants), engaging with individuals within communities across Derbyshire to generate referrals onto the programme, as well as promoting the benefits of the Connect to Work programme. Our participants are the lifeblood of our business and providing them with an excellent service is at the very core of the Employment Specialist role.


*Please note this role will require you to work and travel within Derby and the surrounding areas*


Just some of your day-to-day responsibilities will include:

Taking Ownership

  • Meeting with and supporting a caseload of jobseekers in the community, identifying their barriers and creating tailored action plans to progress them into employment.
  • Delivering personalised, one-to-one guidance to our participants including CV writing, interview preparation, and skills development.
  • Meeting and exceeding performance targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

Working Together

  • Collaborating with participants to shift their mindset and build the confidence they need to find and sustain work.
  • Engaging with local employers to identify job opportunities.
  • Signposting participants to internal and external stakeholders to address specific barriers such as health, housing, or financial challenges.
  • Promoting the Connect to Work programme within the community to generate referrals, raising awareness of its benefits and impact.
  • Attending events within the local community to promote the Connect to Work programme to generate referrals, raising awareness of its benefits and impact.

Being Fair, Open, and Honest

  • Providing inclusive support and advice to people from all backgrounds.

What’s in it for you?

A generous base salary (pro-rata for part time), and great flexibility with your working schedule, we offer training, development and progression opportunities. You will have access to the range of Reed in Partnership benefits, which include:

  • 25 days annual leave (pro-rata for part time) plus statutory bank holidays
  • Reed Pension Scheme
  • Award Winning Management & Leadership training
  • Professional & Personal Development Funds
  • Bi-annual pay reviews
  • Plus, much more that can be found on our website.

The Employment Specialist role offers immense satisfaction of connecting people with the tailored support that they need to fulfil their potential. At Reed in Partnership, our values - Fair, Open & Honest, Take Ownership, and Work Together, guide everything we do. Join us in delivering services that make a real difference.

To be successful in this role, we are looking for someone with:

  • Ability to demonstrate coaching/mentoring experience and persuasion/influencing skills through previous work or social activities.
  • Experience of working in a customer facing environment (i.e. Customer Services, Hospitality, Social Care, Customer Services, Sales)
  • Experience of working in a fast paced, performance target driven environment.
  • Willingness to travel locally (e.g. to meet customers/employers).
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.
  • A minimum of 2 A-Levels or an equivalent Level 3 Diploma.
  • GCSE English Language at a minimum of a Grade B (or equivalent Level 2 qualification). OR achievement of a Level 2 in Literacy Assessment at interview stage OR International Equivalents.

Desirable Criteria:

  • Experience working within a Community Engagement role (i.e. Business Development, Outreach)
  • Fluency in more than one language

We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. We offer a guaranteed interview scheme for disabled applicants who meet the minimum criteria.

At Vertex, we value teamwork through collaboration and provide support across the entire organization. If you think you have what it takes to play for the Vertex team, please apply.

title: Technical Data Analyst (AMM)
description:
Job Description:

Job Description – Technical Data Analyst (AMM)

There is an opportunity in Airbus Customer Services to join the Operational Unit "Technical Data Support and Services", which works towards developing and delivering aircraft maintenance documentation, to enable the safe and efficient accomplishment of maintenance operations by the customers (airlines, MRO, lessors).The products developed are AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual), TSM (Troubleshooting Manual), IPC (Illustrated Part Catalogue).

To deliver the complete documentation at aircraft entry into service and to maintain it throughout the aircraft life cycle is our main mission, and is part of the airworthiness requirements. The main challenge is to define precisely the consequences of the design changes on the already published documentation and to understand the immediate impact on Customers operations, with the objective to provide customised documentation in accordance with aircraft configuration.

Experience Level needed: 5-10 years Experience

The jobholder will be responsible for a portfolio of ATA chapters for all aircraft programs across Airframe /Systems / Cabin perimeters and will be responsible for the following activities:

  • Writing of Technical Data Authoring activities of a Manual(AMM/IPC/TSM) in accordance with specifications and quality standards, contractual commitments, configuration management rules, approved schedules, quality standards.

  • Mentor the junior members in the team and work as a specialist for Tech data topics.

  • Innovate and bring the process improvements in the technical data perimeter

  • Answer to customer questions for complex queries relative to his/her scope of activities. The jobholder will be responsible for providing efficient support to the customer, sometimes under high time pressure (following AOG…). He/she will guarantee accurate and on time correction of Technical Data deliverables.

  • Assessment of aircraft design inputs (Mod & Mod Proposal, Service Bulletin, …) that drive aircraft evolution in order to detect the impacts in the technical documentation.

  • The jobholder could have to work in close cooperation with numerous interfaces: customer services departments, design offices, airlines, suppliers.

  • The jobholder also plays a key role in terms of continuous improvements for Technical Data processes & tools and for transnational standardisation of ways of working.

  • Ensure and maintain compliance with EASA/FAA regulations (ICA process) and EN9100 for their own technical scope and perimeter of responsibility..

  • Provide continuous and efficient support to customers and all users of the Maintenance, Material deliverables.

  • Customer queries through TRM as per OTD/FTR targets

  • Ensure integration and management of all design criteria impacting Technical Data products.

  • Assess and provide technical justification for all non-integrated design criteria.

  • Manage all potential impacts of a criteria under the responsibility of ATA Systems

  • Technical Steering and Monitoring with Design Office for SDR’s and DO Contributions

  • Technical Steering and Monitoring of Illustrations request with Sub Contractors for a given ATA System

  • Launch preventive/corrective actions to continuously improve products, processes and practices based on customer feedback in line with product definition.

  • Verification and Validation – Incoming Inspection maintenance or material procedures

  • Manage Technical Data & Services Subcontracted Activities in accordance to AP2539

  • Monitor critical suppliers performance and prepare improvement plan





Qualifications

Aircraft Maintenance Engineering (AME) degree or Aeronautical / other Engineering Degree with knowledge/exposure to Aircraft Maintenance domain. 5-10 years experience in the Technical Data domain.

For this position the following skills are requested

- Basic knowledge of Aircraft and Aeronautics

- Knowledge of aircraft Systems

- Aircraft maintenance

- Knowledge of Technical Data authoring in AMM, IPC, TSM

- Aircraft configuration Management

- Project Management

- Proactive, good team player and good organisational skills.

- Communication skills and assertiveness.

- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvement.

- English Advanced level is mandatory

title: Senior Program Manager, Bachelor of Design (Digital Media)
description:
Overview:

RMIT Vietnam is seeking a Senior Program Manager, Bachelor of Design (Digital Media) to join our academic community and deliver high-quality teaching, research, and student engagement. This is an exciting opportunity for an educator-scholar who is passionate about shaping future-ready graduates and contributing to impactful research.


WHY JOIN RMIT VIETNAM?

At RMIT Vietnam, international exposure meets real-world impact through strong industry and government collaboration. Working at RMIT means building a meaningful career while creating impact in a high-performing environment.

Further insight into our mission, impact and global connections is available in the RMIT Vietnam Profile.


WHAT WE OFFER

Expatriates

  • Competitive remuneration package USD for expatriate candidates
  • Relocation allowance package from US$6,000
  • Relocation flights from home location to Vietnam for candidate and direct dependents (if applicable)
  • International repatriation flights for the staff and direct dependents at the end of their contract.
  • School tuition fees for children to attend the K-12 program in Vietnam, up to US$20,000 per child or US$40,000 for two children per year.
  • Premium private medical insurance for employee and immediate family, plus Personal Accident Insurance
  • Dedicated support from Global Mobility Team to support with immigration and relocation to Vietnam.

Vietnamese candidates

  • Competitive remuneration VND package for Vietnamese candidates.
  • 13th month Tet bonus
  • Private Health insurance for you and your family, plus Personal Accident Insurance

Other benefits

  • Generous annual leave, sick leave, volunteer leave and public holidays (Christmas and Tet Holidays)
  • Professional development and career advancement
  • Access to state-of-the-art facilities and resources
  • A vibrant and diverse campus life and more!

SCHOOL OF DESIGN & COMMUNICATION

For further information about SCD, please visit our website:


ABOUT THE ROLE

The Senior Program Manager will be responsible for the Bachelor of Design (Digital Media) program offered by RMIT Vietnam. The appointee will provide senior academic and operational leadership for the program, including responsibility for teaching and learning activities, curriculum development and quality assurance, timetabling, student experience, resource planning, financial sustainability, program promotion, industry engagement, staff workload planning, professional development review, research and scholarship trajectory, and multi-campus delivery.


The appointee will line manage academic staff as required, including Associate Program Managers and other senior academic staff within the program where applicable, and will work closely with the Dean of School and Deputy Deans of School.


The scope of responsibilities includes teaching and learning activities, curriculum development and quality assurance, timetabling, student experience, resource planning, program promotion, industry engagement, staff workload planning and professional development review. Proven success in program leadership, marketing, promotion, innovation, quality assurance and curriculum renewal is required.


The appointee will contribute to the strategic direction of the School by working collaboratively with peer Program Managers, Associate Program Managers, senior academic staff, and other members of the School leadership team, contributing to school-wide leadership, curriculum coherence, workforce planning, research and scholarship development, engagement, and program sustainability.


The role combines program leadership with teaching, scholarship, research and/or creative practice appropriate to the academic level of appointment. This position will suit an experienced senior academic leader with a strong record in design education, academic leadership, curriculum development, industry engagement, and the management of complex academic programs.


Reports to:

Dean, School of Communication & Design



KEY ACCOUNTIBILITIES

Program Leadership and Management

  • Provide senior academic leadership for the Bachelor of Design (Digital Media) as a large, multi-campus program, ensuring academic quality, curriculum coherence, operational effectiveness, financial sustainability, student outcomes and program reputation.
  • Lead curriculum development, review, renewal and mapping, including alignment of Program Learning Outcomes, Course Learning Outcomes, assessment, graduate capabilities, RMIT academic frameworks, accreditation requirements and industry needs.
  • Oversee program delivery, timetabling, assessment moderation, quality assurance processes, program amendments and course-related policies pursuant to School, College and University procedures and in liaison with key stakeholders.
  • Ensure compliance with University, College, School, TEQSA, MOET and other relevant academic governance and regulatory requirements.
  • Contribute to annual and longer-term program planning, including planning related to student load, staffing, resources, facilities, curriculum renewal, program promotion, industry engagement and program sustainability.
  • Work collaboratively with the Dean, Deputy Deans, Associate Program Managers, peer Program Managers and senior staff to ensure the program contributes to the School’s broader learning and teaching, research, engagement and growth objectives.

Teaching and Learning

  • Contribute to undergraduate teaching within the Bachelor of Design (Digital Media) program, including assessment design, delivery, moderation and continuous improvement.
  • Lead innovation in teaching and learning, including blended and digital learning approaches appropriate to creative disciplines.
  • Use evidence-informed practice, peer review, moderation, course evaluation data, student feedback and program-level quality assurance processes to enhance learning outcomes and student experience.
  • Support academic staff to understand and implement program-level priorities, including curriculum alignment, assessment quality, moderation, feedback, student progression, retention and success.

Student Experience and Engagement

  • Champion a positive, inclusive and supportive student experience across Saigon South and Hanoi cohorts.
  • Monitor student progression, retention, success, satisfaction, complaints, feedback and risks, and lead program-level strategies to address identified issues.
  • Support student engagement with industry, community projects, exhibitions, competitions, applied learning opportunities, international opportunities and employability initiatives.
  • Ensure students experience the program as coherent, well-managed, academically rigorous, professionally relevant and aligned across delivery locations.

Staff Leadership and Development

  • Provide academic leadership and line management to Associate Program Managers and academic staff teaching into the program, fostering a collegial, collaborative and high-performing culture.
  • Lead workload planning in alignment with program needs, financial sustainability, staff capability, individual development plans and the School workforce plan.
  • Support mentoring and capability building in teaching, curriculum design, assessment, research, scholarship, creative practice, industry engagement and academic leadership.
  • Ensure Associate Program Managers and senior staff have clear delegated responsibilities and are supported to contribute effectively to program leadership.
  • Foster a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion, academic excellence and continuous improvement within the program.

Industry, Engagement and Promotion

  • Build and sustain strong industry, community, alumni and professional partnerships relevant to Bachelor of Design (Digital Media) disciplines.
  • Build partnerships that contribute to curriculum relevance, student experience, graduate outcomes, research, creative practice, external engagement and program reputation.
  • Contribute to program marketing, recruitment and promotion in collaboration with RMIT Vietnam Marketing and Engagement teams.
  • Represent the program internally and externally to support reputation, growth and strategic positioning.
  • Ensure industry and community engagement is embedded meaningfully across the program through applied projects, exhibitions, competitions, internships, guest lectures, partnerships, live briefs, public-facing outcomes and other forms of authentic learning.

Research, Scholarship and Creative Practice

  • Maintain an active profile in research, scholarship of teaching and learning, and/or creative practice appropriate to the level of appointment.
  • Provide leadership for the research, scholarship, creative practice and/or scholarship of teaching and learning trajectory of the Bachelor of Design (Digital Media) program, aligned with School priorities and appropriate to the academic level of appointment.
  • Contribute to the School’s research culture and priorities, including supervision where eligible, collaborative projects, publications, creative practice outputs, industry-engaged projects, external partnerships, exhibitions, public outcomes and dissemination.
  • Mentor staff to build research, scholarship, creative practice, supervision, publication, industry-engaged and impact-oriented profiles appropriate to their academic level and discipline.
  • Identify and support opportunities for external income, research funding, consultancy, industry-funded projects, creative practice partnerships and community-engaged research relevant to the Bachelor of Design (Digital Media).

Financial, Operational and Resource Management

  • Contribute to program-level budgeting, financial planning, load planning, staffing projections, resource allocation and operational decision-making in consultation with the Dean, Deputy Deans and relevant professional teams.
  • Monitor program performance in relation to student load, enrolments, retention, progression, staffing, delivery costs, workload, resource needs and contribution to School sustainability.
  • Ensure effective planning and use of teaching spaces, studios, equipment, technical resources, learning materials and other physical and digital resources required for high-quality design education.
  • Identify risks, pressures and opportunities related to program delivery, staffing, student numbers, resources, facilities and financial sustainability, and propose evidence-based solutions.
  • Work with relevant School and University teams to ensure the program is appropriately resourced and operationally well-managed across all delivery locations.

Service and Governance

  • Contribute to School, College and University committees, working groups and academic governance activities.
  • Actively contribute to the collegial life of the School and broader University community.
  • Lead or contribute to program amendments, course amendments, program review, annual reporting, quality assurance, academic governance and risk management processes.
  • Work in alignment with RMIT’s Academic Expectations and Development Framework, RMIT Values, the RMIT Leadership Model, and relevant policies and procedures.

KEY SELECTION CRITERIA

  • Relevant PhD or equivalent doctoral qualification from a recognised institution is preferred. Candidates without a PhD may be considered where they demonstrate equivalent senior academic, professional, creative practice, industry and/or leadership experience relevant to the role.
  • Minimum of five years' teaching experience of relevant programs/courses at undergraduate level.
  • Senior academic and/or professional experience in design, digital media, creative practice or at least one of the specialisms within the program.
  • Proven success in program leadership, marketing, promotion, innovation, quality assurance, curriculum renewal, student experience and multi-campus delivery.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a large or complex academic program, including responsibility for curriculum coherence, academic quality, staffing, workload planning, student outcomes, operational planning and financial sustainability.
  • Demonstrated capacity to manage academic and professional teams and contribute to a collaborative, collegial and productive workplace.
  • Demonstrated understanding of program-level financial, operational and resource management, including student load, staffing, workload planning, resource allocation, facilities and contribution to School sustainability.
  • Demonstrated experience in and understanding of financial, governance and quality management systems within a University.
  • Demonstrated experience leading curriculum development, review, renewal and mapping, including alignment of Program Learning Outcomes, Course Learning Outcomes, assessment, moderation, graduate capabilities and quality assurance processes.
  • Demonstrated range of skills relating to the conceptualisation, execution and evaluation of courses, including the capability and competence to teach a range of program-relevant courses.
  • Evidence of a research, scholarship, creative practice, industry-engaged and/or scholarship of teaching and learning profile appropriate to the level of appointment, with capacity to contribute to and support the research and engagement trajectory of the program.
  • Demonstrated ability to build and sustain industry, community, alumni and professional partnerships that enhance curriculum, student experience, graduate outcomes, research, creative practice and program reputation.
  • Demonstrated high level of interpersonal, communication and negotiating skills, including the ability to consult with senior executives and external bodies, produce executive reports, and negotiate agreed directions, outcomes and targets within a collaborative environment.
  • Proven ability as an effective member of a management team that develops and achieves shared goals and objectives.
  • Ability to display appropriate behaviours in line with the position, RMIT Values and RMIT Leadership Model.

Additional level-specific expectations

For appointment at Academic Level C, candidates should demonstrate an emerging nationally recognised profile in research, scholarship, creative practice, industry-engaged practice and/or scholarship of teaching and learning, with evidence of outputs, impact and leadership potential.

For appointment at Academic Level D, candidates should demonstrate a recognised national and/or international profile in research, scholarship, creative practice, industry-engaged practice and/or scholarship of teaching and learning, including evidence of senior academic leadership, outputs, partnerships, supervision where applicable, income generation and/or impact.


HOW TO APPLY

To be considered for this role, it is mandatory to submit both a resume and a cover letter. Please click on the 'Apply' link provided in this Job Ads to initiate the application process.

Please note that we will be running a rolling recruitment process, so please apply as soon as possible.


COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS

All academic appointments at RMIT Vietnam must meet University and local regulatory requirements, including English proficiency, background checks, and (for international candidates) eligibility for a work permit.

English is the language of teaching and communication at RMIT Vietnam. For this role, the minimum requirement is IELTS (Academic) with a score of at least 7.0 with no competency less than 6.5 (or equivalent, as outlined in the Recruitment, Selection and Onboarding Guidelines).

Further guidance will be provided during the recruitment process.


RMIT UNIVERSITY COMMITMENT

RMIT is committed to the rights of students and staff to be safe, respected, valued, and treated as an equal in their place of study and work. All staff are expected to share this commitment and contribute to a safer community. While carrying out their role, staff are in a position of trust with students. Staff have a duty of care to report wellbeing concerns about students through the designated channels and uphold the code of conduct. RMIT Vietnam expects all staff members to comply with its Code of Conduct, policies and procedures, which relate to legal and regulatory requirements and our ways of working.

  • Please ensure that your application is submitted through our Workday system on the RMIT Careers page. We do not accept applications through other means.
  • RMIT Vietnam will never request any fees or payments during the application process. Be vigilant about scams asking for payment to apply.
  • For any questions or support, feel free to reach out to Viet Nguyen- Senior TA Advisor at nguyen.vanviet@rmit.edu.vn

title: Vikarierande Officiell Veterinär till Kalmar, deltid
description:
Vill du arbeta med djurskydd och livsmedelssäkerhet, med stöd av kompetenta och hjälpsamma kollegor? Vill du ha en arbetsgivare som satsar på ett hållbart medarbetarskap och erbjuder trygga, förmånliga arbetsvillkor?

En hållbar anställning

Livsmedelsverket jobbar aktivt för att erbjuda alla medarbetare en hållbar anställning. Vi ger dig en god introduktion när du börjar hos oss och vi erbjuder trygga arbetsvillkor och goda förmåner. Vi vill att du ska känna att det är roligt att gå till jobbet, och att det du gör är viktigt. Som officiell veterinär bidrar du till att Sverige har ett gott djurskydd och säkra livsmedel. Som veterinär på Livsmedelsverket har du ett självständigt arbete, men inför svåra beslut och situationer finns dina kunniga kollegor bara ett samtal bort. Här blir du del av ett team där vi hjälps åt och stöttar varandra i det dagliga arbetet. Det är tillsammans vi gör skillnad!

Ett samhällsviktigt uppdrag

Som officiell veterinär bidrar du till att Sverige har ett gott djurskydd och säkra livsmedel. I arbetet ansvarar du för levandedjursbesiktning och besiktning efter slakt. Du arbetar för att upptäcka eventuella brister i djurskyddet, genom att granska djuren som kommer till slakteriet och hur företagens anställda hanterar djuren. Du säkerställer att djuren är friska på både individ och flocknivå, och bedömer huruvida köttet efter slakt kan godkännas som livsmedel.

Som myndighetsperson har du ett viktigt uppdrag gentemot företagaren. Du har en kontrollfunktion, men ska också agera stöd och underlätta för företagaren att göra rätt. Det gör du genom att informera om vad ett bra djurskydd innebär, om djurens behov och artspecifika egenskaper och genom att hjälpa till att skapa en förståelse för hygien och livsmedelssäkerhet i livsmedelsproduktionen.

Om teamet och anställningen

Du kommer att tillhöra team Kalmar, med placering i Kalmar. Här arbetar du tillsammans med 15 engagerade, hjälpsamma och trevliga kollegor, både officiella veterinärer och livsmedelskontrollanter. Det kommer alltid finnas en kunnig kollega i tjänst att rådfråga vid behov. Det finns möjlighet att kombinera jobbet hos oss med annan anställning/sysselsättning som inte är i konflikt med Livsmedelsverkets uppdrag.

Dina kompetenser

Du har svensk veterinärlegitimation samt god administrativ förmåga och goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift. Du förstår och kan göra dig förstådd på engelska. B-körkort är ett krav. Du behöver ha aktuell erfarenhet av AM och PM-besiktning.

Som person behöver du vara självgående och kunna ta egna välgrundade beslut och initiativ. Du är trygg i dig själv och de beslut du fattar. Samtidigt ställer tjänsten höga krav på god samarbetsförmåga, då det är tillsammans med ditt team som du lyckas och utvecklas. Samråd med företagare och andra intressenter är också en central del av arbetet, vilket kräver att du är tydlig och lyhörd i din kommunikation. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Välkommen att kontakta oss

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-11-09. Du ansöker via platsannonsen på https://www.livsmedelsverket.se/om-oss/jobba-hos-oss/lediga-jobb

Om du vill veta mer om tjänsten är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande teamchef Marie Johansson. Representant för Saco-S är Amar Ajwad och för ST Ronny Holmqvist samtliga nås via vår växel, tel. 018-17 55 00.

Mer information om tjänsten

Anställningsform: Vikariat, februari-december

Omfattning: 40% av heltid

Tillträde: 1 februari 2027

Organisationstillhörighet: Avdelning livsmedelskontroll/enheten för Livsmedelskontroll i mellersta Sverige

Diarienummer: 2026/03519

Inför intervju

Veterinärlegitimation, relevanta betyg samt ID-handling som styrker din ansökan tas med vid eventuell intervju. Vi kommer även efterfråga referenser.

Mer om Livsmedelsverket

Livsmedelsverket arbetar för att maten som produceras, säljs och serveras i Sverige ska vara säker och ärlig, för ett samhälle där det är lätt för människor att äta på ett hälsosamt och hållbart sätt, och en trygg livsmedels- och dricksvattenförsörjning i vardag och kris. Våra verktyg är kunskap, råd, regler och kontroll. Totalt är vi cirka 700 medarbetare, varav drygt 390 i Uppsala och ytterligare ca 300 som arbetar med livsmedelskontrollen ute i landet

title: Security Systems Programmer | Access Control & CCTV Surveillance
description:
Security Systems Programmer | Access Control & Video Surveillance

Building Technology Solutions | Dallas-Fort Worth, TX


DataVox is hiring an experienced Security Systems Programmer to join our Building Technology Solutions team in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.

This role is ideal for a physical security professional who enjoys the technical side of the industry: programming, configuring, commissioning, integrating, and troubleshooting access control, video surveillance/CCTV, intrusion detection, and related IP-based security systems.

For more than 30 years, DataVox has delivered technology solutions across Texas, specializing in Physical Security, Audio Visual Solutions, Network Cabling, Data Center & Network Technologies, Network Security, IT Support Services, and Communications Solutions.

If you have hands-on security installation experience and have progressed into system programming, configuration, troubleshooting, and commissioning, we want to hear from you.

What You'll Do

As a Security Systems Programmer, you'll help ensure our customers' physical security systems are properly programmed, integrated, tested, commissioned, and performing as designed.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Program, configure, commission, and troubleshoot access control, video surveillance/CCTV, intrusion detection, and integrated physical security systems
  • Configure and support enterprise-level access control and video management systems (VMS)
  • Evaluate and troubleshoot security system hardware, software, databases, and network connectivity
  • Perform system programming and final adjustments through project completion and commissioning
  • Install and configure complete turnkey security systems, including software and hardware
  • Diagnose communication, network, hardware, and software issues
  • Troubleshoot system and network-related issues remotely with customers, manufacturers, and vendors
  • Troubleshoot database-related issues in coordination with internal and customer teams
  • Configure remote connectivity and ISP/network connections for customer security systems
  • Install and troubleshoot field devices, including electric strikes, magnetic locks, REX devices, door contacts, cameras, controllers, and power supplies
  • Work with Project Managers to coordinate programming, installation, testing, and commissioning activities
  • Assist with material procurement and communicate project workforce needs
  • Maintain accurate installation and project tracking documentation
  • Prepare customer training materials and provide system training
  • Verify overall system functionality and performance before project completion
  • Update or modify scripts used to automate server-based functions, when applicable

What We're Looking For

You bring hands-on knowledge of both the field installation and technical programming sides of physical security systems.

Successful candidates will have:

  • 3+ years of Security Installer Technician and/or Security Service Technician experience
  • Hands-on experience with access control, CCTV/video surveillance, intrusion detection, and/or identity management systems
  • Experience programming, configuring, troubleshooting, or commissioning physical security systems
  • Working knowledge of IP networking, LAN/WAN environments, TCP/IP, PCs, servers, and network-connected security devices
  • Experience installing and troubleshooting electric strikes, mag locks, REX devices, contacts, cameras, controllers, and power supplies
  • Strong understanding of electronics, door and locking hardware, alarm devices, CCTV technology, and card access systems
  • Ability to troubleshoot systems at the component level and use diagnostic equipment such as a multimeter
  • Ability to troubleshoot integrated hardware, software, database, and network issues
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills
  • Strong communication and customer-service skills
  • Ability to work effectively with customers, technicians, Project Managers, vendors, and manufacturers
  • Ability to successfully complete required security and background checks

Required Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED
  • 3+ years of physical security installation and/or service experience
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the appropriate Texas DPS security license/registration
  • Ability to work assigned schedules and travel to customer/job sites as required
  • Ability to work with multiple manufacturers' security platforms and systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Trade school certificate or associate degree in Electronics, Information Technology, Networking, Security Technology, or a related technical field
  • Manufacturer certifications or hands-on experience with platforms such as:
    • Genetec
    • LenelS2
    • Brivo
    • Verkada
    • DMP
    • Axis
    • Bosch
    • Video Insight
    • HID
  • Experience with access control programming, VMS configuration, CCTV systems, intrusion systems, physical security integrations, and system commissioning
  • Experience updating or modifying scripts used to automate server-based functions

Don't check every box? If you have strong physical security experience and solid programming, commissioning, networking, or troubleshooting skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits That Support You and Your Family

DataVox offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support you at every stage of life:

  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Company-Paid Life Insurance
  • Company-Paid Long-Term Disability Insurance
  • Matching 401(k) and Roth Retirement Plans
  • Sponsored 529 College Savings Plan
  • Professional Development Reimbursement
  • Paid Vacation, Sick Time & Company Holidays

A Culture That Brings People Together

At DataVox, our culture is built around connection, collaboration, recognition, and growth. We invest in our employees and create opportunities for people to build their skills, strengthen relationships, and make an impact.

You'll find:

  • An encouraging environment focused on professional development and career growth
  • Team and company events, including social gatherings, sporting events, and seasonal celebrations
  • Employee Appreciation Days and recognition programs
  • An Employee Engagement Committee focused on company events, appreciation initiatives, and community involvement
  • Opportunities to connect with coworkers across teams and locations

At DataVox, you're not just joining another project. You're joining a team that values technical expertise, collaboration, and doing great work for our customers.

Physical Requirements

This position requires the ability to perform work in both office and active job-site environments.

Employees may be required to:
