title: VP Major and Planned Giving
description:
Location Address:

9521 San Mateo NE
Albuquerque, NM 87113-2237


Summary:

Presbyterian Healthcare Foundation seeks a strategic fundraising leader to serve as its next Vice President, Major & Planned Giving. This role represents a unique opportunity to build upon a period of significant momentum and help shape the next chapter of philanthropy at Presbyterian.

Over the past two years, the Foundation has increased philanthropic revenue by more than 25 percent and is positioned for continued growth as it expands fundraising capacity, strengthens donor engagement, and prepares for future campaign opportunities. The Vice President will lead the Foundation's most critical fundraising function, overseeing a major and planned giving program that generates approximately 80 percent of annual philanthropic revenue and serves as the primary engine for transformational giving.

This role succeeds a highly respected long-tenured leader and offers the opportunity to inherit an established, successful fundraising program with a strong reputation, engaged donor base, and experienced team. The successful candidate will honor and preserve the strengths of the current program while helping evolve major gifts, planned giving, grateful patient fundraising, physician engagement, and campaign readiness to support the Foundation's next phase of growth.

As a member of the Foundation's senior leadership team, this executive will play a central role in advancing philanthropy in support of Presbyterian's mission. The Vice President will lead a team of major gift and planned giving professionals, oversee the Luminary Circle program, manage a portfolio of highly qualified donors and prospects, and partner closely with physicians, advanced practice providers, executives, board members, volunteers, and community leaders to deepen philanthropic engagement and expand the Foundation's impact.

This role is both strategic and highly fundraising-focused. The Vice President is expected to serve as a player-coach, providing leadership to the team while maintaining an active fundraising portfolio and personally securing major and planned gifts.

The ideal candidate is a highly relational fundraising executive with a demonstrated ability to secure six- and seven-figure gifts, build high-performing teams, navigate organizational change, and create sustainable fundraising growth. Healthcare philanthropy experience is preferred; however, exceptional fundraising leaders from higher education, academic medicine, or other sophisticated fundraising environments will also be considered.

Job Description:

Major & Planned Giving Strategy

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for major gifts, planned giving, grateful patient philanthropy, and donor engagement.
  • Establish fundraising goals, performance metrics, and portfolio strategies that support continued philanthropic growth.
  • Lead long-term planning for major gifts, principal gifts, estate gifts, and campaign readiness efforts.
  • Ensure alignment between fundraising priorities, organizational strategy, and community needs.
  • Identify opportunities to expand philanthropic support across Presbyterian Healthcare Services.

Fundraising Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of major gift and planned giving professionals.
  • Provide coaching, mentoring, portfolio management guidance, and accountability to gift officers.
  • Foster a culture of relationship-based fundraising excellence, collaboration, and results.
  • Establish consistent portfolio review, prospect strategy, and performance management processes.
  • Support professional growth and succession planning within the fundraising team.

Personal Fundraising Portfolio

  • Maintain an active portfolio of approximately 100 major and planned gift prospects.
  • Identify, qualify, cultivate, solicit, and steward high-capacity donors.
  • Personally secure six-figure, seven-figure, and transformational gifts.
  • Develop customized engagement and solicitation strategies for key prospects.
  • Partner with executives, physicians, board members, and volunteers to advance donor relationships and gift opportunities.

Planned Giving Leadership

  • Serve as the Foundation's lead planned giving strategist and subject matter expert.
  • Expand awareness of charitable planning opportunities throughout Presbyterian's service area.
  • Develop and execute strategies to increase planned gift commitments and legacy society membership.
  • Cultivate and steward donors interested in bequests, charitable remainder trusts, charitable gift annuities, beneficiary designations, and other gift-planning vehicles.
  • Build relationships with attorneys, CPAs, trust officers, wealth advisors, and other professional advisors.
  • Develop marketing and educational materials that increase awareness and participation in planned giving.

Grateful Patient & Physician Engagement

  • Lead Foundation efforts focused on grateful patient philanthropy.
  • Partner with physicians, advanced practice providers, and staff to identify and cultivate philanthropic opportunities.
  • Strengthen physician engagement in fundraising and donor stewardship efforts.
  • Develop systems that encourage referrals and deepen donor relationships.
  • Foster a culture of philanthropy throughout Presbyterian Healthcare Services.

Portfolio Strategy & Fundraising Operations

  • Partner with Foundation Operations leadership to ensure effective portfolio development and management.
  • Develop tools, resources, and reporting processes that support fundraising effectiveness.
  • Utilize fundraising analytics to improve prospect strategy and team performance.
  • Ensure appropriate pipeline development and donor movement through the fundraising cycle.
  • Promote disciplined and data-driven portfolio management.

Luminary Circle & Donor Stewardship

  • Provide executive oversight of the Luminary Circle patient navigation and amenities program.
  • Ensure exceptional donor stewardship and engagement experiences.
  • Oversee donor cultivation events, stewardship programs, salons, and recognition activities.
  • Participate in Foundation fundraising events and community engagement opportunities.
  • Strengthen donor retention and long-term philanthropic relationships.

Foundation Leadership & Community Engagement

  • Serve as an active member of the Foundation's senior leadership team.
  • Support strategic planning, budgeting, and organizational development initiatives.
  • Present fundraising results, pipeline updates, and strategic recommendations to executives and board members.
  • Represent Presbyterian Healthcare Foundation within philanthropic, healthcare, and community organizations.
  • Serve as an ambassador for Presbyterian's mission and philanthropic priorities.

Success Measures


Within the first 12–24 months, the Vice President will be expected to:

  • Successfully transition leadership of the major and planned giving program while maintaining team stability and fundraising performance.
  • Achieve personal fundraising goals through management of a portfolio of high-capacity donors and prospects.
  • Increase major and planned giving revenue while growing the number of six- and seven-figure gifts.
  • Expand physician and caregiver participation in grateful patient philanthropy initiatives.
  • Strengthen planned giving awareness, participation, and documented gift commitments.
  • Enhance campaign readiness and position the Foundation for future campaign success.
  • Improve portfolio management discipline, prospect qualification, and pipeline development.
  • Increase donor retention, stewardship effectiveness, and long-term engagement.
  • Strengthen community relationships and professional advisor networks.
  • Help position the Foundation to exceed its long-term fundraising growth objectives.

Additional Job Description:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • Professional Experience: 10+ years of professional fundraising experience, including:
  • Securing six- and seven-figure major gifts
  • Closing gifts involving complex/non-cash assets
  • Planned giving, including life-income vehicles
  • Leadership Experience: 3–5 years of experience managing staff in a complex, hierarchical environment.
  • Industry Experience: Fundraising experience in healthcare (hospital or health system) or higher education (college or university).
  • Certifications: Not required; CFRE, FAHP, and gift planning certifications preferred.


Benefits
Benefits are effective day-one (for .45 FTE and above) and include:

  • Competitive salaries
  • Full medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Free wellness programs
  • Paid time off (PTO)
  • Retirement plans, including matching employer contributions
  • Continuing education and career development opportunities
  • Life insurance and short/long term disability programs

About Us
Presbyterian Healthcare Services is a locally owned, not-for-profit healthcare system of nine hospitals, a statewide health plan and a growing multi-specialty medical group. Founded in New Mexico in 1908, it is the state's largest private employer with approximately 11,000 employees.

Presbyterian's story is really the story of the remarkable people who have chosen to work here. Starting with Reverend Cooper who began our journey in 1908, the hard work of thousands of physicians, employees, board members, and other volunteers brought Presbyterian from a tiny tuberculosis sanatorium to a statewide healthcare system, serving more than 700,000 New Mexicans.

We are part of New Mexico's history - and committed to its future. That is why we will continue to work just as hard and care just as deeply to serve New Mexico for years to come.

About New Mexico
New Mexico's unique blend of Spanish, Mexican and Native American influences contribute to a culturally rich lifestyle. Add in Albuquerque's International Balloon Fiesta, Los Alamos' nuclear scientists, Roswell's visitors from outer space, and Santa Fe's artists, and you get an eclectic mix of people, places and experiences that make this state great.

Cities in New Mexico are continually ranked among the nation's best places to work and live by Forbes magazine, Kiplinger's Personal Finance, and other corporate and government relocation managers like Worldwide ERC.

New Mexico offers endless recreational opportunities to explore, and enjoy an active lifestyle. Venture off the beaten path, challenge your body in the elements, or open yourself up to the expansive sky. From hiking, golfing and biking to skiing, snowboarding and boating, it's all available among our beautiful wonders of the west.

AA/EOE/VET/DISABLED. PHS is a drug-free and tobacco-free employer with smoke free campuses.

title: Unblinded CRA I (Scotland, North of England)
description:
Join our sponsor-dedicated team as an Unblinded Clinical Research Associate I, supporting clinical trials across the UK and Ireland, with a particular focus on Scotland and the North of England.

In this role, you will be responsible for unblinded monitoring activities, primarily monitoring pharmacies at clinical trial sites across Scotland and the North of England, with the possibility of supporting additional sites across the UK and Ireland. We are looking for CRAs with at least 1 year of independent monitoring experience who are confident managing site activities and Investigational Product oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform unblinded monitoring activities in line with ICH-GCP guidelines, applicable regulations and study requirements, including Investigational Product oversight
  • Independently monitor assigned pharmacies at clinical trial sites, with a focus on Scotland and the North of England
  • Ensure protocol compliance, data integrity and patient safety across assigned sites
  • Maintain accurate and complete study documentation, including eTMF and relevant regulatory documentation
  • Build strong working relationships with site and pharmacy staff and act as the primary point of contact for assigned pharmacy monitoring activities
  • Contribute to audit and inspection readiness at site level

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience
  • At least 1 year of independent clinical trial monitoring experience as a CRA
  • Good understanding of ICH-GCP guidelines and clinical trial processes
  • Knowledge of or interest in unblinded monitoring and Investigational Product management
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly to clinical trial sites/pharmacies across Scotland and the North of England, as well as other locations across the UK and Ireland when required

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work in a sponsor-dedicated environment
  • Exposure to unblinded monitoring activities and Investigational Product oversight
  • Structured onboarding and ongoing development
  • Inclusive and collaborative working environment

If you have at least one year of independent monitoring experience and are interested in developing your experience within unblinded clinical trial monitoring, we’d love to hear from you!

title: Global Logistics Specialist
description:
Global Logistics Specialist

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.


As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.


As a Global Logistics Specialist at ICON, you will play a key role in supporting and optimizing global logistics operations for clinical trials. You will provide logistics expertise and oversight across the movement of laboratory kits, clinical samples and other study-related materials, helping to ensure reliable, compliant and cost-effective transportation across ICON’s global network.

Working with regional logistics teams, couriers, suppliers, laboratories and internal stakeholders, you will help develop effective logistics solutions, monitor performance, resolve complex issues and drive continuous improvement across global clinical trial logistics.

What You Will Do

Key responsibilities include:

  • Provide specialist logistics support and oversight across global clinical trial studies and sponsor accounts, helping ensure logistics requirements are understood, planned and implemented effectively.
  • Support study start-up activities, including logistics requirement gathering, courier selection and setup, shipping-process design and development of appropriate logistics strategies.
  • Provide expertise relating to the transportation of clinical samples, laboratory kits and other study-related materials across domestic and international markets.
  • Support complex import/export and customs requirements, working with regional teams, couriers, customs brokers and other stakeholders to facilitate compliant movement of clinical trial materials.
  • Monitor courier and logistics performance, service levels and operational trends to identify risks, recurring issues and opportunities to improve quality, service and cost.
  • Act as a logistics subject matter expert, supporting the resolution and escalation of complex transportation, courier, customs and operational issues.
  • Build effective relationships with couriers, logistics providers, laboratories and internal stakeholders to ensure logistics solutions meet operational and study requirements.
  • Use logistics data and performance metrics to identify trends, support root-cause analysis and develop practical, data-driven recommendations.
  • Support sponsor inquiries, operational reviews and client discussions relating to logistics capabilities, performance and study-specific requirements.
  • Drive and support logistics process improvements, standardization and global initiatives designed to improve service, quality, efficiency and cost effectiveness.
  • Provide guidance and knowledge sharing to regional logistics teams, helping strengthen logistics capability and consistent application of processes globally.
  • Maintain appropriate documentation and ensure logistics activities are conducted in accordance with applicable regulations, ICON procedures and quality requirements.

Your Profile

You will bring strong practical logistics experience, ideally gained within the pharmaceutical, medical, healthcare or clinical research industry, together with the ability to operate effectively in a complex global environment.

Required qualifications and experience:

  • Strong relevant logistics or supply chain experience.
  • Demonstrated logistics experience within the medical, pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences industry. Experience specifically within the clinical trial environment would be a significant advantage.
  • Strong practical understanding of international transportation, courier operations, import/export processes, customs requirements and global logistics networks.
  • Experience working with logistics providers, couriers and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve complex operational issues.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using logistics data and performance measures to identify trends, risks and opportunities for improvement.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and take ownership of complex logistics issues in a fast-paced global environment.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to engage effectively with operational teams, suppliers, senior stakeholders and clients.
  • A tertiary qualification in Logistics, Supply Chain Management or a related discipline is preferred.
  • Experience with Microsoft Office and data/reporting tools used to analyze operational performance.
  • Willingness to travel as required, approximately 10%.

#LI-SA2


Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.


Rewards & Benefits

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.


Benefits may include:

  • Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
  • Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
  • Retirement and pension plans
  • Life assurance and disability coverage
  • Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
  • Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.

title: Intern Backend Developer
description:
Job Description:

Skywise is a leading digital services company, wholly owned by Airbus. We deliver a first-of-its-kind offer that seamlessly integrates Planning & Operations Control, Flight, Technical, and Ground Operations. By providing interoperable digital solutions for end-to-end operations, Skywise combines aircraft manufacturer expertise and digital know-how to transform operational complexity into predictable and profitable performance, ensuring resilient and more sustainable operations.

As a Backend Software Development Intern, you’ll join our engineering team to contribute directly to high-performance Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) and scalable microservices that power modern aviation operations. You will help build, test, and maintain cloud-based backend systems that process critical aviation data, playing an active role in solving complex technical challenges while advancing digital transformation across Airbus.


The primary objective of this internship is to build practical expertise in digital technologies, management, business processes, and operations through hands-on participation in Software Factory projects, while applying Airbus Group standards. Within the Software Factory department, candidates will develop expertise in backend software engineering, Object-Oriented Design, cloud architectures, automated testing methodologies, and Agile software development lifecycles.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain clean, performant .NET (C#) code across cloud-hosted microservices and technical tooling.
  • Write unit, component, and functional tests to enforce quality standards and maintain application reliability.
  • Participate in code reviews and apply core architecture principles (e.g., SOLID and clean code) to elevate codebase health.
  • Collaborate within an Agile team to investigate defects, debug issues, and deploy feature fixes.
  • Create and update comprehensive technical documentation for internal software systems and databases.
  • Communicate daily project progress, roadblocks, and solutions clearly with team members.

Must Haves:

  • Being a student in the final years of university studies (preferred fields of study: Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline).
  • Being available for 30–40 hours per week.
  • Sound understanding of Object-Oriented Programming principles with practical experience in C# / .NET.
  • Basic knowledge of relational databases and Object-Relational Mapping tools.
  • Academic or practical exposure to Representational State Transfer (REST) Web APIs.
  • Familiarity with version control concepts (such as Git) and software testing principles.
  • Strong problem-solving mindset with fluent spoken and written English skills.

Software/Technologies You’ll Use:

  • C# / .NET
  • Git / GitHub / GitLab
  • Relational Databases (SQL) & Object-Relational Mappers (e.g., Entity Framework)
  • Testing frameworks (NUnit, XUnit, or MSTest)

Nice to Haves:

  • Exposure to cloud platforms (Amazon Web Services or Azure) or container technology (Docker).
  • Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) pipelines or Python automation.
  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks (e.g., Vue.js or JavaScript).
  • Interest in aviation systems or air navigation principles.

What we offer:

  • 12-Month Fixed-Term Employment Contract
  • Additional 3 days off during the holiday season (floater days)
  • Additional 1 day off for thesis defense

Recruitment Roadmap:

  • Application Review: Initial screening of resume and qualification fit.
  • Technical Interview: Virtual discussion covering basic software engineering concepts, project experience, and mutual culture fit.
  • Interview with the Hiring Manager: in person conversation with the team lead to discuss specific role expectations, team dynamics, and potential technical projects

title: Housing & Property Management Apprentice - Manchester
description:
Please note, this site is only for external candidate applications. If you currently work for Lloyds Banking Group please apply via the internal career site.

Please note: In order to complete an apprenticeship there needs to be a significant learning need. You need to consider your previous qualifications or significant relevant work experience which may mean you cannot proceed with this application.

End Date

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Job Description Summary

Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the programmes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Our apprenticeship programmes may close early if we receive a high number of applications, so it’s best to apply as soon as you can.

If you have any questions, please do contact the team at lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com


Job Description

Duration: 2 years

Salary: £27,400

Location: Manchester

Start: September 2027

Qualification: Level 3 Housing & Property Management apprenticeship

Build your future from the ground up
Our secret to keeping our properties safe, compliant and ready for customers to move in at any given time? The Lloyds Living Property Management (LLPM) team. They work with Lloyds Living and take care of it all – from supporting our customers through move-in and move-out to managing tenancies, maintaining the professionally managed homes, and helping everyone feel safe.

And as a Level 3 Housing & Property Management apprentice, you’ll get to be in the thick of the action.


The work you could be doing
Joining the LLPM team means it’ll be up to you to bring Lloyds Living to life for our customers every day. You’ll rotate through Lettings, and Customer Operations, and then Property Operations. And everything you do will give you hands-on experience on how homes are managed and customers are supported throughout their journey. You’ll also:

  • Get hands-on with helping customers find high-quality homes they can move into
  • Ensure all our properties are well looked after, and issues are resolved quickly
  • Bring your professionalism and care to every interaction
  • Gain first-hand insider knowledge on how professionally managed homes are run

Even better? You’ll also get to work with our charity partner, Regeneration Brainery, where you’ll support young people from diverse backgrounds to make a career in the property and regeneration sector.


The lesson before the leap
At the same time, you’ll be working towards your Level 3 Housing & Property Management apprenticeship with a dedicated training provider. You’ll build a solid foundation in how the housing sector operates, learn how to navigate tenancies and make customer experience your priority. But of course, that’s just the tip of the iceberg. You’ll also learn how to:

  • Manage a full tenancy lifecycle – from lettings and contracts through the end of tenancy
  • Navigate the inner workings of the legal and regulatory framework that governs landlord and tenant law
  • Keep houses safe by managing repairs and running regular maintenance work
  • Manage all stakeholders, including helping customers when a problem arises
  • Respond to real-world challenges like anti-social behaviour and supporting vulnerable customers

Your future. Fully backed
By the end of the apprenticeship, you’ll have:

  • Level 3 Housing & Property Management Apprenticeship (A-level equivalent)
  • Two Several years of real-world experience combined with classroom learning
  • Opportunity to progress or gain membership with professional bodies like ARLA Propertymark or the Chartered Institute of Housing (CIH)

Requirements

What you need to apply

  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old on 1st September 2027
  • 5 GCSEs grades 4-9 including English & Maths (achieved)

Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to three years.

Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.


Location
This programme is based in Manchester. With our hybrid policy, you’ll spend four days a week in the office with a young and dynamic team.


If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.


About working for us

Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 15th December.

Our roles generate a lot of interest, and occasionally we need to close applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!

If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days (Monday – Friday).

What happens next?
Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in February → Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.

About the position:


As a Data Engineer, you will support the design, development, testing, and deployment of data solutions that enable Digital Twin initiatives and enterprise analytics. You will work with senior data engineers, product teams, and business stakeholders to develop data pipelines, integrations, and data quality solutions across engineering systems and cloud platforms. This role provides an opportunity to build technical expertise in Facilities Engineering data, Digital Twin solutions, and Agile software delivery within the Oil & Gas industry.

Technical Skills:


Data Engineering


  • Working knowledge of the Azure data platform, including Azure Data Factory, Databricks, and cloud-based data solutions.
  • Proficiency in Python programming for data processing and automation.
  • Understanding of ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, and data modeling fundamentals.
  • Familiarity with data governance, data quality, and data profiling practices.
  • Experience developing reports, dashboards, or analytics solutions.
  • Understanding of DevOps practices, source control, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience working with SQL databases, REST APIs, data lakes, and other structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Knowledge of data integration and transformation techniques for engineering and operational data.

Facilities Engineering Data Services & Workflows


  • Support functional testing and unit testing of data pipelines, models, and data products.
  • Assist with implementation of data quality rules and resolution of data defects.
  • Familiarity with tag aliasing, entity resolution, and entity relationship management.
  • Basic understanding of tag-to-document associations and information management taxonomies (e.g., CFIHOS).
  • Support the creation and maintenance of data quality reports.
  • Perform data enrichment and augmentation activities to improve engineering datasets.
  • Assist in tag extraction and scraping activities from engineering documents.
  • Build and support API connectors for engineering and operational data sources.

Product Development


  • Assist with the design and maintenance of conceptual, logical, and physical data models.
  • Develop and support data pipelines, data validation rules, and testing activities.
  • Participate in Agile development processes including sprint planning, daily standups, and retrospectives.
  • Support requirements gathering, design, development, testing, and deployment of data solutions.
  • Apply data analytics techniques to support business decision-making.
  • Seek guidance from senior data engineers and actively participate in knowledge sharing and skill development activities.

Soft Skills:


Teamwork & Collaboration


  • Work effectively with business owners, analysts, product owners, data engineers, and other project team members.
  • Contribute to Agile delivery teams and support successful execution of sprint commitments.
  • Demonstrate a willingness to learn new tools, technologies, and business processes.

Communication


  • Effectively communicate technical information to team members and stakeholders.
  • Participate in requirements gathering sessions and discussions with business users.
  • Document technical solutions, data requirements, test results, and process improvements.

Problem Solving & Organization


  • Demonstrate strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Investigate data quality issues and support root cause analysis activities.
  • Manage assigned tasks effectively and deliver high-quality work within established timelines.
  • Support process improvement initiatives and identify opportunities for automation and efficiency.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
  • Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
  • Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
  • Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
  • Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

How to apply

To be a part of our success, click APPLY to submit your application. Chevron regrets that it is unable to sponsor employment Visas or consider individuals on time-limited Visa status for this position.

Privacy and Terms and Conditions

We respect the privacy of candidates for employment. This Privacy Notice sets forth how we will use the information we obtain when you apply for a position through this career site. If you do not consent to the terms of this Privacy Notice, please do not submit information to us.

Please access the Global Application Statements, select the country where you are applying for employment. By applying, you acknowledge that you have read and agree to the country specific statement.

Terms of Use

“ENGINE” refers to the Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center, which operates under Chevron Global Technology and Services Private Limited, an affiliate of Chevron Corporation. References to ENGINE in this document are for convenience only and do not denote a separate legal entity.

This job advertisement is intended to provide a general overview of the role and workplace environment. Role details and outcomes may vary based on business needs and individual performance.

title: Arbetsledare till LSS-gruppbostad på Fogdegatan 56
description:
Omsorgsgruppen söker en engagerad och strukturerad stödpedagog med ett kompletterande arbetsledaruppdrag till vår gruppbostad på Fogdegatan 5–6 i Linköping.

Är du en trygg och ansvarstagande person som brinner för att utveckla kvaliteten inom LSS? Har du god förmåga att organisera, samordna och stötta dina kollegor? Då kan detta vara rätt tjänst för dig!

Om verksamheten

Fogdegatan 5–6 är en gruppbostad enligt LSS där vi erbjuder individuellt anpassat stöd till personer med funktionsnedsättningar.

Vi arbetar för att skapa en trygg, meningsfull och självständig vardag för våra boende, där delaktighet, självbestämmande och respekt för individens behov står i centrum.

Om tjänsten

Du anställs som stödpedagog med ett särskilt tilläggsuppdrag som arbetsledare.

I din grundprofession som stödpedagog arbetar du med att utveckla det pedagogiska arbetet, säkerställa kvaliteten i omsorgen och vägleda kollegor i det dagliga arbetet.

Utöver detta får du ett arbetsledaruppdrag där du, i nära samarbete med verksamhetschefen, ansvarar för samordning, planering och uppföljning av verksamhetens dagliga arbete.

Arbetsuppgifter som stödpedagog:

  • Arbeta utifrån de boendes individuella behov, förutsättningar och genomförandeplaner.
  • Utveckla och kvalitetssäkra det pedagogiska arbetet.
  • Handleda och stötta kollegor i pedagogiska arbetssätt och metoder.
  • Ansvara för att genomförandeplaner och social dokumentation håller god kvalitet.
  • Främja de boendes självbestämmande, delaktighet och självständighet.
  • Delta i det dagliga omsorgsarbetet.


Arbetsuppgifter inom arbetsledaruppdraget:

  • Leda, fördela och samordna det dagliga arbetet.
  • Ansvara för daglig bemanningsplanering och hantering av korttidsfrånvaro.
  • Vara ett stöd för medarbetarna i verksamhetsrelaterade frågor.
  • Säkerställa att rutiner och arbetssätt efterlevs.
  • Samordna introduktion av nya medarbetare och vikarier.
  • Följa upp dokumentation, avvikelser och förbättringsåtgärder.
  • Bidra till en god arbetsmiljö och ett välfungerande samarbete i arbetsgruppen.
  • Utföra administrativa uppgifter i samråd med verksamhetschefen.
  • Ha en kontinuerlig dialog med verksamhetschefen kring verksamhetens behov och utveckling.


Arbetsledaruppdraget utförs på delegation och enligt överenskommelse med verksamhetschefen. Verksamhetschefen har det övergripande ansvaret för verksamheten.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har:

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning som stödpedagog eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig.
  • Erfarenhet av arbete inom LSS, gärna gruppbostad.
  • Goda kunskaper om LSS, social dokumentation och pedagogiska arbetsmetoder.
  • God organisatorisk förmåga och vana att arbeta självständigt.
  • God datorvana.
  • Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift.


Meriterande:

  • Tidigare erfarenhet av arbetsledning eller samordningsansvar.
  • Erfarenhet av schemaläggning och bemanningsplanering.
  • Erfarenhet av Treserva, Tidvis eller liknande system.
  • Erfarenhet av kvalitets- och utvecklingsarbete inom LSS.


Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är trygg, tydlig och ansvarstagande. Du har lätt för att skapa goda relationer, kommunicerar professionellt och har förmågan att motivera och vägleda andra.

Du är strukturerad, lösningsorienterad och har förmåga att prioritera även när verksamhetens behov snabbt förändras.

Som arbetsledare förväntas du vara en god förebild, bidra till ett positivt arbetsklimat och skapa förutsättningar för ett gott samarbete.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera det pedagogiska arbetet med ett utvecklande arbetsledaruppdrag. Du får en betydelsefull roll i verksamhetens dagliga arbete och möjlighet att bidra till utveckling, kvalitet och trygghet för både boende och medarbetare.

Anställningsinformation

Befattning: Stödpedagog med tilläggsuppdrag som arbetsledare

Arbetsgivare: Omsorgsgruppen IN AB

Placering: Fogdegatan 5–6, Linköping

Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse

Ansökan

Välkommen att skicka in ditt CV och personliga brev. Beskriv gärna din erfarenhet av LSS-verksamhet, pedagogiskt arbete och eventuella tidigare samordnings- eller arbetsledaruppdrag.

Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Community Health Assistant (Population Health)
description:
Love + medicine is who we are, it's what we do, it's why people want to work here. If you’re looking for a job to love, apply today.

Scheduled Weekly Hours:

40

We’re not just filling positions, we’re building careers. At Emplify Health, we care for our teams, while they care for their communities. Whether you are just starting out or looking for a change, Emplify Health supports you now and into the future. Join us and find out how a little empathy changes everything.



Emplify Health is seeking a Community Health Assistant to support innovative population health and community well-being initiatives across the communities we serve.


In this role, you'll collaborate with leaders, community partners, employers, and internal teams to advance health promotion efforts, address Social Drivers of Health (SDOH), and support programs that improve the well-being of patients, employees, and community members. If you enjoy building relationships, educating others, and making a meaningful impact through public health work, we'd love to hear from you.


Major Responsibilities Include:


  • Collaborate with the Community Health Improvement Manager on Social Drivers of Health (SDOH) screening and response initiatives, including volunteer programming requirements which may include but are not limited to recruitment, screening, training, performance evaluation, and supporting program needs through data management and collection.
  • Participate in the delivery of health promotion, community outreach, and health fair events by serving as an informational resource to participants and facilitating access to health education and support services. Distribute health education and promotional materials, answer routine participant questions, and connect individuals with appropriate organizational or community resources. Prepare and maintain event displays and booths with event-appropriate education materials and resources. May include early mornings, late evenings, and occasional weekends.
  • Conduct worksite biometric screenings, including point of care testing and health risk assessment consultations, maintaining an effective screening process that provides effective and user-friendly results for the individual and meaningful reporting for the employer. Assist in data collection and entry.
  • Provide support for employee well-being programs and initiatives through coordination and implementation of wellness activities, and engagement efforts. Collect, maintain, and analyze program data. Facilitate participant engagement at outreach events through the effective presentation of health education materials and resources.
  • Reinforce evidence-based health promotion messages and educational content developed by departmental staff. Collaborate with community health staff on Community Health Needs Assessment priorities, Implementation Plan initiatives, community benefit activities, and related reporting efforts.
  • Engages with patients, employees, and community members to support health promotion, education and access to resources in a professional manner, ensuring patient safety and privacy as appropriate.
  • Applies foundational knowledge of public health, population health, health promotion, behavior change, social drivers of health, and community engagement principles when performing assigned responsibilities.
  • Performs other job-related responsibilities as requested.
  • Adheres to regular and predictable attendance.

What's Available:

  • Full time, 1.0 FTE - 40 hours/ week
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday Days typically 8:00am-4:30pm. However, willingness to flex hours based on business related events necessary. Some events or responsibilities may include flexing your hours to work early mornings, evenings, or potentially some weekends.
  • Location: Onsite - based at our Front Street Office in La Crosse, WI; this role may have light local travel requirements
  • Starting pay of $22.90/hour plus more based on relevant work experience



What You'll Need:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in a health-related field
  • Experience: 1 year of experience in health education or public health in the worksite setting. Preference given for those with experience in point of care testing or use of other health screening equipment.
  • License/ Certification: Valid Driver's License, Required
  • Current Infant-Adult Basic Life Support for Health Care Providers (with hands on learning) from one of the following programs; American Heart Association or American Red Cross within three months of hire - Required
  • Experience conducting biometric screenings and point-of-care testing, preferred
  • Experience utilizing health screening equipment and interpreting screening results, preferred
  • Familiarity with public health principles, health promotion strategies, and community engagement.
  • Comfortable working in a variety of settings, including community events, employer worksites, and healthcare environments.
  • Strong interpersonal and relationship-building skills.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.



In addition to the rewarding work, you'll receive:

  • A highly adaptable and mission-driven organization with a work environment that supports you personally and professionally and a work culture where you are valued and appreciated
  • Competitive Benefits: A comprehensive and generous benefits package (Medical, Dental, Life Ins, HSA/FSA) ensuring your comfort and well-being as a valuable team member
  • Substantial retirement contribution including a 401k match & annual discretionary base contribution
  • Work-Life Balance: Paid Time Off (PTO) combines vacation, sick, and personal days into one balance to allow you the flexibility to use your time off as you need
  • Professional Development: Support for your career growth through Professional Development Opportunities, our Tuition Investment Program, and our Career Development Center
  • Additional Employee Discounts and Perks Other benefits include a Wellness program with incentives, employer-paid life insurance and AD&D, optional short-term and long-term disability coverage, an employee assistance program, identity theft protection, pet insurance, Inspire & Celebrate colleague recognition and rewards program, a discount program, and more!

PRACTICES AND PROMOTES BEHAVIOR CONSISTENT WITH THE MISSION, VISION AND VALUES:


Mission:

Together, we inspire your best life by relentlessly caring, learning and innovating.

Vision:

Leading with love, we courageously commit to a future of healthy people and thriving communities.

Values:

Belonging, Respect, Excellence, Accountability, Teamwork, Humility


Emplify Health is comprised of two of the Midwest’s most respected healthcare systems, Bellin Health and Gundersen Health System. Once neighbors, we are now partners, united in our mission to provide exceptional care to our communities. As a not-for-profit, patient-centered healthcare network, we have headquarters in Green Bay and La Crosse, Wisconsin. Our extensive network includes 11 hospitals and more than 100 clinics, serving 67 cities and rural communities across Wisconsin, Iowa, Minnesota and Michigan’s Upper Peninsula. With over 4,500 dedicated nurses and providers, we are committed to delivering primary, specialty and emergency care, along with innovative medical education programs. Join us in making a meaningful difference in the lives of our patients and communities

If you need assistance with any portion of the application or have questions about the position, please contact HR-Recruitment@gundersenhealth.org or call 608-775-0267.

title: Major Incident Management - Advisor II
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Major Incident Management - Advisor II

Advisor I, Major Incident Manager

Location: Chennai

Shift: 12 hours coverage in 2 shifts and only in Daytime [6 AM IST – 6 PM IST] [ 7 AM IST – 7 PM IST during day light savings]

Grade: 11

Job Profile Title: Incident Management – Advisor I

What does a successful Major Incident Manager II do at Fiserv?

You will lead high-pressure Major Incidents that are (or could) impact IT services, ensuring strong command and control, accurate real-time documentation, and coordinated actions that drive safe and timely service restoration. You will partner with IT Support and Business teams throughout the incident lifecycle, with a focus on P2/P3/P4 Major Incidents.

What you will do

- Provide strong command and control for Major Incidents, with frequent impact assessments and a focus on safe, timely client service restoration.

- Ensure real-time incident documentation in MIMIC (level-set and workstream tool), including fix attempts, infrastructure details (IP addresses, device names, etc.), and impact assessments (applications affected, clients impacted, impact types/amounts).

- Lead efforts for P3/P4 Major Incidents and serve as the focal point for MIMIC documentation on P1/P2 Major Incidents alongside a Major Incident Management SRT associate who drives command and control of the incident meeting.

- Perform thorough Post Incident Reviews (PIRs) for every Major Incident; ensure accurate and detailed incident synopses are provided by root cause owners and restoration teams.

- Identify opportunities/shortfalls and ensure they are documented as Problem Tasks (pTasks) for follow-up in the formal Problem Review process.

- Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure consistent communication and coordination throughout the Major Incident lifecycle.

- Support process improvement and Continual Service Improvement initiatives to streamline Major Incident Management execution.

What you will need to have

- 12+ years of experience working in a Major Incident Management organization with strong understanding of the Major Incident Management lifecycle.

- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills across multiple levels of the organization.

- Ability to remain calm, make decisions under pressure, and drive outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

- Proficiency with MS Office tools (Power BI, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams) and ServiceNow.

- Proficiency with Command Center technologies and software.

What would be great to have

- ITIL Foundation certification.

- Strong working knowledge of monitoring tools (Splunk, Dynatrace, ThousandEyes, Moogsoft, etc.).

- Strong working knowledge of financial transaction processing (authorization), monetary movement processing (Funding and Settlement), and digital/branch banking flows.

- Strong understanding of core infrastructure domains (compute, network/communications, storage/data management).

Working conditions

- Flexible shift support as required, which may include nights, weekends, and holidays.

- Fast-paced, high-stress environment requiring quick thinking, critical decision making and adaptability.

title: Utvecklingsledare till Teknik och serviceförvaltningen
description:
Unga, expansiva Bollebygd är en kommun med framtidspotential som präglas av en helhetssyn, hållbar utveckling och tillväxt. I kommunen är vi cirka 650 medarbetare och vi har några av Sveriges viktigaste uppdrag. Barns lärande, god vård och omsorg, hållbar samhällsutveckling och miljöfrågor är bara några exempel. Kommunen strävar efter att vara en attraktiv arbetsgivare där medarbetarskap och ledarskap präglas av delaktighet och påverkansmöjligheter.

I Bollebygd bor knappt 10 000 invånare. Endast 30 minuter från Göteborg, Borås och Alingsås ligger Bollebygd geografiskt bra till. Kommunen har ett rikt friluftsliv med skidbacke, vackra vandringsleder och golfbana i herrgårdsmiljö. Bollebygd har välutvecklade verksamheter med bra kvalitet och ett rikt näringsliv med över 1000 företagare. Läs gärna mer på bollebygd.se

Vill du vara med och utveckla arbetet på teknik och serviceförvaltningen i Bollebygd? Nu söker vi dig som vill ha en nyckelroll i en spännande, omfattande och komplex förvaltning med många kundorienterade tjänsteleveranser och politiska uppdrag. Nu tar vi tillsammans med dig utvecklingsarbetet till nästa nivå och söker därför en innovativ och trygg utvecklingsledare som kan leda arbetet i hela förvaltningen.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Du kommer vara placerad direkt under förvaltningschef och ingår i förvaltningens ledningsgrupp. I rollen är du metodstöd till förvaltningschef. Du omvärldsbevakar och samverkar inom och utanför förvaltningen i styr- och ledningsfrågor samt kvalitets- och verksamhetsutveckling. Genomförande av analyser och sammanställande av beslutsunderlag och utredningar ingår i rollen.

I tjänsten som utvecklingsledare kommer du stödja förvaltningschefen och förvaltningsledningen i arbetet med att leda, utveckla och styra förvaltningen genom lednings- och stödprocesser. I rollen ingår att arbeta förvaltningsövergripande med ansvar för att samordna arbetet med planering och uppföljning, riskhantering, intern kontroll och intern styrning i förvaltningen. Inom ramen för detta uppdrag ingår att utveckla systematiken i arbetet i syfte att säkerställa effektiva och kvalitetssäkrade processer tillsammans med förvaltningens chefer.

I tjänsten ingår flera varierande uppgifter bland annat:

	• Uppföljning av verksamhetens mål, processer och kvalitet
	• Omvärldsbevakning, verksamhetsutveckling och digitalisering
	• Kvalificerat stöd och rådgivning till förvaltningens chefer
	• Ansvar för förvaltningens arbetsprocess kring riskanalys och intern kontroll
	• Sammanställa rapporter
	• Genomföra utredningar och skriva remissvar till den politiska organisationen

KVALIFIKATIONER
Krav:

	• kandidatexamen från högskoleutbildning om minst 180 hp inom till exempel ekonomi, offentlig förvaltning, samhällsbyggnad eller annan inriktning som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant
	• flerårig erfarenhet inom ekonomi, offentlig förvaltning, samhällsbyggnad eller liknande inriktning
	• flerårig erfarenhet av att arbeta i politiskt styrd verksamhet
	• erfarenhet och intresse av hållbart förändrings- och utvecklingsarbete
	• B-körkort

Meriterande:

	• dokumenterad erfarenhet av att arbeta i Stratsys eller liknande verksamhetssystem
	• erfarenhet av liknande uppdrag inom samhällsbyggnad

Vi söker dig som kan arbeta självständigt, strukturerat och lösningsfokuserat med uppdraget. Du skapar engagemang och motivation i utvecklingsarbetet och har en god förmåga att stötta och vägleda chefer och medarbetare i omställningen. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du kunna samverka internt så väl som externt och vara bekväm att prata inför större grupper. 

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Löneform: Månadslön.
Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet: Tillsvidare, tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse.
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Registerkontroll utförs i enlighet med rådande lagstiftning. För dig som söker en tjänst som faller in under någon av de aktuella lagarna kommer du innan anställning att behöva uppvisa utdrag ur belastningsregister och i vissa fall misstankeregister.

Innan en eventuell anställning behöver du uppvisa giltigt pass eller nationellt ID för kontroll av id- och medborgarskap. Är du inte medborgare i Sverige, EU, EES eller Schweiz måste du kunna uppvisa ett giltigt uppehåll-/arbetstillstånd eller kunna styrka att du är undantagen från skyldigheten att ha arbetstillstånd.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Vi använder e-rekrytering för att effektivisera och kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsarbetet. Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Fyll därför i dina uppgifter så omsorgsfullt som möjligt för att ge en rättvisande bild av dig själv. Uppgifterna behandlas och sparas i enlighet med dataskyddsförordningen (GDPR). Har du har skyddade personuppgifter? Ring rekryterande chef för att få reda på fler ansökningsalternativ i stället för att skicka in en ansökan.

Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Manager, Compliance
description:
Join Our Team

We are looking for an experienced and engaging Manager, Compliance to lead a diverse and highly competent team supporting critical compliance and validation activities across the site Engineering at BNK site.


This is an excellent opportunity for a leader who thrives in a dynamic environment and enjoys working across multiple disciplines and stakeholder groups. In this role, you will be responsible for developing both people and processes while ensuring high levels of quality, compliance, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of specialists with diverse academic backgrounds and areas of expertise.
  • Ensure the timely execution of compliance activities across the BNK site.
  • Support the planning, execution, and lifecycle management of validation activities, including equipment, systems, processes, and periodic reviews.
  • Drive compliance initiatives and ensure adherence to GMP requirements and internal quality standards.
  • Oversee and support Change Requests, Deviations, CAPAs, risk assessments, and other quality system processes.
  • Collaborate closely with Production, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and other stakeholders.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvements and operational efficiencies.
  • Build and maintain a strong culture of quality, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Manage team resources, priorities, and competencies to ensure successful delivery of departmental objectives.

About the Team

The Compliance team consists of dedicated professionals with a broad range of academic backgrounds and technical expertise. The team supports a variety of activities related to validation, compliance, quality systems, and regulatory requirements, playing a key role in ensuring that BNK operates in accordance with internal standards and external regulations.


The department is known for its collaborative culture, strong knowledge sharing, and close partnerships across the organization.


Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Pharmacy, Biotechnology, Quality Management, or a related field.
  • Proven leadership experience, preferably within a GMP-regulated environment.
  • Solid understanding of compliance, validation, and quality management systems.
  • Experience with Change Control, Deviations, CAPAs, risk management, and continuous improvement activities.
  • Experience of internal and external Regulatory audits is an important pre-requisite
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to lead teams with diverse educational and professional backgrounds.
  • Structured, proactive, and solution-oriented approach to leadership.

Language Requirements

As the role requires close collaboration with both local and global stakeholders, fluency in English is required.


What We Offer

  • A leadership role with significant impact on quality, compliance, and business performance.
  • The opportunity to lead a highly skilled and diverse team of specialists.
  • A collaborative and supportive working environment with a wide range of stakeholders.
  • Professional and personal development opportunities within a growing organization.
  • The chance to contribute to continuous improvement and compliance excellence across the BNK site.

If you are passionate about people leadership, quality, and driving a strong compliance culture, we look forward to hearing from you.


Salary Package

Annual base salary range: DKK 738.810 –902.990 gross


Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and potential bonus opportunities.

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

Ready to help keep life-saving vaccines moving?

Apply through our designated application platform. Applications sent by email will not be considered.


We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.


Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

title: IAM-arkitekt till Axfood IT i Stockholm
description:
Axfood IT i Stockholm söker en IAM-arkitekt som vill modernisera vårt identitetslandskap, med stora teknikskiften framför oss.

Vi bygger vidare på ett etablerat IAM-landskap, där äldre plattformar successivt ersätts och nya lösningar tar plats. Som IAM-arkitekt får du ta ett helhetsgrepp om arkitekturen och vara med och sätta riktningen för den fortsatta utvecklingen från målbild till realisad lösning tillsammans med andra arkitekter och specialister.

Vi erbjuder dig

På Axfood IT arbetar nästan 400 medarbetare med att utveckla och förvalta koncernens IT-miljö. Här finns en stor bredd av teknisk kompetens och möjlighet att arbeta med frågor som spänner över flera delar av organisationen. Samtidigt är samarbetet nära och vägarna till beslut ofta kortare än man kanske förväntar sig i en organisation av vår storlek. Här får du bland annat:

  • Ett stort inflytande över vår framtida IAM-arkitektur, där flera viktiga teknikval fortfarande ligger framför oss
  • Möjligheten att arbeta med modern identitetshantering i en komplex IT-miljö med höga säkerhetskrav
  • Ett kunnigt och sammansvetsat team som delar med sig av sin kompetens och gärna utmanar varandras idéer
  • En arbetsplats som värnar om ett hållbart arbetsliv

Det här gör du hos oss

Som IAM-arkitekt ansvarar du för den övergripande arkitekturen inom identitets- och åtkomsthantering på Axfood IT. Du arbetar i en modern, molnbaserad miljö med Entra ID i centrum, samtidigt som du har ansvar för integrationen mot våra lokala system som MIM och SAP IDM. IAM-området omfattar hela bredden, från PAM och PKI till kundidentiteter (CIAM), och vi har redan tagit viktiga steg på resan mot en modernare teknikmiljö. I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Utveckla målarkitektur, principer och tekniska riktlinjer för IAM.
  • Utvärdera nya lösningar och göra tekniska vägval med hänsyn till säkerhet, integrationer och förvaltning.
  • Säkerställa att IAM-arkitekturen fungerar tillsammans med övrig infrastruktur och applikationer, bland annat i frågor som rör Zero Trust och ZTNA.
  • Vägleda team och projekt i IAM- och arkitekturfrågor och reda ut tekniska beroenden.

Ditt team och arbetsplats

Du blir en del av IAM-teamet inom enheten Core IT, som även omfattar teamen för nätverk och operativ säkerhet. Inom IAM arbetar vi med flera delar av identitets- och åtkomsthantering, från Microsofts identitetsplattformar och PAM till PKI och roll- och behörighetshantering inom SAP.

Som IAM-arkitekt arbetar du nära specialister inom dessa områden, men också tillsammans med kollegor inom nätverk, säkerhet och andra delar av infrastrukturen.

Mer om dig

Vi söker dig som har arbetat brett och på djupet inom IAM, med erfarenhet av att utforma arkitektur för identitetshantering, autentisering och behörighetsstyrning i komplexa IT-miljöer. Du förstår hur olika plattformar, protokoll och integrationer samverkar och har erfarenhet av att fatta tekniska beslut där säkerhet, förvaltningsbarhet och långsiktig utveckling behöver vägas samman.

Du är van att sätta tekniska riktlinjer och driva arkitekturella vägval. Vi tror också att du har en stark förankring i Microsofts identitetsplattformar, exempelvis Entra ID, och gärna erfarenhet av både on-prem- och molnmiljöer. Har du dessutom arbetat med större IAM-transformationer, PAM, PKI eller CIAM är det meriterande.

Vi tror att du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera tekniskt djup med ett större perspektiv. Du kan väga verksamhetens behov mot säkerhetskrav och tekniska förutsättningar, även när alla svar ännu inte finns på plats. Du är analytisk och strukturerad, men också lösningsorienterad och van att samarbeta med andra arkitekter, specialister och verksamheten för att komma vidare i komplexa frågor.

Axfood IT AB gör bakgrundskontroll vid samtliga rekryteringar. Läs mer på Axfoods hemsida här: https://www.axfood.se/karriar/din-karriarvag/sa-gar-det-till-nar-du-soker-jobb-hos-oss/.

Vår rekryteringsprocess innehåller tester, intervjuer, bakgrundskontroll och ID-kontroll. Observera att vi inte under denna rekryteringsprocess kommer be dig logga in med ditt Bank-id eller scanna någon QR-kod, men vi kommer be dig styrka din identitet i processens slutskede.

Så här får vi kontakt

I den här rekryteringen har vi valt att samarbeta med Ada Digital som strävar efter en transparent, inkluderande och snabbrörlig rekryterings- och konsultupplevelse. Vi vill veta mer om dig och din potential! Du söker tjänsten enkelt och behöver inte bifoga några dokument. Det räcker med en motivering till varför du söker tjänsten och om du saknar CV kan du bifoga din LinkedIn-profil. Följ sedan din ansökan live via vår hemsida. Urvalet sker löpande och tjänsten kan bli tillsatt före sista ansökningsdatum. Är du nyfiken och vill veta mer innan du söker? Hör av dig till ansvarig rekryterare. Vi ser fram emot att få kontakt med dig!

title: Pharmacovigilance Intern
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position


Responsabilidades principales


  • Desarrollar el proyecto de graduación asignado, asegurando su cumplimiento dentro del cronograma establecido y alineado con los objetivos de la organización.
  • Apoyar a los miembros de la unidad local de seguridad del paciente en la ejecución de procesos, monitoreando el desempeño y ayudando en la identificación de casos de incumplimiento, proponiendo acciones adecuadas para su resolución.
  • Apoyar a los miembros de la unidad local de seguridad del paciente en su participación en el desarrollo e implementación de la estrategia local de seguridad del paciente, colaborando con partes interesadas locales y globales para maximizar el impacto del equipo en la Pharma Vision.
  • Desarrollar el acercamiento como estudiante a la actividad laboral facilitando la obtención no sólo de con conocimiento en el área técnica, sino destrezas y habilidades blandas.

Responsabilidades clave:


Apoyar a los miembros de la unidad local de seguridad del paciente en su responsabilidad de habilitar un sistema de FV local, transparente y eficaz. Esto incluye brindar soporte en la ejecución operativa eficiente y de alta calidad de las actividades relacionadas con la seguridad relevantes para el sistema de FV, cuando se requiera. Las áreas clave de actividades que concuerdan con los procedimientos operativos estándar de Roche son las siguientes:

  • Informes de casos individuales de seguridad.
  • Gestión de informes de seguridad agrupados, acuerdos de farmacovigilancia y acuerdos de intercambio de datos de seguridad.
  • Manejo de riesgos y comunicación de seguridad (p. ej., comunicación directa con profesionales de la salud, problemas de seguridad emergentes)
  • Estudios, programas y otras actividades empresariales con implicaciones en cuanto a la seguridad del paciente y el cumplimiento de la FV (p. ej., CT intervencionales, NIS, PASS, PAES, MAP, PAA, CUP, PTAP)
  • Etiquetado de seguridad y compromisos de farmacovigilancia
  • Archivo maestro del sistema de farmacovigilancia local (cuando corresponda)
  • Apoyar a los miembros de la unidad local de seguridad del paciente en su responsabilidad de facilitar y promover la estrategia de seguridad del paciente.
  • Apoyar a los miembros de la unidad local de seguridad del paciente en su responsabilidad de catalizar la autogestión del equipo de seguridad del paciente de la filial

title: Commercial Partnerships Lead
description:
About us

Southern Cross Health Insurance is shaping a healthier Aotearoa New Zealand. Our purpose is simple: empowering our members to live well for longer. We're here to give peace of mind through timely access to quality care, inspire healthier living, and lead positive change across the health system. As a New Zealand-owned, member-based organisation, we're building a future where wellbeing is at the heart of everything we do -- delivering exceptional value for our members and creating an environment where our people thrive.

Now is an exciting time to join us. You'll be part of a high-performing, values-driven team where people are at the heart of everything we do -- and in return for your talent, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and be proud of the difference your work makes.

About the role

We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Commercial Partnerships Lead to join us on a 12 month fixed-term basis.


You’ll play an important role in developing strategic partnerships that support Southern Cross to create greater value for our members and advance our ambition to help New Zealanders live healthier lives.


Working across an evolving portfolio of opportunities, you’ll identify and assess prospective partners, develop compelling commercial propositions and lead opportunities from initial engagement through to agreement and implementation. You’ll also help establish the commercial frameworks and ways of working needed to support a growing partnerships capability.


In this role, you’ll:

  • Identify and evaluate potential strategic partners, considering strategic alignment, member value, commercial potential and delivery feasibility.
  • Develop partner engagement strategies and lead commercial discussions and negotiations.
  • Build compelling partnership propositions and presentations that clearly articulate mutual value.
  • Develop commercial models that create sustainable value for Southern Cross, our members and our partners.
  • Establish practical frameworks for partner evaluation, contracting, governance and performance measurement.
  • Collaborate across Product, Marketing, Legal, Commercial and other teams to take partnership opportunities from concept through to delivery.

About you

You’ll be an experienced partnerships professional who can confidently navigate commercial discussions, build trusted relationships and establish practical ways of working in an evolving environment.


You’ll bring:

  • Experience in commercial partnerships, ideally within loyalty, rewards or a comparable programme-based environment.
  • Strong commercial acumen, with experience evaluating opportunities, developing commercial models and negotiating complex agreement.
  • Experience taking partnership opportunities from initial engagement through negotiation, contracting and implementation
  • The ability to create credible, engaging partner presentations and represent Southern Cross confidently with prospective partners.
  • Strong influencing, negotiation and relationship management skills.
  • A practical, pragmatic mindset and experience establishing frameworks and processes in evolving environments.

Our values: who we are and what’s important to us

Ngākau nui. Āhurutanga. Tikanga.

Join a team that’s always there, always real, always true. If you thrive in a purpose-driven, diverse and supportive culture, we think you’ll love working with us.


We know that it is our team’s culture and wellbeing that will drive us forward. That’s why we prioritise not only professional development opportunities, but opportunities to thrive personally too. We offer exceptional work-life balance, and our employees are encouraged and rewarded for living well.


Based at our Auckland office, we offer an excellent work-life balance. You’ll be supported to continually learn and improve your skills, share knowledge and ideas, and be part of an amazing values-based culture where people are at its heart.


You’ll also be able to participate in aspects of our employee wellness programme, helping empower you and your whānau to live your healthiest lives.


We are proud to have taken the Pride Pledge, reflecting our commitment to inclusion and belonging. We also facilitate an active, employee‑led Diversity, Equity and Inclusion Forum, which includes our Rainbow Network, Māori Network, Pasifika Collective, and Neurodiversity and Whānau Support networks.

If you share our commitment and passion, we'd love to hear from you.
