title: Machinery Monitoring Engineer
description:
Total Number of Openings

1

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.


About the position


The Machinery Monitoring Engineer is part of the Reliability and Integrity organization within Chevron’s ENGINE Center and provides remote monitoring, diagnostics, and development of new solutions for critical rotating equipment across Chevron offshore operating assets. Monitoring activities include the review of predictive analytics alerts and reviews trends, providing insights to business unit customers through weekly or bi-weekly reporting and meetings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Performs remote support through exception-based monitoring of critical rotating and reciprocating machinery across Business Units and business segments.
  • Supports expansion of predictive analytics and other advanced analysis tools for machinery performance evaluation and early warning detection.
  • Engages with Business Units on equipment troubleshooting and identification of long-term trend deviation and equipment degradation.
  • Utilizes online condition monitoring programs to support asset health evaluations.
  • Supports data collection and reporting for benchmarking of critical rotating equipment reliability and efficiency metrics.
  • Supports data gathering for advanced machinery issues and collaboration with Subject Matter Experts.
  • Scales and develops analytics for machinery performance analysis and mechanical condition monitoring utilizing a combination of 3rd party and Chevron-developed solutions.
  • Supports data gathering for equipment benchmarking and RCA investigations.
  • Integrates vibration, process and performance data to diagnose developing faults, forecast deterioration, and recommend intervention before functional failure.
  • Teams with BU customers and experts to diagnose complex issues
  • undefined

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Machinery, Reliability, Electrical, or related Engineering discipline, or equivalent machinery analyst experience.
  • Minimum 10 years of machinery condition monitoring or equipment diagnostics experience in oil and gas, LNG, refinery, petrochemical, power generation, or heavy industry.
  • ISO 18436 ASNT SNT-TC-1A Level II Certification or equivalent;
  • Bently Nevada Machine Diagnostics skilled competency.
  • Demonstrated analysis of rotating equipment using vibration and operating-performance data.
  • Experience with rolling-element machinery and at least one complex machinery class such as gas turbines, centrifugal compressors, reciprocating compressors, or ESPs.A
  • bility to interpret process context and connect equipment behavior to operational and production consequences.
  • Working knowledge of machinery protection, condition-monitoring practices, and relevant engineering standards.

Preferred Qualifications

  • ISO 18436 or ASNT SNT-TC-1A vibration certification, Level II or above.
  • Bently Nevada System 1 / machinery diagnostics competency.
  • Experience with SmartSignal, PI, Seeq, thermal performance monitoring, lube-oil analysis, or advanced anomaly detection.
  • Offshore rotating equipment or ESP monitoring experience.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.


What we can offer you

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
  • Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
  • Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
  • Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
  • Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

title: Internal Communications Analyst
description:
Do you want your voice heard and your actions to count?

Discover your opportunity with Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group (MUFG), one of the world’s leading financial groups. Across the globe, we’re 150,000 colleagues, striving to make a difference for every client, organization, and community we serve. We stand for our values, building long-term relationships, serving society, and fostering shared and sustainable growth for a better world.

With a vision to be the world’s most trusted financial group, it’s part of our culture to put people first, listen to new and diverse ideas and collaborate toward greater innovation, speed and agility. This means investing in talent, technologies, and tools that empower you to own your career.

Join MUFG, where being inspired is expected and making a meaningful impact is rewarded.

MUFG, one of the world’s top five banks and a global presence in 50 markets, is seeking an Internal Communications Analyst to join their EMEA Corporate Communications, Brand & Digital team in London. This role offers you the opportunity to be part of a highly respected financial institution renowned for its stability, commitment to employee wellbeing, and dedication to fostering a culture of trust and inclusion. As an Internal Communications Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in shaping clear, creative, and impactful communications that drive employee engagement, support organisational transformation, and reinforce MUFG’s values across the region. You will work closely with senior leaders and cross-functional teams, contributing to strategic business priorities while enjoying flexible working opportunities and access to ongoing training. If you are passionate about connecting people through meaningful communication and thrive in a supportive environment where your ideas are valued, this is your chance to make a lasting impact at MUFG.

  • Join a globally recognised financial group with a strong reputation for stability and trustworthiness, offering you the chance to contribute to high-profile internal communications initiatives.
  • Work within an inclusive and collaborative team environment where your interpersonal skills and creativity will help shape employee engagement, cultural change, and organisational transformation across EMEA.
  • Benefit from flexible working arrangements and continuous professional development opportunities as you partner with senior stakeholders to deliver coordinated campaigns that reinforce MUFG’s values and support key business priorities.

What you'll do:

As an Internal Communications Analyst at MUFG in London you will be immersed in a environment where your day-to-day responsibilities revolve around creating engaging content that connects employees with the organisation’s vision. You will collaborate closely with senior leaders as well as cross-functional teams to plan integrated campaigns that foster employee engagement while supporting cultural transformation agendas. Your role involves developing compelling narratives for multiple platforms, ranging from intranet articles to video scripts and ensuring these messages resonate with diverse audiences across EMEA. You will also coordinate editorial calendars and governance processes to maintain consistency in messaging while adapting quickly to shifting priorities. By leveraging analytics and feedback tools you will evaluate campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements that enhance communication outcomes. Your ability to build trusted relationships across functions will be crucial as you share best practices globally while contributing flexibly to wider team objectives. Success in this role means consistently delivering high-impact communications that reinforce MUFG’s values promote inclusion support organisational change initiatives and ultimately help create a more connected workplace.

  • Support the planning and delivery of internal communications campaigns, programmes, and initiatives across EMEA by collaborating with colleagues at all levels.
  • Take ownership of defined communications campaigns by managing activities from initial brief and audience insight through content development, approvals, delivery, and evaluation.
  • Develop, edit, and publish high-quality content across various internal channels including intranet, email newsletters, presentations, videos, town halls, and leader communications.
  • Deliver communications that strengthen employee engagement by reinforcing MUFG's culture and values while supporting priorities such as employee listening, recognition, wellbeing, inclusion, volunteering, and the wider employee experience.
  • Contribute to transformation and change communications programmes by helping colleagues understand business priorities, organisational change processes, and new ways of working.
  • Support client-centricity and risk culture communications by translating complex themes into clear, practical messages that reinforce responsible decision-making and accountability.
  • Partner with stakeholders across Communications, HR, Risk, Technology, and business teams to develop comprehensive communications plans that shape messaging and deliver coordinated campaigns.

title: Global Process Owner - Time and Absence
description:
Introduction to the Job


Now is the time to join ASML Business Services, People Operations. As our business continues to grow and evolve, People Operations is transforming its services to deliver a consistent, compliant and high-quality experience for employees and managers worldwide.

As Global Process Owner Time and Absence, you will own the global process framework for work schedules, time registration, leave and absence administration, and time-to-payroll interfaces. You will create global consistency while providing clear governance for legitimate legal and regional differences.


Role and Responsibilities


You are accountable for the design, performance and continuous improvement of the global Time and Absence processes owned and executed by People Operations.

You will:

  • Own the global framework for work schedules, time registration and corrections, overtime, leave and absence registration, leave balances and time-to-payroll interfaces.
  • Define global standards and minimum process requirements, while governing differences arising from legislation, collective labor agreements and local working arrangements.
  • Translate policy, legal and business requirements into scalable Level 4 processes and Level 5 work instructions.
  • Maintain clear process documentation, controls, ownership, decision rights and handovers.
  • Define the global Time and Absence roadmap and prioritize improvements based on employee impact, risk, compliance, and business value.
  • Establish and monitor KPIs for data accuracy, payroll readiness, timeliness, correction volumes, employee experience, and efficiency.
  • Use process data, recurring cases, and employee feedback to identify root causes and deliver structural improvements.
  • Reduce manual corrections, rework and avoidable employee and manager inquiries.
  • Lead standardization, simplification, automation and self-service initiatives.
  • Partner with Payroll to ensure reliable time-to-payroll interfaces, data quality and clear cut-off management.
  • Partner with IT to translate process requirements into system capabilities, integrations and configuration principles.
  • Ensure processes are compliant by design and aligned with internal control, privacy, security and audit requirements.
  • Assess the impact of legislative, policy and technology changes and coordinate implementation across regions.
  • Provide process leadership during implementations and transformation programs.
  • Act as the escalation point for structural and cross-regional process issues.
  • Build an effective global Time and Absence process community.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in HR, Business Administration, Operations Management, Information Management or a related field.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in Time and Absence, workforce management, payroll, HR operations or global process ownership.
  • Strong understanding of work schedules, time registration, leave administration and time-to-payroll dependencies.
  • Experience working across countries with different legal and operational requirements.
  • Experience designing and improving processes in a shared-services or global business-services environment.
  • Experience with HR or workforce-management platforms such as Workday and service-management platforms such as ServiceNow.
  • Experience leading process or technology changes involving HR, Payroll, IT, employees and managers.
  • Knowledge of Lean or comparable continuous-improvement methodologies is an advantage.

Skills

  • Strong end-to-end process, governance and analytical capabilities.
  • Ability to balance global standards with legitimate local requirements.
  • Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills.
  • Ability to translate complex policy, legal and system requirements into practical processes.
  • Strong control and data-quality mindset.
  • Clear communication and facilitation skills, with fluency in English.
  • Structured, pragmatic and confident challenging legacy practices.
  • Collaborative mindset aligned with ASML’s values of Challenge, Collaborate and Care.

Other Information

The role is part of the Global Operational Excellence team within People Operations, ASML Business Services. It provides the opportunity to improve processes employees and managers use every day, while directly influencing payroll accuracy, compliance and employee experience.

Interested? Please apply with your English CV and cover letter, outlining your relevant experience and motivation.


Inclusion and diversity

ASML is an Equal Opportunity Employer that values and respects the importance of a diverse and inclusive workforce. It is the policy of the company to recruit, hire, train and promote persons in all job titles without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation, or gender identity. We recognize that inclusion and diversity is a driving force in the success of our company.

title: Senior Lead Embedded Software I&V Engineer
description:
Change people’s lives and love what you do! Cochlear develops world-leading medical devices that help people hear. As a top 100 medical device company and market-leader in implantable hearing devices, more people choose a Cochlear-branded cochlear implant system than any other. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives.

Job Overview & Purpose

The Senior Lead Embedded Software Integration & Verification (ES I&V) Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, safety, stability, and regulatory compliance of Cochlear's embedded software platforms. Working closely with development teams throughout the product lifecycle, the role leads software integration, verification, issue investigation, release readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives.


The position also provides technical leadership, mentors team members, and drives the adoption of effective testing processes, automation, tools, and best practices to support the delivery of reliable medical device software.



Key Responsibilities


1. Governance and Compliance

  • Define and support ES I&V governance frameworks and operating models across products and locations.
  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and verification reports in accordance with medical device regulatory standards.
  • Establish metrics to monitor ES I&V performance and progress.
  • Implement effective processes for issue reporting, tracking, and management.

2. Integration and Verification

  • Plan and coordinate component integration with development teams and product owners.
  • Support continuous integration and configuration of embedded software components.
  • Verify integration builds, investigate issues, and work with development teams to resolve them.
  • Deliver stable embedded software platform releases and associated test software for final verification activities.
  • Escalate issues through established tracking systems when required.

3. Planning and Stakeholder Coordination

  • Collaborate with engineering leaders and stakeholders to plan ES I&V activities aligned with product roadmaps and development plans.
  • Participate in product and service planning reviews from an ES I&V perspective.

4. Process, Infrastructure, and Tool Improvement

  • Help define future ES I&V capabilities, infrastructure, and organizational needs.
  • Develop, maintain, and improve ES I&V processes and best practices.
  • Drive the adoption of modern testing methods, tools, and infrastructure.
  • Improve efficiency and scalability through automation and platform-based approaches.

5. Technical Leadership

  • Develop training materials and conduct workshops for team members and external partners.
  • Ensure current and future verification capabilities meet business needs.
  • Serve as a key technical point of contact for embedded software verification challenges.
  • Coach engineers, share technical expertise, and support team development.


Team Role

As an individual contributor, you will:

  • Follow quality processes and support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Contribute ideas that improve systems, tools, and processes.
  • Comply with workplace health and safety requirements and report hazards, incidents, or injuries.


Qualifications, Skills & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computing, Engineering, Science, or a related discipline.
  • Fluent in written and spoken English.
  • Minimum 8 years of experience in embedded software integration and verification within highly regulated industries such as medical devices, automotive, aerospace, or similar environments.
  • Strong programming skills in Python, C, C++, C#, or similar languages.
  • Experience debugging test scripts and developing test cases.
  • Solid understanding of embedded software development methodologies, architectures, tools, and best practices.
  • Experience with embedded software testing, including unit, integration, regression, smoke, stress, and system-level testing.
  • Experience with test-driven development and automated testing approaches.
  • Experience with Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing environments.
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD practices and experience using tools such as Git, Bitbucket, Perforce, TeamCity, Bamboo, Jira, or equivalent platforms.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts using scripting languages such as Python, Bash, JavaScript, PowerShell, or Perl.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Experience in medical device product development is highly desirable.
  • Knowledge of active implantable medical devices and applicable regulatory requirements is advantageous.
  • Experience using Microsoft Copilot or similar generative AI tools to improve engineering productivity and collaboration is beneficial.



In Summary

This role combines embedded software integration, verification, technical leadership, and quality assurance to ensure embedded software platforms are reliable, compliant, and ready for product release. The successful candidate will drive testing excellence, continuous improvement, and collaboration across engineering teams while supporting the delivery of safe and effective medical device solutions.

Cochlear Malaysia provides shared services to support Cochlear’s global operations. The growing team of professionals in Malaysia provides critical support in areas such as IT infrastructure and applications, development and testing, business intelligence development and support, procurement, customer service, service and repairs and returned device analysis engineering.

Nattis hör till Piteå Centrala Förskoleområde och ligger centralt i stadskärnan i kvarteret Rönnen bredvid Norrmalmskolan. Verksamheten delar lokal med Rönnens förskola. Vi har nära till bibliotek, grönområden nere vid Norrstrand och skogen.

Verksamheten vänder sig till barn mellan 1 – 12 år som är inskrivna i Piteå Kommuns barnomsorg och skolbarnomsorg. Hos oss erbjuds barnen en i förhållande till deras ålder och vistelsetid väl avvägd dags rytm och miljö. Såväl omvårdnad och omsorg som vila och andra aktiviteter ska vägas samman på ett balanserat sätt. Leken har en viktig och central plats i verksamheten såväl inomhus som utomhus. Nattis har öppet alla årets dagar, om behov finns. Verksamhetens öppettider är vardagar från kl. 17.00-08.00 morgonen efter. Under helger är verksamheten öppet dygnet runt. Under sommaren stänger verksamheten under fem veckor.

Arbetsuppgifter:

  • Vi arbetar för att verksamheten genomsyras av grundläggande värden som allas lika värde, se olikheter som en resurs, respekt för varandra och den personliga integriteten.
  • Ett bra förhållningssätt samt att vara god förebild som visar engagemang i barnens lekar och aktiviteter är en grund för att skapa ett positivt klimat i verksamheten.
  • Barnens intressen vägleder oss i planering av innehåll och miljön i vår verksamhet.
  • Genom många olika lekmiljöer inomhus såväl som utomhus ges barnen tillfälle till lek och samspel i lugn och ro.
  • En god relation med vårdnadshavarna är av stor vikt för oss för att barnen ska kunna trivas och utvecklas. Innan barn börjar i vår verksamhet har vi alltid ett inskolningssamtal samt en inskolning som vi planerar i samråd med vårdnadshavarna.
  • Tillberedning och matlagning - Under helger serveras frukost, lunch, mellanmål, middag och kvällsmål.
  • Tvätt, diska samt vardagsstädning i lokalerna
  • I tjänsten ingår även att samarbeta med förskolans dagliga verksamhet. Detta innebär bland annat att du får arbeta i förskolans verksamhet när behov finns.

Vi ser det som önskvärt med examen från barn-och fritidsprogrammet, pedagogisk utbildning eller annan utbildning/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren finner relevant. Det är en fördel om du har erfarenhet av arbete med barn i behov av särskilt stöd.

title: Senior Field Service Specialist - Chemical Processing
description:
Pall Corporation | A Danaher Life Sciences Company
Location: Kuwait with periodic travel across GCC

Find what drives you on a team with more than 75 years of discovery, determination, and innovation.

At Pall Corporation, a global leader in high-tech filtration, separation, and purification, we help customers solve some of their toughest operational and process challenges. Our technologies support critical applications across industries, advancing health, safety, sustainability, and environmental responsibility.

Pall is part of Danaher Life Sciences, where our operating companies work together to accelerate the discovery, development, and delivery of solutions that safeguard and improve human health. Through the Danaher Business System, we continuously improve how we serve customers, solve problems, and deliver meaningful impact.

About the Role

The Senior Field Specialist will be responsible for independently performing contamination and filtration technology assessment surveys, as well as supporting the execution of customer rental orders across industrial process environments.

This is a highly field-based technical role, focused mainly on customers in the Energy sector, including Oil & Gas, Refinery, Polymers, and Chemical processes.

The role will be based primarily in United Arab Emirates (Abu Dhabi) with periodic missions across other GCC countries. The expected work pattern is approximately 70–80% at customer sites and 20–30% office-based.

Key Responsibilities

Process Contamination Assessment

You will lead technical field activities at customer sites, including:

  • Conducting contamination assessment surveys and identifying process bottlenecks or production issues
  • Preparing field activity documentation such as work protocols, JSA, HIP, and related safety/process documents
  • Performing contamination sampling and analysis campaigns at customer locations
  • Defining technical service scope and required field resources
  • Reviewing technical elements of commercial proposals when required
  • Attending customer kick-off meetings and executing field activities
  • Producing daily field reports and final technical campaign reports
  • Performing laboratory analysis on collected samples
  • Providing technical recommendations on potential contamination sources and improvement opportunities

Rental Operations & Technical Solutions

Based on assessment findings, you will support customers by identifying and implementing suitable Pall filtration and separation technologies, including:

  • Evaluating appropriate filtration/separation solutions from Pall’s portfolio
  • Sizing solutions based on customer process conditions
  • Conducting site visits to collect installation and commissioning data
  • Supervising installation, commissioning, and start-up of rental units
  • Monitoring job progress and performing required analysis
  • Troubleshooting Pall products and systems at customer sites
  • Preparing final job reports with clear technical recommendations

Technologies covered include:

  • Particulate filtration
  • Liquid-liquid coalescence
  • Liquid-gas coalescence
  • Industrial filtration and separation systems

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will bring a strong technical foundation and hands-on field experience in industrial process environments.

Essential Requirements

  • Degree in Chemical, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent relevant industry experience
  • Strong exposure to Oil & Gas, Refinery, Chemical, or Polymer processes
  • Experience in filtration, separation, contamination control, process troubleshooting, or field technical service is highly valuable
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken
  • Valid driving license
  • Valid passport with ability to travel across GCC countries without restrictions

Why Join Pall and Danaher

This role offers the opportunity to work directly with customers on complex process challenges, applying advanced filtration and separation technologies in real industrial environments.

You will be part of a global organization where technical expertise, customer impact, continuous improvement, and career growth are strongly supported through the Danaher Business System.

At Pall, your work can help improve process reliability, reduce contamination risk, enhance operational efficiency, and support safer, cleaner, and more sustainable industrial operations.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit .

title: PhD student in Applied Physics
description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!

We are looking for a PhD student in flexible X-ray detectors.

Your work assignments

Flexible X-ray detectors represent a future technology that can benefit applications spanning several scientific, medical, and technological fields. Our joint project funded by the Knut and Alice Wallenberg foundation aims to realize flexible X-ray detectors by developing new organic semiconductors that can fulfil the critical requirements on flexibility, X-ray absorption, and charge transport simultaneously. You will focus on the development of X-ray detectors using new materials, assisted by advanced characterisations. You will be working jointly with chemists, materials scientists and device physicists to carry out your research, which will involve close and regular interaction with the other participating research groups at Linköping university (led by Prof. Mats Fahlman), Chalmers University (led by Prof. Eva Olsson) and Uppsala University (led by Prof. Sascha Ott).

As a PhD student, you devote most of your time to doctoral studies and the research projects of which you are part. Your work may also include teaching or other departmental duties, up to a maximum of 20 per cent of full-time.

Your qualifications

You have graduated at Master's level in Physics, Chemistry, Materials or a related field or completed courses with a minimum of 240 credits, at least 60 of which must be in advanced courses in Physics, Chemistry, Materials or a related field . Alternatively, you have gained essentially corresponding knowledge in another way.

Qualified candidates are expected to:

  • Independently undertake the research activities
  • Work collaboratively and openly as part of a team
  • Act as a source of information and advice to other members of the group on scientific protocols and experimental techniques
  • Take initiatives on research-related tasks
  • Acquire new knowledge
  • Have prior experimental experience of what is described in the job description above— especially that related to physics, and/or materials/device development.

Please include a Letter of Intent, specifying:

  • why you want to do a PhD,
  • why you are interested in this position, and
  • why you believe that you are qualified for this position.

Your workplace

The group led by Prof. Feng Gao focuses on solution-processed optoelectronic devices, mainly based on semiconducting perovskites and organic semiconductors. The group is part of https://liu.se/en/organisation/liu/ifm/efm, where we develop photonic and electronic materials energy conversion and storage.

The employment

When taking up the post, you will be admitted to the program for doctoral studies. More information about the doctoral studies at each faculty is available at https://liu.se/en/research/doctoral-studies

The employment has a duration of normally four years' full-time equivalent. Extension of employment up to five years is based on the degree of teaching and institutional assignment. Further extensions may be granted in exceptional circumstances. You will initially be employed for one year, after which your employment will be renewed for a maximum of two years at a time, depending on your progress through the study plan.

Starting date by agreement.

Salary and employment benefits

The salary of PhD students is determined according to a locally negotiated salary progression.

More information about employment benefits at Linköping University is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than 30 November, 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

We look forward to receiving your application!

This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Who We Are


At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation.


We act boldly — because we believe that good business means a better world. Every day, we commit to scientific rigor, unshakable ethics, and broad access to medical breakthroughs. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow, today.


We’re also deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. By bringing together people with a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, we create an environment where innovation thrives, creativity flourishes, and everyone belongs.



The Opportunity


We’re looking for a Senior Penetration Tester to join our Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO) — a dynamic global team ensuring the resilience and trustworthiness of Roche’s products and digital solutions.


In this hands-on role, you’ll lead vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities across our physical and cloud-based products. You’ll collaborate with engineering, product, and architecture teams to strengthen Roche’s cyber defenses and ensure that innovation in diagnostics goes hand in hand with security and patient safety.


Your work will directly influence the security of next-generation healthcare technologies used worldwide.


What You’ll Do

  • Design, prioritize, and lead internal penetration testing activities across our diverse product portfolio, including digital solutions, cloud applications, and medical devices.
  • Proactively identify and assess vulnerabilities, and collaborate with product teams to prioritize and fix them throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Provide strategic technical support and security knowledge to product teams during the design and development phases to ensure security by design.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level pentesters in advanced testing techniques and strategic thinking.
  • Collaborate with the team to contribute to, utilize, and help maintain the central repository of testing methods and tools, supporting our goal of reusability across the business.
  • Support the Incident Response team with technical analysis and forensics during security incidents.
  • Execute red team exercises to assess product and solution resilience.
  • Prepare and present clear security reports with risk assessments and actionable recommendations.
  • Contribute to integrating defense and security-by-design principles across product lines.
  • Continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools for scalable product security.
  • Explore and integrate advanced automation and offensive agentic AI capabilities into the penetration testing lifecycle to simulate sophisticated, autonomous threat actor behaviors.

Who You Are

You are a technically strong, curious, and impact-driven professional who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments. You enjoy uncovering vulnerabilities and turning insights into stronger, safer products

Your profile includes:


  • Proven senior-level experience (5+ years) in offensive security, encompassing strategic planning and hands-on execution across diverse environments (cloud, web, APIs, and specialized devices).
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
  • Solid Background in vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.
  • Solid knowledge of common attack vectors, security best practices (e.g., OWASP Top 10), and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
  • Experience automating security controls (e.g., shell scripting, Python).
  • In-depth understanding of information security and privacy risks.
  • Experience with incident response and forensics (a plus).
  • Strong ability to communicate complex vulnerabilities, their impact, and required mitigation steps clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders, acting as a trusted advisor to influence business and architectural decisions.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and leadership skills.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and self-driven, focused on continuous learning and sharing knowledge within a diverse global team.
  • Proactive, self-driven, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as SANS GIAC (GCIH, GPEN, GXPEN, GCIA, GCFA, GSE), OSCP, OSEP, OSCE, OSWE, CISSP, CISA, CISM, or ISO27001 Lead Auditor are highly valued.
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML security risks (e.g., OWASP Top 10 for LLMs) and hands-on experience or deep knowledge in leveraging offensive agentic AI to automate complex attack chains.
  • You share Roche’s core values: Customer Empathy, Trust, Ownership, Bias for Action, Curiosity, Optimism, Collaboration, and Data-driven Decision-Making

Grade: SE6-SE7


Why Join Us?


This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to shape the future of healthcare technology, strengthen the security of life-saving solutions, and directly protect patient trust.


At Roche, your expertise matters every day. You’ll collaborate with world-class teams, tackle meaningful challenges, and grow in a global environment that values learning, integrity, and innovation.


Together, we make technology safe for better health — everywhere.


🧭 Ready to Secure What’s Next?


Join us and help redefine how security powers trust in healthcare.


👉 Apply now and be part of the team protecting the future of diagnostics.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Job Description:

There is an opportunity in Airbus Customer Services to join the Operational Unit "Technical Data Support and Services", which works towards developing and delivering aircraft maintenance documentation, to enable the safe and efficient accomplishment of maintenance operations by the customers (airlines, MRO, lessors).The products developed are AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual), TSM (Troubleshooting Manual), IPC (Illustrated Part Catalogue).


To deliver the complete documentation at aircraft entry into service and to maintain it throughout the aircraft life cycle is our main mission, and is part of the airworthiness requirements. The main challenge is to define precisely the consequences of the design changes on the already published documentation and to understand the immediate impact on Customers operations, with the objective to provide customised documentation in accordance with aircraft configuration.


Experience Level needed: 0~3 years


The jobholder will be responsible of a portfolio of ATA chapters for all aircraft programs across Aircraft Systems Perimeter, working in close collaboration with our Tech Data teams in Europe and will be responsible for the following activities:


Main Responsibilities


  • Manage Technical Data & Services Subcontracted Activities in accordance to AP2539
  • Verification and Validation – Incoming Inspection maintenance or material procedures
  • Writing of Technical Data Authoring activities of a Manual (AMM/TSM/IPC) in accordance with specifications and quality standards, contractual commitments, configuration management rules, approved schedules, quality standards.
  • Assessment of aircraft design inputs (Mod & Mod Proposal, Service Bulletin, …) that drive aircraft evolution in order to detect the impacts in the technical documentation.
  • Answer to customer questions for complex queries relative to his/her scope of activities. The jobholder will be responsible for providing efficient support to the customer, sometimes under high time pressure (following AOG…). He/she will guarantee accurate and on time correction of Technical Data deliverables.
  • Ensure and maintain compliance with EASA/FAA regulations (ICA process) and EN9100 for their own technical scope and perimeter of responsibility.
  • Manage all potential impacts of a criteria under the responsibility of ATA Systems
  • Technical Steering and Monitoring with Design Office(DO) for SDR’s and DO Contributions
  • Technical Steering and Monitoring of Illustrations request with Sub Contractors for a given ATA System
  • Responsible to ensure the delivery of manual content in accordance with specifications on time, on quality and within budget objectives
  • Proactive identification, mitigation and follow up of blocking points as well as constant assessment of your manual content in terms of quality assurance
  • Act as an interface between technical data, the airline customers and all the other Airbus internal contributors (Design Office, Programs, Delivery Center, other Customer Services units, etc.)
  • Working with and supporting other teams from across the world.



Values

  • Develop and maintain a collaborative working environment across organisation, by fostering engagement, active listening, developing team spirit, establishing feedback culture, establishing a trustful environment and Speak-up culture
  • Propose and develop innovation and digitalisation initiatives with respect to the interests of the Company
  • Develop and maintain a Quality First Mindset
  • Support a value driven organisation by creating/increasing the awareness level of personal values, Airbus values and policies

Safety

  • Report any (potential) safety issue or (potential) safety event that is detected in the frame of the day to day activity
  • Contribute, on request of their safety representatives, in any safety enhancement initiative as part of Safety management activity (PSP, SMS), eg, in the analysis and follow up of reported events, identification and analysis of hazards and risk assessment in their own domain of activity
  • Promote a safety culture

Qualifications

Aircraft Maintenance Engineering (AME) degree or Aeronautical / other Engineering Degree with knowledge/exposure to Aircraft Maintenance domain. 0~3 years experience in the Technical Data domain.

Avionics Knowledge & experience preferable.

- Basic knowledge of Aircraft and Aeronautics

- Knowledge of aircraft Systems

- Aircraft maintenance

- Knowledge of Technical Data authoring in AMM/TSM/ IPC.

- Aircraft configuration Management

- Project Management

- Proactive, good team player and good organisational skills.

- Communication skills and assertiveness.

- Curious and open-minded for change and continuous improvement.

- English Advanced level is mandatory

- Safety and quality knowledge.

At Roche, seamless service delivery relies on how effectively we train our teams and transition new services and technology into live operations. We are looking for a tech-savvy, highly curious IT Training & Transition Intern to join our team.

Under the mentorship of a Senior IT Training Expert, you will serve as our "Technology & Enablement Explorer." In this role, you will evaluate Roche’s suite of digital tools to discover how they can be used to improve training delivery, streamline knowledge sharing, and support upcoming service transitions. Beyond exploring new technologies, you will play a crucial role in auditing, restructuring, and cleaning up our shared digital repositories to ensure our training assets and transition documentation are organized, up-to-date, and accessible across the organization.

If you love exploring software, organizing complex information, and helping people adopt new technologies, this internship offers a direct look into how enterprise IT enables seamless global operations.


Key Responsibilities

  • Technology Exploration & Tool Enablement:
    • Explore and evaluate existing Roche applications, software, and digital tools.
    • Identify practical use cases for how these tools can enhance training delivery, automate learning workflows, or streamline transition handovers.
    • Present recommendations on underutilized tool features that could improve knowledge retention and team productivity.
  • Knowledge Management & Shared Drive Cleanup:
    • Audit and reorganize shared drives, SharePoint sites, and repository folders used by the Training and Transition teams.
    • Archive outdated assets, establish standardized naming conventions, and build a streamlined folder structure for Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), transition checklists, and training modules.
    • Ensure transition documentation and training collateral are easily searchable for trainers, L1 support agents, and operational stakeholders.

title: Subject Matter Expert - Banking Industry
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role


Your Role:

You will drive measurable outcomes by helping customers address complex business challenges through industry specific insight, technology strategy, and execution planning. The role balances discovery, analysis, solution design, and delivery oversight, with clear ownership of defined workstreams and customer outcomes. Success is demonstrated through actionable recommendations, trusted customer relationships, and progress against agreed business objectives.


What You Do:


  • Act as a trusted advisor, helping customers address business challenges and achieve measurable outcomes through technology solutions.
  • Lead discovery, assessment, and planning activities to develop actionable recommendations, roadmaps, and execution strategies.
  • Own customer workstreams, ensuring delivery against business objectives, timelines, and success metrics.
  • Build strong stakeholder relationships and serve as a key interface between customers, Delivery Partners, Architects, and SREs.
  • Provide technical leadership and oversight to ensure secure, reliable, and high-quality IT service delivery.
  • Drive innovation, automation, and continuous improvement to enhance service performance and customer value.
  • Monitor service health, customer satisfaction, and business outcomes, proactively identifying and resolving risks and issues.
  • Foster collaboration, accountability, and technical excellence across teams to deliver exceptional customer experiences.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.


Required Skills & Experience:


  • 15+ years of experience in IT service delivery, customer success, and leading high-performing technical teams.
  • Strong understanding of managed services, enterprise platforms, IT operations, and technology vendor ecosystems.
  • Proven experience in Incident, Problem, Change, and Major Incident Management, including root cause analysis and service restoration.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with Delivery Partners, Architects, and SRE teams to drive customer outcomes and service excellence.
  • Hands-on knowledge of AIOps, automation, and modern operational practices, with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Strong customer engagement and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships at all levels.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including coaching, mentoring, and developing technical teams in a customer-focused environment.

Preferred Skills & Experience:


  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Industry certifications such as ITIL, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or equivalent service management and project management credentials.
  • Experience leading service transformation, operational excellence, or digital modernization initiatives.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

title: NIMT REDOVISNING AB söker MINST EN SENIOR REDOVISNINGSKONSULT
description:
Är du en erfaren ekonom som trivs i en varierad roll där du får arbeta både självständigt och nära kund? Vill du bli en del av ett mindre, sammansvetsat team där din insats verkligen gör skillnad? Då kan detta vara en fantastisk möjlighet för dig.

Vi söker nu en senior redovisningskonsult med placering i hjärtat av Landskrona. Här arbetar ett engagerat team med stor bredd och hög servicenivå, där varje medarbetare är viktig. Du kommer in i en verksamhet med hög kompetens, god stämning, nära samarbete och många spännande uppdrag.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter och ansvarsområden

Som senior redovisningskonsult kommer du att arbeta med ett flertal olika kunder och uppdrag – små och medelstora företag inom varierande branscher. Arbetsuppgifterna kräver 5-7 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet från konsultbyrå. Du förväntas vara prestigelös och tycka om att arbeta hands-on, både med enklare och mer kvalificerade uppgifter.

Exempel på arbetsuppgifter

  • Löpande bokföring och redovisning
  • Självständigt upprätta månads-, kvartals- och årsbokslut
  • Lönsamhetsuppföljning och rapportering
  • Löneadministration
  • Skatte- och inkomstdeklarationer
  • Kontakt med myndigheter
  • Stöd och rådgivning till kunder
  • Business controlling

Du kommer att arbeta parallellt med 20–40 kunduppdrag, vilket kräver att du är strukturerad, flexibel och tycker om att ha många bollar i luften. Du är givetvis noggrann men vet också när det är good enough.

Personlighet

Vi söker dig som är:

  • Flexibel och lösningsfokuserad.
  • Nyfiken och handlingskraftig.
  • Prestigelös och positiv.
  • Van att ta egna initiativ.
  • Trivs med att arbeta nära kund och sprider god stämning omkring dig.
  • Har en privat situation som medger flexibilitet i samband med säsongstoppar.

Kvalifikationer

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi (högskola, KY/YH eller motsvarande).
  • 5-7 års erfarenhet som redovisningskonsult eller från liknande roll.
  • Goda kunskaper i redovisning och löneadministration.
  • Erfarenhet av system som Fortnox, Visma, Capego, Entré(Qrona) och Accountec.
  • God svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Om anställningen

  • Tjänsten är på heltid (100%).
  • Placeringsort: Centrala Landskrona.
  • Rapporterar till företagets VD och ägare.
  • Goda anställningsvillkor erbjuds (30 semesterdagar, övertidsersättning, friskvård, pension och sjukvårdsförsäkring).
  • Introduktionsutbildning (FAR).
  • På plats / Hybrid – upp till en dag per vecka på distans medges.
  • Tjänsten kan vid behov innebära arbete på plats ute hos kund.

Kontakt och ansökan

I det här uppdraget samarbetar vi med rekryteringsföretaget ComCube. Vänligen inkludera, i din ansökan, CV och ett motivationsbrev som svarar på:

  • Varför är du intresserad av tjänsten som Senior Redovisningskonsult?
  • Vad tror du framför allt att du kan bidra med som Senior Redovisningskonsult?

Har du några frågor beträffande rekryteringsprocessen eller tjänsten är du mycket välkommen att kontakta Helena Heijmink, 070-554 03 42, helena.heijmink@comcube.se eller Helena Fransson, 070-554 05 04 som hjälper oss i detta uppdrag. Du ansöker om tjänsten genom att följa ansökningslänken.

Notera att vi arbetar med löpande urval. Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via ansökningslänken. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Nimt Redovisning AB är en personlig redovisningsbyrå med sex anställda och kontor i centrala Landskrona. Vi hjälper företag med bland annat löpande redovisning, bokslut, rapportering och ekonomisk rådgivning. Vår värdegrund bygger på att vi ska vara pålitliga, kompetenta, engagerade och personliga. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och lägger stor vikt vid hög kvalitet, ett personligt bemötande och långsiktiga relationer. Hos oss blir du en del av ett engagerat team där vi hjälps åt, delar kunskap och tillsammans skapar trygghet och värde för våra kunder.

title: Machinery Diagnostics & Condition Monitoring Engineer
description:

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.


About the position


The Machinery Diagnostics & Condition Monitoring Engineer is part of the Reliability Engineering team in the Chevron ENGINE center. This role is responsible for advanced diagnostics, failure investigations, and reliability improvement of critical / complex rotating equipment. The role focuses on deep technical analysis, complex machinery troubleshooting, performance monitoring and driving sustainable reliability and availability improvements across operations of Oil & Gas business functions. This role utilizes process and performance data to diagnose developing faults, forecast deterioration, and recommend intervention before functional failure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform advanced machinery diagnostics and failure investigations on critical and complex rotating equipment, including Gas Turbines, Centrifugal and Reciprocating Compressors, Steam Turbines, Turbo Expanders, Blowers, and Pumps.
  • Execute in-depth vibration and condition-based diagnostics to identify early-stage faults, abnormal operating behavior, and degradation mechanisms.
  • Support major equipment overhauls, commissioning, startup, and post-overhaul condition assessments.
  • Collaborate with operations, maintenance, and engineering teams to drive and implement actions.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to condition monitoring engineers and junior diagnostics staff.
  • Deliver high-quality diagnostic reports with clear recommendations focused on risk reduction, reliability improvement, and operational availability.
  • Drive value delivery through proactive diagnostics, early fault detection, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Should be flexible to support Reliability Rotating Equipment workflows (Condition Monitoring, Preventive Maintenance Optimization, History Briefs, Lubrication Analysis & Management, BOP offline Vibration Management etc.)
  • Contribute to standardization of diagnostics methodologies, best practices, and knowledge sharing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering.
  • Minimum 10+ years of overall experience, including at least 8+ years of specialized experience in Machinery Diagnostics and Condition Monitoring.
  • Demonstrated expertise in diagnosing and monitoring complex rotating machinery, including gas turbines, centrifugal and reciprocating compressors, steam turbines, turbo expanders, blowers, and pumps.
  • Proven experience working with complex, high-energy machinery within the oil & gas, refining, petrochemical, LNG, or power generation industries.Vibration Analyst Category II (VCAT II) certification is mandatory.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience in rotating equipment overhauls, field troubleshooting, and machinery diagnostics.
  • Vibration Analyst Category III (VCAT III) certification.
  • Machinery Lubrication Analyst Level II (MLA II) certification.
  • Formal training in Machine Diagnostics Methodology from Baker Hughes / GE Oil & Gas, or equivalent recognized training.

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.

Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.

  • Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.

  • Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.

Join IMP Quality Distribution, a critical function within Global Quality Assurance. We are responsible for maintaining the quality and compliance of Investigational Medicinal Products (IMP) throughout the clinical supply chain. Our team acts as the appointed Delegate of the Swiss Responsible Person (FvP) and holds Global QA oversight over the entire IMP Distribution Network (Depots) and our key business counterpart, Global Clinical Supply Chain Management Distribution (PTDS-L). We drive continuous improvement and ensure adherence to international GMP/GDP standards.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Global Quality Manager to step into a role of significant reach. This position is instrumental in safeguarding product quality and regulatory compliance for global clinical trials. You will utilize your expertise in quality systems and supply chain distribution knowledge to provide guidance and maintain oversight over complex GxP processes.

Key Differentiators & Core Functions:

  • Regulatory Compliance: Act as the appointed Delegate of the Swiss Responsible Person (FvP), providing necessary final Quality decision-making.

  • Inspection Management: Actively drive and support all GxP inspections and audits.
  • Quality Decision-Making: Manage Temperature Excursion Management for clinical trials, including performing assessments and managing Expert Statements/Opinions.
  • Clinical Study & Quality Operations: Review and approve IMP supply flowcharts, transfer requests, expert opinions, quality agreements, and manage clinical trial complaints across the Roche network.
  • Compliance & Continuous Improvement: Drive network projects and improvement initiatives while ensuring strict adherence to GMP/GDP, Good Documentation Practices, and PQS training compliance.

Who You Are

To succeed in this highly critical and impactful role, you should possess the following professional profile:

  • QA & Compliance Expertise: You possess proven and comprehensive experience in Quality Assurance with a strong focus on compliance. You have deep knowledge of a regulated GxP environment (GMP/GDP)
  • Educational Foundation: You hold a Bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific or technical field (e.g., Pharmacy, Chemistry, Biology, Engineering).
  • Regulatory Language Skills: You are a fluent speaker and writer in both German and English. Your fluency is essential for managing critical regulatory documentation, providing authoritative guidance to European sites, and ensuring successful support during Health Authority Inspections.

Ready to take the next step? We'd love to hear from you. Apply now to explore this exciting opportunity!

Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

About the position


CMMS Engineer supports asset master data governance and execution activities within Chevron's ENGINE Operations - Reliability & Integrity organization. Reporting to the CMMS Team Lead, this role is responsible for implementing approved Master Data Structure (MDS) changes and maintaining high-quality asset master data within SAP S/4HANA.


The position is responsible for creating and executing SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Change Requests and preparing UX Loader files to implement approved Master data updates. The role collaborates closely with Business Unit Data Stewards, CMMS Coordinators, DCAM Advisors, and other stakeholders to support data governance processes, resolve data quality issues, and ensure compliance with established standards.


The successful candidate demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to effectively engage stakeholders while maintaining accurate and reliable asset master data that supports maintenance, reliability, integrity, and operational excellence.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Create, manage, and execute SAP Master Data Governance (MDG) Change Requests to implement approved asset master data updates.
  • Prepare, validate, and execute UX Loader files for equipment, functional location, asset hierarchy, and Equipment Asset Strategy updates.
  • Analyze MDS requests and support documentation in the MDS PowerApps to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance with governance requirements prior to implementation.
  • Perform data validation and quality assurance activities to identify and resolve data inconsistencies, errors, and compliance issues.

title: Senior Manager - Software Engineering (.NET)
description:

About Us

Daifuku Intralogistics America Corporation is a leading provider of intelligent material handling systems. With hundreds of engineers in-house, the company designs, manufactures, integrates, and installs a full spectrum of intralogistics solutions to meet client needs. These include leading-edge conveyor and sortation systems, voice- and light-directed order fulfillment equipment, a suite of warehouse controls & execution software, robotics, Automated Storage and Retrieval Systems (AS/RS), mezzanines, and structures, all backed by critical round-the-clock service and support.

In this role, you will provide strategic leadership to a team of Software Engineering Managers and highly skilled software engineers focused on developing scalable .NET applications that integrate with advanced automation technologies, warehouse execution systems, robotics, AS/RS solutions, sortation systems, and third-party platforms.

title: Co-op - Test and Measurement Facility Engineer (Internship)
description:
Introduction to the job

ASML US brings together the most creative minds in science and technology to develop lithography machines that are key to producing faster, cheaper, more energy-efficient microchips. We design, develop, integrate, market and service these advanced machines, which enable our customers - the world’s leading chipmakers - to reduce the size and increase the functionality of their microchips, which in turn leads to smaller, more powerful consumer electronics. Our headquarters are in Veldhoven, the Netherlands, and we have 18 office locations around the United States including main offices in Chandler, Arizona, San Jose and San Diego, California, Wilton, Connecticut, and Hillsboro, Oregon.


Role and responsibilities

Through exposure to advanced test and measurement techniques, you will design and develop test systems and/or applications to support feasibility, robustness, reliability or lifetime testing of advanced semiconductor lithography mechatronic parts and modules.


As a Co-op in the Test and Measurement Facility (TMF) within the Service and Enablers Department, you will participate in the following:

  • Develop portions of the lithography system and/or associated tooling and test equipment.
  • You will work on sub-systems involving robotics, mechatronics, precision mechanics and/or opto-mechanics
  • You will need to consider engineering specifications and performance, lifetime, failure modes, root cause analysis, statistical analysis, reliability predictions, 6 sigma techniques, measurement system capability, etc.
  • You will collaborate with system architects and engineers in a multidiscipline project team to develop concepts, perform engineering analysis, build and test prototypes, partner with suppliers, analyze data and support system integration and test

This position is located on-site in Wilton, CT. It requires onsite presence to attend in-person work-related events, trainings and meetings and to further ensure teamwork, collaboration and innovation. Must be available for 6 to 9 months


Education and experience

  • Pursuing a Bachelor's, Master’s or PhD Degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or Machine Controls with a minimum 2 years completed (Must be a current student and pursuing a degree)
  • Prior use of LabVIEW preferred
  • Prior use of CAD software (Siemens NX) preferred
  • Prior use of measurement equipment, such as but not limited to the following:
    • Accelerometers
    • Data Acquisition systems
    • National Instruments equipment
    • Oscilloscopes
    • Multimeters
    • Hand tools

Skills

Working at the cutting edge of tech, you will always have new challenges and new problems to solve – and working together is the only way do that. You will not work in a silo. Instead, you will be part of a creative, dynamic work environment where you will collaborate with supportive colleagues. There is always space for creative and unique points of view. You will have the flexibility and trust to choose how best to tackle tasks and solve problems.


To thrive in this job, you will need the following skills:

  • Hands-on attitude
  • Capability to interface with multidisciplinary groups including senior leadership
  • High energy self-motivated team player with strong desire to learn
  • Customer oriented and willing to work with high level problem solvers on a daily basis
  • Possess strong leadership and ownership characteristics with commitment to achieve results on time

Other information

  • Co-Ops typically work at ASML for a semester and a summer, 8 months total
  • This position is located on-site in Wilton, Connecticut. It requires onsite presence to attend in-person work-related events, trainings and meetings and to further ensure teamwork, collaboration and innovation
  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee routinely is required to sit; walk; talk; hear; use hands to keyboard, finger, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, reach, and stretch
  • The employee is occasionally required to move around the campus
  • The employee may occasionally lift and/or move up to 20 pounds
  • May require travel dependent on company needs
  • Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception and ability to adjust focus
  • Can work under deadlines
  • The environment generally is moderate in temperature and noise level
  • Must be able to read and interpret data, information, and documents
  • Can observe and respond to people and situations and interact with others encountered in the course of work
  • Can learn and apply new information or skills


The current base hourly range for this role is currently:

$18.00 to $48.00 per hour

Pay scales are determined by role, level, location and alignment with market data. Individual pay is determined through interviews and an assessment of several factors that that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to job-related skills, relevant education and experience, certifications, abilities of the candidate and pay relative to other team members

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Örebro län
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Örebro län.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.
