title: Associate, Digital Review Team Senior Analyst
description:
Role Responsibilities

As Associate, Digital Review Team Senior Analyst you will perform below -

  • Monitor and analyze digital transaction activity to identify potential fraud trends, suspicious behaviors, and emerging risk patterns.
  • Review and investigate transactions from real-time monitoring queues and fraud detection platforms.
  • Conduct detailed analysis of transactional data, customer profiles, account activity, and supporting documentation to identify potential fraud, financial crime, or compliance risks.
  • Perform customer profile reviews, KYC verification, customer due diligence (CDD), enhanced due diligence (EDD/ECDD), identity verification, and document authentication in accordance with regulatory and company requirements.
  • Support customer onboarding and account verification processes by validating customer identity, information, and documentation.
  • Contact customers via phone, email, or other approved communication channels to validate suspicious transactions and verify account activity.
  • Make risk-based decisions regarding transaction approvals, holds, cancellations, escalations, account restrictions, and customer verification outcomes.
  • Handle complex investigations independently and determine appropriate escalation paths when necessary.
  • Collaborate closely with Analysts, Senior Analysts, Supervisors, Compliance, Fraud Operations, Product, and other stakeholders to identify risks and develop mitigation strategies.
  • Share fraud typologies, emerging trends, best practices, and lessons learned to strengthen fraud prevention and compliance controls.
  • Support incident investigations, root cause analyses, and remediation activities related to fraud, operational risk, or customer verification concerns.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, accuracy, and service-level expectations while maintaining a high standard of investigation quality.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and contribute to operational excellence initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed case documentation to support regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements.
  • Demonstrate flexibility and adaptability by supporting new business initiatives, projects, and responsibilities aligned with Western Union's Center of Excellence model.

Role Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, college diploma, or equivalent professional experience in Business, Finance, Criminology, Risk Management, Compliance, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 2-3 years of relevant experience in fraud prevention, transaction monitoring, customer profile verification, KYC (Know Your Customer), Customer Due Diligence (CDD),
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD/ECDD), digital identity verification, compliance operations, financial crime investigations, banking, fintech, payments, or e-commerce.
  • Demonstrated experience performing customer onboarding reviews, customer profile reviews, KYC verification, identity verification, document authentication, sanctions screening, and risk assessments in accordance with regulatory and company requirements.
  • Working knowledge of regulatory compliance requirements, KYC/CDD/EDD processes, customer verification controls, fraud detection methodologies, and financial crime prevention practices within a regulated financial services environment.
  • Experience using fraud monitoring systems, transaction review platforms, case management tools, customer verification solutions, or related risk management platforms is preferred.
  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Ability to assess risk, exercise sound judgment, and make independent risk-based decisions with limited supervision.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong customer-centric mindset with the ability to manage sensitive customer interactions professionally while balancing customer experience, risk mitigation, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to changing business needs, and consistently meet quality, productivity, and service level targets in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to work independently and collaboratively within a global team environment.
  • Ability to quickly learn new systems, tools, processes, and regulatory requirements.
  • Additional language proficiency is considered an advantage, particularly Japanese, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Thai, Vietnamese, Bahasa Indonesia, Mandarin, or Tagalog.

Work Shift

Western Union values in-person collaboration, problem solving, and ideation whenever possible. We believe this fosters common ways of working and supports how we execute initiatives for our customers. The expectation is to work from the office a minimum of three days a week. Demonstrated flexibility to work Morning, Mid, and Graveyard shifts, including weekends, public holidays, and rotating schedules, to support global business operations and coverage requirements.

Benefits

You will also have access to short-term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and life insurance, and access to best-in-class development platforms, to name a few. Please see the benefits below specific to your country. If applicable, additional role-specific benefits will be mentioned during your interview process or in an offer of employment.

  • HMO coverage with dependents from day 1 of employment, subject to insurer's review

We are passionate about honoring our employee's identity and fostering a feeling of belonging. title: Trading Operations Technical Lead
description:
Entity:

Supply, Trading & Shipping


Job Family Group:

Supply & Trading Group


Job Description:

Our purpose is to deliver energy to the world, today and tomorrow. For over 100 years, bp has focused on discovering, developing, and producing oil and gas in the nations where we operate. We are one of the few companies globally that can provide governments and customers with an integrated energy offering. Delivering our strategy sustainably is fundamental to achieving our ambition to be a net zero company by 2050 or sooner.


About the role


The trading teams in ST&S RPTE are one of three regional Performance Units in ST&S and are primarily responsible for marketing BP’s Exploration production throughout the region, sourcing crude for our refineries, trading on behalf of our associates and for supporting our refinery assets in order to improve commercial performance. Operations are a vital part of Supply and Trading. In RPTE this covers physical and refinery coordination elements of operations across a large geographical region and deals with a wide variety of cultures and rigors. The Operations team comprises of sub teams namely Trading Operations, Voyage Operations, Cargo Assurance, Doc. Admin, Inventory Analysts and Shipping Coordination. Operations have a key role to play in ensuring that the front to back process runs smoothly, technical expertise is provided, and that valuable data and information is collected, entered and forwarded in a timely manner in order to provide full support to others dependent on such information in order to maintain an efficient and compliant process. The team manages the logistics of a deal to BP’s best commercial advantage whilst ensuring that all contractual and Group assurance obligations are met.


As member of the Operations Extended Leadership team, the Trading Operations Tech Leader is responsible for the smooth, compliant and flawless running of their trading operations team. Managing crucial front office, functional and cross regional relationships.


In this role You will


  • Building the technical and operational capability of the operators on your bench including the training of new joiners, fostering of learning and encouraging the sharing of knowledge.
  • Supporting in the delivery of the day-to-day operations as required by the individual bench, and thus supporting the bench strategy.
  • Providing out of hours’ coverage as required by the individual bench.
  • Supporting operators in sophisticated operational scenarios, encouraging people to speak up when vital, and sharing takeaways with the wider operations community for future learning.
  • Supporting crossbench training and capability upskilling as part of the Tech Lead community.
  • Ownership operational input for bench related new business activity (to include NAI’s), through regular engagement with both the front office and the functions.
  • Collaborate with support functions as required for operations i.e. Tax, Commodity Risk, Credit.
  • Organising and running of weekly technical meetings including delivery of key messages to the bench.
  • Root cause analysis-based incident reporting and risk management where required for operations on your bench.
  • Supporting the delivery of the trading strategy through technical input to maximise value.
  • Working with the operations Team Leader on your bench to develop and embed 'our beliefs’ within the team.
  • Supporting and where required lead in continuous improvement initiatives and projects across operations.
  • Lead on ensuring strict Trading Operations adherence to the ST&S and RPTE Risk Management Report and the associated Trading Operations Risk Register, with a keen focus on ensuring key purple risks barriers are maintained through adherence to Group, ST&S and RPTE Trading Operations policies and procedures and self-verification of these barriers.
  • Lead in the reporting of Key ops Metrics & Key Performance Indicators through the Ops Performance Management app to support and ensure Trading Operations are performing against our Operations Framework and specific strategic goals

What You will need to be successful

  • Strong skill in oil trading operations (cargo and / or barges). Able to demonstrate a proven experience in operational experience
  • Understand risk, compliance, HSSE and Shipping requirements relating to operations
  • Consistent track record of delivering commercial value
  • Strong leadership and communication skills including ability to empower a team
  • Strong teammate
  • Strong negotiation skills (formulating and implementing strategy)
  • Ability to achieve operation and business goals through influencing, systematic planning and effective management of available resources
  • Attention to operational detail
  • Ability to find innovative solution to problems
  • Proven track record of relationship building in front office environment and with external counterparties
  • Willingness to speak up
  • Having a strategic attitude as well as understanding / managing risks and implications of the business / people decisions.
  • Identifying key issues in a sophisticated situation, adapting quickly using the resources available to lead the Operations team and relating partners through changes effectively
  • Demonstrated ability to identify and inspire change and simplification within a team.
  • Voyage Operations knowledge


Why Join us:

At bp, we offer a supportive and inclusive environment where you can grow and develop your career. We provide flexible ways of working, competitive benefits, and opportunities to learn within a global organisation. We are committed to building a diverse workforce and creating a culture where everyone feels valued, respected, and able to thrive. We understand that people have different priorities and responsibilities, which is why we offer a range of benefits and flexible options to help you balance work and life effectively.

Join us in shaping the future and take the next step in your career with bp. Apply now.



Travel Requirement

No travel is expected with this role


Relocation Assistance:

This role is not eligible for relocation


Remote Type:

This position is a hybrid of office/remote working


Skills:

Ancillary cost management, Commercial Acumen, Communication, Competitor intelligence, Customer service delivery excellence, Demurrage, Developing and implementing strategy, Influencing, Inventory Management, Listening, Marine assurance, Mentoring, Negotiating, Problem Solving, Sentiment and Trends, Shipping/transport, Supply chain management, Trade discipline and compliance, Trading and scheduling operations, Trading Fundamentals, Trading knowledge, Troubleshooting, Voyage operations

.

title: Director Executive Reward & Performance
description:
Please submit your application as soon as possible, as we reserve the right to close this advertisement at any time.

Cochlear’s mission is to help people hear and be heard. As the global leader in implantable hearing solutions, Cochlear is dedicated to helping people with moderate to profound hearing loss experience a world full of sound. We aim to transform the way people understand and treat hearing loss and innovate to connect people with future technologies. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives. Learn and grow with us as we tackle the most complex challenges in helping more people to experience a lifetime of hearing.

The Opportunity.

We’re looking for a Director, Executive Reward & Performance to play a key role in shaping and delivering our approach to executive reward, performance and equity globally.


Reporting to the Vice President, Global Talent Reward, this is a senior and influential role with exposure across our Executive Team, People & Culture Committee and broader global People & Culture community. You’ll combine deep reward expertise with commercial judgement, strong stakeholder influence and the ability to turn complex remuneration concepts into clear, practical solutions.


What you’ll do

This is a broad role spanning strategy, governance and execution.

You’ll take end-to-end responsibility for key executive remuneration processes, including supporting the People & Culture Committee, preparing remuneration-related papers and managing actions arising from the Committee. You’ll also lead the remuneration components of Cochlear’s Annual Report and Notice of Meeting, partnering closely with Finance, Legal and Investor Relations.


You’ll also:

  • Lead the management, review and communication of Cochlear’s global executive incentive plans, including the Cochlear Executive Incentive Plan and Short-Term Incentive Plan.
  • Co-develop Cochlear’s Executive Total Rewards & Performance strategy, ensuring our approach remains competitive, sustainable and aligned with business and cultural priorities.
  • Monitor executive remuneration trends and market competitiveness, bringing strong external thinking and insights from the ASX environment.
  • Provide strategic and operational leadership across executive base pay, incentives, superannuation/pension and other rewards.
  • Oversee the design, management and administration of Cochlear’s global equity plans, including LTI, Deferred STI, Special Awards and employee share plans.
  • Partner across Legal, Finance, Tax, Payroll and People & Culture to ensure reward and equity processes are robust, effective and compliant.
  • Manage external partners and providers, ensuring leaders have access to high-quality market data and advice.
  • Lead and contribute to global projects that continuously improve how we approach reward and performance.

What you’ll bring

We’re looking for someone who knows their craft, but importantly, can also influence, simplify and connect the dots.


You’ll bring significant experience across performance and reward, remuneration and benefits, and reward strategy development, together with hands-on experience managing executive remuneration.


You’ll also bring:

  • (Approximately) 10 years’ experience in Performance & Reward / Remuneration & Benefits and Reward Strategy development with the ability to integrate with broader People and culture strategies·
  • Strong conceptual and analytical capability, with confidence working with complex data and financial information.
  • Experience developing and improving systems and processes.
  • Strong organisational awareness and the ability to build credibility and influence across senior stakeholder groups.
  • The ability to lead significant projects with a high degree of autonomy.
  • A pragmatic mindset. You can move comfortably between strategic thinking and getting into the detail when it matters.
  • Experience and exposure working in an ASX listed business would be advantageous.

What will set you apart

The strongest candidates for this role won’t simply have excellent technical reward knowledge.


They’ll be able to translate complexity into clarity, balance executive and shareholder perspectives, challenge constructively and build trust with senior stakeholders. They’ll understand that great reward strategy isn’t just about designing programs. It’s about ensuring those programs reinforce the performance, behaviours and culture the organisation wants to create.


Why this role?

This is an opportunity to work at the intersection of executive reward, performance, governance and business strategy, with genuine global scope.

You’ll have the opportunity to influence some of Cochlear’s most important reward and performance programs while working collaboratively across People & Culture, Finance, Legal, Tax, Payroll and Investor Relations.

If you feel that you have the skills and experience to be successful in this role and take on new challenges to build your career with Cochlear, please start your application by clicking the apply button below.

#CochlearCareers

How we recognise your contribution

At Cochlear we value and welcome the unique contributions, perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds of our employees and aim to build a culture that celebrates and leverages these differences, creating a sense of belonging and enabling our people to realise their full potential. Through our internal programs and employee benefits, we aim to create an environment where our people will feel value and supported. Whether your focus is on continuous learning, professional development or simply finding an environment which enables you to thrive whilst balancing family or personal life commitments, then we have several programs in place to support you.

For more information about Life at Cochlear, visit www.cochlearcareers.com

title: Lead Engineer - Enterprise PLM Applications
description:
Job Description Summary

Lead Engineer - Enterprise PLM Applications will convert requirements into technical capabilities and provides application capability options, sequence delivery priorities, configure designed solution, and perform testing to ensure achievement of the right outcomes.

This role will be working with product, business, and technology leaders to focus on solving the right problems, in the right way, at the right time using LEAN methodologies.

This includes understanding business requirements working the technical resources on application design, troubleshooting, performing root causes analysis, testing, and end-user support.

Job Description

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business requirements.
  • Gather and formalize business requirements for PLM solution.
  • Validate requirements with representatives who will be affected by the business process or change and receive sign off from the stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with business group members to ensure the full end-to-end business process will function and meet business requirements within the project scope.
  • Recommend improvements to, or new requirements for, business processes and operational procedures.
  • Analyse existing system functionality and business processes in the scope of the business need and design valued cost-effective solutions to support the business requirements.
  • Conduct research on PLM module functionalities and changes (User groups, Product Support Documentation etc.).
  • Create documentation (business rules, as is/to be flows, requirements, data configuration, use cases, functional specs, testing forms etc.).
  • Collaborate with implementation team (including system Architects, Software Engineers, etc.) to determine best IT and PLM solutions for identified business requirements.
  • Create, communicate, and coordinate test plans and test cases (integration, functional, user acceptance, regression, etc.).
  • Validate configuration changes meet the business requirements without negatively impacting existing functionality.
  • Document system configuration changes.
  • Participate in lessons learned.
  • Trouble-shoot customer issues on products supported within the business domain.
  • Provide guidance for the support teams by creating knowledge articles, process documentation.
  • Create end-user training materials.
  • Capable of training others as applicable on specific areas of business processes or systems.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering with 8-10+ years of relevant experience.
  • Strong functional & implementation knowledge about various PLM modules viz. Part Management, Product & Program Management, Change Management, Configuration Management, BoM Management etc.,

Desired Characteristics

  • Strong background & implementation knowledge of Siemens Teamcenter or ARAS PLM.
  • Strong functional & implementation knowledge about PLM integration with CAD (NX, CATIA, CREO etc.,), ERP (SAP, MS Dynamics etc.,).
  • Strong communications skills (verbal, written, and listening).
  • Ability to clearly convey ideas and concepts verbally, in writing, and via presentations.
  • Ability to translate stakeholder requests into well-defined, documented use cases / requirements and review with stakeholders.
  • Ability to critically review and interpret technical documentation.
  • Able to communicate and convince users on design based on holistic and long-term solution and effectively trade off with short term benefits.
  • Ability to handle multiple priorities and consistently meet deadlines through effective time management skills.
  • Ability to lead & mentor team members including other business analyst.
  • Ability to provide technical guidance within a global, cross-functional team.
  • Must be detail-oriented and able to work within a team setting.
  • Proficient at problem solving and analytical techniques.
  • Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with internal team members and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to work with integrity and build trust.
  • CBAP (Certified Business Analyst professional) preferred.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Six sigma Greenbelt / Blackbelt training / certification preferred.

The Manager will oversee LHD and internal care management to ensure adherence to the Maternal & Child Health Policy Manual which includes comprehensive, cost effective, high quality, coordinated physical health, behavioral health, and social services while achieving Care Management program outcomes and process metrics.

Operations

  • Provide effective leadership in staff management with respect to recruitment, selection, retention, training, evaluation, and continued professional and educational development, and communication.
  • In collaboration with the senior director and other CCNC team members, develop performance drivers, policies, and procedures that align with contractual requirements and promote population health improvement.
  • Assist with development and implementation of new processes, tools, workflows, and guidance, as necessary to ensure contract adherence and success of the organization.

  • Ensure standards are transparent and applied consistently, impartially and ethically across all staff members.
  • Identifies and develops opportunities for innovation to increase effectiveness and quality.

  • Other duties as needed to support Senior Director and LHD leadership to achieve a successful programs under this new model design and improved health outcomes for the Maternal & Child populations.

Quality Improvement

  • Use data to drive decisions and plan/implement performance improvement strategies related to Care Management metrics for assigned members
  • Provide feedback to LHD and internal care managers on ways to improve the quality and effectiveness of service delivery
  • Collaborate with appropriate leadership and team members to address member complaints.


Staff Management

  • Participate in recruitment/interviewing/hiring as needed

  • Provide ongoing staff development

Qualifications

  • Minimum bachelor’s degree
  • Must have licensure as an RN.
  • Must have three (3) years of experience providing care management, case management, or care coordination to maternal and/or pediatric populations OR three (3) years managing/supervising care management of these populations.
  • CCM certification required
  • At least 3 years of management/supervisor experience

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Advanced knowledge and understanding of office applications, including MS Office (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook) is required, as well as internet and digital literacy
  • Excellent communication skills – oral and written
  • Critical thinking skills, effective clinical judgment, independent decision-making, change management skills, and problem-solving abilities
  • Skilled in establishing rapport with members, providers, and community partners either in person or via telephone
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Coaching, team building and supervisory skills
  • Ability to work independently and function as an integral part of the team
  • Motivational Interviewing skills and knowledge of adult learning and teaching principles
  • Sensitivity to diversity of cultures, language barriers, health literacy, and educational levels
  • Clinical competence in disease management and Care Management principles
  • Responds to change with a positive attitude and a willingness to learn new ways to accomplish work activities and objectives
  • Ability to shift strategy or approach in response to the demands of a situation
  • Perform all other duties as requested


Working Conditions

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Västmanlands län
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Västmanlands län. Vi är godkänd leverantör i dynamiska inköpssystem (DIS) för socionombemanning hos Sala, Fagersta, Surahammar, Arboga och Köping, vilket innebär att kommunerna kan vända sig direkt till oss när de behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

title: ADAS - Senior Field Calibration Technician
description:
Senior ADAS Calibration Technician

Advanced Technology. Expert-Level Work. Real Career Growth.

Are you an experienced ADAS Calibration Technician who enjoys solving complex diagnostic challenges and staying ahead of rapidly evolving vehicle technology?

VIVE Collision is looking for a Senior ADAS Calibration Technician to join our growing team. This is more than a calibration role — you’ll serve as a technical expert, mentor, and trusted resource for ADAS operations across multiple locations.

You’ll perform advanced diagnostics, calibrations, programming, and system testing while helping ensure every vehicle is repaired according to OEM procedures and the highest safety standards. You’ll also have the opportunity to mentor technicians, provide remote technical support, and assist the ADAS Manager with operational and technical decisions.

If you’re ready to take your ADAS expertise to the next level, VIVE Collision wants you on our team.

What’s in it for you?

  • Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options for you and your family (this includes domestic partners)
  • $50,000 employer-paid life insurance policy
  • 401K plan with an employer match
  • Employee Assistance Program includes confidential assistance in the following areas
    • Counseling from relationships to stress and substance abuse
    • Work/Life benefits, including personal, financial, and legal issues
    • Self-Help benefits
    • Peak performance coaching
    • Lifestyle saving benefits for wellness, shopping, travel
    • Personal development and training
  • Heath savings account to assist with medical bills
  • Paid time off to promote work-life balance
    • 8 paid holidays, including Black Friday, and get your Birthday as a floating holiday!
  • Growth opportunities within our company

The specific pay rate/salary offered to a candidate may be influenced by several factors including experience, education, specialized certifications from OEMs, and where the job is located.


Key Responsibilities

ADAS Calibration & System Integration

  • Perform advanced static and dynamic ADAS calibrations following OEM repair procedures and manufacturer specifications.
  • Diagnose, calibrate, and repair complex ADAS components, including cameras, radar sensors, lidar, ultrasonic sensors, and related vehicle safety systems.
  • Ensure proper integration of ADAS components with vehicle electrical, mechanical, and safety systems.
  • Perform comprehensive pre- and post-repair diagnostic scans and functional testing to verify system operation.
  • Confirm all ADAS repairs meet OEM requirements and vehicle safety standards.
  • Complete programming, resets, software updates, and system adjustments as required.

Advanced Diagnostics & Technical Support

  • Lead advanced diagnostics and troubleshooting using OEM-specific tools, aftermarket diagnostic platforms, and calibration equipment.
  • Identify and resolve complex ADAS concerns involving vehicle communication systems, sensors, modules, and electronic components.
  • Provide remote diagnostic support and technical guidance to ADAS Technicians and shop teams.
  • Assist locations with repair planning by reviewing diagnostic findings and calibration requirements.
  • Interpret OEM repair procedures, technical bulletins, wiring diagrams, and manufacturer documentation.
  • Maintain current knowledge of evolving vehicle technology, ADAS systems, and calibration requirements.

Field Support & Multi-Location Leadership

  • Travel between multiple VIVE Collision locations to perform ADAS calibrations and provide technical support.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource for field technicians and collision repair teams.
  • Support the development and training of ADAS Technicians through coaching, mentoring, and sharing best practices.
  • Provide guidance on complex calibration procedures and assist technicians with challenging repairs.
  • Perform quality control reviews of completed ADAS work to ensure compliance with OEM procedures and company standards.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and escalation point for ADAS-related technical issues.
  • Provide operational support to the ADAS Manager, including assisting with workflow management, prioritization, and technical decisions.

Operational & Customer Service Excellence

  • Manage assigned ADAS workload across multiple locations while maintaining efficient scheduling and completion timelines.
  • Communicate clearly with shop leadership regarding repair status, diagnostic findings, calibration results, and recommendations.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of diagnostics, calibrations, repairs, and vehicle information.
  • Represent VIVE Collision professionally while interacting with internal teams, customers, and partners.
  • Identify opportunities to improve ADAS processes, technician capabilities, and overall repair quality.
  • Perform other duties as assigned to support collision repair operations.


Qualifications

  • Must be at least 18 years of age.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of direct ADAS calibration experience or equivalent advanced automotive diagnostic experience.
  • Advanced understanding of automotive electrical systems, vehicle communication networks, sensor alignment, and calibration theory.
  • Strong knowledge of OEM ADAS procedures, calibration requirements, and safety standards.
  • Proficiency with OEM and aftermarket ADAS diagnostic tools, software, and calibration equipment.
  • Experience diagnosing complex vehicle electrical and electronic systems.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor, train, or provide technical guidance to other technicians preferred.
  • Ability to interpret OEM repair procedures, technical documentation, wiring diagrams, and diagnostic information.
  • Strong problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication, documentation, and organizational skills.
  • Microsoft Office Suite proficiency; CCC ONE experience preferred.
  • Valid driver's license with a clean driving record and ability to meet VIVE insurance requirements.
  • Ability to work independently while managing travel schedules and supporting multiple locations.

Physical & Travel Requirements

  • Travel between multiple shop and customer locations (company vehicle provided).
  • Able to lift up to 50 lbs and work in physically demanding environments (bending, kneeling, standing for extended periods).
  • Manual dexterity to operate diagnostic and calibration equipment effectively.

Job Description

Duration: 4 years
Salary: £27,400
Location: Manchester

Start: September 2027
Qualification: Level 6 Digital & Technology Solutions Professional Degree Apprenticeship with Manchester Metropolitan University


Your tech future starts here
At Lloyds Banking Group, tech isn’t just part of the business. It is the business. With £3bn a year going into AI, cloud and engineering, we’re busy reinventing how 23 million customers manage their money.


As a Digital & Technology Solutions Degree Apprentice, you’ll dive into coding, problem-solving and building digital products people use every day. Forget tea runs. Think real projects, real customers, real impact.

Four years. Big learning. Real projects

This apprenticeship is a deep dive into software engineering. You’ll study at Manchester Met and apply your learning directly to projects at Lloyds.


You’ll cover modules like:

  • Programming fundamentals & databases
  • IT project management & cyber security
  • Full stack web development
  • Software design, architecture & enterprise programming
  • Testing, quality assurance & professional practice

By the end, you’ll graduate with a degree-level qualification and four years of hands-on experience.


The impact you could make

  • Build and test apps used by millions
  • Develop secure systems that keep customers safe
  • Solve big problems in payments, platforms and more
  • Learn to deliver tech the right way - ethical, scalable, inclusive

Your skills toolkit

You’ll master:

  • Python, Java and other core languages
  • Databases, networks and security
  • Full stack web development
  • Agile teamwork and modern software practices

Support in your corner

  • Blended learning - classroom + real projects
  • Time carved out for your development
  • A mentor, a manager and a buddy to back you
  • A community of techies who get as excited about clean code as you do

Your future. Fully funded

We’ll pay your salary and fully fund your degree, so by the end of the programme, you’ll have completed a level 6 apprenticeship in Digital & Technology Solutions. You’ll also gain four years of experience working on one of the UK’s largest tech transformations, equipping you with skills that can take you anywhere in the industry—from specialist engineering roles to future tech leadership positions.


Requirements

What you’ll need

  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old on 1st September 2027
  • GCSEs grades 4-9 in both English and Maths (Achieved)
  • You’ll need a minimum of 104 UCAS points (These grades can be predicted, but any offer made to you will be conditional upon successful achievement of these qualifications)

If you’re unsure of your UCAS points, you can visit to check your total.


Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to four years.


Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.


Location

This apprenticeship is based in Manchester, and you will be expected to work from the Manchester office throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.


About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 15th December 2026

Our roles generate a lot of interest and occasionally we need to close for applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!


If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days (Monday – Friday).


What happens next?
Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in February → Receive your outcome.


At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: MDCD A350F Master Production Scheduler
description:
Job Description:

An opportunity for a Master Production Scheduler has arisen within Airbus Operations, Illescas (Toledo).


The selected candidate will join the Planning & Scheduling Team, responsible for the mid- and long-term planning (18 months) for MDCD A350F. The role operates across two core axes: leading the monthly finite capacity planning routines alongside manufacturing and program stakeholders, and steering the planning IT ecosystem (APC Jaguar and SAP). In this position, you will drive scenarios, simulate program updates for MCA & Elementary Parts, and provide the decision-making backbone for resources, buffer levels, and delivery priorities across the plant.


RESPONSIBILITIES

The main tasks of the jobholder will be:

  • Evaluate program and production requirements, analyzing recovery scenarios and plant calendar constraints to propose optimized production plans.
  • Lead Master Production Schedule (MPS) routines and stakeholder reviews, challenging delays to secure firm operational commitments.
  • Design and simulate capacity scenarios within assembly lines to absorb program cascades and minimize lead-time disruptions.
  • Build, track, and analyze execution KPIs measuring deliveries and schedule compliance, defining and driving targeted recovery action plans.
  • Maintain and calibrate planning models and parameters across core systems (APC Jaguar, SAP, and APC-ARP interface).
  • Coordinate logistics alignment and resource availability, actively mitigating supply disruptions to guarantee smooth assembly execution.

SKILLS

Is your profile aligned to the following list of skills? Apply! We are looking forward to knowing you:

  • Education: Degree in Engineering (Aeronautical, Industrial, Mechanical) or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Hands-on background in production planning, scheduling, or manufacturing operations within industrial or aerospace environments.
  • Technical Knowledge: Mandatory advanced proficiency in APC Jaguar (and APC-ARP interface) as well as Google Sheets / advanced spreadsheets; working familiarity with SAP.
  • Soft Skills: Strong negotiation, conflict resolution, active listening, proactive prioritization, and ability to coordinate multi-functional stakeholders under time constraints.
  • Languages: Negotiation level / fluent in both English and Spanish (written and spoken).
  • Valuable / Nice to have: Direct experience managing assembly lines planning or aerostructures manufacturing environments.

WHICH BENEFITS WILL YOU HAVE AS AIRBUS EMPLOYEE?

At Airbus we are focused on our employees and their welfare. Take a look at some of our social benefits:

  • Vacation days plus additional days-off along the year (approx. 35 days per year in total).
  • Attractive salary.
  • Hybrid model of working (up to 40% per quarter when possible), promoting work-life balance.
  • Collective transport service subject to working calendar/home location.
  • Benefits such as life insurance, health insurance, employee stock options, retirement plan, or study grants.
  • On-site facilities (among others): free canteen, kindergarten, medical office.
  • Possibility to collaborate in different social and corporate social responsibility initiatives.
  • Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects in a multicultural environment.
  • Option to access special rates in products & benefits.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

title: Anaesthetic Technician
description:
St John of God Midland Public Hospital we provide a comprehensive range of services including emergency medicine, critical care, day chemotherapy, paediatric care, aged and stroke care, maternity and general surgery. Our 307-bed public hospital is operated under a public-private partnership between the State Government and St John of God Health Care.


Our Services include wide range of public health care services for people in Midland and surrounding communities. Our services include 24-hour emergency care, public maternity care, Aboriginal pregnancy and maternity support through Moort Boojari Mia, acute mental health treatment and medical and surgical care.


Your role

St John of God Midland Public Hospital is currently seeking Anaesthetic Technicians and Registered Nurses to join our Anaesthetics team


Why you will enjoy working with us:

  • We are equipped with state-of-the-art technology
  • 12 busy operating theatres
  • Specialised day procedure unit
  • Speciality case exposure, including vascular surgery, orthopaedic surgery, plastic surgery and paediatric cases
  • Flexibility with casual opportunities or part -time opportunities to support your lifestyle and promote work-life balance
  • You will be supported by a highly skilled team that ensure our nurses have everything they need to perform their duties

This is a fantastic opportunity to expand your skills while working alongside a dedicated and experienced team in a modern surgical environment.


Casual and permanent part-time positions are available, offering flexibility while still allowing you to be part of a team committed to clinical excellence and outstanding patient care.


We have a variety of shifts available to suit your lifestyle

  • 24 hour roster, AM, PM and Nights
  • Shift of 5, 9.5 or 10 hours
  • To be considered you will need to be available for a minimum of 2 shifts per fortnight and be able to cover the 24 hour roster.

The Position

  • Act as the patient advocate.
  • Preserve patient confidentiality.
  • Deliver competent assistance throughout the anaesthetic phase in both routine and emergency situations.
  • Ensure patient safety throughout the anaesthetic phase, in particular with respect to the nominated position of the patient.
  • Participate in the daily maintenance of associated anaesthetic equipment.
  • Contribute to the orientation and continuing learning and development of new anaesthetic caregivers and other Operating Rooms caregivers.
  • Cooperate with preceptorship of student technicians and new caregivers.
  • Act as an anaesthetic resource for Operating Rooms caregivers.

Position Requirements

You will hold a Certificate IV and/or Diploma Qualification in Anaesthetic Technology or you will be a current Registered Nurse with AHPRA and demonstrate recent clinical experience with Anaesthetics and PACU. You will also have the ability to work without direct supervision and in less stable conditions.


To succeed you will implement the care plan/care path as well as monitor and evaluate patient care all (within your scope of practice), whilst having the ability to solve problems, or seek help from appropriate resources. To be considered for this role you will demonstrate a minimum of 2 years clinical experience within an Anaesthetics speciality.


Above all, patient care will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.


We can offer you

  • Anaesthetic Technician Salary: $81,827 to $99,892 per annum (pro rata for part-time), plus 12% superannuation
  • Anaesthetic Technician Casual Rate: $51.60 to $62.99 per hour (inclusive of casual loading), plus 12% superannuation
  • Registered Nurse Salary: $82,945 to $106,629 per annum (pro rata for part-time), plus 12% superannuation
  • Registered Nurse Casual Rate: $52.30 to $67.74 per hour (inclusive of casual loading), plus 12% superannuation
  • Several casual and permanent positions available
  • Discounts on hospital services & private health insurance
  • We offer a range of salary packaging options tailored to your employment status such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses – up to $18,550 as a permanent employee and a percentage of your earnings as a casual
  • Free on-site parking
  • Access to fitness and wellbeing benefits through Fitness Passport
  • Innovative Professional Development opportunities
  • A welcoming and supportive culture
  • A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave & well-being programs

​All applicants are asked to submit a covering letter (of no more than two (2) pages) demonstrating how you meet the above position requirements


If we identify a surplus of suitable candidates for this role, you may also be invited to a candidate talent pool list where you could be offered an alternative position. Applications will be reviewed throughout the advertising period and interviews conducted regularly. Apply today!


For enquiries contact Jade Pike, Clinical Nurse Manager, on (08) 9462 5117.

title: Lead Data Scientist
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Lead Data Scientist

Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Overview

The Security Solutions Data Science team develops AI and machine learning capabilities that help protect the global payments ecosystem from fraud and cyber threats. Supporting Mastercard’s fraud and risk product, the team builds and enhances models that analyze billions of transactions and enable real-time detection of fraudulent activity.

We are looking for a highly motivated Lead Data Scientist to drive the next generation of AI-powered fraud detection systems. This is a senior, hands-on technical role that combines deep individual contribution with technical leadership across predictive modeling, AI agents, LLM-based solutions, real-time decisioning systems, and large-scale data engineering while contributing directly to Mastercard's mission of enabling secure and trusted commerce worldwide.

Role

As a Lead Data Scientist, you will be expected to be highly hands-on while providing technical leadership in designing, developing, coding, testing, and deploying enterprise-scale AI solutions that enhance fraud detection and risk intelligence capabilities across Mastercard's Security Solutions portfolio. This is not just a model development role; it is a strong fit for someone who enjoys working closely with complex data, exploring patterns, understanding the business and technical problem deeply, experimenting through R&D, and bringing interdisciplinary research ideas—such as advances in NLP, deep learning architectures, graph learning, or agentic systems —into the fraud and security space. The role is also about identifying practical solutions and implementing them in scalable production systems.

You will lead complex AI engineering initiatives while directly contributing to model development, experimentation, system design, and production implementation.

Key responsibilities include:

Lead and directly contribute to the design, development, deployment, and optimization of machine learning models for fraud detection, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and related security applications.

Define, build, and guide scalable AI and ML pipeline architecture supporting model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, retraining, and continuous improvement.

Hands-on design and implementation of Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), reasoning and planning workflows, Chain-of-Thought-style prompting techniques, tool/function calling, LLM-based modular systems, and multi-agent orchestration.

Work with large-scale transactional datasets using distributed computing technologies such as Spark and Databricks.

Implement MLOps best practices, including CI/CD, model governance, observability, experimentation frameworks, and performance monitoring.

Drive the design of reusable AI platforms, libraries, and engineering frameworks that accelerate AI development, improve quality, and establish best practices across teams.

Set technical direction by evaluating emerging AI technologies, defining adoption patterns, and identifying opportunities to apply them to fraud prevention and security challenges.

Contribute to Mastercard's innovation efforts by publishing top-tier research papers, filing patents, and translating applied AI research into scalable fraud and security solutions.

Ensure solutions meet Mastercard standards for scalability, reliability, explainability, security, responsible AI, and long-term maintainability.



All About You

Demonstrated experience leading AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Data Science, or applied research initiatives from concept through production deployment.

Expert-level hands-on programming skills in Python and strong experience building production-quality software, reusable frameworks, and scalable AI systems.

Deep understanding of machine learning fundamentals and practical application of supervised learning, ensemble methods, feature engineering, model evaluation, experimentation, and production model risk controls.

Proven track record as a hands-on practitioner developing, deploying, debugging, and improving machine learning solutions in production environments with measurable business impact.

Strong hands-on experience writing, reviewing, testing, and maintaining production-grade code for AI/ML applications.

Experience working with LLMs, prompt engineering, reasoning and planning frameworks, RAG architectures, vector databases, AI agents, and Generative AI application development.

Experience with distributed computing platforms such as Spark, Databricks, or similar big data technologies.

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP and associated AI/ML services.

Strong understanding of MLOps principles, including model deployment, model monitoring, CI/CD, ML lifecycle management, governance, observability, and operational reliability.

Experience working with SQL and large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for solving complex real-world challenges.

Excellent communication, technical leadership, and collaboration skills with the ability to influence architecture decisions and work effectively across cross-functional teams.

Ability to mentor engineers, raise engineering standards, and bring strong learning agility, intellectual curiosity, and thought leadership in AI and machine learning.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience developing fraud detection, risk management, trust & safety, cybersecurity, or financial crime solutions.

Hands-on experience with Hadoop, Spark, Databricks, MLflow, Agentic AI frameworks, reasoning and planning frameworks, LangChain, or similar AI engineering technologies.

Experience building Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent systems.

Exposure to graph learning, anomaly detection, network intelligence, or real-time decisioning systems.

Publications, patents, open-source contributions, Kaggle achievements, or demonstrated research experience in AI/ML.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m)
description:
Job Description:

In order to support Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg, Airbus is looking for a


Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m)


As Loads & Aeroelastic Engineer (d/f/m) we are at the heart of aircraft design and deal as part of the engineering organisation with the key flight sciences.


In the Manoeuvre Loads Team in Hamburg we perform load calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification and finally during airline operations. We are responsible for build model activities such as aerodynamics modelling for the manoeuvre loads models and integrating model bricks. We subsequently perform manoeuvre loads calculation and provide the loads data to our component loads colleagues. In addition to this, the team is strongly involved in performing loads in-service support, research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning.


Having the transverse view of the whole aircraft, our main mission is to deliver suitable aircraft design and configuration for optimum performance. As such we are fully part of the current and future challenges in designing a safe aircraft meeting the highest sustainability and operational standards.


We are present throughout the full aircraft life-cycle: supporting sales campaigns from early definition phase through the core design phase and onwards into supporting manufacture, flight testing and the aircraft in service. By this we ensure the best-operational and safe use of the aircraft and create value for our customers.


We are aeronautical engineers, developers and innovators. We make use of cutting edge technologies in our tools as digital enablers are key to ensure our success.


Your location

You will be working at the largest production site for civil aircraft situated in Hamburg. Its location on the southern banks of the river Elbe includes the option to commute by ferry. Experience the special flair of Hamburg in your spare time where vibrant cosmopolitan culture meets nautic legacy.


Our Benefits for You

  • Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
  • Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
  • Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
  • Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
  • Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

  • You will perform manoeuvre loads calculations covering our fleet from a very early design stage until certification taking into consideration the certification requirements and the A/C specificities such as aerodynamic loads & flight control design.
  • You will support research and technology aspects with new aircraft configuration assessments, new services, model based system engineering, automation, and machine learning.
  • You would also support airlines through Airbus Customer Services by carrying out L&A analyses of in-service events:
    • Contribute to Loads In-Service Support with trouble shooting activities in the L&A design office context for development and production flight test and in-service aircraft, perform related L&A assessments.
    • Engage for timely response to engineering queries as on-call engineer for Loads In-Service Support.

Desired skills and qualifications

  • You have a Master degree in the STEM field (Science, Technology, Engineering or Mathematics), preferably having focussed on aircraft design
  • You are curious and interested in developing new methodologies, driving improvements and shaping the future of aeronautical engineering
  • Your positivity and motivation enthuses your team. You are willing to master your responsibilities in an empowered environment.
  • Your English is at a negotiating level whereas German language skills would be a plus.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.


This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

Permanent

title: Sr Associate, Disputes and Fraud Analysis
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Sr Associate, Disputes and Fraud Analysis

What does a great Fraud & Dispute Associate do at Fiserv?

As a Fraud & Dispute Associate, you will provide support to Fiserv clients’ card portfolio chargeback programs (debit, credit, prepaid). You will investigate claims, compare multiple avenues of processing disputes/chargebacks, and decide on the best path to resolution.

This important position is required to ensure that we take care of our clients, as well as their customers. This directly follows our values of earning client trust every day and creating with purpose. You will contribute to efforts small and large!


What you will do:

  • Investigate, evaluate, and process disputes/chargebacks, contacting cardholders to investigate possible fraud.
  • Understand compliance and verification procedures to effectively process cardholder information, while staying up to date on network regulatory requirements and client guidelines.
  • Monitor systems to detect possible fraudulent behavior related to card usage and deliver great customer experience via inbound and outbound calls with clients and cardholders.
  • Track and take action on cases within timeframes based on regulatory guidelines and client requirements, entering data into client-specific systems to accurately record and keep track of cardholder, card, transaction, and case information.
  • Respond to inquiries from internal and external stakeholders regarding chargeback requirements, system processing and functionality, dispute lifecycle, claim status, and data input.

What you will need to have:

  • 1-4 years of financial or customer service experience

What would be great to have:

  • Knowledge of Regulation E and Regulation Z
  • Knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard operating regulations
  • Experience with electronic funds transfer (EFT)
  • Proficient in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, OneDrive, SharePoint)
  • Intermediate computer skills (40 WPM minimum)
  • Strong problem-solving skills
  • Strong decision-making skills
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to work in a collaborative team

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

title: Graduate Engineer- UAE National
description:
Job Description

Who we are

Do you want to join our Geo-data revolution? Fugro’s global reach and unique know-how will put the world at your fingertips. Our love of exploration and technical expertise help us to provide our clients with invaluable insights. We source and make sense of the most relevant Geo-data for their needs, so they can design, build and operate their assets more safely, sustainably and efficiently. But we’re always looking for new talent to take the next step with us. For bright minds who enjoy meaningful work and want to push our pioneering spirit further. For individuals who can take the initiative but work well within a team.



Responsibilities:

  • Support the maintenance, inspection, testing, troubleshooting, and repair of ROV systems and associated equipment.
  • Assist with preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure equipment reliability and operational readiness.
  • Prepare and test ROV systems, tooling, and ancillary equipment for project mobilisation and offshore deployment.
  • Conduct functional testing of electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, and control systems.
  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, asset data, test reports, and technical documentation using company systems.
  • Support inventory management, equipment tracking, and certification compliance activities.
  • Participate in ROV refurbishment, upgrade, and technology improvement projects.
  • Contribute to innovation initiatives involving robotics, remote operations, automation, digital solutions, and AI-enabled maintenance tools.
  • Ensure compliance with company QHSSE standards, procedures, and safe working practices at all times.


Requirements:


  • Must be a UAE national with a Family Book.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, Robotics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 0-2 years of engineering or technical experience; fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.
  • Foundational knowledge of electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, or control systems.
  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
  • Eagerness to learn and develop technical expertise in ROV systems, robotics, and offshore technologies.
  • Hands-on mindset with the ability and willingness to work directly with equipment in a workshop environment.

What we offer

Fugro provides a positive work environment as well as projects that will satisfy the most curious minds. We also offer great opportunities to stretch and develop yourself. By giving you the freedom to grow faster, we think you’ll be able to do what you do best, better. Which should help us to find fresh ways to get to know the earth better. We encourage you to be yourself at Fugro. So bring your energy and enthusiasm, your keen eye and can-do attitude. But bring your questions and opinions too. Because to be the world’s leading Geo-data specialist, we need the strength in depth that comes from a diverse, driven team.

Our view on diversity, equity and inclusion

At Fugro, our people are our superpower. Their variety of viewpoints, experiences, knowledge and talents give us collective strength. Distinctive beliefs and diverse backgrounds are therefore welcome, but discrimination, harassment, inappropriate behaviour and unfair treatment are not. Everybody is to be well-supported and treated fairly. And everyone must be valued and have their voice heard. Crucially, we believe that getting this right brings a sense of belonging, of safety and acceptance, that makes us feel more connected to Fugro’s purpose ‘together create a safe and liveable world’ – and to each other.

What’s in it for you?

At Fugro, our people are our number one priority and central to our purpose to create a safe and livable world. Our values set the foundation for our unique culture: we are determined to deliver, we prepare for tomorrow, we do what’s right, and we build trust. Our talent philosophy is driven by our values and fueled by a passion for learning, developing leadership behaviors, transparency, and accountability. Fugro offers opportunities to sharpen skills and provide career growth through on-the-job learning experiences, LinkedIn Learning access, business and technical training, and leadership development programs. We also offer competitive benefits packages including hybrid working to support you in your career journey with us.

title: Vi söker vårdpersonal till hemtjänsten – dag, kväll och helg
description:
🌟 Vi söker vårdpersonal till hemtjänsten – dag, kväll och helg

Trött på en arbetsdag där allt handlar om att hinna?

I hemtjänsten är det lätt att fastna i för många besök, för lite tid och ständig stress. På Nya Hemtjänsten Syd har vi valt att bygga verksamheten på ett annat sätt.

Sedan starten 2010 arbetar vi efter en enkel princip: vi tar inte in fler kundtimmar än vi har bemanning till.

Det betyder inte att jobbet alltid är lugnt – hemtjänst är hemtjänst – men det ska finnas rimliga förutsättningar att göra ett bra jobb, hjälpa sina kollegor och ge kunderna den omsorg de behöver.

Nu söker vi vårdpersonal för arbete både dagtid och kvällstid.

Vi ser allra helst att du är utbildad undersköterska, men även du med erfarenhet från vård och omsorg är välkommen att söka.

🚀 Därför är vi annorlunda

  • ✅ Kapacitetstak – Vi tar inte in fler kundtimmar än vi har bemanning för.
  • ✅ Tid för kunden – Vår planering ska ge rimliga förutsättningar att utföra insatserna ordentligt.
  • ✅ Smart rotation – Uppdragen roteras så att ingen alltid får de tyngsta passen eller arbetsuppgifterna.
  • ✅ Tydliga rutiner – Du ska veta vad som gäller och vem du ska vända dig till när något händer.
  • ✅ PTAI – Vi arbetar aktivt med arbetsmetoder och teknik som förebygger belastnings- och förslitningsskador.
  • ✅ Teamarbete på riktigt – Vi förväntar oss att man hjälper varandra när det behövs.

💡 Det här erbjuder vi

title: 05P - Incident Management
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. The Role

Your role As an Incident Manager, you will lead the end-to-end management of incidents that impact customer services, with a strong focus on service restoration, coordination, and clear communication. This role is central to maintaining customer trust during service disruptions by driving structured incident response, orchestrating cross functional teams, and ensuring incidents are resolved efficiently and consistently. You will balance real-time incident leadership with continuous improvement of incident management practices and outcomes. What you will do •Lead the management of incidents from identification through resolution, ensuring timely service restoration •Orchestrate incident bridges and coordinate multiple technical teams and service partners during active incidents •Own communication to customers and internal stakeholders throughout the incident lifecycle using defined communication plans •Ensure incident priorities, impacts, and escalations are assessed accurately and consistently •Drive post incident reviews, documenting root causes, actions taken, and improvement opportunities •Partner with Problem Management to trigger deeper root cause analysis when required •Monitor incident trends and metrics to identify recurring issues and opportunities for service improvement •Maintain compliance with IT Service Management (ITSM) processes and continuously improve incident management execution


Who You Are

Required skills and experience •Experience working within ITSM frameworks and incident management processes •Hands on experience with ITSM tools such as ServiceNow or equivalent platforms •Ability to lead and coordinate cross functional technical teams during high impact incidents •Experience managing customer communications during service disruptions •Familiarity with formal troubleshooting and root cause analysis methodologies •Ability to manage multiple incidents, priorities, and stakeholders concurrently •Experience documenting incidents, actions, and outcomes in structured systems Preferred skills and experience •ITIL Foundation certification v3 or v4 or higher •Experience supporting large scale or enterprise customer environments •Experience facilitating post incident reviews and driving corrective actions •Comfort working with ambiguity while maintaining structured decision making •Experience managing executive or senior stakeholder expectations during critical incidents


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!
