title: Staff Reliability Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
The Staff Reliability Engineer leads product reliability analysis and prediction throughout the product lifecycle. The position applies reliability methods to evaluate DVP&R results, warranty claims, field-performance data, failure modes analysis and risk evaluation. In collaboration with cross-functional team, the role ensures effective execution of reliability processes, drives continuous improvement of reliability tools, and strengthens the integration of reliability principles across the organization.

LI-Hybrid


Key Responsibilities:


Design Validation Plan & Report Support (DVP&R)


  • Perform design life predictions and improve life test efficiency for new and existing programs.
  • Analyze historical warranty and DVP&R data to assess product risks.
  • Correlate design lifetime, validation/accelerated durability test results, and field data to validate customer required lifetime performance

Warranty Analysis

  • Conduct and quantify product specific warranty risk evaluations using statistical analysis.
  • Analyze warranty claims and warranty returns root causes, to identify improvement opportunities and validate corrective actions.
  • Correlate warranty performance and field data to improve reliability prediction accuracy and support design decisions.
  • Support escalated field issue investigations with reliability assessments and structured data analysis.
  • Identify emerging failure trends to enable early intervention.

Warranty Data Management

  • Improve reliability prediction models, simulation methods, and durability test strategies through analysis of warranty, validation, and field-performance data.
  • Develop and enhance warranty analytics tools, databases, and Power BI dashboards to support reliability assessments and business decisions.
  • Ensure the integrity, quality, and effective use of warranty data to identify trends, assess risks, and improve prediction accuracy.
  • Develop and maintain product and customer reliability databases to support warranty forecasting, reliability prediction models, and identification of trends across products and customers.

Training, Coaching and Plant Support

  • Provide internal training and coaching on reliability methods and statistical tools.
  • Support manufacturing plants with reliability assessments and structured problem-solving methodologies and best practices.
  • Lead knowledge-sharing activities to promote lessons learned and the application of reliability best practices across the organization
  • Support customer meetings and technical discussions when required.
  • Prepare executive-level summaries to support leadership decision-making.

CORE DELIVERABLES

  • Reliability risk assessments and life prediction analyses supporting product development and production programs.
  • Warranty and field-performance analyses identifying emerging failure trends and risks
  • Reliability prediction models and data-driven recommendations support design, validation, and business decisions.
  • Product and customer reliability databases providing warranty forecasting, trend analysis, and predictive analytics.
  • Reliability dashboards, reports, and analytical tools that improve visibility of warranty and field performance.
  • Technical assessments and recommendations for critical field issues, customer escalations, and reliability risks.
  • Training materials, coaching programs, and knowledge-sharing activities that strengthen organizational reliability capability.
  • Executive-level summaries and presentations supporting leadership decision-making.

What we’re looking for:


  • EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE (Minimum Qualifications)
    • Experience with reliability analysis tools and methodologies (e.g., Weibull++, Minitab, JMP)
    • Knowledge of warranty processes, field performance analysis, and reliability prediction techniques.
    • Experience with statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and warranty forecasting.
    • Experience with Power BI, database management, and data visualization tools.
    • Working knowledge of DFMEA, Design for Reliability (DfR), and structured problem-solving methodologies (8D, 5 Whys, Root Cause Analysis).
    • Experience supporting senior management in a fast paced, metrics driven technical teams.
    • Ability to lead small global, cross-functional teams during investigations with strong communication, negotiation, and consensus building skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to generate innovative solutions and explore new analytical methods.

  • Education, Skills, Knowledge Requirements:
    • Hands-on experience with reliability analysis and Weibull tools (e.g., Weibull++, MATLAB, Minitab, JMP).
    • Knowledge of warranty procedures and requirements.
    • Experience using Six Sigma tools; Lean Green or Black Belt preferred.
    • Working knowledge of DFMEA and problem-solving tools (8D, 5 Whys, Quality Alerts, Root Cause Analysis).
    • Familiarity with Python programming.
    • Experience with Power BI and SharePoint for data visualization and collaboration.

    • Motivating Others
    • Process Management
    • Problem Solving
    • Functional/Technical Skills
    • Decision Quality

title: AI and Digital Health Specialist – The Integrated Innovation Highway (IIH) Project Ethiopia
location: Ethiopia, Addis Ababa Country Program Office
description:
PATH current employees - please log in and apply Here

PATH is a global nonprofit advancing health innovations for the people who need them most. With 50 years of experience, a global team of experts, and trusted partnerships spanning 70+ countries, PATH turns breakthroughs into better health for millions every single year.

PATH combines scientific and public health expertise, implementation experience, innovation, and strong partnerships with governments, communities, civil society, and development partners. In Ethiopia, PATH works closely with the Federal Ministry of Health, Regional Health Bureaus, health facilities, communities, local organizations, and development partners to strengthen health systems and expand access to high-quality, equitable health services.


PATH Ethiopia implements and supports health programs across multiple regions and city administrations, with a strong focus on maternal, newborn and child health, immunization, malaria, health systems strengthening, digital health, and other priority areas of the national health agenda.


Project overview

The Integrated Innovation Highway (IIH) is a Gates Foundation-funded initiative supporting the Government of Ethiopia and the Ministry of Health (MOH) to establish a government-owned platform for identifying health system needs, prioritizing innovations, assessing evidence, and moving proven solutions into routine use at scale. It covers six innovation areas, including medical devices, diagnostics, vaccines, digital health, artificial intelligence, and other health products and system innovations.


Through four functional hubs, the IIH will use AI-assisted tools to strengthen intelligence, evidence assessment, planning, and implementation. AI-enabled point-of-care ultrasound (AI-POCUS), Pluslife tuberculosis testing, and Ebola diagnostics serve as tracer innovations, with a focus on deploying and operationalizing 50 obstetric AI-enabled ultrasound units in selected primary health care facilities in Oromia, Sidama, and Somali regions. This includes strengthening facility readiness, workforce capacity, digital data integration, referral pathways, and government ownership to support sustainable adoption and scale-up.


Position purpose

The AI and Digital Health Specialist will provide in-country technical coordination, stakeholder engagement, and implementation support for digital and AI-enabled activities under Ethiopia’s Integrated Innovation Highway (IIH).


The Specialist will work closely with the Federal Ministry of Health (FMOH), the Health System Innovation and Quality (HSIQ) Lead Executive Office, Strategic Affairs, relevant national institutions such as Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute and INSA, Ethiopian technology partners, and PATH project and technical teams. Key responsibilities include identifying practical needs, coordinating technical inputs, supporting implementation and learning, and promoting alignment with national systems and government priorities.


The Specialist will also coordinate private software development partners, support interoperability standards such as HL7/FHIR and DHIS2, and facilitate field deployments. Responsibility for solution development, technical assurance, regulatory decisions, and approvals will remain with the designated project teams, competent authorities, and relevant specialists.


Key roles and responsibilities

  • Digital and AI solution design, strategy and technical support
  • Provide technical leadership, advisory support, in country coordination on digital health and artificial intelligence (AI) implementation under the Ethiopia’s Integrated Innovation Highway (IIH).
  • Support project teams and government counterparts in gathering user requirements, mapping workflows, consulting stakeholders, documenting specifications for prioritized digital and AI-enabled use cases, including AI-enabled point-of-care ultrasound (POCUS) for obstetric (OB) services.
  • Contribute to discussions and practical assessments of whether proposed AI tools offer value over simpler digital or non-AI approaches, considering accuracy, timeliness, usability, cost, and feasibility.
  • Liaise with Ethiopian AI firms, developers, and other technology partners; coordinate consultations, prototyping, user feedback, testing, documentation, and iterative refinements.
  • Interoperability, data architecture, and infrastructure
  • Support the integration of AI-enabled obstetric POCUS data into the District Health Information Software 2 (DHIS2) and assess alignment with Ethiopia’s digital health architecture and opportunities for interoperability with relevant systems, including eCHIS, EMRs, and surveillance platforms.
  • Collaborate with FMOH data owners, relevant project specialists, and technology providers to establish data exchange workflows, interoperability standards (e.g., HL7/FHIR), and reporting mechanisms, seeking to minimize duplicative reporting.
  • Support the establishment and configuration of server infrastructure for secure storage, management, retrieval, and sharing of AI POCUS images and reports, defining technical requirements for image archiving, data backup, system availability, access control, and disaster recovery.
  • Contribute to the development, review, and use of dashboards or analytics products to inform implementation monitoring, data quality, completeness, and evidence-based decision-making.
  • Responsible AI, cybersecurity, and clinical governance
  • Work with designated AI, clinical, data governance, and cybersecurity specialists to support the coordination and documentation of proportionate risk assessments, validation activities, human-oversight arrangements, and escalation procedures, and performance monitoring.
  • Facilitate consultation with FMOH and relevant institutions, including the Ethiopian Artificial Intelligence Institute (EAII) and INSA, on hosting, privacy, data sovereignty, security, and model deployment options.
  • Promote patient data privacy, confidentiality, cybersecurity, and compliance with applicable digital health standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Support the relevant clinical and regulatory teams by compiling technical information for AI-POCUS evaluation and safety documentation, ensuring formal clinical and regulatory assessments remain the responsibility of qualified specialists and competent authorities.
  • Clinical workflow integration: Referrals, Mentorship, and Implementation
  • Support the development and optimization of digital referral workflows linking spoke facilities with hub hospitals.
  • Support the establishment of remote mentorship systems for healthcare professionals, facilitating virtual case discussions, image reviews, and ongoing technical support to strengthen skills in POCUS utilization.
  • Support implementation planning, technical documentation, system testing, deployment, and troubleshooting of digital health solutions, monitoring system functionality, user adoption, and referral workflows.
  • Coordinate with health authorities, implementing partners, and facility teams to address implementation challenges and ensure digital referral mechanisms are integrated into existing maternal and newborn health service delivery pathways.
  • Management and oversight of technology partners
  • Lead, supervise, and provide technical direction to locally contracted AI companies and software development partners responsible for developing, customizing, deploying, and maintaining AI-enabled POCUS and related digital health solutions.
  • Translate project requirements into clear technical specifications, scopes of work, implementation plans, milestones, and measurable deliverables.
  • Review and validate technical proposals, system designs, software configurations, and interoperability approaches to ensure alignment with project objectives and applicable digital health standards.
  • Monitor the performance of contracted companies against contractual obligations, review and verify deliverables, and convene regular technical review meetings to document progress and follow up on corrective actions.
  • Promote knowledge transfer, technical documentation, and local capacity development to ensure sustainable handover arrangements.
  • undefined
  • Digital health and AI governance
  • Support the development and operationalization of data and AI governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with national policies, FMOH guidelines, and ethical AI principles.
  • Facilitate the establishment of technical and clinical governance structures or working groups involving FMOH, EAII, INSA, and PATH to oversee data sharing, AI model deployment, and system interoperability.
  • Ensure that all digital health solutions adhere to national data governance regulations, data sovereignty requirements, and privacy standards.
  • Coordinate with designated clinical and regulatory specialists to ensure appropriate governance oversight, human-in-the-loop mechanisms, and escalation procedures are documented and implemented for AI-enabled tools.
  • undefined
  • Cross-functional coordination, capacity strengthening, and sustainability
  • Work closely with the Maternal, Newborn and Child Health (MNCH), Digital Health, PMED, HSIQ, and LEO teams to ensure coordinated implementation of digital health and AI interventions under the IIH project.
  • Collaborate with relevant government health authorities, (ministry of Innovation and Technology) implementing partners, hub and spoke facilities, clinical specialists, monitoring and evaluation teams, and technology providers.
  • Facilitate joint planning, technical reviews, implementation monitoring, problem-solving, and continuous quality improvement across participating teams.
  • Contribute information for lifecycle-cost estimates and sustainability discussions—including hosting, connectivity, maintenance, software support, and cybersecurity—in consultation with project finance, procurement, and technical colleagues; support documentation and handover planning.
  • Support government and partner capacity-strengthening activities through coordination of coaching, training sessions, practical guidance, and documentation, drawing on subject-matter experts as needed.
  • Work planning, monitoring, and reporting
  • Contribute to the AI/digital components of the project work plan and support tracking of agreed milestones, dependencies, risks, and periodic progress updates.
  • Support baseline reviews and feasible monitoring activities related to tool usability, adoption, data quality, and implementation readiness, using indicators agreed with the MEL and technical teams.
  • Develop performance indicators and provide technical input for progress reports, technical updates, and continuous quality improvement.

Reporting, coordination, and accountability


The Digital Health and AI Specialist will report directly to the IIH Project Director, working under PATH Ethiopia management and collaborating closely with IIH project teams, regional technical advisors, and PATH’s Africa AI, Data, and Digital leadership for technical guidance.


This role is designed to facilitate and support agreed activities rather than independently own all technical workstreams or approve specialist outputs. Government institutions retain ultimate policy, regulatory, clinical, and data-governance authority. Where advanced expertise in AI, regulatory compliance, clinical safety, cybersecurity, or systems architecture is required, the Specialist will consult and coordinate with appropriately qualified experts, partners, and competent authorities.


Illustrative deliverables


  • Contributions to documented user requirements, workflow assessments, technical specifications, and data governance discussions for agreed priority activities.
  • Coordinated user feedback, testing records, and implementation notes for selected digital or AI-enabled tools, in collaboration with their technical owners.
  • Inputs to responsible AI risk and validation documentation, with review and approval by designated technical specialists and government counterparts.
  • Technical coordination notes and supporting documentation for AI-POCUS or other priority tracer activities, as requested by relevant project leads.
  • Periodic progress summaries, training and knowledge-sharing materials, and contributions to sustainability and handover documentation, as agreed in the workplan.

Required qualifications and experience


  • Master’s degree in health informatics, computer science, data science, software engineering, information systems, biomedical engineering, or related field.
  • At least five to seven years of relevant experience in digital health, health information systems, applied data/AI, or related implementation and coordination work, preferably in Ethiopia.
  • Familiarity with health information systems, data exchange, analytics, user requirements, solution testing, or implementation support; direct hands-on experience in all these areas is not required.
  • Working understanding of practical AI use cases, their limitations, and responsible use considerations, with willingness to engage specialized experts when needed.
  • Experience collaborating with government health institutions, software vendors, multidisciplinary teams, and health program implementers.
  • Strong technical writing, facilitation, stakeholder management, and English communication skills; proficiency in Amharic or another relevant Ethiopian language is an advantage.

Preferred qualifications

  • Exposure to DHIS2, eCHIS, EMR interoperability, FHIR or other health data standards; AI-enabled medical devices; data protection; digital infrastructure; public-sector digital transformation; or government capacity strengthening would be an advantage.

title: Audit Practitioner Apprenticeship - Edinburgh
description:
Please note, this site is only for external candidate applications. If you currently work for Lloyds Banking Group please apply via the internal career site.

Please note: In order to complete an apprenticeship there needs to be a significant learning need. You need to consider your previous qualifications or significant relevant work experience which may mean you cannot proceed with this application.

End Date

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Job Description Summary

Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the programmes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Our apprenticeship programmes may close early if we receive a high number of applications, so it’s best to apply as soon as you can.

If you have any questions, please do contact the team at lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com


Job Description

Duration: 5 years

Salary: £27,400

Location: Edinburgh

Start: September 2027

Qualifications: You’ll work towards the Level 4 Internal Audit Practitioner qualification.


See the small stuff? Shape the big stuff

If you’re big on small details and love solving problems, welcome to your happy place.

At Lloyds Banking Group, Audit is about keeping our business secure, fair and future‑ready. We protect the Group’s assets, reputation and sustainability. And as an apprentice you’ll be part of it from the moment you join.

Making a real impact

Audit’s job is to make sure our risk management, governance and internal controls are rock‑solid. We’re here to keep the business and 28 million customers safe.

That means spotting risks before they become problems, making recommendations that matter, and helping keep the Group fair, trusted and future‑proof.

And here’s something that might surprise you. Our Audit team has its own industry‑leading Data Science unit. We’re experimenting with AI and embedding it into daily audit life. And as an apprentice, you’ll get hands‑on time with these tools, learning how tech is transforming the profession.

Learn it. Do it. Own it

Audit isn’t about sitting on the side lines. We don’t give you a clipboard. Instead, within three months you’ll be working on live audits - observing, contributing, and taking on cases of your own.

As you progress, you’ll spend time in areas like:

  • Business Banking
  • Insurance
  • Technology

Plus, a 6‑month placement outside Audit, an opportunity to work alongside teams like Finance, Tech, Risk, and Customer Services - giving you a 360° view of how we get things done. These will be defined during your programme.

Your licence to ask “Why?”

This is a 5-year apprenticeship programme based in Bristol or Edinburgh. You’ll start by working towards the Level 4 Internal Audit Practitioner qualification. Once completed, you’ll have the opportunity to progress to higher-level professional study, building your expertise and working towards becoming a Chartered Auditor.

In your first 18–24 months, you’ll work towards your Level 4 Internal Audit Practitioner qualification, supported through a mix of structured learning and workshops covering areas such as:

  • Corporate Governance and Risk Management
  • Internal Audit Planning
  • Interpersonal Skills

Your future, fully funded

You’ll earn a competitive salary from day one. Your learning - all of it - tuition, exams, study materials, professional memberships - is covered.

With a team of around 300 audit pros working across a Group of 70,000+ colleagues, the career opportunities are endless.

By the end, you won’t just understand Audit - you’ll be ready to shape it. You’ll have the skills, qualifications and confidence to take your career anywhere. And you’ll have played a key role in Helping Britain Prosper.

Requirements

What you’ll need


  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old at the end of February 2028
  • Nat 5 Maths & English at grades A-C (achieved)
  • 4 Highers BBCC (these grades can be predicted, but any offer made to you will be conditional upon successful achievement of these qualifications)

Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to five years.

Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.

Location

This apprenticeship is based in Edinburgh, and you will be expected to work from your main office location throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.

About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 26th January.

Our roles generate a lot of interest and occasionally we need to close for applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!


If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days (Monday – Friday).


What happens next?
Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in March → Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: Global Service Manager AMS – Enhancement Governance
description:
Job Description Summary

Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!

The Global Service Manager AMS – Enhancements is accountable for end-to-end governance of enhancement demand across the global AMS portfolio, from intake and assessment through delivery, release, and closure. This role partners with business stakeholders, application owners, AMS providers, and technology teams to ensure enhancements are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and within agreed scope, capacity, and commercial frameworks while protecting production stability and validated environments.

Job Description

Global Service Manager AMS – Enhancement Governance

Sandoz continues to go through an exciting and transformative period as a global leader and pioneering provider of sustainable Biosimilar and Generic medicines. As we continue down this new and ambitious path, unique opportunities will present themselves, both professionally and personally. Join us, the future is ours to shape!

Job Summary

Accountable for end-to-end governance of enhancement demand across the global AMS portfolio—from intake, assessment and prioritisation through delivery, release and closure. The role aligns business, application owners, EAS/SST’s, Architecture, Infrastructure, Quality, Cybersecurity, Finance and AMS providers to deliver value within approved scope, capacity, compliance and commercial guardrails while protecting production stability and the validated state.

Your Key Responsibilities

Your responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

Major accountabilities:

  • Lead the global AMS enhancement lifecycle and deliver measurable business value.
  • Own enhancement intake, classification, estimation, prioritisation, approval, delivery, release, acceptance and closure.
  • Maintain a transparent demand pipeline covering value, priority, scope, ownership, effort, cost, capacity, dependencies, compliance impact and delivery status.
  • Apply agreed scope and commercial criteria, delivering routine enhancements within AMS and routing material process, architecture, integration, security, compliance or support-model changes through major-enhancement or project governance.
  • Coordinate solution, risk, effort and operational-impact assessments across EAS/SST’s, Architecture, Infrastructure, Quality, Cybersecurity and AMS providers.
  • Drive value-based prioritisation, capacity allocation, delivery planning and recovery actions; hold providers accountable for estimates, quality, timelines, documentation and risk escalation.
  • Ensure compliance with SDLC, change, release, testing, validation, cybersecurity, data-integrity and GxP/CSV controls.
  • Confirm production readiness, including support ownership, knowledge transfer, CMDB, monitoring, access, recovery, Service Desk documentation and hyper care.
  • Maintain clear boundaries: AMS governs and coordinates delivery; EAS/application owners' own strategy, prioritisation and solution approval; Infrastructure executes changes within its control.
  • Report demand, backlog, capacity, delivery, quality, risk, compliance and benefits; improve cycle time, estimation, automation, reuse and productivity.
  • Own Internal CAB and govern all incoming enhancements
  • Working closely with Change Process Owners from Sandoz IT

Minimum Requirements

What you’ll bring to the role:

· 10+ years in IT, including 5+ years in application service, enhancement, demand, portfolio or managed-service delivery.

· Proven global, multi-supplier enhancement governance across intake, estimation, prioritisation, capacity, delivery, release and benefits.

· Strong SDLC, ITIL, agile, operational-transition and commercial knowledge; experience with ServiceNow or comparable platforms.

· Experience in regulated environments; life sciences, GxP/CSV, data integrity, cybersecurity and audit knowledge preferred.

· Strong supplier management, analytics, facilitation, negotiation, executive communication and cross-functional leadership.

Qualifications

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent
  • ITIL Foundation required.
  • Advanced service, project, agile, cloud, validation or change certification desirable

Why Sandoz?

Generic and Biosimilar medicines are the backbone of the global medicines industry. Sandoz, a leader in this sector, provided more than 900 million patient treatments across 100+ countries in 2024 and while we are proud of this achievement, we have an ambition to do more!

With investments in new development capabilities, production sites, new acquisitions, and partnerships, we have the opportunity to shape the future of Sandoz and help more patients gain access to low-cost, high-quality medicines, sustainably.

Our momentum is powered by an open, collaborative culture driven by our talented and ambitious colleagues, who, in return for applying their skills experience an agile and collegiate environment with impactful, flexible-hybrid careers, where diversity is welcomed and where personal growth is supported!

Join us!


#Sandoz

title: Supp Advanced Pract Prdr, Emer Med - Cypress Hospital
description:
At Memorial Hermann, we pursue a common goal of delivering high quality, efficient care while creating exceptional experiences for every member of our community. When we say every member of our community, that includes our employees. We know that when our employees feel cared for, heard and valued, they are inspired to create moments that exceed expectations, while prioritizing safety, compassion, personalization and efficiency. If you want to advance your career and contribute to our vision of creating healthier communities, now and for generations to come, we want you to be a part of our team.

Job Summary

Responsible for providing comprehensive patient care congruent with role and approved population foci (Family/Individual across lifespan, Adult/Gerontology, Neonatal, Pediatrics, Women’s Health/Gender Related, Psychiatric Mental Health) through systemic assessment, diagnosis, treatment, management, and follow up affecting direct patient care.

Job Description

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS


Nurse Practitioner / Advanced Practice Nurse

  • Education: Graduate of a Nurse Practitioner program approved by the State of Texas and Masters required.
  • May encompass the following specialties: CRNA, CNM, CNS, CNP.
  • Licensed to practice professional nursing by the State of Texas.
  • Licensure by the State of Texas APRN and eligibility for full prescriptive authority by the State of Texas.
  • Certified by a recognized national certification by the State Board of Texas in area of population foci and/or additional specialty recognition beyond the APRN.
  • Eligibility for DEA licensure.
  • Basic Cardiac Life Certification OR Advanced Cardiac Life Certification

Physician Assistant

  • Education: Graduate of a nationally accredited Physician Assistant program, masters strongly preferred.
  • Certified by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants, Inc.
  • Licensed by the Texas State Board of Physician Assistant Examiners.
  • Eligibility for DEA licensure.
  • Basic Cardiac Life Certification OR Advanced Cardiac Life Certification

EXPERIENCE / KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS

  • One (1) year of clinical experience preferred in area of intended practice.

PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES

  • Provides health promotion and the assessment, diagnosis, and management of patient problems which includes the use and prescription of pharmacologic and non-pharmacologic intervention, assessment, triage, and therapeutic management of patient/family needs throughout the disease process and across the health wellness-illness continuum as an integral part of an interdisciplinary team, according to the age/needs of the patient population served.
  • For prescriptive authority, APRN or PA acts under the delegation of a supervising physician, maintaining an active Prescriptive Authority agreement in accordance with regulations and policy.
  • Practices within approved protocols, guidelines, and clinical pathways and evidence based medicine.
  • Transitions between inpatient/outpatient
  • Directs and evaluates throughput; delegates or provides backup assistance including triage
  • Ability to float, round to multiple facilities and/or take call (first call)
  • Provides accurate billing, coding and documentation Completes medical records and submit charges in a timely manner
  • Responsible for overall unit performance in collaboration with physicians or other providers
  • Obtains medical histories; performs physical examinations/ reviews/orders/interprets diagnostic tests and radiographic results; formulates and manages patient treatment plan and outcomes; provides interventions and performs procedures within legal cope and authority that the APRN or PA is approved, delegated to and credentialed to perform including but not limited to incision and drainage, pelvic exams, lesion removal/destruction, suturing, and casting/splinting.
  • Collaborates in the development and evaluation of patient care. Updates clinical guidelines/protocols/pathways; works autonomously and accepts accountability for outcomes; signs orders in accordance with institution and state board requirements; collaborates in research and teaching projects and applies research to practice.
  • Uses interpersonal and verbal communication skills to educate patient/family on care resources; participates in process improvement and multidisciplinary clinical outcome improvement activities utilizing advanced nursing expertise.
  • Ensures safe care to patients, staff and visitors; adheres to all Memorial Hermann policies, procedures, and standards within budgetary specifications including time management, supply management, productivity and quality of service.
  • Promotes individual professional growth and development by meeting requirements for mandatory/continuing education and skills competency; supports department-based goals which contribute to the success of the organization; serves as preceptor, mentor and resource to less experienced staff.
  • Demonstrates commitment to caring for every member of our community by creating compassionate and personalized experiences. Models Memorial Hermann’s service standards by providing safe, caring, personalized and efficient experiences to patients and colleagues.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Senior Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
About us

Southern Cross Health Insurance is shaping a healthier Aotearoa New Zealand. Our purpose is simple: empowering our members to live well for longer. We're here to give peace of mind through timely access to quality care, inspire healthier living, and lead positive change across the health system. As a New Zealand-owned, member-based organisation, we're building a future where wellbeing is at the heart of everything we do -- delivering exceptional value for our members and creating an environment where our people thrive.

Now is an exciting time to join us. You'll be part of a high-performing, values-driven team where people are at the heart of everything we do -- and in return for your talent, you'll have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and be proud of the difference your work makes.

About the role

As we accelerate our shift to a cloud-first, Azure-based technology estate, we're looking for Azure Cloud Engineers to help maintain a resilient, cost-effective and continuously improving cloud infrastructure.


This role plays a key part in our insourcing strategy - strengthening internal capability and supporting future cloud initiatives.


Also hiring: Cloud & Infrastructure Engineer


The Opportunity

This is a hands-on Senior role where you’ll combine cloud engineering with design, technical ownership, and continuous improvement.


Reporting to the Infrastructure Platforms Lead, you’ll design & implement scalable, secure & highly available cloud solutions, while ensuring our Azure infrastructure performs reliably & cost-effectively.


You’ll collaborate on new platform capabilities & infrastructure improvements, with a strong focus on automation, self-service & standardisation.


You’ll also take ownership of troubleshooting complex platform issues, root cause analysis & implementing sustainable fixes.


Beyond delivery, you’ll help shape engineering patterns, influence how our cloud platforms evolve & support the growth of other engineers across the team.


What you'll do

  • Design, build & improve Azure cloud infrastructure
  • Take cloud solutions from design through to delivery
  • Build reusable Terraform/IaC modules, automation & deployment patterns
  • Improve self-service & standardisation, reducing manual work
  • Keep our platforms secure, resilient, reliable & cost-effective
  • Troubleshoot complex issues, get to the root cause & put lasting fixes in place
  • Help shape engineering standards & better ways of working
  • Mentor other engineers & share your technical knowledge

What you'll bring

We’re looking for someone who has already built a strong career in hands-on cloud engineering, rather than someone looking to make their first move into cloud at Senior level.


You’ll ideally bring:

  • Strong hands-on Azure cloud/infrastructure engineering experience
  • Experience designing & delivering complex cloud infrastructure solutions
  • Strong Terraform / IaC capability, including reusable modules
  • Experience with Azure Landing Zones, ideally including design rather than solely operating within an established environment
  • Automation, scripting & CI/CD experience
  • Experience across cloud security, identity, governance, resilience & operational practices
  • Experience working across Azure cloud & hybrid environments
  • Strong troubleshooting, monitoring, incident & problem-management capability
  • The ability to explain technical decisions & trade-offs clearly
  • Experience influencing engineering practices & supporting adoption across teams
  • A collaborative approach with experience mentoring or developing other engineers

Know a great Azure Engineer?

Yep, we’re hiring at that level too! So send them our way. We’d love to hear from them!


The key difference is that our Senior Engineer takes greater ownership of complex design & delivery, contributes to setting engineering standards, mentors others & helps teams adopt engineering patterns.


One team. Two levels. Plenty to get your hands on.


Why join us

We’re investing – in people, in technology, and in the mission. At a time when the market is hesitant, we’re continuing to strengthen our foundations and build our capabilities.


You’ll work closely with the Head of Technology Platforms, product and engineering leaders, and the wider Digital team, with real ownership over how the work grows.


We’re building something worth joining. Our teams are growing, our employer brand is gaining real traction, and the way we show up for our members and each other is being recognised. In 2026, Southern Cross placed 8th in the Kantar Corporate Reputation Index and 5th in New Zealand for Trust.


Who we are


Ngākau nui. Āhurutanga. Tikanga.


Join a proud, diverse team that's always there, always real, always true. If you thrive in a caring, honest and open culture, we think you'll love working with us.


We know our team's culture and wellbeing drive us forward. That's why we prioritise not only professional development but opportunities to thrive personally. We offer exceptional work/life balance, and our people are encouraged — and rewarded — for living well.


Southern Cross employee benefits include:

  • Five days of wellbeing leave per year
  • Health insurance for you and your immediate whānau
  • Life insurance cover and discounts on pet and travel insurance
  • Extra parental leave benefits and financial wellbeing support
  • Participation in our workplace wellbeing programme
  • The option to purchase flexi leave for study, volunteering, or supporting your whānau
  • An annual volunteer day to contribute to a cause with your team

description:

Locatie: Opmeer

Ontwerp technologie met wereldwijde impact

Wil jij werken aan innovatieve machineoplossingen die wereldwijd worden ingezet in de voedingsmiddelenindustrie? Bij JBT Marel krijg je de ruimte om jouw technische kennis en creativiteit in te zetten voor de ontwikkeling van geavanceerde food processing-technologie.

Over de functie

Als Mechanical Engineer word je onderdeel van een gespecialiseerd engineeringteam van zes engineers in Opmeer. Samen ontwikkelen en verbeteren jullie machines voor de verwerking van eenden en kalkoenen.

Je vertaalt klantwensen naar slimme, betrouwbare en praktische mechanische oplossingen. Daarbij ligt de nadruk op het optimaliseren van bestaande machines, maar werk je ook mee aan nieuwe producten en technologieën.

Door de korte lijnen en de omvang van het team krijg je veel verantwoordelijkheid en zie je direct resultaat van jouw werk.

Wat ga je doen?

  • Ontwerpen, aanpassen en optimaliseren van mechanische machineonderdelen en samenstellingen.
  • Vertalen van klantwensen naar technische oplossingen.
  • Verbeteren van bestaande machines op het gebied van prestaties, hygiëne en betrouwbaarheid.
  • Ontwikkelen van nieuwe machines en doorontwikkelen van bestaande platformen.
  • Uitwerken van ontwerpen in Autodesk Inventor.
  • Opstellen en beheren van technische tekeningen, documentatie en stuklijsten (BOM’s).
  • Samenwerken met engineers uit verschillende disciplines aan complete klantoplossingen.

Jouw bijdrage: je vertaalt technische ideeën naar robuuste, efficiënte en productieklare machines die wereldwijd impact maken.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Een afgeronde hbo-opleiding Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of vergelijkbaar.
  • Ervaring met mechanical engineering, bij voorkeur in de machinebouw of food processing.
  • Kennis van CAD-software, bij voorkeur Autodesk Inventor.
  • Ervaring met PDM/PLM-systemen en technische documentatie is een pré.
  • Een nauwkeurige en oplossingsgerichte werkhouding.
  • Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in het Nederlands en Engels.
  • Een teamgerichte instelling en interesse in internationale projecten.
  • Bereidheid om incidenteel te reizen (circa 5-10%).

Werken bij JBT Marel

Bij JBT Marel werk je aan technologie die ertoe doet. Samen met internationale collega's bouwen we aan slimme oplossingen voor een duurzame voedselindustrie.

Onze cultuur draait om samenwerking, vakmanschap, innovatie en integriteit. We geven je de ruimte om initiatief te nemen, jezelf te ontwikkelen en je ambities waar te maken.


Wat bieden we jou?

  • 40 vakantiedagen en flexibele werktijden.
  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken.
  • Een goede pensioenregeling en mogelijkheid tot collectieve zorgverzekering.
  • Laptop, mobiele telefoon en faciliteiten voor een goede thuiswerkplek.
  • Persoonlijke begeleiding via een mentor en buddy.
  • Ruime ontwikkelmogelijkheden via ons Learning Platform, LinkedIn Learning en Busuu.
  • Een open en inclusieve werkomgeving waarin je kunt leren, experimenteren en groeien.
  • Volop doorgroeimogelijkheden, zowel nationaal als internationaal.

Bij ons vind je niet alleen een baan, maar ook ruimte om aan je carrière te bouwen.

Klaar om impact te maken?

Wil jij jouw engineeringtalent inzetten voor hoogwaardige machineoplossingen en meebouwen aan de toekomst van food processing?

Dan maken we graag kennis met je!

Analog Devices is seeking a Test Engineer to join the Evaluation Board (EVB) Operations team within Manufacturing Engineering. In this role, you will support the development, validation, and manufacturing test readiness of customer evaluation boards from prototype through production release.


You will work closely with Product Lines, Applications Engineers, Project Managers, Manufacturing Engineering teams, and Contract Manufacturers to develop test solutions, validate board functionality, troubleshoot technical issues, and ensure evaluation boards are ready for manufacturing and customer deployment

  • Support qualification and deployment of test platforms, fixtures, and methodologies.

  • Partner with Contract Manufacturers to establish and sustain manufacturing test capabilities.

  • Assist with evaluation board packaging, kitting, shipment readiness, and RMA investigations.

Required Skills

  • Knowledge of IPC-A-610 and electronics quality standards.
  • Experience working with Contract Manufacturers in a high-mix manufacturing environment.
  • Familiarity with automated test systems, scripting, or data analysis tools.
  • Experience supporting New Product Introduction (NPI), production transfers, or sustaining engineering activities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Experience with PCB-level testing, troubleshooting, and hardware debug.

title: Senior Product Manager, Web Proxy & Secure Web Gateway (SWG) (hybrid)
description:
Our Mission

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.

Who We Are

In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

Job Summary

Palo Alto Networks is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Web Proxy & Secure Web Gateway (SWG) to lead product strategy, roadmap development, and customer adoption for enterprise web proxy capabilities within our Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platform.

You will define how organizations modernize and consolidate legacy forward proxy and Secure Web Gateway architectures using PAN-OS, Panorama, and Strata Cloud Manager (SCM).

This role combines deep network security knowledge with customer-focused product management. You will work closely with engineering, UX, technical marketing, and field teams to deliver secure, scalable, and intuitive proxy solutions across physical firewalls and VM-Series deployments.

Your work will span explicit and transparent proxy architectures, HTTP/HTTPS traffic inspection, TLS decryption, identity-based authentication, routing, and centralized security policy management.

Your Impact

  • Own Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and execute a 12–18 month roadmap for enterprise Web Proxy and Secure Web Gateway capabilities on Palo Alto Networks NGFW platforms, aligned with customer requirements, security outcomes, and business priorities.
  • Lead Legacy Proxy Modernization: Drive the end-to-end customer migration experience from traditional web proxy and SWG environments to consolidated NGFW-based architectures managed through PAN-OS, Panorama, and Strata Cloud Manager.
  • Define Proxy Architecture and Workflows: Translate customer and technical requirements into product capabilities for explicit proxy, transparent proxy, forward proxy, HTTP/HTTPS traffic handling, loopback interfaces, Destination NAT (DNAT), and upstream traffic steering.
  • Advance Web Security and TLS Inspection: Partner with engineering to improve HTTPS inspection, TLS decryption, CONNECT and Server Name Indication (SNI) validation, domain fronting prevention, DNS Security integration, and advanced threat prevention.
  • Improve Identity-Based Access: Define authentication and user identity experiences using technologies such as Kerberos, SAML 2.0, and Palo Alto Networks Cloud Identity Engine.
  • Simplify Configuration and Management: Own customer workflows across command-line interfaces (CLI), REST APIs, and graphical user interfaces (GUI), improving deployment, policy configuration, troubleshooting, and operational visibility.
  • Translate Customer Needs into Product Requirements: Conduct customer discovery, analyze migration barriers, define product requirements documents (PRDs), establish acceptance criteria, and prioritize capabilities based on customer value, technical feasibility, and business impact.
  • Drive Cross-Functional Product Delivery: Collaborate with engineering, UX/design, technical marketing, sales engineering, and go-to-market teams to launch features, support strategic customer opportunities, and accelerate product adoption.
  • Measure Product Outcomes: Establish and monitor product adoption, migration success, configuration efficiency, deployment readiness, and troubleshooting metrics, including mean time to resolution (MTTR).
  • Apply AI to Product Management: Use generative AI, large language models (LLMs), analytics, and rapid prototyping tools to improve product discovery, requirements development, customer insight analysis, and product delivery while maintaining accuracy and responsible use.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, technical marketing, or engineering leadership, including experience defining requirements or delivering enterprise networking or network security products.
  • 3+ years of relevant experience with web proxy, forward proxy, Secure Web Gateway (SWG), next-generation firewall (NGFW), or closely related network security technologies.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise networking and web traffic flows, including HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP, TLS/SSL, proxy deployment models, and network address translation (NAT).
  • Working knowledge of explicit proxy and transparent proxy architectures, including configuration, deployment considerations, and enterprise security use cases.
  • Experience translating technical networking or security requirements into product roadmaps, PRDs, user stories, and engineering deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with software engineering teams on architecture, technical trade-offs, feature prioritization, and product execution.
  • Experience conducting customer discovery, evaluating product adoption challenges, and using customer feedback and data to prioritize product improvements.
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Secure Web Gateway products, legacy web proxy modernization, proxy consolidation, or migration from enterprise proxy platforms.
  • Familiarity with TLS inspection, SSL decryption, proxy auto-configuration (PAC) files, CONNECT methods, SNI validation, DNS Security, and domain fronting prevention.
  • Knowledge of identity and authentication technologies, including Kerberos, SAML 2.0, and cloud identity integrations.
  • Experience with PAN-OS, Panorama, Strata Cloud Manager, Palo Alto Networks NGFWs, or comparable enterprise firewall and security management platforms.
  • Familiarity with CLI, REST APIs, GUI-based configuration, policy management, and network troubleshooting workflows.
  • Understanding of Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), Secure Access Service Edge (SASE), Security Service Edge (SSE), or cloud-delivered security architectures.
  • Experience using AI-assisted product management tools, generative AI, LLMs, analytics, or rapid prototyping to improve product development workflows.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

Compensation Disclosure

The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here.

$153,000.00 - $247,500.00/yr

Our Commitment

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com.

Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Class Definition

GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES: To perform moderately complex engineering work in the area of specialization indicated by the title of the class of position; to assist a civil engineer or engineering technician of a higher rank in the supervision of a subordinate staff of engineering technicians in the area of specialization indicated by the title of the class of position; and, to do related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Works under the supervision of a civil engineer or engineering technician of a higher rank, involving the exercise of independent judgment in the application of the basic principles of engineering; work is reviewed in process and upon completion for results obtained.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Assists a superior in the supervision of a staff of subordinate engineering technicians and/or other personnel assigned to assist.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • Under supervision, in the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position:

Construction and Maintenance:

  • On a construction or highway maintenance assignment, to oversee and perform inspections and document all materials and workmanship going into the project; to make daily, weekly, and monthly estimates of work accomplished as required; to submit detailed reports as to progress of work and manner of performance in accordance with current policies and procedures; to submit final estimates for contract items; to assist in and oversee inspections of the workmanship and practices of the contractors and/or state crews engaged in highway construction or maintenance projects; to coordinate appropriate materials tests during the construction or maintenance phase of projects; to check the work of contractors or crews against plans and specifications and to immediately report findings contrary to such plans and specifications; to study and evaluate requests by contractors for changes in plans during construction; to approve minor changes in plans on projects when authority has been delegated, and to submit all other requests for changes in plans to a superior for approval; to assist a superior in the supervision of subordinate engineering technicians’ workmanship, inspections and materials testing activities; or to act as a Construction Resident Engineer on simple to moderately complex construction projects.

Materials:

  • To assist a civil engineer or an engineering technician of higher rank in the supervision of a staff of subordinate Engineering Technicians engaged in materials testing activities; to take and test samples of aggregates, mixes, asphalt, steel and other materials used in highway or bridge construction; to prepare materials test reports; to assist in reviewing the work of Engineering Technicians of lower rank, stationed at materials plants, construction projects and the central laboratory, or to perform such work as assigned; to assist in conducting materials research.

Surveyor-In-Training:

  • As a Surveyor-In-Training, to assist in the coordination and supervision of the work of a field survey party performing comprehensive civil engineering field surveys and related duties for the location, construction and reconstruction of state highways and bridges; and to perform complex technical survey work.

Final Acceptance:

  • To assist in supervising the preparation of contract documents and specifications for engineering, construction, reconstruction and maintenance of state highways and bridges; to assure compliance with all federal and state regulations; to monitor all preliminary engineering contracts, and to assist in the instruction of personnel in construction procedures; to prepare quantity computations and cost estimates for all contracts, and to assist in the updating of the Secondary Road Plan; to review and verify final quantities used in various construction projects in the transportation area, ensuring that all work accomplished is in conformance with state specifications and federal requirements.

Natural Resources:

  • To perform moderately complex engineering functions and to assist in the planning and supervision of technical engineering work related to the development, construction and maintenance of state parks, recreation areas, structures and grounds, and/or stormwater management; to assist an engineer, or an engineering technician of a higher classification, in planning and constructing of roadways, water systems, building and related structures; to assist in the conduct of surveys and in the preparation of surveys and in the preparation of topographical maps and wetlands project evaluations.

Construction Records:

  • To provide technical computer support and perform record keeping tasks within the state’s road and bridge construction program; to render assistance in the resolution of general record keeping problems as they relate to individual projects; to provide computer orientation and training to new employees, and update existing employees on revisions and/or the implementation of new procedures and practices; to monitor problems and recommend possible program corrective actions; to be accountable for ensuring that computerized records are maintained consistent with the Procedures of Uniform Record Keeping (PURK); to maintain both electronic and/or paper based daily engineers’ documentation for work performed by contractors; to consolidate vital specific project data and prepare reports thereon related to item ledger sheets, other project worksheets, materials reports, and time sheets for projects; to input project specific data utilizing approved methods as it relates to the appropriate category; to assist in the preparation of and to enter Reports of Change, contract status, biweekly contractor invoices and progress payment, correspondence updates and other information related to the project; contract agenda, bi-weekly progress payments, correspondence, updates, and other information related to the project; to maintain the approved computerized construction record keeping system throughout all phases of construction activity; to facilitate the final acceptance of the project documentation upon project completion utilizing established practices and procedures.
  • To do related work as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND CAPACITIES: A working knowledge of, and the ability to apply the basic principles of civil engineering applicable to the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge in the use of current computer software, such as Microsoft Office; a working knowledge of the basic materials, elements or products commonly used in the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge of, and the ability to apply the basic principles of the systems of measurement applicable to the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge of the field equipment, instruments, techniques and procedures applicable to the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge of the procedures, rules, guidelines and standards used in the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; the ability to read and interpret technical specifications and engineering plans, maps and drawings; the ability to supervise the work of engineering technicians and others engaged in either design and/or construction or maintenance, or materials testing; and related capacities and abilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Graduation from a community college or technical institute, or completion of two years of study in an accredited college including the successful completion of courses in mathematics, construction management, computer-aided drafting, civil engineering technology, and/or structural drafting; and

Experience: At least three (3) years of employment as an engineering technician in a public agency or in private industry which has provided responsible experience in an area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position.

Or, any combination of education and experience that shall be substantially equivalent to the above education and experience.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

1. Must possess and maintain a valid motor vehicle operator’s license as a condition of employment.

2. Must be physically fit to perform assigned duties as evidenced by a physician’s certificate.

3. At the time of appointment and continually thereafter, employees in the Surveyor-In-Training classification must possess a valid certificate from the R.I. Board of Registration for Land Surveyors.

Purpose of this position / Position summary

The Innovation Manager will be responsible for identifying, developing, and translating high-impact deeptech opportunities from IIT Madras and other universities into commercially viable solutions for ZEISS. The role exists to bridge academic research, startups, and ZEISS business units, ensuring the successful incubation and transfer of new technologies. The position contributes to ZEISS’s global innovation strategy by driving collaboration and fostering an entrepreneurial culture within the ZEISS Innovation Hub Chennai.

Primary duties and responsibilities

  • Identify and evaluate deeptech opportunities:
    • Scout and assess innovation topics emerging from IIT Madras and partner universities. Evaluate ideas based on desirability, feasibility, and viability for ZEISS.
  • Build and maintain innovation partnerships:
    • Develop and manage relationships with academic institutions, startups, and ZEISS departments globally. Act as a key point of contact for the Innovation Hub Chennai.
  • Conduct innovation and market research:
    • Lead studies on emerging technologies and market trends. Identify customer needs and define solution concepts with interdisciplinary teams.
  • Initiate and manage projects:
    • Drive the development of proof-of-concept demonstrators and prototypes. Manage internal and external partners to ensure knowledge transfer to ZEISS business units.
  • Support technology and business transfer:

  • Screen and evaluate startups:

  • Foster innovation culture:

title: Training Delivery Senior Specialist - WebOps - Web Analytics
description:
Join Us!

At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

We are seeking a Training Delivery Specialist who combines deep hands-on expertise in Web Analytics, Tagging Infrastructure, and GCP Data Engineering with a passion for adult learning and technical enablement. In this role, you will bridge the gap between analytics operations, data engineering, and learning delivery. You will diagnose capability gaps, design practical, production-aligned technical curricula, and deliver hands-on training to upskill operations and engineering teams across end-to-end measurement, BigQuery analytics, ETL workflows, and emerging AI/LLM data solutions.


Responsibilities:

1. Technical Training Delivery & Enablement

  • Deliver engaging, hands-on technical training sessions, live labs, bootcamps, and debug clinics across both classroom and virtual formats.
  • Demystify complex tracking, data collection, and pipeline architectures (e.g., client-side vs. server-side GTM, attribution models, BigQuery partition/cluster optimization, ETL pipeline debugging, and LLM prompt design).
  • Facilitate hands-on walkthroughs for building robust tagging strategies, validating data layers, peer-reviewing SQL queries, and optimizing campaign analytics.

2. Curriculum Design & Content Creation

  • Design, build, and continuously update comprehensive technical learning paths, hands-on lab exercises, and evaluation rubrics based on adult learning principles.
  • Create real-world, production-aligned exercises covering tag deployment, data warehouse modeling in BigQuery, and pipeline orchestration.
  • Develop implementation documentation templates, training modules, and best-practice guides for DataOps/DevOps release management.

3. Capability Assessment & Learning Impact

  • Proactively assess current-state skills across operations and engineering verticals within GOC to build structured capability roadmaps.
  • Design and implement rigorous pre- and post-training assessments, practical data-modeling challenges, and tag audit simulations to measure measurable skill acquisition.
  • Leverage learning metrics and operational performance data to evaluate program effectiveness, demonstrate ROI, and optimize learning interventions.

4. Stakeholder & Domain Collaboration

  • Forge strategic relationships with Product Marketers, Senior Data Engineers, Technical Leads, and training partners to keep training curricula aligned with shifting business goals and industry standards.
  • Serve as the resident Subject Matter Expert on Google’s marketing and measurement ecosystem, BigQuery data warehousing, and modern data-layer architectures.

Technical Scope & Requirements:

  • Web Analytics & Tagging Architecture: Designing and deploying end-to-end tagging strategies using Google Tag Manager (GTM), Global Site Tag (gtag.js), Google Analytics 4 (GA4) understanding attribution modeling, cross-domain tracking, and headless/coupled CMS data layer integration.
  • Data Engineering & BigQuery: Architecting, querying, and optimizing large datasets using advanced SQL in GCP BigQuery; building and troubleshooting batch/streaming ETL pipelines; understanding OLAP concepts and data warehousing design.
  • Modern DataOps & Applied AI: Implementing release management, error handling, system stability, and data quality checks; applying Large Language Models (LLMs) and prompt engineering patterns to streamline data extraction, documentation, and technical problem-solving.
  • Web Fundamentals: Reading and debugging HTML5, CSS/CSS3, JavaScript, and basic PHP/server logic to diagnose tag execution failures, race conditions, and DOM changes.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: 7–10+ years of total experience, including:
  • At least 4–5 years of hands-on technical experience in web analytics implementation (GTM, GA4, Ads) and data engineering using advanced SQL on GCP BigQuery.
  • At least 2–3 years in a role delivering technical training, facilitating bootcamps, or leading structured technical mentorship/enablement programs.
  • Web Analytics Expertise: Proven track record in implementing end-to-end website tagging strategies, data layer validation, and campaign performance troubleshooting.
  • Data Engineering Depth: Demonstrated proficiency in advanced SQL, data manipulation, and building/maintaining ETL pipelines in GCP BigQuery.
  • Web Tech Acumen: Solid hands-on understanding of JavaScript, HTML, and CSS to audit, inspect, and troubleshoot website code and tracking scripts.
  • Instructional Competence: Strong foundation in adult learning principles, instructional design, and technical presentation skills, with comfort leading live coding and data debugging sessions.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Practical experience working with Large Language Models, prompt engineering, and translating business workflows into AI-augmented data solutions.
  • Experience with Headless or Decoupled CMS platforms (e.g., Brightspot, Contentful, Strapi, Drupal, or AEM).
  • Experience with DataOps/DevOps practices, CI/CD code check-in workflows, and peer-reviewing production SQL queries.
  • Proficiency with data visualization tools (Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI) to present learning impact and analytics data.
  • Google Cloud (GCP) certifications (e.g., Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Digital Leader) or Google Analytics/Ads certifications.
  • Certifications in Project Management (Agile/Scrum, PMP) or Process Improvement (Six Sigma).

Benefits

  • We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage

  • We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums

  • Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

The OT (Operational Technology) Cybersecurity Engineering and Innovation team is responsible for the strategic and technical direction of OT/IACS (Industrial Automated Control Systems) cybersecurity in Chevron. About the Company

The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.

Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.


About the Position

The OT (Operational Technology) Cybersecurity Engineering and Innovation team is responsible for the strategic and technical direction of OT/IACS (Industrial Automated Control Systems) cybersecurity in Chevron Engine, Bengaluru.


Key Responsibilities

  • Contribute to the development and execution of enterprise-wide OT/IACS cybersecurity strategies, initiatives, and technology programs.
  • Design, evaluate, and advise on secure OT/IACS network architectures, including data flows, communications, ports, protocols, and services.
  • Establish and promote secure-by-design cybersecurity guardrails for OT architectures, solutions, and technologies.
  • Provide expert guidance on emerging technologies, risk assessments, and long-term OT cybersecurity roadmaps to support strategic decision-making.
  • Apply industry standards and frameworks (e.g., NIST 800-53/82, IEC 62443, MITRE ATT&CK for ICS) to enhance cyber defense capabilities.
  • Lead or support OT cybersecurity research, testing, and proof-of-concept initiatives for innovative technologies.
  • Perform cybersecurity assessments of IACS designs, installations, and emerging OT solutions to identify risks and determine criticality.
  • Conduct comprehensive OT cybersecurity assessments, including architecture reviews, system and component analysis, network topology evaluations, and data flow mapping.
  • Support deployment of OT cybersecurity safeguards, including asset management, endpoint protection, logging, firewall policies, and vulnerability management, in collaboration with OT product teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or master’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or related STEM field is preferred with 5 to 10 years of experience.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in conducting cybersecurity assessments and creating a detailed mitigation plan and recommendations to address gaps identified
  • Experience in performing OT/IACS vulnerability scans, passively and actively with technologies such as Tenable Nessus or NMAP scanning tools.
  • Experience with selecting, designing, architecting, and deploying security technologies to an OT/IACS environment
  • Communicates in a clear, concise, understandable manner both orally and in writing.
