title: Senior ETL Developer
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities

  • Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
  • Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
  • Collaboration with peers, participate in code reviews, and promote a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
  • Stay informed of industry technology trends and innovations and actively contribute to the organization’s technology communities to foster a culture of technical excellence and growth.
  • Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
  • Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Senior ETL Developer at Barclays where you will spearhead the evolution of our infrastructure and deployment pipelines, driving innovation and operational excellence. You will harness cutting-edge technology to build and manage robust, scalable and secure infrastructure, ensuring seamless delivery of our digital solutions.

To be successful as a Senior ETL Developer, you should have experience with:

  • Strong expertise in ETL technologies, preferably Ab Initio. Ability to design, develop, and maintain complex Ab Initio ETL processes and data flows.

  • Hands‑on expertise in ETL development (Ab Initio), data warehousing, Oracle, and Unix.

  • Solid understanding of data warehouse concepts, including dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, and enterprise‑scale ETL architecture. Proven experience in data pipeline optimization, performance tuning, and data quality management.

  • Proficiency in shell scripting and programming languages such as Scala or Python.A strong focus on automation using Unix/Python scripting.

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  • Expertise in SQL, including advanced SQL capabilities.

  • Broader knowledge of data warehousing practices.

  • Familiarity with data transformation and data quality tools.

  • Prior experience working within the banking or financial services domain.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

The role is based out of Pune.

title: Maintenance & Integration Expert (m/f/x)
description:
ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology​

​

Enabler for smaller, more powerful, and more energy-efficient microchips​

​

Working for tomorrow today. ​

Around 80 percent of all microchips worldwide are produced using ZEISS technologies. As the centerpiece of every electronically controlled system, they have become an integral part of our everyday lives – whether in smartphones, smart homes or smart factories. ZEISS is a technology leader in the field of semiconductor manufacturing equipment. With high-precision lithography optics, photomask systems and process control solutions, ZEISS enables the production of ever smaller, increasingly powerful, and more energy-efficient microchips, and thus plays a pivotal role in the age of micro- and nanoelectronics.


The Maintenance Management area (SMT-OM) is responsible for maintenance processes of SMT secondary equipment and consolidates all manufacturing-related topics. The setup and integration of equipment into the SMT core competencies—such as optical metrology systems and interferometry—create an optimal interface to R&D. In addition, these assets must be kept in good working order through preventive maintenance and repairs.



Your Role

  • Perform mechanical maintenance, inspection, and repair work on complex production, metrology, and assembly systems; analyze mechanical disturbances, systematically isolate root causes, and implement countermeasures.
  • Support the setup, integration, and commissioning of new machines and equipment.
  • accompany the ramp-up of Anlagen (systems) and identify technical weaknesses and improvement potential early.
  • Carry out repairs, modifications, adjustments, and replacement of mechanical components; participate in preventive maintenance, retrofit, and optimization measures.
  • Document completed work, fault patterns, and technical solutions in the designated systems in a traceable manner; create and update work instructions, checklists, and maintenance documentation as needed.
  • Coordinate actions with system operators, internal departments, and external service partners.
  • Adhere consistently to applicable safety, quality, and cleanliness standards.

Your Profile

  • Successfully completed vocational training leading to the status of state-certified master craftsman or technician (m/f/x) in Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronics / Electrical Engineering or an equivalent qualification and field.
  • Professional experience in mechanical maintenance, mechanical engineering, special purpose machinery, or technical service is advantageous.
  • Good knowledge in at least several of the following areas: mechanics and precision mechanics, pneumatics and possibly hydraulics, assembly and adjustment of mechanical subsystems, technical drawings and bill of materials, systematic fault analysis.
  • Ideally, experience with complex or automated production equipment.
  • Independent, structured, and solution-oriented working style, with a strong emphasis on quality and safety.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills, and willingness to pursue ongoing professional development.
  • Willingness to work in required shift models or on-call duties if applicable to the role.


Our Added Value

We provide stability and security!

The long-standing success, strong market position of ZEISS, and the continuously growing demand for IT components offer security for every ZEISS employee and a reliable long-term perspective you can count on.

Your work-life balance matters to us!

Benefit from flexible working time models (including flexible shift systems), the option to work remotely, and a range of childcare support services.

Your skills are highly valued!

At ZEISS, we offer a wide range of opportunities for professional development, including qualification programs, our internal online learning platform CurioZ, external training opportunities, and attractive career paths. With individually defined annual development goals, we support our employees in achieving their career ambitions.

Your work is valuable!

As part of our team, you will benefit from a variety of attractive employee benefits, such as corporate benefits programs, subsidies for the Germany ticket and company bicycles, as well as an award-winning pension scheme. In addition, you will of course receive collectively agreed special payments, including holiday pay, Christmas bonuses, transformation payments, and additional collective bonuses (T-Zug), as well as an annual performance-based bonus tied to the fiscal year.

We invest in your health & well-being!

Our health management program includes online fitness classes, webinars, partnerships with gyms, ZEISS sports groups and running clubs, occupational health physicians, and a unique health partnership with Barmer, offering health courses and a personal contact. In our company restaurants, you will enjoy healthy and diverse meals, including daily vegetarian and vegan options as well as regional organic products.

People are at the center of everything we do!

ZEISS is a foundation-owned company. This is why we are deeply committed to values such as social responsibility, family-friendliness, and the social security of our employees. They are the driving force behind our innovation and the engine of our company—and they are our top priority. In addition, we offer flat hierarchies along with autonomy and responsibility.

Learn more about us as a company & team | ZEISS SMT (About us as company & team | ZEISS Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology) and your career opportunities at ZEISS SMT (Your Career and Job offerings at ZEISS SMT)!

Your ZEISS Recruiting Team:

Marlies Weisser

title: Quarry Manager | Clarence NSW
description:
QUARRY MANAGER

Clarence Quarry | Clarence, NSW | Heidelberg Materials

Lead a high-performing team. Drive operational excellence. Shape the future of our quarry operations.

Heidelberg Materials Australia is seeking an experienced quarrying professional and proven operational leader to lead our operations at Clarence Quarry, located just outside Lithgow in the beautiful NSW Blue Mountains.

Reporting to the Regional Supply Chain Manager, this is a key leadership position with responsibility for the overall performance and strategic direction of the quarry. You will lead all aspects of site operations, including people leadership, production, health and safety, environmental compliance, operational development and financial performance.

This is an excellent opportunity for an accomplished operational leader who is passionate about developing people, driving continuous improvement and delivering sustainable business outcomes.

What you'll be responsible for:

  • Lead and inspire your team: Provide visible, engaging and effective leadership, building a high-performing culture where people are empowered, developed and aligned towards achieving shared goals.
  • Drive business performance: Take ownership of operational and financial outcomes, including production targets, KPIs, budgeting, cost control, business planning and identifying opportunities for growth.
  • Oversee quarry operations: Manage day-to-day site activities, ensuring efficient production, effective quarry development, preventative maintenance and optimal utilisation of resources.
  • Champion safety and risk management: Foster a proactive safety culture, ensuring high-risk activities are effectively managed and that the health, safety and wellbeing of employees and contractors remain a priority.
  • Promote environmental responsibility: Drive environmental compliance and continuous improvement initiatives, maintaining the site's reputation as a responsible operator and industry leader.
  • Deliver operational excellence: Identify and implement opportunities to improve productivity, processes and overall site performance while supporting the long-term sustainability of the operation.

What you'll bring:

  • Hold a minimum Tier 2 NSW Quarry Manager qualification and have a sound understanding of NSW quarrying legislation, regulatory requirements, environmental obligations and relevant statutory responsibilities, with appropriate qualifications or competencies to fulfil the requirements of the role.
  • Demonstrated experience in quarry operations, with a strong understanding of quarry production processes, extraction methodologies, processing plant operations, quarry development and maintenance. Previous experience in a Quarry Manager or senior operational leadership role within the quarrying industry will be highly regarded.
  • A strong track record of driving business performance, operational improvement and positive organisational change.
  • Commercial acumen, with the ability to interpret business performance, manage budgets and make sound decisions that deliver sustainable results.
  • A genuine commitment to safety, with a proactive approach to risk management and a strong alignment with our Zero Harm philosophy.
  • Strong communication, negotiation and influencing skills, with the ability to build effective relationships across all levels of the business and with external stakeholders.
  • A solutions-focused mindset, with the ability to prioritise competing demands, make timely decisions and perform effectively in a dynamic environment.
  • Resilience, adaptability and a collaborative approach, with the ability to navigate change and bring people along on the journey.
  • A passion for continuous improvement, innovation and developing a culture of accountability and operational excellence.

What we offer:

  • Competitive base salary package and performance-based incentive program.
  • Fully maintained company vehicle.
  • Company-provided uniforms and personal protective equipment (PPE).
  • Long-term career stability with a globally recognised organisation.
  • Ongoing training, professional development and support from an experienced management team.
  • Opportunities for career progression and development across our national operations.
  • The opportunity to make a genuine impact within an established and successful operation.

Build your future with Heidelberg Materials

Heidelberg Materials Australia is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, inclusion and the unique perspectives that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.

We welcome applications from people of all walks of life, including Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples, people with disability, individuals from culturally and linguistically diverse backgrounds, and members of the LGBTQIA+ community.

If you have the right to work in Australia and are committed to maintaining a safe, fit-for-work environment, we encourage you to apply.

Take the next step in your career. Join Heidelberg Materials and help us build a better future.

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Kronobergs län
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Kronobergs län.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

title: Field Services Technician I
description:
Overview:
 The Field Service Technician plays an important role in enabling a seamless user experience. Responsibilities encompass a wide range of tasks, from meticulously tracking orders to efficiently managing hardware and accessory deployment. Field Service Technicians are the backbone of front-line user support, ensuring that conference rooms are well-maintained and behind-the-scenes user setups are flawlessly executed. Beyond their technical duties, Field Service Technicians focus on fostering strong relationships with users, understanding their needs, and ensuring their satisfaction. They will support Astreya's ever-expanding customer base and ensure a consistently high-quality user support experience. The successful candidate will be familiar with industry best practices and willing to go above and beyond for our clients.


Scope:
 ● Provide end-to-end onsite and remote user support, ensuring high-quality solutions and user experiences.
● Manage inventory, assets, and e-recycling, utilizing data management software for accuracy and workflow efficiency.
● Diagnose hardware issues, support AV equipment, and collaborate across teams to ensure smooth operations and customer satisfaction.



Primary Responsibilities:


● User Support: Provide end-to-end onsite and remote user support on service requests raised by clients. Use logic and reasoning to identify alternative solutions, conclusions, or approaches to solving problems and delivering the best possible solutions resulting in a high quality user experience.
● Inventory & Asset Management: Handle inventory and asset management and e-recycling. Utilize Inventory Data management software to maintain inventory accuracy and workflow. Deploy and recover assets and accessories. Assist in Workstation dressing and other asset management racks and locations.
● Hardware Support & Management: Diagnose and resolve hardware issues. Support product lifecycle management activities, tracking and managing inventory, e-recycling of hardware.
● Room & Audio Equipment Support: Support a complex and fast paced environment focused on video conference rooms and ensure audio and visual quality, troubleshooting any issues and requests that may arise. Participate in installing AV equipment and displays.
● Ticket Management: Ensure assigned request tickets for support are prioritized and completed in a timely manner. Handle tasks related to order tracking, hardware deployment, and user setup, which may be tracked through ticketing systems. Use the defined ITSM System to properly
manage your work related to defined service activities.
● Issues Escalation: Effectively document and escalate issues which cannot be resolved within the Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Proactively communicate to your supervisor when you encounter errors in documented support procedures. Adhere to incident management, problem management, change management, and knowledge management best practices.
● Collaboration: Participate in cross team/site collaboration used to share service knowledge, isolate potential problems and ensure the consistent delivery of defined service activities. Collaborate within the broader IT customer experience team, as well as extended IT organization to ensure the highest level of customer support and experience.
● Customer Experience: Ensure positive user experience and customer satisfaction through smooth working operations and effective work management. Enable the success of your peers and teammates.
● Complete other duties as assigned.


Required Qualifications/Skills:
 ● High school diploma or general education degree (GED) and 1 to 2 years’ related experience and/or training in IT Services; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
● Strong knowledge in policies and procedures related to requested support activities.
● Capable of understanding customer needs and providing a high level of interaction, ensuring customer satisfaction.
● Proactive in mastering all aspects of service delivery processes, communication, and the quality of your work.
● Facilitate and promote a team culture which encourages ownership of team goals, trust, respect, and strong cross collaboration throughout the service program.
● Provide general IT support within a high volume and fast-paced technology environment.
● Possess the ability to assist with a variety of basic technical issues, including but not limited to applications, hardware, mobile technologies.
● Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows 11, Mac OS X, Linux Fundamentals, Hardware Level troubleshooting, Hardware Installation, Upgrades.
● Knowledge of basic functionality and use of various mobile devices (iOS, Android, etc.)
● Knowledge of hardware (desktop/laptop) deployment methods using image deployment tools.
● Ability to quickly diagnose, organize, and prioritize competing deadlines and properly set service expectations with clients.
● Time Management: Must possess strong time management skills to prioritize tasks effectively, meet deadlines, and deliver exceptional customer support


Preferred Qualifications:
 ● Active listening and detail oriented to perform and document your work
● Enjoy working with collaborative individuals and understand that you are in a customer-facing support role.
● Strive to deliver a high quality user support experience.
● Excellent written and verbal communications are second to none.
● Self-motivated and the ability to execute tasks and handle time sensitive situations
● Commitment to excellence


Other Requirements:
 ● This role requires weights of 50lbs/22kg to be regularly lifted
● Strong Communication Skills, Written and Verbal English required.
● This is an office based role, it requires the successful candidate to be on site during working hours.

Health & Safety Requirements:
 ● Must conduct work activities in accordance with all applicable Environmental, Health & Safety regulations and rules. Additionally, will follow all Astreya’s Health & Safety Program, Code of Conduct, and client Health & Safety rules at all times.

title: Senior Engineer, Data Model & Agent first building
description:
The role

You own the ontology at the heart of Brickanta: how we structure data, how it gets in, and how the codebase is built around it. You are also a central part in how we prove changes to the codebase, so that us as a fast moving AI enabled team can move even faster without slop clean up and reviewing becomes the bottleneck.

Brickanta is the agentic platform for construction. Agents read tender documents, extract requirements, check them against what a contractor knows about itself, and draft bids, reviews and change orders. Every answer is only as good as the data that is available to the agents.

That model is hard to get right. Tenders arrive as bundles of PDFs, drawings and spreadsheets, revised mid-process. The same requirement appears in several documents in different words. Customers are groups with dozens of subsidiaries. Turning that into clean, versioned objects takes real skill and experience.

What you'll own

1. The ontology

  • The objects everything rests on: organisations and subsidiaries, projects, documents and versions, requirements (krav), company facts, standards, bids and their answers. How they relate, version and carry provenance, so every agent answer traces to a document, page and fact.
  • The pipelines that fill it: parsing, extraction, entity resolution and backfills that turn raw documents into those objects and rerun cleanly when the model changes.
  • Permissions and tenant isolation across groups with dozens of subsidiaries.
  • How the codebase is structured around it: schema, migrations that ship daily without breaking what's live, and the typed tools agents use to read and write it.

2. Shipping at agent speed

  • Evals and verification by default: every change to the ontology, a pipeline or a prompt comes with evidence it works.
  • Rules and playbooks for the repo: how code is structured, tested and shipped, so engineers and coding agents build the same way.
  • The systems that take review off the critical path: automated checks and small, verifiable changes, so reviewers judge decisions instead of reading every diff.

First 90 days

Day 30

Understand where we stand with the current data model. Improvements to the existing data structures shipped to production.

Day 60

3 more concepts modelled and integrated into the product. Map out and experiment with how we can improve our codebase to enable us to run event faster with agents.

Day 90

Entire product team is shipping on top of your data model and we as a team are moving faster than ever.

How we build

Agents write most of our code (Cursor, Claude Code, Devin). Writing code is no longer the slow part. Judgement and proof are: the model, the interfaces, and knowing a change works without someone reading every line.

We like how Lauren Tan (poteto) at Cursor frames it in pstack: don't let agents just write more code. Go deep and get it right first, leave verifiable evidence, and only then run agents in parallel. Few teams have made that work across many engineers. You'll help us do it.

Must-haves

  • You have designed and owned the data model of a product customers depend on, and evolved it through migrations and backfills.
  • You have built pipelines that turn messy, unstructured documents into structured data people trust.
  • Strong in TypeScript and/or Python, with relational and reactive databases.
  • You have built LLM features in production: tool use, retrieval, structured output, evals.
  • You ship with coding agents daily and know how to verify their work without reading every line.
  • You write clearly. Decisions and interfaces get written down.
  • Fluent English.

Nice-to-haves

  • Document-heavy domains: legal, construction, procurement, compliance.
  • Ontology, knowledge-graph or entity-resolution work.
  • Convex or Cloudflare Workers.
  • You have built eval harnesses, CI checks or MCP servers other engineers rely on.
  • Swedish.

Practical

Team

Product & Engineering, reporting to Linus Bein Fahlander (CTO & co-founder), working daily with CJ (Engineering Team Lead)

Location

On-site by default, Linnégatan 89B, Stockholm

Level

Senior. What you've built matters more than years

Comp

Competitive salary and equity

Brickanta is backed by Northzone and Y Combinator and works with some of the largest contractors in the Nordics.

title: Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) III
description:
Overview

Abacus Technology is seeking an Information Systems Security Officer (ISSO) to provide security and information assurance support for the Air Force Intranet Control (AFINC) III Support program at Maxwell AFB/Gunter Annex. This is a full-time position.

Responsibilities

  • Perform security analysis of operational and development environments, threats, vulnerabilities and internal interfaces to define and assess compliance with accepted industry and government standards.
  • Implement the Assessment and Authorization (A&A) processes under the Risk Managed Framework (RMF) for new and existing information systems.
  • Maintain a current authorization to operate (ATO), and approval to connect (ATC) (if required), and in implementing corrective actions identified in the plan of action and milestones.
  • Facilitate development of Memorandums of Understanding (MOU), Interconnection Security Agreements (ISA) and Risk Acceptance Letters.
  • Develop an Information System Continuous Monitoring (ISCM) strategy and monitor any proposed or actual changes to the system and its environment to maintain compliance.
  • Audit systems to ensure security posture integrity.
  • Conduct assessments and test/analysis data to document state of compliance with security requirements.
  • Conduct risk assessments and investigations, recommend implementation of risk mitigations, and coordinate incident response activities.
  • Conduct periodic hardware/software inventory assessments.
  • Supervise the development and deployment of program information security for all program systems to meet the program and enterprise requirements, policies, standards, guidelines and procedures.
  • Manage assigned team to facilitate effective execution of the RMF.
  • Coordinate and participate in security assessments and audits.
  • Prepare, review, and present technical reports and briefings.
  • Register, maintain, verify, submit exceptions, conduct annual review, or decommission systems ports, protocols, and services (PPS) as necessary to ensure compliance with the DoD PPS Category Assurance List (CAL) and DoD PPS Vulnerability Assessment reports.

Qualifications

5+ years experience in a cyber security or information assurance role including at least 3 years supporting the RMF. HS diploma or GED. Must hold one of the following IAM II certifications: CISM, CISSO, CISSP, CISSP-ISSMP, FITSP-M, GCIA, GCIH, GCSA, GICSP, and/or GSLC. Must hold the CAP or Certified in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (CGRC) certification. Must have participated in training for DISA ACAS Supervisor and Operator and DISA Enterprise Mission Assurance Support Service (eMASS). Additional certifications such as CCNA or Microsoft Certified: Information Security Administrator Associate preferred. Experience with DoD cybersecurity policies and implementation of Risk Management Framework (RMF): e.g. NIST SP 800 series, CNSSI 1253. Experience as an information system security officer (ISSO) or information system security manager (ISSM) supporting classified programs. Experience in assessing and documenting test or analysis data to show cybersecurity compliance. Experience utilizing security relevant tools, systems, and applications in support of Risk Management Framework (RMF) to include: NESSUS, ACAS, DISA STIGs, Audit Tools, ESS, eMASS, PPS. Outstanding communication skills across all levels of the organization. Must be a US citizen and hold a current Top Secret clearance with SCI Access (TS/SCI).

Applicants selected will be subject to a U.S. government security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information.

title: Country Disease Area Lead
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

The Opportunity


As an Ecosystem & Pod Leadership Partner at Roche Malaysia, you will serve as a strategic and operational leader, empowering autonomous, cross-functional business pods to redefine how we partner with healthcare systems. In this integrated, function-agnostic role, you will act as a Visionary, Architect, Catalyst, and Coach (VACC), driving agile ways of working, fostering a high-performance culture, and connecting local teams to our global international network to deliver faster, better outcomes for patients.


In this strategic leadership role, you will:

  • Guide & Coach Autonomous Pods: Provide non-hierarchical coaching and mentorship to self-organized, cross-functional teams spanning Medical, Commercial, and Access functions to achieve outcome-based goals.
  • Architect Strategic & Business Impact: Co-own business outcomes, helping teams analyze gaps, identify growth opportunities, and establish sustainable solutions across the Malaysian healthcare landscape.
  • Champion Agile & Networked Operations: Facilitate agile rituals, resource fluidity, and 90-day outcome-based planning, embedding a culture of rapid experimentation, psychological safety, and continuous learning.
  • Navigate International Networks: Connect local business pods with international Roche networks and communities of practice to adapt global innovations locally and share Malaysian best practices globally.
  • Translate Ecosystem & Customer Needs: Partner closely with field customer engagement teams to translate healthcare system insights into clear strategic visions and rapid, customer-centric solutions.
  • Uphold Excellence & Governance: Drive an enterprise mindset, ensuring all team activities strictly adhere to corporate compliance guidelines, ethical standards, and health and safety policies.

Who You Are

You are an authentic, entrepreneurial leader and system thinker who thrives on unlocking human potential. You lead with empathy and courage, navigate complex matrix ecosystems with ease, and are deeply passionate about transforming healthcare delivery for patients.


Your Qualifications:

  • Educational Background: You hold a University Degree, preferably in Health Sciences, Medical Sciences, Business, or a related discipline.
  • Industry & Leadership Experience: You bring significant leadership experience within the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or healthcare sectors across commercial, medical, customer experience, or market access functions.
  • Ecosystem & Market Knowledge: You possess a deep understanding of the healthcare landscape and proven customer-facing experience in managing complex account networks.
  • Agile & Network Mastery: You demonstrate proven expertise in leading cross-functional teams using agile methodologies, resource fluidity, and collaborative coaching models.
  • Communication & Growth Mindset: You carry excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with strong learning agility, active listening capabilities, and an enterprise-first perspective.

Our leaders empower you to achieve your fullest potential, fostering a culture where everyone can demonstrate leadership and navigate change with confidence.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Förvaltningsledare / Projektledare IT
description:
Enhet Lednings- och Verksamhetsstöd

Säker digital utveckling i en samhällsviktig verksamhet genom digitala identiteter och strukturerad grunddata – Det är vad du kommer jobba med i nyckelrollen som Förvaltningsledare på IT-centrum. Ett ansvar som skapar reell verksamhetsnytta i en verksamhetsnära förvaltning. 

Rollen som förvaltningsledare
I rollen som förvaltningsledare kommer du jobba som systemförvaltare och ansvara för att driva och utveckla vår användar- och organisationskatalog (HSA) och regionens identifieringstjänst (SITHS) med ett tydligt verksamhetsperspektiv. Du kommer leda ett team som arbetar med den verksamhetsnära systemförvaltningen samtidigt som du kommer ha ett nära samarbete med flera andra enheter och den IT-nära förvaltningen på IT-centrum.

En central del av uppdraget är att samordna och utveckla hanteringen av organisationsinformation. Vid organisationsförändringar samordnar du utredningen av hur förändringen ska återspeglas i organisationsinformationen. Du arbetar för att informationen är korrekt, enhetlig och användbar i de verksamheter och digitala tjänster som är beroende av den.

Rollen som förvaltningsledare kommer även kräva att du är med och utvecklar arbetet och processerna för hur vi jobbar med organisationsinformation och digitala identiteter. Det innebär också att samverka med Inera och att jobba i nätverk med andra regioner.

Du kommer jobba nära vår utvecklingschef som är ytterst ansvarig för leveransen inom området. Vi erbjuder en tillsvidaretjänst på heltid med tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Din blivande arbetsplats
IT-centrum stödjer invånare, patienter och medarbetare i Region Jönköpings län med digitala lösningar som gör verklig skillnad. Vi drivs av att möta regionens behov av IT-tjänster och att vara proaktiva i att identifiera möjligheter för verksamhetsutveckling genom effektiva IT-lösningar. IT-centrum har ett samlat ansvar för IT-verksamheten i Region Jönköpings län. I ett nära samarbete med våra kunder medverkar vi till att regionens verksamheter utvecklas och stöds med bra IT-lösningar.

Vi arbetar processorienterat och kvalitetsmedvetet i enlighet med vårt ISO-certifierade verksamhetssystem. Vi är idag 250 engagerade och framåtlutade medarbetare med hög kompetens och framåtanda inom sina respektive ansvarsområden. Vår vision på regionen är ”Tillsammans för ett bra liv för alla!” vilket innebär att vi alla jobbar för en region där människor vill leva, arbeta och utvecklas – med god hälsa, bra miljö och ett rikt kulturliv. IT är en viktig del av denna helhet. Tillsammans arbetar vi för att bli Sveriges bästa IT-avdelning.

Vill du veta mer om oss? Besök oss på LinkedIn och Instagram:
IT-centrum, Region Jönköpings län: Översikt | LinkedIn (https://www.linkedin.com/company/region-jonkopings-lan/)
Instagram (https://www.instagram.com/regionjonkopingslan/)

Din profil
Vi söker dig som har en högskoleutbildning inom lämpligt område eller annan relevant utbildning/arbetslivserfarenhet som vi bedömer likvärdig. Du har mycket god ledarskapsförmåga och erfarenhet av att leda förvaltning och utveckling i en komplex verksamhet. Du skapar engagemang och riktning i teamet och kan självständigt driva frågor där flera verksamheter berörs och olika behov behöver vägas samman. Du har mycket god analytisk förmåga och kan omsätta komplexa verksamhetsfrågor i tydliga informationsstrukturer, arbetssätt och beslutsunderlag. Erfarenhet av organisations- och identitetsinformation är särskilt relevant. Kunskap om HSA, SITHS och tillhörande tillitsramverk är meriterande.

För att trivas i rollen som förvaltningsledare hos oss behöver du ha förmågan att skapa engagemang, bygga förtroende och leda med tydlighet. Du har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicerar på ett lyhört sätt. Med ett strukturerat arbetssätt håller du fokus och driver arbetet framåt, samtidigt som du väger in helheten och gör avvägningar som gynnar hela verksamhetens behov. För oss på IT-centrum är förändring en naturlig del av vardagen då vårt arbete hela tiden utvecklas. Det betyder att du som person också behöver vara flexibel och trivas i denna miljö som följer med i teknikens framfart. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vårt erbjudande till dig
Hos oss blir du en del av en kreativ, utvecklingsinriktad och lösningsfokuserad kultur. Vi jobbar tillsammans mot att vara Sveriges bästa IT-avdelning. Här får du möjlighet att växa både som person och i din profession – samtidigt som du bidrar till en stabil grund för digital utveckling i hela vår region.
Vi erbjuder en hållbar arbetsmiljö där balans mellan arbete och privatliv är en självklar del. Du har också möjlighet till distansarbete upp till två dagar i veckan, när arbetet tillåter.

Som medarbetare hos oss inom Region Jönköpings län får du tillgång till våra anställningsförmåner. En del av dem ökar din grundtrygghet, andra sätter lite guldkant på vardagen. title: Director, Global Transaction Banking
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

Product Managers are responsible for the leading the strategic focus of the product(s), defining the product vision, market strategy, and competitive analysis. They think about the product's future and how it will evolve over time. They work with various teams, including marketing, engineering, operations, and sales, to ensure everyone is aligned on the product strategy. They use data and market research to inform their decisions and prioritize product features.

Accountabilities

  • Define Product Strategy: Accountable for defining a product strategy that aligns with business vision, managing capabilities, balancing short-term with long-term goals, ensuring that products meet market demands and drive growth.
  • Cross functional alignment: Leadership of cross functional relationships, working with various cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of product strategy and goals.
  • Risk and Control: Accountable for overseeing product risk management, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to mitigate those risks, and maintenance of alignment between the product management and control functions.
  • Product Development Lifecycle: Own product development lifecycle, from concept to launch, ensuring efficient processes, on-time delivery, and alignment with E2E customer expectations and experience. – working with product owners to drive change objectives.
  • Deliver Product Goals and Performance: Deliver clear objectives and key outcomes to steer the product vision and ensure alignment with company’s business goals, financial targets, and strategic vision, driving long-term business success.
  • Data driven decisions: Monitor product performance through data-driven analysis and insights, regularly assessing progress against objectives and adjusting the strategies as needed to optimise outcomes and maximise value for both business and customer.
  • Customer-Centric Focus: Drive a customer -first approach across the product vision, ensuring customer insights, feedback, behaviours, and pain points are at the core of the product strategy and decision-making process.
  • Business and financial acumen: Understanding pricing models, costs structures, and ROI to make financially grounded decisions regarding product development.

Director Expectations

  • To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
  • They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
  • Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.

title: Vi söker säljare till Albrekts Guld i PUB, Stockholm
description:
Är du vår nästa stjärna inom försäljning? Nu söker vi säljare till Albrekts Guld i PUB, Stockholm! Är du en driven och serviceinriktad person med ett genuint intresse för försäljning och service? Vi söker dig som sätter kunden i fokus och gör det lilla extra för att överträffa deras förväntningar! Om du trivs i en roll där du får ta ansvar och göra skillnad - då kan du vara den vi letar efter! Vi söker dig som:
  • Brinner för försäljning och alltid ser möjligheter.
  • Har erfarenhet av detaljhandel eller annan försäljning och service.
  • Är ansvarsfull, noggrann och trivs i en dynamisk arbetsmiljö.
  • Har en naturlig känsla för service och tycker om att möta människor.
  • Är flexibel, lösningsorienterad och kan arbeta både självständigt och i team.
Som säljare hos oss sätter du en ära i att överträffa kundens förväntningar på bemötande, produkt, pris samt butiksmiljö. Du ser merförsäljning som ett naturligt sätt att skapa mervärde för våra kunder. Vi erbjuder en roll i ett engagerat team som tillsammans jobbar för att nå butikens uppsatta mål. Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper och att du drivs av det personliga mötet. Att du har en positiv inställning, erfarenhet av försäljning samt att du gillar att jobba i ett högt tempo är en förutsättning för att lyckas i rollen. Tjänsten avser ett vikariat 15 tim/v under 6 månader, med chans till förlängning med tillträde omgående. Låter detta intressant är du välkommen med din ansökan! Vi kallar till intervju löpande, varför tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag. Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk av tillsvidareanställd/medarbetare med företrädesrätt. Golden Heights koncernen där Iduna AB ingår med butikskedjorna Guldfynd, Hallbergs Guld och Albrekts Guld är marknadsledare i Sverige inom guldsmedsvaror och smycken. Sortimentet utgörs av guld, silver och bijouterier med klockor och presentartiklar som komplement. Idag är IDUNA representerade över hela Sverige genom Guldfynd med 118 butiker, Hallbergs Guld med 33 butiker och Albrekts Guld med 36 butiker. Sedan 2015 ingår även Lyxxa på Väla Helsingborg i koncernen. Golden Heights koncernen har ca 1465 anställda inklusive anställda på deltid. Omsättningen var 2020 ca 1,6 miljarder kronor. Koncernbolaget i Finland består av Kultajousi med 71 butiker samt Westerback och Alexander Tillander med vardera en butik.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Plans, directs, coordinates, supervises and reviews the work of a professional, technical and clerical staff assigned to assist.

  • To do related work as required.

Education: Such as may have been gained through: graduation from a college of recognized standing with specialization in business management, social sciences or a related field; and

Experience: Such as may have been gained through: employment in a supervisory position in a private or public agency involved in the development, management, reorganization, and/or operation of a service program.

Create your future with Affin! ​​You too can make a difference.

Join us at AFFIN, where the open minds meet and be inspired by a shared commitment to great work. Here, you don’t just stay at the forefront of the industry – you can make a difference too.

JOB PURPOSE

To plan and strategize for SME and commercial loans portfolio and manage the existing lending portfolio of Business Centre (BC) accounts with a view to maximize returns for the Bank. To lead and provide support, supervision and guidance to the Assistant Relationship Managers / Relationship Managers (RMs) and other staff of the Centre.

Sales & Portfolio Growth

  • Drive achievement of lending targets as outlined in the Branch Centre (BC) Annual Credit Plan.

Credit & Service Management

title: Roligt jobb som personlig assistent till aktiv kvinna i Ludvika!
description:
Vi söker nu efter en personlig assistent till ett roligt arbete, till en tjänst på 50 % men även till att kunna hoppa in vid behov.

Kund bor i ett eget boende, och behöver hjälp med många insatser i det vardagliga livet. Det inkluderar allt från personlig omvårdnad till att åka ut på aktiviteter. Kundens intressen som vi gärna ser att du delar är att bada, åka karusell, matlagning och hushållssysslor. Vi ser gärna kvinnliga sökanden, och det är viktigt att du behärskar svenska språket väl både i tal och i skrift då kommunikationen sker via oss assistenter. Önskvärt är att du även är lugn och organiserad, då brukaren är i stort behov av daglig struktur.

En stor merit är om du har erfarenhet av bildkommunikation samt tecken.

Krav på bil, och körkort för manuell växel.

Arbetstider: Dag, kväll, helg och natt med jour.

Anställningsvilkor: 50% tjänst samt hoppa in vid behov.

Tillträde: Efter överenskommelse.

För oss på Kompis Assistans är det viktigt att kunna ha en god kommunikation med våra kandidater samt kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen och vi ber därför vänligen att skicka in ansökan via länken digitalt och inte genom e-post.

Det här erbjuder vi dig som anställd hos oss!

* Längre uppsägningstider än vad kollektivavtalet regler

* Marknadsmässiga löner

* Kompetens- och utvecklingsmöjligheter

* Friskvårdsbidrag

* Handikappanpassat semesterhus

Vi har valt att själva genomföra rekryteringsprocessen och undanber oss alla former av erbjudande från annonserings- och bemannings-/rekryteringsföretag.Vi tillämpar individuell lönesättning, semester och OB enligt kollektivavtal med Vårdföretagarna.Om Kompis AssistansKompis Assistans EF gör det möjligt för personer med funktionsnedsättning att kunna leva sina liv som alla andra, utifrån sin egen förmåga och vilja. Hos oss är alla lika mycket värda och vi strävar efter rättvisa förhållanden för våra assistansberättigade och medarbetare. Vår vision är att vara det tryggaste valet, nu och i framtiden. Kompis Assistans EF erbjuder sedan 1995 personlig assistans till barn, ungdomar och vuxna med funktionsnedsättning i hela Sverige. Vi verkar i hela Sverige och vårt huvudkontor är placerad i Borlänge och har även kontor i Sundsvall, Stockholm och Åstorp.Kompis Assistans är en av de 25 största assistansanordnarna i Sverige med cirka 650 medarbetare. Personlig assistent är ett kvalificerat och ansvarsfullt arbete. Det innebär att du behöver vara trygg i dig själv och lyhörd för andras behov. Självbestämmande, valfrihet, integritet och delaktighet är Kompis Assistans värderingar och något som du förväntas arbeta utifrån.BelastningsregistretFör att få arbeta som personlig assistent hos oss måste du uppvisa ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister - utdrag (442.3). Viktigt att tänka på är att polisens handläggningstid kan vara upp till två veckor så beställ ditt registerutdrag så snart som möjligt. Utdraget kommer att efterfrågas vid en eventuell intervju.

title: Global Economics Intelligence Manager – Product Management
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Global Economics Intelligence Manager – Product Management

Overview

The Economic Intelligence program is looking for a Global Manager of Product Management to refine our products, develop and scale new capabilities, and drive our go-to-market strategies as part of a cross-functional team of economists, data scientists, and consultants. The ideal candidate is intellectually curious, has a background in economics or consulting, possesses an entrepreneurial mindset, and is passionate about embedding actionable economics in the businesses of our partners.

The Manager – Product Management will support the P&L of the Economic Intelligence Program and will work directly with the Mastercard Economics Institute to match an understanding of market needs with existing capabilities and the art of the possible to create a meaningful impact with our clients.

The role reports to the Director of Macro and Signals Intelligence within the Economic Intelligence Program and will partner with Practice leads in the regions to define and execute our go-to-market playbook, with the Mastercard Economics Institute to apply innovation to client problems, and with other practices to develop and manage integrated solutions.

What will you do?

In partnership with the Director,
• develop and manage the strategic plan of how Macro and Signals Intelligence positions solutions and goes to market
• develop and maintain the roadmap from conceptualization to deployment at scale of new products
• define standards for execution and create feedback loops that ensure virtuous cycle of continued innovation and improvement
• coordinate across sales and execution functions as well as regions within Mastercard to enable regionalization within parameters of global standards
• maintain visibility on performance against budget
In partnership with Regional Leads,
• develop and evaluate initiatives to meet regional financial objectives, consistent with global financial and strategic objectives
• identify and prioritize client needs for new solutions

All about you:
• Ideal candidate would possess technical fluency across economics, statistics, and data science discipline, or the foundation on which to build this knowledge base
• Familiar with the suite of economics consulting and data products in the market
• Strong collaborator who can coordinate teams across functions and time zones
• Demonstrated track record of stakeholder management skills
• Able to manage complex projects and timelines effectively

Mastercard is a merit-based, inclusive, equal opportunity employer that considers applicants without regard to gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, disabled or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We hire the most qualified candidate for the role. In the US or Canada, if you require accommodations or assistance to complete the online application process or during the recruitment process, please contact reasonable_accommodation@mastercard.com and identify the type of accommodation or assistance you are requesting. Do not include any medical or health information in this email. The Reasonable Accommodations team will respond to your email promptly.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Relationship Director, Large Corporate Business & Professional Services Sector Client Coverage
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To establish and nurture profitable partnerships with corporate clients. It's the bridge between the bank's offerings and clients' needs, ensuring mutual benefit and long-term success.

Accountabilities

  • Management of client relationships to identify the clients financial goals, challenges, and risk tolerance to support the analysis of data obtained from various sources, including the investment portfolio and cash flow, to identify trends, insights, areas for improvement and additional services to support client needs.
  • Research and understanding of the client's industry trends, regulatory landscape, and competitive environment to inform strategic recommendations.
  • Design of customised solutions that address the client's specific needs and objectives, incorporating a range of products and services from the bank's portfolio.
  • Communication of the value proposition of proposed solutions, justification of recommendations, and negotiation of terms that are beneficial for both the client and the bank.
  • Provision of guidance to clients to support their financial decisions, risk management and wealth management strategies and updates on market trends to ensure a positive and continuous relationship.
  • Assessment of financial, legal, and operational risks associated with client relationships, and implementation of measures to minimise potential losses.
  • Documentation of all client interactions, transactions, and agreements to ensure transparency and auditability, and communicate findings effectively to support product development, service offerings, and the overall bank strategy.
  • Monitoring of client satisfaction, revenue generated, and other relevant metrics to evaluate the effectiveness of relationship management efforts.
  • Execution of market research and analysis to support the identification of potential new opportunities, market trends, and customer needs, to develop strategies for business growth.

Director Expectations

  • To manage a business function, providing significant input to function wide strategic initiatives. Contribute to and influence policy and procedures for the function and plan, manage and consult on multiple complex and critical strategic projects, which may be business wide..
  • They manage the direction of a large team or sub-function, leading other people managers and embedding a performance culture aligned to the values of the business. Or for an individual contributor, they lead organisation wide projects and act as deep technical expert and thought leader, identifying new ways of working and collaborating cross functionally. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..
  • Provide expert advice to senior functional management and committees to influence decisions made outside of own function, offering significant input to function wide strategic initiatives.
  • Manage, coordinate and enable resourcing, budgeting and policy creation for a significant sub-function.
  • Escalates breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
  • Foster and guide compliance, ensure regulations are observed that relevant processes in place to facilitate adherence.
  • Focus on the external environment, regulators, or advocacy groups to both monitor and influence on behalf of Barclays, when appropriate.
  • Demonstrate extensive knowledge of how the function integrates with the business division / Group to achieve the overall business objectives.
  • Maintain broad and comprehensive knowledge of industry theories and practices within own discipline alongside up-to-date relevant sector / functional knowledge, and insight into external market developments / initiatives.
  • Use interpretative thinking and advanced analytical skills to solve problems and design solutions in often complex/ sensitive situations.
  • Exercise management authority to make significant decisions and certain strategic decisions or recommendations within own area.
  • Negotiate with and influence stakeholders at a senior level both internally and externally.
  • Act as principal contact point for key clients and counterparts in other functions/ businesses divisions.
  • Mandated as a spokesperson for the function and business division.

All Senior Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Role Responsibilities


  • Develop and enhance relationships with a portfolio of largely Midlands region located UK Corporate Bank clients operating across the Business & Professional Services sector.
  • Foster proactive collaboration with teams such as Large Corporate Lending, M&A, Trade and Working Capital, Risk Solutions, Payments & Cash Management and the Private Bank to win new business and deliver consistently excellent outcomes for clients.
  • Play a leading role in developing and executing UK Corporate Bank’s strategy for Business & Professional Services clients, with a clear focus on delivering segment leadership, building on UK Corporate Bank’s strong reputation and growing the business in a significant and sustainable way.
  • Represent Barclays with external and internal stakeholders and contribute to a sector-focused and Midlands region-focused marketing and origination strategy, including the creation of thought leadership, development of intermediary and adviser relationships, and delivery of sector-specific client events.
  • Act as First Line of Defence in line with the Bank’s risk management framework.

To be successful in this role, candidates should possess the following experience and attributes:


  • Coverage Mindset: Proven track record of developing high-quality client account plans, building trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and identifying opportunities to meet clients’ current and evolving needs through the Bank’s products and services.

title: Postdoc: Satellite-based urban CO2 and air pollutant emissions
description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

The postdoctoral researcher will investigate urban fossil fuel CO₂ and air pollutant emissions using satellite observations, emission inventories, and data assimilation. The research will characterize spatial and temporal emission patterns across major cities worldwide, from city to sub-city scales, and examine their relationships with urban development, emission sources, and mitigation strategies.


The researcher will combine satellite-based CO₂ emission estimates from OCO-2/3 with air pollutant emission estimates informed by observations from TEMPO, GEMS, and TROPOMI, leveraging JPL’s MOMO-Chem and CMS-Flux systems. Key activities include analyzing urban emission distributions, trends, comparing satellite-based estimates with multiple emission inventories; and applying the modified environmental Kuznets curve (MEKC) framework to examine emission changes in relation to economic development and mitigation efforts.


The research will advance understanding of urban emission processes, inform improvements to emission inventories, and support the assessment of climate and air quality mitigation strategies. The researcher is expected to develop reproducible analysis methods, collaborate with interdisciplinary research teams, and publish findings in peer-reviewed scientific journals.


Candidate Qualifications:

  • PhD in Atmospheric Sciences, Physics, Geophysics, Environmental Sciences, or a related technical discipline
  • Demonstrated experience and knowledge of atmospheric composition and related fields
  • Experience with python and similar languages.
  • Excellent oral (including public speaking) and written communication skills
  • Experience working in a team environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills
  • Peer-reviewed publications related to atmospheric composition modelling and/or their utilization for Earth system science research

The appointee will carry out research in collaboration with the JPL advisor, resulting in publications in the open literature.

Applicants may be subject to additional program requirements by NASA. Postdoctoral Scholar positions are awarded for a minimum of one-year period and may be renewed up to a maximum of three years. Candidates should submit the following to this site: CV, representative publications, contact information for three references, and a cover letter stating their research accomplishments and interests.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Manufacturing Technology
description:
Job Description

Just imagine helping shape how manufacturing knowledge becomes reliable software used across our factories. Then make it real.


About the role

As our Senior Software Engineer, you’ll join a new manufacturing technology initiative where many of the answers haven’t been decided yet. We’re exploring how manufacturing recipes, processes and production knowledge can move from fragmented systems and ways of working into scalable digital solutions used across our manufacturing landscape.


You’ll join at the beginning. The initial phase is discovery: understanding how manufacturing processes work today, learning from what already exists and helping translate our manufacturing strategy into a technical direction. Then comes the important part: you’ll help build and implement what we decide.

This is software with a physical consequence. Our manufacturing solutions interact with production environments that operate continuously and with high levels of precision. Connectivity can’t always be assumed, and availability matters. That changes the engineering decisions we make around architecture, resilience, deployment and how systems behave when things don’t go to plan.


You’ll be part of a small team working closely with a Lead Engineer, product teams and manufacturing specialists. The longer-term team setup is still taking shape, just as some of the technology decisions are. So we’re not looking for someone to arrive and follow an architecture that has already been decided. We’re looking for someone who can investigate, question, design and then help turn those decisions into software that works in the reality of manufacturing.


Required Qualifications


  • Designed software architectures and production solutions in software development, covering distributed systems, APIs, integration patterns or event-driven architecture.
  • Delivered hybrid cloud, on-premises or edge solutions that continue operating when network connectivity is unavailable.
  • Built solutions using AWS in complex enterprise environments, making decisions about scalability, resilience, performance, cost and maintainability.
  • Implemented continuous integration and delivery pipelines, automated testing, and observability for software supporting operational environments.
  • Deployed containerised solutions and infrastructure as code using Kubernetes, Docker, Terraform or equivalent technologies.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Developed software using modern object-oriented technologies such as C# and .NET.
  • Built or maintained manufacturing applications such as Manufacturing Execution Systems or Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition systems.
  • Applied ISA-95 or IEC 62264 standards when designing manufacturing systems and integrations.
  • Created manufacturing solutions using Unified Namespace patterns, ontologies or knowledge graphs.

What you'll build


  • Shape architecture and engineering practices for our evolving manufacturing landscape.
  • Explore how manufacturing processes and knowledge can become scalable digital solutions.
  • Build secure, resilient software for operational environments.
  • Improve live products through monitoring, observability and systematic debugging.

If you’ve owned software from architectural decisions through delivery and operation, you’ll feel at home here. What matters most is your ability to question assumptions, solve complex problems and think beyond the immediate solution.


Life on the team


You’ll work in a small team within Manufacturing Technology, collaborating closely with engineering and manufacturing colleagues. Curiosity matters here. So does constructive technical debate, sharing what you know and being comfortable saying when an answer still needs to be discovered.


What success looks like


You’ll help turn an emerging manufacturing strategy into resilient software that supports physical production. You’ll balance architecture with practical delivery while working closely with the Lead Engineer, product teams and manufacturing specialists to create solutions built for the realities of manufacturing.

We aim to transform the way people understand and treat hearing loss and innovate to connect people with future technologies. Our employees tell us that the number one reason they enjoy working for Cochlear is the opportunity to make a difference to people’s lives. Learn and grow with us as we tackle the most complex challenges in helping more people to experience a lifetime of hearing.

The opportunity

We are looking for a Clinical Technical Specialist – Rehabilitation to deliver specialist post-implant rehabilitation across the southern region of Saudi Arabia. This is a field-based role with travel of up to 80%, supporting cochlear implant recipients, families, hospital teams and cochlear implant programs across multiple locations.


You will combine hands-on rehabilitation expertise with strong service coordination. The role includes evidence-based therapy, family education and counselling, multidisciplinary case management, second-side cochlear implant and upgrade referrals, and continuous improvement of rehabilitation services.


Your responsibilities

  • Deliver evidence-based post-implant aural rehabilitation for pediatric and/or adult cochlear implant recipients.
  • Develop individual rehabilitation plans, monitor progress against agreed goals and maintain timely, accurate clinical documentation.
  • Provide accessible, culturally responsive education and counselling to recipients and families.
  • Coordinate caseloads, appointments and rehabilitation pathways across multiple hospitals and cochlear implant programs.
  • Conduct structured assessments and prepare clinically sound referrals for second-side cochlear implantation and upgrades.
  • Maintain accurate referral and service records in relevant systems, including Salesforce.
  • Coordinate multidisciplinary Ground Round meetings, including agendas, case documentation, decisions and follow-up actions.
  • Collaborate with ClinTech, Sales, Marketing, surgeons, audiologists, speech-language professionals and hospital stakeholders.
  • Use outcome measures, service data and feedback to identify gaps and implement practical quality improvements.
  • Maintain professional credentials, current clinical knowledge and contribute to education and knowledge sharing.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Speech-Language Pathology from an accredited university or program.
  • Valid Speech-Language Pathologist license or registration from the Saudi Commission for Health Specialties.
  • Required certificate issued or recognized by the relevant Saudi government authority.
  • Current Basic Life Support or CPR certification for healthcare providers.

  • 1–3 years of hands-on cochlear implant rehabilitation experience, including auditory training, speech therapy and family counselling.
  • Experience coordinating clinical services or caseloads across multiple facilities or locations.
  • Strong knowledge of cochlear implant rehabilitation, auditory development, Auditory-Verbal Therapy principles and family-centred practice.
  • Ability to conduct structured assessments, document clinical decisions and work effectively across disciplines.

Why join Cochlear?

This role offers the opportunity to make a direct contribution to the hearing outcomes of cochlear implant recipients and their families. You will work across clinical, technical and commercial teams, build rehabilitation capability across the region and help improve the accessibility and quality of post-implant care.

Through our internal programs and employee benefits, we aim to create an environment where our people will feel value and supported. Whether your focus is on continuous learning, professional development or simply finding an environment which enables you to thrive whilst balancing family or personal life commitments, then we have several programs in place to support you.
