title: Installation Manager
description:
Are you ready for a role where your technical expertise and decisions directly shape the success of complex projects? And are you motivated by leading on-site work, ensuring that projects are delivered safely, on time and to the highest quality?

Then join GEA and combine hands-on installation work with planning, coordination and continuous improvement.

At our office in Skanderborg, you will join the Project Execution function within GEA Liquid Technologies. The team works closely across disciplines, bringing together mechanical engineering, process knowledge, project management and procurement to ensure that each project is executed with high technical quality and strong coordination.

You will work closely with the Project Manager, Quality and HSE Managers and the Site Management. Your wider network will include engineering teams, customer representatives, customer contractors and subcontractors.Your role involves supporting the Sales, Planning and Installation phase of a project where required.

Responsibilities / Tasks

You will be the main point of contact for resolving issues on site, as you negotiate and align stakeholder priorities and involve local consultants and authorities as required.


Between site assignments, you will prepare upcoming installations by assessing material needs, arranging logistics and supporting contractor selection through audits, User Requirement Specifications (URS), requests for quotation (RFQs) and purchase orders. During tendering, you will provide assembly cost estimates to the sales team.


More specifically, you will:

  • Lead assembly teams and subcontractors, allocate resources, and manage deliveries, material handling and the availability of equipment and site supplies.
  • Define a Work Breakdown Structure (WBS), establish activity sequences and schedules, and monitor progress while coordinating customer interfaces and finalizing design details with engineering teams.
  • Ensure assembly work meets company standards, enforce contractual and health, safety and environmental (HSE) requirements, and hand over a SAT-approved plant to the commissioning engineers.
  • Prepare and maintain site documentation, record labour hours, monitor costs against the budget, and report on progress using methods such as Earned Value Management (EVM), as well as HSE performance and financial forecasts.
  • Alert the Project Manager to risks and deviations, estimate assembly hours and revise plans for change orders, manage non-conformity reports and site audits, inspect building readiness, and capture lessons learned and improvement suggestions.
  • Supervise installation work at customer sites, contribute technical input through reviews of 3D models and documentation, and take part in inspections or supervision at selected workshops.
  • Support continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to optimise site processes, documentation and supplier quality practices.
  • Adapt to new standards and technologies to maintain high-quality project delivery.

Your Profile / Qualifications

You have demonstrated your ability to lead subcontractors, adapt your approach to local cultures, and maintain motivation and team spirit across nationalities. When circumstances change, you take action and find a practical way forward, communicating effectively both face to face and within remote and virtual project teams.


Finally, we imagine that you:

  • Have experience in site assembly or installation supervision, alongside experience in project delivery and developing or improving assembly practices.
  • Hold a technical qualification or have completed vocational training in mechanical engineering or piping installation, with practical experience in piping design and installation, lifting operations and heavy equipment handling.
  • Have experience in the dairy or food processing industry and knowledge of hygienic design, mechanical installation, welding supervision and sanitary weld quality procedures, together with the ability to work with risk assessments, KPIs, cost estimation and productivity analysis.
  • Are a proficient user of Outlook, Word and Excel, have experience with Navisworks and 3D viewers.
  • Have full professional working proficiency in English.

Would you like to know more?

If you would like to find out more about this position before submitting your application, please do not hesitate to contact Director Project Execution, Jørgen Pedersen, phone no. +45 2779 7111.


Please apply via the indicated link. Please note that GEA exclusively uses electronic recruiting, and only applications received through our application system will be considered.

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Jämtland
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Jämtland.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

title: Montör till Testing
description:
Company description:

At NKT in Karlskrona, we develop and manufacture high voltage power cables that enable the transition to renewable energy. Here, you will be part of an international engineering centre with advanced high voltage test halls, modern cable production and the cable laying vessel NKT Victoria. As Connectors, we collaborate to develop innovative technology that connects a greener and more sustainable world. NKT is headquartered in Denmark and operates in more than 30 countries.NKT - We connect a greener world. www.NKT.com.

Job description:

Bli en del av ett globalt företag och en viktig del i den gröna omställningenVill du ha ett varierat och lärorikt arbete med ett brett ansvarsområde? Då kan rollen som Montör inom Testing och OTR i Karlskrona vara något för dig.

Som Montör får du möjlighet att arbeta i en varierad roll med utvecklande arbetsuppgifter, samtidigt som du blir en del av ett engagerat och kunnigt team. Verksamheten omfattar flera olika områden där arbetet bedrivs både dagtid och i skiftgång (5‑skift), beroende på avdelning.Har du ett stort teknikintresse och trivs i en miljö där samarbete, noggrannhet och problemlösning är viktigt, då kan det här vara rätt nästa steg för dig.

En roll med breda ansvarsområdenInom OTR utförs bland annat rutinprov på samtliga kablar som produceras inom företaget och ansvarsområden inom avdelningen är rutinprov på landkablar (högspänningsprov, AC och DC), rutinprov på sjökablar, fibermätningar, inkopplingar och stötprover. Som montör arbetar du med både montering och avancerade mätningar. Utöver samarbetet med dina kollegor så kommer du få ett stort eget ansvar och möjlighet att utvecklas i rollen.

Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat bestå av:

  • Provuppkopplingar
  • Montage av kabeltillbehör
  • Kvalitetssäkring av våra leveranskablar
  • Diverse elektriska mätningar

Då vi utför en stor variation av elektriska provningar på kablar och tillbehör finns det stora möjligheter att även prova och lära sig andra arbetsuppgifter inom avdelningen.

Engagerad, positiv och noggrannFör att trivas i rollen behöver du vara engagerad, noggrann och ha ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt till utmaningar vi kan stöta på i vår vardag. Du är positiv och motiverar dina kollegor och du tycker om att samarbeta med andra. Du har ett stort teknikintresse och en förmåga att hantera mycket information.

Viktigt för tjänsten är:

  • Tekniskt intresse
  • Flytande svenska samt engelska Meriterande för tjänsten är:
  • Gymnasial utbildning inom ellära eller liknande
  • Tidigare erfarenheter som elektriker eller telemontör

Bli del av ett engagerad team i en internationell miljöVi tror att en mångsidig organisation möjliggör hållbar prestanda, och att en inkluderande och välkomnande kultur gör för en bättre arbetsplats. Vi är engagerade i att främja en mångsidig organisation och en kultur där människor från olika bakgrunder och med olika ståndpunkter kan trivas och inspireras att prestera sitt bästa. Du kommer att få spännande möjligheter att utveckla din egen karriär och attraktiva förmåner.

Är du intresserad av en karriär på ett expansivt företag och samtidigt bidra till den gröna omställningen? Läs mer om vårt erbjudande och lyssna på några röster från NKT Connectors här!

Kontaktuppgifter och ansökanAnsök via länken nedan med CV och personligt brev senast den 22 november, urval kommer ske löpande. Tester och bakgrundskontroller kan förekomma i våra rekryteringsprocesser.

Vi samlar in konfidentiell feedback om kandidatupplevelsen för att förbättra vår rekryteringsprocess. Dina svar används endast i utvecklingssyfte och påverkar inte våra rekryteringsbeslut. Fackliga representanterIF Metall - Marcus Degerskär, +46 455 753 52Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Broista – Crystal Lake, IL
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they are doing. At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are more than just a coffee company. We are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company that makes a difference one cup at a time.

At Dutch Bros Coffee, we are a fun-loving, mind-blowing company, making a massive difference one cup at a time.

But let’s be real, this job isn’t for everyone. It’s fast, high-energy, and physically demanding. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and keeping up with a steady flow of customers all while delivering next-level service. As the face of Dutch Bros, you’ll connect with customers, hustle with heart, and bring positive energy onto every single shift.

Who You Are:

  • A people person who thrives on connection and loves making someone’s day.
  • Adaptable and quick; you can handle a rush and keep the kindness rolling.
  • Team-oriented and ready to support your crew, no matter what’s needed.
  • Positive and considerate; even when it gets busy or during inclement weather you continue to show up.
  • Committed to growth and always looking for ways to improve.

What You’ll Do:

  • Engage. Greet every customer with a smile, make genuine connections, and ensure every visit is full of kindness & fun.
  • Educate. Help customers navigate the menu and discover new favorites, all while delivering top-tier service.
  • Embody. Live out the Dutch Bros values: radiate kindness, get up early, stay up late, and change the world.
  • Stay Fast & Focused. Work efficiently to craft high-quality drinks while keeping up with the hustle of a busy shop.
  • Be Reliable. Show up on time, communicate your availability, and be ready to roll when your shift starts.
  • Keep it Clean. Maintain a tidy workspace and follow food safety standards.

What to Expect:

  • Fast-paced, high-energy environment. You’ll be on your feet, moving quickly, and handling a steady flow of customers for up to 10-hour shifts!
  • Crew-first mentality. We support each other, have everyone’s backs, and get the job done together.
  • Weather-ready. Be prepared for all conditions; rain or shine. Don’t worry we’ve got Dutch gear to help!
  • Some heavy lifting. You may need to push, pull, lift, or carry up to 65 lbs (talk about a workout).
  • Reliable transportation. You’ll need to show up on time for scheduled shifts and mandatory meetings.
  • Training & Development. We’ll set you up for success with training, certifications, and knowledge tests to ensure you meet the Dutch Bros standards.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • We’ve got your back. Competitive pay & tips, opportunities for tuition reimbursement, and career growth within the shops, HQ, Emerging Talent Program, and warehouse/fulfillment opportunities.
  • Perks on perks. Free drinks & food on shift, exclusive Dutch Bros swag and giveaway items, and a work environment like no other.
  • Make a difference. Every cup you serve supports local & national communities and brings people together.
  • Room to grow. We believe in pouring into our people; Broista today, leader tomorrow! We’re set to double in size within the next three years which means a ton of growth opportunities for you.

At Dutch Bros, our culture is unmatched. We’re a fun, tight-knit crew that supports each other and creates connections you won’t find anywhere else. Ready to make a massive difference together?!

Compensation:

$15.00 per hour base pay + an average of $6.00 per hour in tips

What we strive for: a fun environment, great co-workers, and a chance to make a difference in your community. What we don't guarantee: tip averages. Actual tips may vary based on a variety of factors including location, position, hours, and quality of service. Average hourly tips are based on 2025 reporting.

If you like wild growth and working in a unique and fun environment, surrounded by positive community, you'll enjoy your career with us!

title: Global Order Management Specialist – Global Order Management, Demand & Supply, Lund
description:
Job Title

Global Order Management Specialist – Global Order Management, Demand & Supply, Lund

Job Description

Do you want to contribute to efficient, reliable, and forward-looking global order management process? Axis is looking for a structured, energetic and driven Order Specialist to join our Global Order Management team.
Temporary position covering a 1-year parental leave.

Who is your future team?

The Global Order Management team plays a key role in meeting customer expectations and delivering on promises. The team consists of 12 skilled and dedicated professionals who make things happen! They are Master Schedulers, Process Developers, and Global Order Specialists. Through close collaboration with stakeholders, the team ensure timely delivery, develop enhanced capabilities, and planning alignment, ultimately providing a trustworthy and seamless experience for our customers while driving business growth and supporting Axis' strategic objectives. We are a tightly knitted team who work very closely together.

Within our team, you’ll be part of the group specializing in Global Order Management. With eight Configuration and Logistics Centers (CLCs) strategically located around the world, you'll play a key role in communicating between production and our sales regions in order to meet the demand in the best possible way.

In this role, you'll collaborate closely, not only with your team members, but also cross-functionally with Demand & Supply, local Sales Operations, and local planners at each of our CLCs. It’s an exciting opportunity to work in a truly global, fast-paced environment where your contributions directly impact our operations.

What You’ll Do

As a Global Order Management Specialist you will be responsible for coordinating and communicating all questions and queries around our orders.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Order Management Processing: Respond to order-related inquiries, analyze returns, and continuously optimize processes to ensure smooth and efficient global operations. Handle requests in a structured, focused, and timely manner.
  • Collaboration and Communication: Work cross-functionally to ensure alignment and effective communication of production plans and sales orders. Facilitate clear, timely, and transparent communication, providing accurate delivery estimates and regular updates to stakeholders through established forums on a global level.
  • Order Analysis and Impact Assessment: At a global level, analyze demand and order backlog, and in close collaboration with Master Schedulers, ensure optimal conditions to meet demand and effectively respond to changes.

What We’re Looking For

Required Skills and Abilities:

  • A university degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in similar operational roles within an international or global supply chain environment.
  • Practical experience working with end-to-end order flows in a global setup, including order management, planning coordination, allocation, delivery follow-up, and deviation handling.
  • Solid experience in import and export operations, customs documentation, Incoterms, trade compliance, and coordination with freight forwarders and customs brokers.
  • Experience managing cross-border shipments and resolving operational issues related to lead times, capacity constraints, and transport deviations.
  • Daily use of ERP systems in transaction-heavy environments, including order handling, inventory visibility, reporting, and master data updates.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office, reporting, and KPI tracking.
  • Used to working in a global matrix organization with multiple stakeholders such as sales, production, warehouses, forwarders, and regional supply chain teams.
  • Strong understanding of cultural differences and experience collaborating with colleagues and partners across different regions, time zones and levels.
  • Excellent written and spoken English and Swedish. Additional languages are an advantage.


What Axis has to offer

We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.


Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.

As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.

Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.

To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:

Life at Axis blog

Innovation at Axis

Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.

We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today!

In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Josefin Billing at Josefin.Billing@axis.com

We enable a smarter and safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Our missions are complex, long-lasting, far-reaching, and each one is unique. We’re constantly developing new mission-specific technologies. For engineers, researchers, scientists, and technologists who like to test the limits, JPL is a constant source of new stimulating challenges.

JPL is seeking highly motivated college and university students with intellectual curiosity to join our team and aid in our quest to ensure mission success. In this role you would be a vital team member in a JPL engineering group. You will partner with lead engineers to work on projects like JPL’s spacecrafts, science instruments, mission control systems, and science analysis pipelines.

JPL’s Flight Communications and Tracking Section is looking for an Academic Part Time Intern to join their GNSS, Radiometric & Gravity Sensing Instruments Group. As a member of this Group, you will support senior engineers responsible for development of spacecraft antennas for telecommunications and remote-sensing instruments. You will have an opportunity to be involved in all phases of product development from research and technology advancement through build and test. Depending on current project phases, responsibilities may include:

  • Designing, building and testing of PCB (printed circuit boards).
  • Using Test Equipment to troubleshoot, characterize and validate circuit designs.
  • Working on a multi-disciplinary team to create instruments for space flight.
  • Assisting engineers and scientists in a laboratory environment.

Qualifications

  • Students are typically enrolled at least half-time at an accredited local college or university pursuing a Bachelor's, Master’s, or PhD in Electrical Engineering or other technical discipline related to work assignment
  • Must be available to work a minimum of 8 hours per week, with a maximum of 40 hours per week over the summer.
  • Minimum cumulative GPA 3.0 out of 4.0 or equivalent
  • Recently completed coursework providing an understanding and application of standard principles, theories, concepts and techniques in related work assignment
  • General knowledge of applicable industry and/or academic practices and standards in related work assignment
  • Good verbal and written communications skills with ability to work in a team environment

Responsibilities:

We invite you to join the Flight Communications and Tracking Section within the GNSS, Radiometric & Gravity Sensing Instruments Group to serve as an Academic Part Time Intern. You will be reporting administratively to the Group Supervisor.

This group is responsible for delivering flight instruments, primarily based on the Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS) signals, for use in space to measure atmospheric properties of Earth and planets.

Tasks Include

  • Support Lab activities including setting up tests, lab equipment and programming embedded systems.
  • Work with a team to develop, test and program software defined radios.
  • Support Shipping and Loan Pool activities related to ground support equipment set up and transportation.
  • Use oscilloscopes, spectrum analyzers and GNSS simulators to facilitate testing.
  • Support the software team writing and testing of GNSS Instrument software.
  • Participate in lab maintenance, set up and cleaning activities.
  • Write software test scripts and perform and execute test sequences.

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with electronics engineering, radio frequency communications and digital signal processing.
  • Knowledge of lab equipment including signal generators, network analyzers and digital multimeters.
  • Experience with Python and C++.
  • Strong background in software systems architecture, design, development, integration, test, deployment, and/or operations, i.e., the full project and software development life cycle.

Skills

title: Product Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: IT Support Engineer

Experience required: Minimum 3 years and maximum 5 years
Work schedule: 24×7 rotational shifts with monthly shift rotation

Role Overview

We are looking for an IT Support Engineer with 3–5 years of relevant experience to join our 24×7 monitoring and support team. The role involves monitoring applications, infrastructure, cloud resources, and containerized services; investigating alerts using metrics, logs, and traces; and supporting incident response to maintain service availability and performance.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate practical troubleshooting skills, apply knowledge gained through product and application knowledge-transfer (KT) sessions, and communicate technical findings clearly. The role also requires familiarity with AI-assisted troubleshooting and a willingness to use approved AI tools to improve investigation, documentation, and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Continuously monitor applications, infrastructure, cloud resources, and services using available observability tools and existing dashboards.
  • Review alerts, events, logs, metrics, and traces using OpenSearch, Grafana, and applicable APM and infrastructure-monitoring platforms.
  • Identify application errors, service unavailability, performance degradation, infrastructure failures, and unusual system behaviour.
  • Perform initial investigation and troubleshooting using monitoring data, logs, dashboards, and standard operating procedures.
  • Monitor Kubernetes clusters, nodes, pods, containers, deployments, and services.
  • Use basic SQL queries to retrieve and validate data during application or database-related incident investigations.
  • Acknowledge, prioritize, and respond to alerts according to severity, business impact, and established response procedures.
  • Create and update ServiceNow incident tickets with accurate technical details, observations, troubleshooting actions, and supporting evidence.
  • Escalate unresolved or critical incidents to the appropriate support teams and coordinate follow-up activities.
  • Maintain clear shift handovers covering active incidents, outstanding alerts, actions taken, and pending follow-ups.
  • Contribute to dashboard improvements, alert tuning, knowledge articles, and documentation of investigation findings.
  • Apply AI tools to explore problems and develop simple scripts, utilities, documentation, or proofs of concept that improve monitoring and support activities, in accordance with company policies.

Required Skills and Experience

Skill Area

Required Tools and Knowledge

Relevant experience

3–7 years in observability, monitoring, application support, infrastructure operations, or a related production-support role

Monitoring and visualization

Hands-on experience with Grafana and monitoring dashboards

Log monitoring and analysis

Hands-on experience with OpenSearch for searching and analysing logs

Application performance monitoring

Experience with one or more of Dynatrace, New Relic, Datadog, or Azure Application Insights

Infrastructure and network monitoring

Experience with SolarWinds or similar infrastructure-monitoring tools

Observability fundamentals

Strong understanding of metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, and incident investigation

Cloud platforms

Basic knowledge of AWS and Microsoft Azure services and their monitoring capabilities

Container platforms

Basic knowledge of Kubernetes and experience monitoring containerized applications, including pods, nodes, deployments, and services

Database knowledge

Basic SQL skills for retrieving and validating data

Operating systems

Basic Linux knowledge and familiarity with commonly used troubleshooting commands

Technical fundamentals

Understanding of networking, HTTP/HTTPS, APIs, databases, and distributed applications

Service-management tools

Experience with ServiceNow for incident management; familiarity with Jira for issue tracking and Opsgenie for alerting and on-call management

Soft skills

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills

AI Knowledge

Demonstrate a basic understanding of AI and generative AI, including their capabilities, limitations, and practical applications.

Shift Schedule and Allowance

  • This role is part of a 24×7 operations team and requires working rotational shifts, including night shifts, weekends, and public holidays as scheduled.
  • Shift assignments rotate monthly according to the team roster.
  • Team members receive two days off after every five consecutive working days.
  • Both shifts and weekly days off are rotational. Weekly days off may fall on weekdays or weekends.
  • Shift allowance will be provided as per company norms.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree (B.E/ B Tech. Computer Science) from a four-year college or university, or equivalent, Masters a plus.

Our Interview Practices

To maintain a fair and genuine hiring process, we kindly ask that all candidates participate in interviews without the assistance of AI tools or external prompts. Our interview process is designed to assess your individual skills, experiences, and communication style. We value authenticity and want to ensure we’re getting to know you—not a digital assistant. To help maintain this integrity, we ask to remove virtual backgrounds and include in-person interviews in our hiring process. Please note that use of AI-generated responses or third-party support during interviews will be grounds for disqualification from the recruitment process.

Applicants may be required to appear onsite at a Wolters Kluwer office as part of the recruitment process.

title: Process Technician I (First Shift)
description:
Position: Process Technician
Location: Jefferson, Texas
Wage: $26.37
Shift: First Shift (6a-2p) with occasional OT

From a small family business to a multi-billion dollar global company, Sonoco has been changing the face of products and packaging since 1899 — all while keeping the heart of “People Build Businesses” alive. Our talented people are at the core of our growth, constantly reinventing the Sonoco wheel with brilliant solutions every year. Today we are a world leader in global packaging solutions with diversified operations in over 34 countries. We're extremely proud of our portfolio of brands, our achievements in sustainability and industrialization and the groundbreaking work accomplished by our people.

Under the supervision of a Team Lead, the Process Technician I is expected to meet several basic requirements to succeed in their role. These requirements include a strong work ethic, which entails being driven, persistent, and giving 100% effort in all tasks. A positive attitude is also crucial, as it helps maintain a productive work environment and fosters good relationships within the team. Emphasizing solutions over complaints is important, as it shows the ability to problem-solve effectively and contribute constructively to the work process. Collaboration and teamwork skills are essential for a Process Tech I, involving the ability to work well with others, engage in interactive communication, and provide and receive feedback constructively. Reliability is another key attribute, encompassing consistent performance, following through on commitments, maintaining excellent attendance, and demonstrating strong time management skills. By embodying these qualities, a Process Tech I can contribute effectively to the team and help achieve collective goal.

Responsibilities:

  • Ability to keep the team informed
  • Demonstrate appropriate follow-up
  • Follow the plant escalation process
  • Maintain personal accountability
  • Know & understand specifications and schedule
  • Must understand all required quality checks
  • Setup all machines in the area of responsibility
  • Completes setups in a reasonable amount of time
  • Develop and perform DTM responsibilities (Lubrication, inspections, etc.)
  • Fill in at the operator level as needed (operator, forklift, etc.)
  • Demonstrate the ability to plan ahead
  • Utilize ALERE ERP system for production entry and scrap & lumber mgmt
  • Utilize SAGE MRP system for physical inventory, production tickets, and specs
  • Perform end-of-shift reporting functions (production results, scrap mgmt, etc.)
  • Assist maintenance during breakdowns
  • Versatile - willing to interact/approach different personality types

Requirements:

  • Must have fundamental technical knowledge of electronic sensors, pneumatics, HMI, mathematics, and optimization of cycle time
  • Troubleshooting and fixing machine issues require adequate mechanical skills.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills are a must-have.
  • Independent work and multitasking capabilities are essential.
  • Dependable, proactive, committed, and quality oriented.
  • The ability to lift 50 lbs. is required for this position. You should be able to read and comprehend manufacturing instructions.
  • Standing for long periods and performing repetitive tasks are part of the job.
  • Maintaining a high level of craftsmanship and attention to detail while working quickly is necessary.

We'd love to hear from you:

At Sonoco Products Company, we offer a comprehensive total rewards package, including competitive pay and benefits. *Benefits listed below are for employees located in the U.S. Specific benefits and wellbeing programs may vary depending on your location (within the U.S. or global), or if you are a union employee.

title: Senior Director, Technology Engineering and Site Lead
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Director, Technology Engineering & Site Lead serves as the senior engineering leader for Fortrea's engineering organization, the primary Foundry leadership representative for the site, and a strategic partner to the Head of the Global Digital Foundry. This role is responsible for providing strategic and operational leadership across engineering teams, driving delivery excellence, organizational effectiveness, workforce strategy, technology execution, and engineering innovation aligned to enterprise priorities.

The incumbent partners closely with Product, Technology, Architecture, Data & AI, and business leaders to ensure the successful delivery of scalable, reliable, secure, and compliant technology solutions. This leader will help build and scale Fortrea's Global Digital Foundry by advancing modern software engineering capabilities, platform engineering, developer experience, AI-assisted engineering practices, shared services, and common delivery standards across the organization.

As a member of the Technology leadership team, the Senior Director contributes to technology strategy, organizational planning, engineering maturity, AI adoption across the software development lifecycle, engineering excellence, developer productivity, and capability development efforts that support Fortrea's digital transformation and business objectives.

Summary of Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership

  • Lead multiple engineering organizations within the Global Digital Foundry, ensuring alignment with enterprise technology and Foundry priorities.
  • Translate business and technology objectives into actionable engineering strategies and delivery plans.
  • Partner with senior Technology, Product, and business leaders to drive execution of critical initiatives and organizational goals.
  • Contribute to long-term technology and workforce planning efforts that support organizational growth and scalability.
  • Serve as the senior Foundry leader for the hub site, representing engineering interests in global leadership forums.
  • Partner with the Head of the Global Digital Foundry to support engineering standards, reusable platforms, shared services, engineering governance, and common delivery practices across the organization.
  • Contribute to technology strategy across Product Development & Engineering, including engineering maturity, innovation, AI adoption, developer productivity, and organizational scalability.

Engineering Delivery & Operational Excellence

  • Lead engineering teams responsible for delivering scalable, reliable, and secure technology solutions that support business objectives.
  • Lead the adoption and implementation of AI-assisted software engineering practices across the organization, including AI-enabled requirements analysis, software development, testing, quality engineering, documentation, and release management.
  • Partner with Product, Data & AI, and Architecture teams to identify, prioritize, and operationalize AI capabilities that accelerate software delivery while maintaining regulatory compliance and engineering quality.
  • Ensure the successful execution of engineering initiatives through effective governance, prioritization, resource allocation, and performance management.
  • Establish and monitor key operational and delivery metrics to assess performance, identify risks, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Promote engineering best practices, quality standards, operational excellence, and technology lifecycle management.
  • Establish engineering standards, best practices, and governance across software engineering teams.
  • Drive predictable and efficient delivery across multiple initiatives, balancing business priorities, capacity, and technical requirements.
  • Champion Developer Experience initiatives that improve engineering productivity through automation, reusable frameworks, AI-assisted development, self-service platforms, CI/CD optimization, and engineering tooling.
  • Drive engineering innovation by evaluating and adopting emerging technologies, AI capabilities, developer productivity tools, automation frameworks, and modern engineering practices.

People Leadership & Talent Development

  • Lead, develop, and inspire a diverse organization through multiple levels of leadership.
  • Create and execute talent strategies focused on workforce planning, capability development, succession planning, and employee engagement.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, innovation, accountability, and continuous learning.
  • Establish a culture of innovation that encourages experimentation, rapid prototyping, technical learning, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.
  • Coach and develop leaders, ensuring strong leadership pipelines and organizational readiness.
  • Mentor engineering leaders and strengthen leadership capability across the Poland site and broader Product Development & Engineering organization.
  • Drive employee retention and engagement initiatives while creating an inclusive and high-performing work environment.

Capacity Planning & Resource Management

  • Oversee organizational design, staffing strategies, and capacity planning activities to ensure alignment with current and future business needs.
  • Monitor workforce utilization and resource allocation to optimize delivery effectiveness and operational efficiency.
  • Partner with leadership teams to identify skill gaps and implement strategies to build critical engineering capabilities.
  • Support budget planning and investment decisions related to engineering resources and organizational growth.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build strong relationships with executive leaders, cross-functional stakeholders, and global technology partners.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership on engineering performance, talent strategy, and organizational effectiveness.
  • Communicate organizational priorities, risks, and opportunities effectively to executive audiences.
  • Foster collaboration across geographically distributed teams and global delivery organizations.

Qualifications (Minimum Required):

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field required.
  • Fortrea may consider relevant and equivalent experience and successful project outcomes in lieu of educational requirements.

Experience (Minimum Required):

  • Minimum of 12 years of progressive experience within software engineering, technology, or digital organizations.
  • Minimum of 7 years of leadership experience managing large engineering teams through multiple levels of management.
  • Demonstrated experience leading global or geographically distributed engineering organizations.
  • Proven track record overseeing complex technology delivery portfolios and operational excellence initiatives.
  • Experience developing talent strategies, workforce plans, and organizational capability models.
  • Strong experience partnering with Product and Technology leadership teams to drive business outcomes.
  • Demonstrated experience leading engineering modernization, organizational transformation, AI adoption, and large-scale engineering excellence initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications Include:

  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  • Experience leading large, globally distributed engineering organizations within complex matrixed environments.
  • Demonstrated success serving as a site leader or senior location leader with responsibility for organizational culture, employee engagement, and operational performance.
  • Experience supporting technology transformation, modernization, cloud adoption, platform engineering, or digital enablement initiatives.
  • Experience building or scaling digital foundry, platform engineering, developer experience, shared services, or engineering excellence capabilities.
  • Proven track record of scaling engineering organizations through periods of growth, organizational change, and business transformation.
  • Experience partnering with Product Management, Architecture, Data & AI, and Technology leaders to deliver strategic business and technology outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of software development methodologies, Agile delivery practices, DevOps principles, and engineering performance metrics.
  • Experience leading workforce planning, organizational design, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and drive decision-making across global, cross-functional teams.
  • Experience managing large-scale engineering delivery portfolios with accountability for resource planning, financial stewardship, operational effectiveness, and delivery outcomes.
  • Experience establishing and driving engineering best practices related to quality, reliability, security, compliance, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience implementing AI-assisted software delivery practices, automation frameworks, CI/CD optimization, and modern engineering tooling to improve developer productivity and quality outcomes.
  • Prior experience within regulated industries such as clinical research, healthcare, life sciences, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or other highly regulated environments is preferred.

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

Office/Home-Based:

Work Environment:

  • Work is performed in an office environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
  • Occasional drives to site locations with occasional travel both domestic and international.

Physical Requirements:

  • Frequently stationary for 6-8 hours per day.
  • Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists.
  • Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
  • Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
  • Light to moderate lifting and carrying, or moving of objects, including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
  • Regular and consistent attendance.
  • Varied hours may be required.

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Östergötland
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Östergötland.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

title: Systemtekniker Projektstöd nätverk
description:
Beskrivning

Avdelningen utveckling och styrning består av sex enheter, juridik och ärendehantering, IT och digitalisering, kommunikation, inköp och upphandling, säkerhet samt kvalitet. Avdelningen ansvarar för att samordna och utveckla förvaltningsgemensam styrning, utveckling, administration och ledningsstöd samt lägga grunden till gemensam systematik, struktur, och gemensamma arbetssätt/processer. Avdelningen omvärldsbevakar inom ansvarsområdena och har ett övergripande ansvar för att samordna och inspirera till utveckling av förvaltningens verksamhet och kvaliteten på våra leveranser.

Enheten för IT och digitalisering skapar förutsättningar för förvaltning och utveckling så att metoder och arbetssätt bidrar till att verksamhetens mål uppnås samt underlättar service och dialog med kunder. Vidare utvecklar och säkerställer enheten förvaltningens IT-strategi utifrån verksamhetens behov, samt levererar värdeskapande och kostnadseffektiva tjänster och lösningar i samverkan med bland annat Intraservice vid Göteborgs stad.

Nu söker vi en systemtekniker med inriktning projektstöd nätverk.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som systemtekniker med inriktning Projektstöd nätverk ansvarar du för att samordna och administrera nätverksrelaterade frågor i samband med ny-, om- och tillbyggnadsprojekt. Du fungerar som ett stöd till byggprojektledare i frågor som rör nätverksinfrastruktur och säkerställer att rätt beställningar genomförs i rätt tid.

Arbetet innefattar beställning av WAN- och LAN-lösningar samt boendefiber till verksamhetslokaler, exempelvis äldreboenden. Du följer upp beställningar och leveranser för att säkerställa att de färdigställs enligt projektens tidplaner. Rollen omfattar även löpande administration och koordinering kopplat till både pågående och kommande nätverksprojekt.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som har ett stort intresse för nätverk och som trivs i en roll med många kontaktytor. Du är van att samordna, följa upp och driva frågor framåt på ett strukturerat sätt.

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du behöver ha:

  • Gymnasieutbildning eller annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
  • Flera års erfarenhet av arbete med nätverk och nätverksrelaterade lösningar.
  • God administrativ förmåga och vana att hantera flera parallella arbetsuppgifter.
  • Erfarenhet av samverkan med både interna och externa parter i en större organisation.
  • Förmåga att kommunicera tekniska frågor på ett pedagogiskt sätt och anpassa information till olika målgrupper.

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Eftergymnasial utbildning inom IT/data med inriktning mot nätverk.
  • Certifieringar inom nätverk, exempelvis Cisco CCNA, Cisco CCNP Enterprise eller motsvarande.
  • Teknisk byggkompetens och grundläggande kunskap om hur byggprojekt bedrivs.
  • Erfarenhet av att läsa och tolka ritningar.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper. För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är flexibel, strukturerad och noggrann. Du har ett gott bemötande, samarbetar väl med andra och tar ansvar för att skapa goda relationer och driva arbetet framåt på ett professionellt sätt.

Övrigt

Vi erbjuder en arbetsplats i utveckling och med framåtanda. Våra medarbetare har breda och varierande kompetenser. Vi arbetar i trevliga lokaler och erbjuder medarbetarförmåner såsom flexibel arbetstid, friskvårdsbidrag och cykelförmåner. Stadsfastigheter arbetar för ett hållbart arbetsliv där du ska kunna kombinera ett spännande och givande arbetsliv med ett rikt liv också utanför arbetet. Vi erbjuder dig ett utvecklings- och innovationsklimat som ger dig goda möjligheter till karriärutveckling. Inom förvaltningen tillämpar vi ett tillitsbaserat ledarskap som grundar sig i den inkluderande arbetsplatsen.

Vi strävar efter att ha en jämn fördelning mellan kvinnor och män och en spridning när det gäller ålder på vår förvaltning. Vi vill att vår arbetsplats ska präglas av öppenhet och respekt för olikheter och vi tror att mångfald bidrar till att utveckla vår verksamhet.

Som anställd inom Göteborgs Stad omfattas du av allmän tjänsteplikt, utifrån lagen om totalförsvarsplikt.

Till dig som företräder bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag: Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp.

Om oss

Stadsfastighetsförvaltningen skapar miljöer där livet får ta plats genom att planera, bygga, hyra in, förvalta och utveckla lokaler och utemiljöer för Göteborgs Stads verksamheter. Varje dag är hundratusentals göteborgare verksamma i förskolor, skolor, vård- och omsorgsboenden och andra lokaler som vi sköter om.

Gemensamt med stadsmiljöförvaltingen, exploateringsförvaltningen och stadsbyggnadsförvaltningen har vi ett samordnat ansvar för stadsutvecklingen i Göteborgs stad. Detta innebär en delad ansvarsfördelning och roller utifrån skeden: planering; genomförande och förvaltning med mål att bidra till en sammanhållen, effektiv och transparent stadsutveckling för boende, besökare och näringsliv i staden.

title: Chief of Pharmacy and Related Services
description:

Monday - Friday, 8:30 am - 4:00 pm

Non-Standard


Job Requisition Number

JR104205 Chief of Pharmacy and Related Services (Open)

Pay Grade

C00138 A

Classification

Chief Pharmacy and Related Services

Class Definition

GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES: To be responsible for planning, coordinating, organizing, inspecting and administrating a statewide program of pharmacy services for state hospitals, health facilities, clinics and other agencies; to be responsible for the operation of a central pharmacy to supply the state's pharmacies and agencies with medication and medical and surgical supplies; and to do related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Work is subject to the administrative approval of a superior but retains full responsibility for the performance of work in accordance with requirements of the pharmacist profession.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Plans, coordinates, organizes, inspects and reviews the work of a professional, technical and clerical staff engaged in providing pharmacy services.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • To be responsible for planning, coordinating, organizing, inspecting and administrating a statewide program of pharmacy services for state hospitals, health facilities, clinics and other agencies.
  • To be responsible for developing, establishing and implementing policies, procedures and programs relating to pharmacy services within the department.
  • To be responsible for researching, planning, drafting, finalizing and implementing more economical, efficient and safer methods of distribution of medication and medical and surgical supplies.
  • To participate in the process of purchasing medication and medical supplies for patient use by providing the professional knowledge and expertise and by establishing standards needed by the Division of Purchases.
  • To develop guidelines to regulate the procedure by which medical sales representatives disseminate information on their company's products to physicians and nursing personnel within the department.
  • To conduct studies designed to assure that the medication and medical supplies purchased are of the proper quality.
  • To insure that the pharmacy services comply to standards established in federal and state legislation, as well as professional codes for accreditation.
  • To be responsible for the operation of a central pharmacy; to supply the state’s pharmacies and agencies with medication and medical and surgical supplies.
  • To review university oriented programs dealing in the pharmacy area and to coordinate these programs with departmental functions.
  • To be responsible for the control and accountability of all medication distributed within the statewide pharmacy services program.
  • To update and maintain the formulary system utilized by all pharmacies in the department.
  • To be responsible for insuring that the pharmacy personnel, physicians and other members of the patient care team is provided with pertinent and current medical information relating to pharmacy services and medication.
  • To do related work as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT:

KNOWLEDGES, SKILLS AND CAPACITIES: A thorough knowledge of the principles and practices of professional pharmacy; a thorough knowledge of the principles, methods and procedures used in administrating a statewide program of pharmacy services and the ability to plan, coordinate, organize, inspect and administer such a program; a thorough knowledge of the nature, composition and uses of the more common drugs; a thorough knowledge of the federal, state and professional regulations, standards, and codes pertaining to the proper delivery of pharmaceutical services; a thorough knowledge of recent developments in the area of medical information relating to pharmacy services, and the ability to transmit this information to subordinates and medical personnel; a working knowledge of the various elements of the market for sale and purchase of medications and medical supplies; the ability to establish and maintain a system of medication inventory in order to insure strict accountability and control; the ability to conduct pharmaceutical studies for the purpose of quality control; the ability to estimate future pharmaceutical needs; the ability to deal tactfully with the public, medical sales representatives, and with medical, nursing and administrative staffs; and related capacities and abilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Such as may have been gained through: possession of a master’s degree in pharmacy sciences from an accredited school of pharmacy; and

Experience: Such as may have been gained through: considerable employment in a responsible administrative position involving the direction of a staff engaged in providing pharmacy services and the administration of a program with the responsibility to purchasing and inventory control of a large pharmaceutical inventory.

Or, any combination of education and experience that shall be substantially equivalent to the above education and experience.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENT: Registration in pharmacy in Rhode Island and must maintain such registration as a condition of employment.

title: Institutionssekreterare
description:
Gymnastik- och idrottshögskolan, GIH, är Sveriges främsta kunskapscentrum för idrott, prestationsutveckling, fysisk aktivitet och hälsa. Vi bedriver forskning med hög kvalitet och samhällsrelevans med fokus på människan i rörelse. Vi utbildar lärare i skolämnet idrott och hälsa, såväl som tränare, hälsovetare, beteendevetare, sport- och hälsomanagers, idrottsvetare och forskare. Vid GIH arbetar och studerar 160 medarbetare och 1 400 studenter. Högskolan är belägen i centrala Stockholm i nära anslutning till Stockholms Stadion och ett stort idrotts- och friluftsområde.

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker en strukturerad och engagerad institutionssekreterare som vill bidra med administrativt stöd på institutionnivå. Framför allt gäller arbetet studie-, utbildnings- och programadministration.

Hos oss ges du möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med inspirerande kollegor med olika bakgrund och professioner. GIH är ett lärosäte som värnar om att ge plats för nytänkande. Vi erbjuder dig en tjänst i en platt organisation med stort driv.

Vidhttps://www.gih.se/om-gih/organisation/institutioner/institutionen-for-rorelse-kultur-och-samhalle-rks finns ämnesområdena Pedagogik, Ämnesdidaktik och Management - med inriktning mot idrott och hälsa. Institutionen ansvarar för flera lärarutbildningsprogram, Kandidatprogramen Sport Managent och Health Management, Högskoleprogrammet Idrott och hälsa, Masterprogramsinriktning, Högskolepedagogik samt ett antal fristående kurser. RKS leds av en prefekt och tre biträdande prefekter, och utbildningarna samordnas av sammanlagt fyra studierektorer och en mängd kursanavariga/examinatorer. Vi är idag cirka femtio medarbetare varav två institutionssekreterare. Som institutionssekreterare på RKS kommer du att vara placerad direkt under prefekten.

De huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifterna består av:

  • Hantering av studentärenden, bl.a. omprov, registreringar, behörighetsgranskningar, studieuppehåll samt återupptagande av studier.
  • Hantering av utbildningsärenden i studiedokumentationssystemet Ladok, bl.a. resultatnoteringar, resultatuppföljningar och skapande av aktivitetstillfällen.
  • Nedläggning av kurser, i samverkan med studierektorer och kursansvariga.
  • Programadministration kring ÄL inriktning mot gymnasiet, KPU 60, KPU 90 och sommarkurser.
  • Logistik kring kurser i lärplattformen Canvas, bland att placera in studenter.
  • Möteslogistik i samband med större möten.
  • Logistik i samband med programavslutningar.
  • I övrigt förekommande arbetsuppgifter inom ramen för anställningen.

Behörighetskrav

Behörig att anställas är den som har:

  • Genomgått akademisk utbildning, motsvarande lägst kandidat, som arbetsgivaren bedömer relevant.
  • Datorprogramvana och erfarenhet av systemadministration.
  • God förmåga att uttrycka sig väl på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.

Bedömningsgrunder

För denna anställning har följande bedömningsgrunder fastställts:

  • Mycket stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet, där vi ser att du som person är utvecklingsinriktad, nyfiken och flexibel samtidigt som du är organiserad och noggrann när det krävs. Du har en god servicekänsla och tycker om att arbeta med människor. Du tar egna initiativ men är också duktig på att samverka.
  • Stor vikt läggs vid erfarenhet från liknande arbete/arbetsuppgifter, gärna inom utbildningssektorn.

Varaktighet/Arbetstid

Anställningen är en tidsbegränsad anställning på heltid som beräknas pågå under 2027, med möjlighet till till förlängning. Tillträde i februari 2027 eller enligt överenskommelse.

Lön

Individuell lönesättning tillämpas.

Ansökningsförfarande

Du ansöker via vår hemsida genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök". Handlingar bifogas elektroniskt och ska vara i word- eller pdf-format. Ansökan ska innefatta följande handlingar:

  • sammanställning av utbildningar och anställningar (CV),
  • personligt brev.

Ansökan ska vara GIH tillhanda senast den 18 november 2026.

Läs mer om https://www.gih.se/download/18.1e3f17441845fb8d40fdbc/1668082804888/GIH_Medarbetarskaps-och_ledarskapspolicy_2015.pdf.

Åberopade meriter ska kunna intygas vid anmodan. GIH verkar för mångfald och jämställdhet inom samtliga anställningskategorier. Vi ser därför gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och erfarenheter. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: VP Digital and IT- Manufacturing Operations
description:
Job Description

VP Digital and IT- Manufacturing Operations

Full Time

Derby/ Hybrid (3 days per week on site)

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Vice President – Digital & IT to lead the digital and technology agenda for Manufacturing Operations within Civil Aerospace, bringing strong leadership and manufacturing knowledge to deliver business improvement.

The Vice President – Digital & IT role will be a member of the Civil ITLT and Operations Leadership Team (OLT), contributing to manufacturing strategy, performance and transformation while providing clear leadership of the Digital & IT agenda.

As Vice President – Digital & IT, Manufacturing Operations, you will be the accountable Digital & IT partner for the manufacturing function. You will work with operational leaders to understand factory needs, set priorities and translate business strategy into a practical digital and technology roadmap that improves safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity and resilience. Success requires strong leadership, manufacturing knowledge and the ability to lead change and mobilise specialist teams, rather than deep technical expertise or an extensive Digital & IT career. You will own prioritised demand into shared service and product organisations, oversee delivery, adoption and business benefits, and remain the senior escalation point for manufacturing Digital & IT services and risk. Technical specialists will provide the expertise to assure solutions across enterprise IT, operational technology, data and automation.

What you will be doing:

Reporting to the SVP CDIO - Civil, The VP Digital and IT – Manufacturing Operations, will include:

  • Manufacturing Strategy Alignment: Contribute to Manufacturing Operations strategy and partner with operational leaders to identify business priorities, translating them into an integrated Digital & IT roadmap aligned to Civil Aerospace and Group strategy.
  • Digital Manufacturing Transformation: Lead technology-enabled manufacturing improvement across the factory network, bringing together process change, people and digital capabilities. Set clear business outcomes and work with operational and technical teams to deploy and embed solutions such as manufacturing execution, automation, data and AI, planning and quality technologies.
  • Portfolio and Demand Management: Create and own a prioritised manufacturing Digital & IT portfolio, balancing operational need, strategic value, risk, affordability and capacity across sites and value streams.
  • Delivery and Value Realisation: Provide governance, control and visibility of portfolio delivery, ensuring capabilities are adopted into operations and deliver measurable improvements in safety, quality, delivery, cost, productivity, inventory and asset utilisation.
  • Operational Technology and Enterprise Integration: Set business priorities for connected manufacturing processes and information flow across factory systems, engineering, supply chain and enterprise platforms. Hold specialist teams accountable for secure, resilient and scalable integration, clear lifecycle ownership and technical standards.
  • Service, Cyber and Operational Risk: Own the performance and risk profile of Digital & IT services supporting manufacturing, driving service continuity, cyber resilience, regulatory compliance, obsolescence management and effective recovery arrangements.
  • Stakeholder Management and Business Partnership: Build trusted relationships with manufacturing, engineering, supply chain, quality and finance leaders. Act as the voice of Manufacturing Operations into Digital & IT and as a strategic adviser on technology-enabled performance improvement.
  • Financial Accountability: Maintain oversight of Digital & IT investment and run costs for the manufacturing portfolio, ensuring strong cost control, transparent investment choices and demonstrable value for money.
  • Talent, Capability and Change Leadership: Lead and develop a high-performing team, bringing together manufacturing knowledge and specialist Digital & IT expertise. Build commitment across sites and functions, strengthen digital and data capability, and lead the changes in processes, behaviours and ways of working needed to sustain business improvements.

Preferred requirements:

  • Strong senior leadership experience in a large, complex, multi-site manufacturing or engineering organisation, with a track record of setting direction, developing teams and delivering results. Relevant backgrounds include manufacturing operations, business transformation or Digital & IT; extensive prior Digital & IT experience is not required.
  • Proven track record of leading manufacturing improvement or business transformation, delivering measurable operational outcomes and embedding new ways of working. Experience using digital, data or technology to support these outcomes is valuable.
  • Strong manufacturing knowledge and practical understanding of factory operations, lean principles, production systems, quality, supply chain and industrial performance management, with the credibility to understand operational challenges and challenge priorities.
  • Ability to understand how Digital & IT enables manufacturing performance, ask informed questions and make sound decisions on investment, delivery and risk. Deep technical knowledge is not required; the ability to lead, challenge and draw on technical specialists is important.
  • Experience prioritising complex business change and investment portfolios, making clear trade-offs and holding delivery teams to account. Able to apply this discipline to Digital & IT delivery through product, programme and shared service models.
  • Demonstrable success in stakeholder leadership and organisational change across manufacturing sites, functions and senior leadership teams.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with experience managing significant budgets, investment cases, suppliers and benefits realisation.
  • Exceptional communication, influencing and presentation skills, with the ability to connect technology choices to manufacturing and business outcomes.
  • Degree in a relevant discipline such as engineering, manufacturing, computer science, information technology or business administration, or equivalent experience.
  • Experience in aerospace, defence or another highly regulated advanced manufacturing sector is highly desirable.

Regional benefits:

  • Generous Annual Leave
  • Retirement Savings through the Rolls-Royce Retirement Savings Trust
  • Group Life Assurance provides for a lump sum benefit if you die whilst employed by Rolls-Royce
  • Group Income Protection provides an income in the event that you are unable to work due to illness or injury
  • Your Shares: Matched is a simple way to own Rolls-Royce shares and invest in our future, together. Buy one share, get one free!

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

Closing date: Midnight 16th November 2026

title: Strategy Director
description:
Job Description


Collinson is the global leader in travel experiences and customer engagement, a business that builds loyalty 500 million times a day, across 140 countries, for some of the world's most ambitious brands. Our clients include major financial institutions, airlines, transport operators and retailers who trust us to design programmes that move customers from passive participation to genuine, measurable commitment.


Our loyalty practice sits at the intersection of behavioural strategy, data science and programme design. We believe that the best loyalty programmes are strategic assets - not cost centres - and we've built our methodology around the evidence: that incrementality, not points balances, is the true measure of a programme's worth.

Purpose of the job

This is a senior strategy role within our consulting business, with the opportunity to lead major client projects from discovery through to delivery. Working alongside the Experience Strategy Director, Loyalty Consulting, and wider strategy team, you’ll take ownership of strategic challenges, shape the direction of client programmes and be accountable for delivering work that makes a meaningful commercial and customer impact.

You’ll lead projects independently, champion the voice of the customer and bring together research, insight and data to uncover opportunities, challenge assumptions and develop compelling strategic recommendations. You’ll be confident setting the strategic agenda, navigating complex challenges and taking clients and colleagues with you.

This is a strategy role that takes data seriously. We are evidence-led in everything we do. The commercial case for a programme lives or dies on the quality of the insight behind it, and the strongest strategic thinking comes from a genuine understanding of what the numbers are saying. You don't need to be a data scientist, but you do need to know which questions to ask, how to interrogate the evidence and how to turn complex data into a clear, persuasive strategic argument.

Equally important is genuine curiosity and independent thinking. You’ll be someone who keeps asking why, digs deeper, connects the dots and brings fresh perspectives that challenge conventional thinking. You'll have the experience and confidence to lead client conversations, make informed strategic decisions and drive projects forward with autonomy, while knowing when to draw on the expertise of others.

As a senior member of the team, you'll also help shape and evolve our strategic thinking, approaches and capabilities. You'll stay close to developments in loyalty, customer engagement and behaviour change, bringing new thinking and fresh perspectives that strengthen our work, inspire colleagues and create opportunities for clients and prospects.

Key Responsibilities

Client strategy and programme design

  • Lead strategy development across major loyalty accounts, from initial diagnostic and opportunity sizing through to programme design, commercial modelling and go-to-market planning
  • Own the strategic narrative on client engagements - structuring complex problems, commissioning research and data analysis, synthesising those findings into clear recommendations, and presenting with confidence at senior levels
  • Work with and enhance existing frameworks for programme evaluation including commercial modelling, incrementality modelling, headroom analysis, share-of-wallet assessment and behavioural segmentation
  • Lead workshop design and facilitation with clients, from discovery sessions that surface the real commercial question, through to strategic alignment workshops that get the right people in the room making the right decisions
  • Have a point of view on what good looks like: understand how the strongest long-term programmes (Clubcard, Avios, Nectar, others) have stayed relevant, how non-traditional models are working (M&S Sparks) and how that applies to the client and prospect challenges we are exploring
  • undefined

Experience & Skills

Experience

  • Some experience in loyalty, CRM, customer engagement, research or strategy. You don't need to be a loyalty expert, but you should have an interest in what makes customer programmes successful and a willingness to learn.
  • An understanding of customer engagement and behaviour change. You’re curious about what motivates people, what gets in their way and how programmes can influence what they think, feel and do.
  • A strong instinct for research, data and insight. You enjoy digging into evidence, asking questions, spotting patterns and turning findings into meaningful insights that help shape strategic decisions.
  • Confidence working with data and commercial analysis. You don't need to build complex models, but you should be comfortable interpreting numbers, questioning findings and understanding what they mean for the bigger picture.
  • Exposure to public sector, financial services, retail or travel is a bonus, but curiosity, adaptability and the ability to get to grips with new sectors quickly matter far more than category expertise.

  • Skills and capabilities

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication: you write clearly, structure arguments rigorously, and can take a complex brief and turn it into a narrative that sparks fresh thinking.
  • A genuine curious instinct - you can make the leap from insight to idea, from problem to solution.
  • Data literacy and insight-driven thinking: you have an instinct to reach for evidence, strong experience with data as a strategic tool, and the ability to translate analytical output into clear strategic direction.
  • Intellectual curiosity and range: you read widely, have genuine views on loyalty, and are interested in the psychology, economics and behavioural science that underpin how programmes actually work.
  • A bias for clarity over complexity: the best strategy work makes the difficult simple, not the simple complicated.
  • Commercial instinct — you understand that loyalty is ultimately there to solve business problems

  • About you

  • You're proactive and self-motivated. Comfortable taking initiative, managing your own workload and working independently when needed, while knowing when to ask questions or seek guidance.
  • You're a team player. Collaborative, supportive and happy to roll up your sleeves to help Strategy Directors and colleagues deliver great work.
  • You thrive in a fast-paced environment. Adaptable, organised and comfortable juggling different priorities without losing sight of the detail.
