title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag på Gotland
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten på Gotland.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

title: Associate, Disputes and Fraud Analysis
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Associate, Disputes and Fraud Analysis

What does a great Fraud & Dispute Associate do at Fiserv?

As a Fraud & Dispute Associate, you will provide support to Fiserv clients’ card portfolio chargeback programs (debit, credit, prepaid). You will investigate claims, compare multiple avenues of processing disputes/chargebacks, and decide on the best path to resolution.

This important position is required to ensure that we take care of our clients, as well as their customers. This directly follows our values of earning client trust every day and creating with purpose. You will contribute to efforts small and large!


What you will do:

  • Investigate, evaluate, and process disputes/chargebacks, contacting cardholders to investigate possible fraud.
  • Understand compliance and verification procedures to effectively process cardholder information, while staying up to date on network regulatory requirements and client guidelines.
  • Monitor systems to detect possible fraudulent behavior related to card usage and deliver great customer experience via inbound and outbound calls with clients and cardholders.
  • Track and take action on cases within timeframes based on regulatory guidelines and client requirements, entering data into client-specific systems to accurately record and keep track of cardholder, card, transaction, and case information.
  • Respond to inquiries from internal and external stakeholders regarding chargeback requirements, system processing and functionality, dispute lifecycle, claim status, and data input.

What you will need to have:

  • 1-4 years of financial or customer service experience

What would be great to have:

  • Knowledge of Regulation E and Regulation Z
  • Knowledge of Visa and/or Mastercard operating regulations

title: Vulnerability Security Engineer
location: All, Michigan, United States of America
description:
Vulnerability Security EngineerThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

About Our Cybersecurity Team

Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading technology companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that. We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced vulnerability management expert to join our team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.


About the Role

As a Vulnerability Security Engineer at HPE, you will be responsible for identifying, prioritizing, and driving remediation of security vulnerabilities while leveraging automation and AI-driven solutions to reduce cyber risk and improve operational efficiency. Your role will focus on the continuous improvement of the organization's vulnerability management program by identifying, prioritizing, and partnering with technology teams to remediate security vulnerabilities at scale. You will apply your knowledge of vulnerability management to protect HPE’s applications and infrastructure.


About You

You will bring expertise in vulnerability management tools and platforms to reduce organizational cyber risk by ensuring vulnerabilities are identified, prioritized, and remediated efficiently across enterprise systems, applications, and cloud platforms. You will work independently and contribute to high-impact projects in fast-paced environments, applying advanced expertise across cybersecurity and IT security.

Your experience with vulnerability management, technical security engineering, and stakeholder collaboration/ influence will be critical. Strong communication skills are essential, enabling you to explain complex technical issues clearly to non-technical audiences.


You Will Be Responsible For

  • Manage the enterprise vulnerability management program, including vulnerability identification, assessment, prioritization, and remediation tracking.
  • Perform and maintain vulnerability scanning across servers, endpoints, cloud environments, network devices, containers, and applications.
  • Analyze vulnerability scan results and validate findings to reduce false positives and improve remediation effectiveness.
  • Partner with infrastructure, cloud, application, and engineering teams to drive timely remediation of security vulnerabilities.
  • Assess vulnerabilities using CVSS scores, threat intelligence, exploitability, and business risk to prioritize remediation activities.
  • Monitor emerging threats, zero-day vulnerabilities, and security advisories, providing guidance on organizational impact and required actions.
  • Develop metrics, dashboards, and reporting to communicate vulnerability trends, remediation performance, and risk reduction to leadership.
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and security reviews for new technologies, infrastructure deployments, and cloud services.
  • Maintain and administer vulnerability management tools such as Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys, CrowdStrike Exposure Management, or similar platforms.
  • Collaborate with application security teams to integrate vulnerability management into the software development lifecycle.
  • Assist with audit, regulatory, and compliance activities by providing evidence and reporting related to vulnerability management controls.
  • Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions that streamline vulnerability management processes, improve operational efficiency, and reduce manual effort across security and technology teams.
  • Evaluate, implement, and optimize AI-driven security capabilities to enhance vulnerability analysis, risk prioritization, remediation workflows, and data-driven cybersecurity decision-making.

Education & Experience Requirements

  • Required
  • 6+ years of experience in vulnerability management, security engineering, cybersecurity operations, or a related security discipline.
  • Experience conducting vulnerability assessments and coordinating remediation activities across infrastructure, cloud, and application environments.
  • Hands-on experience with vulnerability management platforms such as Rapid7 InsightVM, Qualys, Tenable Nessus, CrowdStrike Exposure Management, or equivalent tools.
  • Knowledge of vulnerability scoring methodologies, including CVSS, EPSS, and risk-based prioritization approaches.
  • Experience supporting Windows, Linux, cloud, and network technologies.
  • Understanding of common security vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and attack techniques.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks and standards including NIST, CIS Controls, PCI-DSS, ISO 27001, and SOC 2.
  • Experience creating executive-level metrics, dashboards, and risk reporting.
  • Preferred
  • Experience with vulnerability management automation and scripting (PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar).
  • Experience integrating vulnerability findings into ticketing and workflow platforms such as ServiceNow or Jira.
  • Knowledge of application security concepts including SAST, DAST, container security, and software composition analysis.
  • Professional certifications such as Security+, CySA+, GSEC, GCIH, CISSP, or equivalent.
  • Experience supporting large enterprise environments and risk-based vulnerability management programs.

title: Retail Store Management - New Store
description:
Position Overview

If you are interested in growing your retail management career with one of the largest and fastest growing off-price retailers in the nation, join the Burlington Stores team as a Store Manager! Are you a proven leader with strong communication and organization skills? Can you lead a team in driving results while building strong teams and partnerships and cultivating an environment based on trust, respect, and integrity? Can you bring innovative ideas to help drive results as you take on the challenge of running all aspects of a multi-million-dollar store operation? If you answer yes, then this may be the right opportunity for you.

As a Store Manager, you’ll be responsible for successfully managing all store operations tasks to maximize sales results while bringing “Our Burlington” values to life in your store. You will be a mentor, role model, and coach for your team members, as well as a partner to associates in other branches of the organization. You will lead your team by example, demonstrating how to deliver excellent customer service with a high degree of professionalism and provide a world-class shopping experience to customers. You will take ownership for the successful execution of all day-to-day merchandising, operations and service management tasks. You are ultimately responsible for the overall success of your store location and the associates on your team.

A Day in the Life

  • Direct management and oversight of Assistant Managers, Supervisors, and Store Associates to ensure implementation of established company policies, standards, expectations and initiatives.
  • Ensure Assistant Managers and store team members are fulfilling their individual responsibilities.
  • Partner with Assistant Store Manager, Merchandising to coordinate merchandise placement, sales promotions and pricing.
  • Partner with Assistant Store Manager, Operations to review receiving, transfers, debits/damages, returns-to-vendor (RTV's), and chargeback paperwork to ensure accuracy of inventory.
  • Act as Manager on Duty (MOD); lead by example, set the standard, and create a strong leadership presence by following and modeling the Burlington SOPs.
  • Manage multi-million-dollar sales volume and expense budget including review of all associated reporting and record-keeping.
  • Recruitment, screening and hiring of associates in order to meet store staffing needs.
  • Facilitate onboarding and training for new associates, provide ongoing coaching in the moment, and implement structured learning and development activities for all team members.
  • Handle personnel and associate relations issues.
  • Payroll budget management, workforce management and scheduling.
  • Facilitate effective communication and partnerships among the store team, district and regional management teams, and other partners within the company.

You'll Come With

  • 5+ years of Retail Management experience in a Big Box or Specialty environment
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule; including early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes weighing up to 40 lbs.
  • Experience utilizing scheduling and reporting computer software
  • Travel may be required from time to time.

Pay Range

  • Store Manager: $78,140 - $97,675 / annual
  • Operations/Service Manager: $ 24.35 - $32.45 / hour

Come join our team. You’re going to like it here!

You will enjoy a competitive wage, flexible hours, and an associate discount. Burlington’s benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage including life and disability insurance. Full time associates may also be eligible for up to 12 days of paid time off annually, up to 8 paid holidays, paid sick time in accordance with applicable law, and a 401(k) plan. We are a rapidly growing brand and provide a variety of training and development opportunities so our associates can grow with us.

Our store teams work hard and have fun together! Burlington associates make a difference in the lives of customers, colleagues, and the communities where we live and work every day. Burlington Stores, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to workplace diversity.

Individual pay decisions will be based on a variety of factors, such as but not limited to, qualifications, education, job-related skills, relevant experience, and geographic location.

title: Manager, Communications (East Southeast Asia)
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Manager, Communications (East Southeast Asia)

The role will support communications across East Southeast Asia (ESEA), working across a dynamic and diverse set of markets including Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia, Laos & Timor Leste. The role will help translate Mastercard’s regional and global priorities into locally relevant communications strategies and campaigns, while identifying opportunities to elevate market-specific stories, leadership voices and business priorities.

This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role, working closely with Country Managers, local market teams, regional and global stakeholders, and external agencies to develop and execute integrated communications programs. The successful candidate will bring strong knowledge of social and digital communications, an understanding of local market nuances, and the ability to manage multiple priorities across markets.


Role

• Support strategic ESEA communications planning across internal and external audiences, including employees, senior customers, regulators, media, industry influencers and public stakeholders. Ensure communications are culturally nuanced, locally resonant and aligned to Mastercard’s regional and global priorities.
• Develop and execute integrated, communications programs across ESEA, combining corporate communications, storytelling, social media, digital content, executive communications and visual storytelling across earned, owned and paid channels.
• Work closely with Country Managers and local market teams to understand business priorities, identify relevant local insights and translate them into compelling communications opportunities. Bring a strong understanding of the different media, cultural and business landscapes across markets such as Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia and Laos.
• Drive market-level storytelling and amplification by identifying stories, proof points, customer successes, partnerships, thought leadership and local trends that can strengthen Mastercard’s presence and relevance in each market.
• Own and execute social media plans for priority markets, narratives and leaders, working with local teams, agencies and regional/global social teams to develop content calendars, create and adapt content, manage publishing and optimise performance across LinkedIn and other relevant platforms.
• Support executive visibility across ESEA, working with Country Managers and senior leaders to develop LinkedIn content, speeches, talking points, thought leadership and other leadership communications that reflect both regional priorities and local market context.
• Drive storytelling through digital, social and visual-first content, translating complex products, platforms, technologies and business propositions into clear and compelling narratives for customers, partners, governments and other stakeholders. Oversee the development of multimedia assets including videos, animations, explainers, data visualisations, presentations and other digital formats.
• Partner closely with regional, global and market stakeholders to deliver aligned, enterprise-wide communications that reinforce Mastercard’s strategy, showcase business performance and innovation, and strengthen the company’s reputation across ESEA.
• Manage agency and vendor relationships across markets, including PR, creative, social, digital, production and specialist partners. Provide clear briefs, manage timelines and budgets, challenge agencies to bring forward strong ideas, and ensure consistently high-quality execution.
• Coordinate multiple agencies and stakeholders across ESEA, ensuring local agency recommendations are informed by market insights while maintaining consistency with Mastercard’s broader narrative, brand and communications standards.
• Execute high-impact regional and market campaigns, leveraging Mastercard’s global and regional sponsorships, partnerships, experiential platforms, products and digital ecosystems to create locally relevant storytelling and engagement opportunities.
• Monitor market and social conversations to identify emerging trends, issues, opportunities and competitive activity. Use these insights to inform communications planning, content development and recommendations to Country Managers and regional leadership.
• Contribute to employee engagement and internal storytelling, using modern, digital-first approaches to help employees understand Mastercard’s strategy, priorities and business performance. Support leadership communications across internal platforms, town halls and social-style channels.
• Measure and optimise communications performance, using social, digital, media and campaign data to understand what is resonating, demonstrate impact and continuously improve market and regional programs.


All About You

• Proven experience across communications, PR, marketing, or related disciplines, with a strong track record in social and digital communications.
• Experience working across multiple markets in Southeast Asia, with an understanding of the cultural, media and business nuances of markets such as Indonesia, Philippines, Vietnam, Cambodia and/or Laos.
• Proven experience managing external agencies, including setting briefs, managing deliverables and budgets, providing strategic direction and ensuring high-quality execution.
• Strong understanding of social media strategy and execution, particularly LinkedIn, with experience developing content plans, executive social strategies, digital campaigns and amplification programs.
• Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone and messaging for different audiences, markets and channels.
• A keen eye for visual storytelling and creative content, with experience briefing or overseeing the development of videos, presentations, infographics, animations, social assets and other multimedia formats.
• Strong strategic thinking combined with a hands-on approach to execution. Comfortable moving between developing a regional strategy and getting into the detail of a local market campaign or social post.
• Highly collaborative and culturally aware, with strong interpersonal skills and EQ and the ability to build trusted relationships with colleagues, agencies and stakeholders across different markets.
• Superb project and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple markets, agencies, stakeholders and deadlines simultaneously.
• Digitally savvy and curious, with the ability to learn and work across multiple content, social and collaboration platforms and tools.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and creative/content tools such as Canva, with experience using other design, video editing or digital content platforms as an advantage.
• Highly self-motivated, organised and detail-oriented, with a passion for content, storytelling and finding new ways to engage audiences.
• Creative, proactive and able to anticipate the needs of the business, identify opportunities and bring forward ideas rather than simply respond to briefs.
• Excellent command of written and spoken English. Additional Southeast Asian language capabilities would be an advantage.

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technical Data Analyst - AMM
description:
Job Description:

Job Description – Technical Data Analyst


There is an opportunity in Airbus Customer Services to join the Operational Unit "Technical Data Support and Services", which works towards developing and delivering aircraft maintenance documentation, to enable the safe and efficient accomplishment of maintenance operations by the customers (airlines, MRO, lessors).The products developed are AMM (Aircraft Maintenance Manual), TSM (Troubleshooting Manual), IPC (Illustrated Part Catalogue).


To deliver the complete documentation at aircraft entry into service and to maintain it throughout the aircraft life cycle is our main mission, and is part of the airworthiness requirements. The main challenge is to define precisely the consequences of the design changes on the already published documentation and to understand the immediate impact on Customers operations, with the objective to provide customised documentation in accordance with aircraft configuration.


Experience Level needed: 0-3 years Experience


The jobholder will be responsible of a portfolio of ATA chapters for all aircraft programs across Airframe /Systems / Cabin perimeters and will be responsible for the following activities:


  • Writing of Technical Data Authoring activities of a Manual(AMM/IPC/TSM) in accordance with specifications and quality standards, contractual commitments, configuration management rules, approved schedules, quality standards.
  • Mentor the junior members in the team and work as a specialist for Tech data topics.
  • Innovate and bring the process improvements in the technical data perimeter
  • Answer to customer questions for complex queries relative to his/her scope of activities. The jobholder will be responsible for providing efficient support to the customer, sometimes under high time pressure (following AOG…). He/she will guarantee accurate and on time correction of Technical Data deliverables.
  • Assessment of aircraft design inputs (Mod & Mod Proposal, Service Bulletin, …) that drive aircraft evolution in order to detect the impacts in the technical documentation.
  • The jobholder could have to work in close cooperation with numerous interfaces: customer services departments, design offices, airlines, suppliers.
  • The jobholder also plays a key role in terms of continuous improvements for Technical Data processes & tools and for transnational standardisation of ways of working.
  • Ensure and maintain compliance with EASA/FAA regulations (ICA process) and EN9100 for their own technical scope and perimeter of responsibility..
  • Provide continuous and efficient support to customers and all users of the Maintenance, Material deliverables.
  • Customer queries through TRM as per OTD/FTR targets
  • Ensure integration and management of all design criteria impacting Technical Data products.

Job Description:

Job Title: Product Specialist


Opportunity:

As a Product Specialist, you will work under Regional Product Manager (RPM), Product Line (PL), Power Transformer (PT), HUB APMEA. Your role will focus on improving competitiveness, conducting benchmarking, monitoring technology trends, and supporting the development and execution of regional product strategies.

This position drives innovation by analyzing market trends, customer requirements, benchmarking internal and external offerings, and monitoring technology developments across portfolios to generate new ideas that strengthen competitiveness and improve the opportunities and solutions that keep the company ahead of market trends and competitors.

Within the Power Transformer Product Line, your primary responsibility will be to enhance competitiveness and support the RPM in tracking regional roadmaps across different portfolios. This will leverage your expertise in power transformer design, comprehensive understanding of project specifications, scheduling, cost estimation, and effective cross-functional collaboration with departments such as Engineering, Supply Chain Management (SCM), Marketing & Sales (M&S), Production, and Finance across 5 PT factories under APMEA. You will also be required to collaborate with the Global Product Managers (GPM) and Global TopGun (TG) Designers as necessary, depending on the specific circumstances. Additionally, you will be tasked with monitoring progress and performance as well as implementing necessary actions to successfully complete projects. The role allows you to develop solutions, collaborate with HUB APMEA PT teams and support the organization's long-term success in a competitive market.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • Define and implement regional product roadmap initiatives aligned with market demand across HUB APMEA.
  • Support the RPM in providing regional MRS including applicable business case to GPMs and business case for R&D initiatives.
  • Enhancing competitiveness by delivering solutions that fulfill customer requirements and align with industry standards, including the optimization of transformer designs and all associated costs. Leading the implementation, validating savings and business cases for DtV projects.
  • You will be responsible for reviewing designs, facilitating design concept evaluations, and collaborating with different stakeholders as necessary to achieve competitiveness for PT factories within HUB APMEA.
  • You will work closely with the M&S team to assess and reach consensus on strategic opportunities required to enhance competitiveness and systematically track progress initiatives with relevant teams. Maintain a thorough understanding of both market conditions and competitor strengths and weaknesses.

Additionally, collaboration with the Global Product Specialist (GPS) and Global TopGun (TG) Designers may be required depending on specific project circumstances.
  • You will provide support to the Regional Product Manager (RPM) in implementing frameworks and strategies for Power Transformer under HUB APMEA.
  • Develop training programs for stakeholders.
  • Ensure all activities adhere to internal and external policies and regulations relevant to regional product management and competitive analysis.
  • Living Hitachi Energy's core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Your background:

  • You have a bachelor's degree in electrical or mechanical engineering, while holding a master's degree would be considered an asset.
  • A minimum of five years’ experience in an engineering role, ideally in the power transformer industry, is required. Having knowledge of product analytics and competitive analysis skills are considered advantageous.
  • Strong technical understanding of manufacturing process of power transformer and industry technologies to effectively work on competitiveness programs.

title: Consultant, Tourism Product Development & Investment Facilitation
description:
We don’t just talk, we do. Lead the change with us.

At the Tony Blair Institute for Global Change, we work with political leaders around the world to drive change. We help governments turn bold ideas into reality so they can deliver for their people. We do it by advising on strategy, policy and delivery, unlocking the power of technology across all three. And by sharing what we learn on the ground, so everyone can benefit. We do it to build more open, inclusive and prosperous countries for people everywhere.


We are a global not-for-profit organisation, operating in more than 40 countries across five continents. Our teams include political strategists, policy experts, delivery practitioners, technology specialists and more. We speak more than 45 languages and are working on over 100 projects, tackling some of the world’s biggest challenges. We’re all here at TBI to make a difference.


In a world of ever more complex challenges, we believe diversity of background and perspective is a strength. We pride ourselves on a culture that values and nurtures difference. We are dedicated to unlocking potential, not only for the countries we work in but also for each of our team members. No matter where you’re from or who you are, if you’re passionate about the transformative power of progressive politics, we invite you to build a better future with us.


Role Summary


Role Summary


The Tony Blair Institute, in partnership with the Rwanda Development Board (RDB), is seeking an experienced Short-Term Consultant – Tourism Product Development & Investment Facilitation to support Rwanda’s ambition to diversify its tourism offer and attract high-quality investment that strengthens its position as a premium destination.


Working closely with RDB’s Tourism Office and investment promotion and facilitation teams, the Consultant will help RDB identify priority gaps in Rwanda’s tourism offer, build a prioritized pipeline of product opportunities, and put in place the tools needed to assess, track, and convert high-quality tourism investments.


This is a deliverables-based assignment of up to 50 billable days over approximately 4 months. The Consultant will produce a defined package: a mapping and gap analysis of the tourism offer, a prioritization framework and first pipeline, investor-facing propositions for priority opportunities, a front-end investor assessment framework, an investor journey guide, and a monitoring tracker. Each deliverable will be handed over to named RDB counterparts, so that RDB can run the pipeline and investor process independently once the assignment ends.


We are looking for someone who combines commercial and investment fluency with a strong understanding of tourism markets: typically, from tourism or hospitality investment advisory, hotel and destination development, transaction advisory, investment promotion, or strategy consulting.


The Consultant will report to TBI’s Senior Manager – Country Program & Delivery and will coordinate with a parallel TBI consultancy on hospitality service quality and regulation.

Location: Kigali, Rwanda, with in-person presence required for consultations, testing of the assessment framework, and handover; other work may be completed remotely



Scope of Work & Deliverables


1. Inception Note & Workplan

  • Agree scope, methodology, stakeholder list, and timeline with TBI and RDB, and identify the RDB counterpart who will own each deliverable after handover
  • Collect and review existing tourism strategies, NST2 targets, market data, and current investor leads and proposals

2. Tourism Product Mapping & Gap Analysis

  • Map Rwanda’s current tourism product offer and assess it against market demand and source-market trends
  • Identify priority gaps and opportunities across high-value and emerging segments, such as nature and conservation, MICE, culture and heritage, wellness, and adventure tourism
  • Output: a concise gap analysis report for RDB leadership

3. Prioritization Framework & First Pipeline

  • Develop a framework for prioritizing tourism product opportunities based on strategic fit, market demand, investor appetite, feasibility, geographic spread, contribution to length of stay, and alignment with national targets
  • Apply the framework to produce a first prioritized pipeline of opportunities, including new concepts and existing investor leads, and flag enabling requirements such as land, access infrastructure, permits, and incentives

4. Investor-Facing Propositions

  • Develop investor-facing propositions for three to five priority opportunities agreed with RDB, each with a clear concept, market and commercial rationale, and key enabling requirements
  • Format the propositions so that RDB can use them directly in investor engagement and promotion

5. Front-End Investor Assessment Framework

  • Design a framework and scoring tool to assess investor seriousness, strategic fit, product quality, commercial viability, sustainability, and contribution to Rwanda’s tourism objectives
  • Test the framework with the Tourism Office on three to five live or recent proposals and refine it

6. Investor Journey & Decision-Point Guide

  • Develop a guide clarifying roles, responsibilities, handover points, and escalation channels across RDB departments and partner agencies
  • Include standard templates and escalation protocols for tourism investment facilitation

7. Investment Monitoring Tracker

  • Set up a simple tracker to record investor interactions, assessment outcomes, pipeline status, and next steps, and populate it with the current pipeline

8. Handover & Final Report

  • Hold a handover, knowledge transfer session with named RDB counterparts on each deliverable and submit a short final report with recommendations for sustaining the pipeline.


Candidate Profile

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in tourism or hospitality investment, hotel and destination development, transaction or investment advisory, investment promotion, or management consulting with a strong tourism focus
  • Strong understanding of tourism markets and product development, including how demand, product mix, and destination positioning drive length of stay, visitor spend, and investor appetite
  • Demonstrated experience assessing investment proposals or projects, including reviewing feasibility studies, business plans, and financial models, and judging commercial viability and investor credibility
  • Experience identifying, prioritizing, and packaging investment opportunities into pipelines and investor-facing propositions, preferably in tourism, hospitality, real estate, conservation, or destination development
  • A track record of producing practical frameworks, tools, or trackers that government or private sector teams have adopted and used
  • Excellent writing, facilitation, and communication skills, with credibility in front of investors, developers, and senior government officials; experience in Africa, or comparable emerging premium tourism destinations, is highly advantageous

Capabilities and Ways of Working


Agility & Comfort with Ambiguity

  • Brings structure and clarity in complex, fast-moving environments
  • Works independently with minimal supervision and manages own time against agreed deliverables
  • Adapts quickly to shifting priorities while keeping to the agreed scope and timeline

Builds & Broadens

  • Builds strong working relationships quickly across government, investors, and partners
  • Shares knowledge so that counterparts can use the tools independently
  • Brings insight across tourism markets, investment trends, and investor needs

Collaboration, Integrity & Trust

  • Builds credibility with senior stakeholders and investors, and operates with sound judgement
  • Navigates complex stakeholder environments with professionalism and discretion
  • Communicates clearly and influences effectively across levels

Drive & Delivery

  • Maintains a strong focus on tangible outcomes and results
  • Delivers high-quality outputs on time and within the agreed level of effort
  • Demonstrates persistence in overcoming barriers and moving outputs through to approval


What Success Looks Like

  • Clear picture of priority gaps: RDB leadership has endorsed the product mapping and gap analysis
  • Prioritized pipeline in place: RDB has a prioritized pipeline of tourism product opportunities, built on an agreed framework and aligned with NST2 and Rwanda’s premium positioning
  • Investor-ready propositions: Three to five priority opportunities have been developed into investor-facing propositions ready for use in investor engagement
  • Investor assessment and facilitation tools in use: The Tourism Office has a tested investor assessment framework, an agreed investor journey guide, and a populated monitoring tracker
  • Clear ownership after the assignment: Named RDB counterparts own the pipeline, framework, and tracker and are equipped to run them independently

title: Head of Production
description:
Did you know that Sweden's largest shipyard for ship repair and conversion projects is in Landskrona? At Oresund DryDocks, vessels from across Northern Europe and beyond come to us for complex repair, maintenance and conversion projects. With a strong reputation for quality, safety and delivery performance, we are a leading player in the maritime industry.

Our success is built on the expertise and commitment of approximately 110 employees, working across project management, engineering, production and support functions.

We are now looking for a Head of Production to lead and further develop our production organization.

The Role as Head of Production

As Head of Production, you will have overall responsibility for leading, developing and optimizing the production organization through your department managers within Steel, Piping, Mechanical, and Dock & Transport.

You will ensure that the organization has the right resources, competencies, processes and working methods in place to successfully deliver projects according to established targets for safety, quality, cost efficiency and delivery performance.

As a member of the management team, you will play a key role in driving operational excellence and contributing to the company's long-term strategic development. The position requires a visible and engaged leadership style, with a strong presence in the business and close collaboration with employees, customers and stakeholders.

Experience

You have several years of experience in a senior production leadership role within the maritime, shipyard, manufacturing or other project-driven industrial sectors.

You have a proven track record of:

  • Leading managers and larger production organizations through delegated responsibility

  • Driving operational performance and achieving demanding business objectives

  • Developing organizations, processes and working methods to improve efficiency, productivity and delivery precision

  • Building and strengthening a proactive safety culture with a strong focus on HSEQ

  • Managing operations in an international business environment

Experience from project-driven production environments where flexibility, coordination and customer focus are critical is highly valued.

Leadership Profile

You are a confident and inspiring leader who leads by example. Through clear communication and a structured approach, you create engagement, accountability and commitment throughout the organization.

You are results-oriented and combine a strong business mindset with a genuine interest in people development. You can balance strategic thinking with operational execution and are comfortable making decisions in a dynamic environment.

Job Description

Location:

Great Plains Correctional Center/Medical


Basic Purpose:

Positions in this job family are assigned responsibilities related to preparing, classifying and abstracting medical reports in the medical records unit.

Typical Functions:

• Reviews medical records for completeness and accuracy and refers incomplete or inaccurate reports to appropriate staff for correction.

• Prepares statistical, case and other types of reports.

• Prepares materials and forms and gathers all pertinent information and data for admissions and discharges.

• Ensures all data is properly coded.

• Abstracts charts and other patient data in order to respond to requests for information on patients; may make determinations on what materials can legally be released.

• Assists in the development of medical records policies and procedures.

• Reviews existing policies and procedures to ensure they are in compliance with federal and state laws and agency rules, regulations and policies.

• Insures the security and confidentiality of patient medical records.

• May supply requested information to courts and other judicial inquires.

Level Descriptor:

This is the career level where incumbents prepare, classify and abstract medical records, performing assigned duties at the full performance level.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities, and Competencies:

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities required at this level include knowledge of methods and techniques of medical records maintenance; of applicable federal and state laws and agency and facility policies and procedures; of current classification systems; of report writing techniques; and of medical terminology.

Ability is required to maintain medical records; to code data to records; to review medical records for completeness and accuracy; to prepare reports; to abstract information from records and other patient data; to present information effectively; to establish and maintain effective working relationships with others; and to utilize personal computers.

Education and Experience:

Education and Experience requirements at this level consist of eligibility for accreditation with the American Health Information Management Association as a Registered Health Information Technician (RHIT); or two years of experience working with patient records in a medical setting such as a hospital, state institution, medical clinic or a physician’s office.

Special Requirements:

Based upon the duties and responsibilities assigned to the position being filled, a user agency may require accreditation with the American Health Information Management Association as a Registered Health Technician (RHIT); or eligibility for registration as a Registered Health Information Administrator (RHIA).

title: Risk Apprentice - Edinburgh
description:
Please note, this site is only for external candidate applications. If you currently work for Lloyds Banking Group please apply via the internal career site.

Please note: In order to complete an apprenticeship there needs to be a significant learning need. You need to consider your previous qualifications or significant relevant work experience which may mean you cannot proceed with this application.

End Date

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Job Description Summary

Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the programmes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Our apprenticeship programmes may close early if we receive a high number of applications, so it’s best to apply as soon as you can.

If you have any questions, please do contact the team at lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com


Job Description

Duration: 2 years

Salary: £27,400

Location: Edinburgh

Start: September 2027

Qualification – Level 3 Compliance & Risk apprenticeship with Kaplan.

Be our safety net

At Lloyds Banking Group, protecting our 28 million customers isn’t just important. It’s essential. From everyday payments to big business deals, people count on us to keep their money and data safe.

That’s where you come in. As a Risk Apprentice, you’ll learn how to spot problems before they happen, help teams stay on the right side of complex regulations, and keep our bank (and our customers) protected. Think of it as being the safety net for Britain’s biggest digital bank.

Two years. Real risks. Real impact

This two-year apprenticeship combines classroom learning with hands-on experience. You’ll rotate through projects that show you just how wide-ranging risk management can be - from fraud prevention to regulatory compliance.

You’ll cover topics like:

  • Understanding legal and regulatory frameworks (yes, the rules of the game)
  • Presenting complex information clearly (because jargon doesn’t help anyone)
  • Reporting and analysing risk situations
  • How to build evidence-based reports leaders can act on

And you won’t just learn theory. You’ll apply it in real life, every day.

The work you could be doing

  • Helping colleagues apply legal and regulatory frameworks
  • Spotting and reducing potential risks before they grow
  • Writing clear reports that help decision-makers take action
  • Communicating risks in ways that everyone can understand

Your skills toolkit

You’ll master:

  • Risk and compliance basics (the “must-haves” in financial services)
  • Analytical thinking and evidence-based reporting
  • Communication skills that make complex stuff simple
  • How to keep customers, colleagues and the business safe

Support in your corner
We’ll back you all the way with:

  • Blended learning: real projects + tutor-led study
  • Time dedicated to your development
  • A mentor, a manager and a buddy who’ll share their experience
  • A network of colleagues who’ve got your back (and your career)

Your future. Fully funded
We’ll pay your salary and cover the cost of your studies, giving you the opportunity to complete a fully funded level 3 apprenticeship in Compliance & Risk. Alongside this, you’ll build transferable skills that can open doors across the financial services sector, and gain valuable experience at the heart of a bank that supports millions of businesses and customers.

Requirements
What you’ll need


  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old before the end of February 2028
  • 5 Nationals 5s at grades A-C including Maths and English (Achieved)

Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to two years.

Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.

Location

This apprenticeship is based in Edinburgh and you will be expected to work from the local office throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.

About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 15th December 2026.

Our roles generate a lot of interest and occasionally we need to close for applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!

If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days

What happens next?

Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in February → Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: Finance Enterprise Partner (2x)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP)

Roche Diagnostics, Almere


The Opportunity:

At Roche, we advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. As the Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) for Roche Diagnostics Netherlands, you will be a pivotal member of our finance team, serving as a trusted enterprise partner across the entire value chain.


You will have the unique opportunity to leverage your financial expertise and deep business understanding to support our business strategy that delivers value for our customers, the affiliate, and the wider enterprise. By working closely with our commercial organization and customers, you will ensure maximum impact along their journey.


To support our dynamic commercial organization and evolving healthcare customer models, we are seeking versatile finance professionals who can steer business growth, protect margins, and optimize complex contract delivery. Depending on your experience, background, and strengths, there are two role offers with tailored exposure, covering these focus areas:


Role 1: Commercial Deal Partnering: Partnering with customer-facing commercial teams across our different customer areas to deliver competitive pricing, contract structuring, deal review, and indexation models.


Role 2: Contract Performance Monitoring: Driving rigorous operational control across contract life cycles and customer care to protect instrument placement margins, monitor contract performance, and track operational write-offs.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Drive Strategy & Growth: You will be a key partner in developing coherent commercial strategies, prioritising opportunities, and creating innovative approaches for revenue generation.
  • Optimise Resource Allocation: You will balance resources across competing priorities, providing expert advice on the financial implications of business activities to achieve targeted results.
  • Enhance Customer Value: You will monitor customer performance over the contract life cycle, ensuring full value realisation through strategic initiatives and process improvements.
  • Foster Innovation: You will support the co-creation of new business models, quantifying value and providing pricing transparency for our customers.
  • Collaborate Across Networks: You will build strong connections across the organisation to share best practices and implement sustainable commercial deals.

Role 1: Commercial Deal Partnering:

  • Act as a key enterprise partner to the commercial organization in deal calculations and contract negotiations.
  • Formulate P&L insights and outlook projections supporting Network Leads
  • Steer annual contract indexations and act as the Enterprise single-point-of-contact (SPOC) for customer area data insights and analytics.

Role 2: Contract Performance Monitoring

  • Generate actionable financial insights across contract models
  • Conduct deep-dive analysis in direct collaboration with other business areas for end-to-end contract performance monitoring, serving as the catalyst for data-driven analytics to accelerate decision-making.

Who You Are

You are an agile, analytical finance professional who embraces cross-functional collaboration and possesses the ability to zoom in on granular financial details while zooming out to guide enterprise commercial strategy.


  • Educational Background: Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Economics, Controlling, Accounting, or a related quantitative field.
  • Professional Experience: 3+ years of progressive experience in commercial finance, business partnering, financial controlling, or contract cost controlling (preferably within MedTech, Diagnostics, Pharmaceuticals, or complex B2B solutions).
  • Technical & Systems Proficiency: Extensive hands-on experience with SAP ERP, modern reporting / BI tools, and financial modelling. Prior familiarity with pricing configurations, contract modules, or Quote-to-Cash platforms is strongly valued.
  • Analytical & Business Acumen: Proven capability to translate complex operational data, contracts, and cost trends into clear strategic guidance for cross-functional teams.
  • Mindset & Communication: Strong stakeholder engagement and influencing skills, capable of challenging the status quo with empathy and candour across commercial and technical teams.

Why Roche?

For over 125 years, Roche has been working towards a healthier future with one clear goal: "Doing now what patients need next". We believe that the greatest medical challenges can only be solved through intensive collaboration with healthcare professionals and patients.

Our impact goes beyond healthcare; we also take full responsibility for our planet. For instance, since 2025, all our locations have run on 100% sustainable electricity—a major milestone in our ambition to be fully climate neutral (net zero) by 2045. At Roche, you are not just working on the healthcare of tomorrow, but also on a healthy, sustainable world.


What you get from us:

  • A workplace where fun and social impact come together.
  • An organization where your expertise is valued, and you can make autonomous decisions within your team.
  • The chance to work with products that are fundamentally transforming oncological care.
  • Abundant opportunities for personal and professional growth; we invest in your unique path.
  • Diversity and inclusion are at our heart; we invite you to be your authentic self.
  • Travel reimbursement 0,25ct per kilometer.
  • Excellent benefits including a half 13th month, performance-based bonus, 30.5 days of holiday, and participation in our stock program.

Ready to make an impact?

Are you excited about this role and do you recognize yourself in this profile? If you have any questions, please contact our Talent Acquisition Partner, Matthijs van Heusden, at +31 6 41607509 or matthijs.van_heusden@roche.com.


Alternatively, you can apply directly via the "Apply Now" button.


Agency calls or unsolicited outreach regarding our vacancies are not appreciated.


Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Private Banking Executive
description:
Job Description

Purpose

Support and assist Relationship Managers in acquiring, onboarding, servicing and retaining clients to deliver overall business goals, managing complex client situations.

Where required liaise directly with clients regarding complex client requests in respect of various banking and servicing requirements such as onboarding, banking transactions, Investments, credit & digital solutions.

Work closely with Operations and other support functions to deliver positive outcomes for clients.

Accountabilities

  • Establish strong client and internal relationships alongside relationship managers to ensure high quality service is provided at all times

  • Responsible for all aspects of clients servicing and service engagement plans. To include leading client service review visits to support and improve client experience

  • Develop relationships with other areas of the bank; in doing so, they will have joint responsibility with internal colleagues for the end-to-end client experience, ensuring high levels of client satisfaction.

  • Point of contact for all new account queries, complex servicing requests and a liaison between relationship teams and support/specialist teams

  • Ensure legal and regulatory standards and internal policies and procedures are adhered to, support relationship managers with risk related activities

Assistant Vice President Expectations

  • To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.

  • Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes

  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.

  • OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.

  • Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.

  • Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.

  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.

  • Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.

  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.

  • Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.

  • Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.

  • Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Private Banking Executive | Barclays | Dublin

As a Barclays Private Banking Executive, you will play a key role in acquiring, servicing and retaining Private Banking clients, helping to deliver the overall objectives of the business. You will act as a key point of contact for clients, providing high-quality support across day-to-day banking requirements while partnering closely with the Private Banker to deepen client relationships and identify opportunities across the broader product offering.

You will take ownership of client servicing and operational activity, including onboarding, lending, FX, account maintenance and security requirements, ensuring these are delivered accurately and in line with regulatory and risk requirements. You will be expected to exercise sound judgement, manage more complex client requirements and proactively resolve issues while maintaining an exceptional standard of client experience.

You will work closely with Private Bankers, clients and their authorised representatives, internal support and advisory teams including Compliance, Financial Crime and Chief Controls Office, and Senior Management across Private Banking and Business Delivery & Control.

Essential Skills / Qualifications

  • APA or QFA qualified.
  • Strong client-facing experience within Private Banking, Wealth Management or a comparable financial services environment.
  • Strong knowledge of Private Banking products and services, including lending, FX, investments and associated security requirements.
  • Demonstrable experience of client onboarding, Client Due Diligence (CDD), KYC and ongoing client servicing.
  • Strong understanding of risk and control frameworks, regulatory requirements and Private Banking procedures, with the ability to identify, manage and escalate risk appropriately.
  • Up-to-date knowledge of relevant regulatory and legislative requirements, including AML and financial crime controls, and their practical application within a Private Banking environment.
  • Proven ability to take ownership of complex client and operational matters, exercising sound judgement and delivering solutions with a high degree of accuracy.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with clients, Private Bankers and internal control functions.


Desirable Skills / Qualifications

  • Degree qualification or equivalent professional experience.
  • Broader knowledge of investment, fiduciary and wealth management products.
  • Experience supporting high-net-worth and/or international Private Banking clients.
  • Commercial awareness with the ability to identify opportunities to deepen client relationships and support business growth.
  • Proactive, self-motivated approach with strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Collaborative and team-focused approach.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.


This role is based in Dublin.

This role is deemed as a Controlled Function role under the Central Bank of Ireland Fitness and Probity Regulations and may require the role holder to hold mandatory regulatory qualifications or the minimum qualifications to meet internal company benchmarks.

Entry Salary: €62,500.00
Upper Salary: €72,500.00


The entry and upper salary information above includes only annual full-time equivalent base salary and represents the typical range of pay for the role. The actual pay rate will reflect the responsibility level of the role and experience level of the individual. The entry and upper salary information does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.


Barclays employees are also eligible for a suite of competitive country-specific benefits.


This position is eligible for an incentive award.

  • Customize and repair RV in accordance with work orders. Execute work orders.
  • Perform body and paint repair
  • Track all parts and materials used in repairs or replacements
  • Keep supervisor appraised of work progress
  • Ensure that the final work product meets quality standards and is inspected by supervisor or designee
  • Maintain a safe and clean work area for customers and coworkers
  • Follows Safety and Hazardous Waste procedures as outlined
  • Performs other miscellaneous duties as assigned and performs duties at company established performance levels.

What You’ll Need to Have for the Role:

  • Certification from college or technical school in trade field (HVAC, Electrical, Plumbing, Maintenance, etc.) is certainly helpful but, we also consider applicable work experience
  • Minimum of 3-year service technician experience or related fields preferred

  • Experience resolving accounting or reporting problems by identifying causes and implementing practical solutions.

  • Advanced-level experience with SAP.
  • Background in audit or experience supporting audit processes.

title: Lärare i hem- och konsumentkunskap, åldersgrupper 10 - 15
description:
Lärare i hem-och konsumentkunskap Vill du jobba i en internationell miljö med tydlig pedagogisk policy? Vi söker snarast en lärare för undervisning 60-70 % i hem - och konsumentkunskap. Vi är en grundskola med årskurserna F-9 och alla lärare hos oss behöver du vara bekväma att undervisa i åldersgrupperna 6-9. Vi söker en person är en hängiven lagspelare och har ett positivt förhållningssätt till sitt ämne. Någon som är kreativ och villig att göra det lilla extra för sina elever och kollegor. Hos oss arbetar vi för att främja en god lärandemiljö i klassrummet genom ett tydligt ledarskap och med gott samarbete med vårt elevhälsoteam och våra specialpedagoger. För oss är fortlöpande, tydlig feedback till elever och vårdnadshavare ett måste och du ser det som en naturlig del av din undervisning. Vi söker dig som är legitimerad lärare för åk 4-9 med behörighet i hem-och komsumentkunskap och som vill undervisa elever i en internationell arbetsmiljö. Undervisningen och arbetsspråket kan ske på både svenska och engelska. Om jobbet: Arbetsbeskrivningen inkluderar, förutom vanligt förekommande läraruppgifter såsom planering, undervisning, betygsättning och uppföljning, även mentorskap för elever i en av de klasserna du undervisar. Du behöver vara tillgänglig för möten med vårdnadshavare, elever och kollegor samt aktivt arbeta för att upprätthålla IES värdegrund och vision. Hos oss ligger fokus på lärande och på en lugn miljö där skolans rutiner och regler följs av både elever och personal. En trevlig atmosfär och ett gott samarbetsklimat är nyckelord bakom vår framgång. Detta är också grunden för att skapa en röd tråd som vägleder och stöttar våra elever genom deras skolgång och hjälper dem att nå sina mål. Internationella Engelska Skolan Hässleholm är en friskola med 300 elever. Skolan öppnade i 2015. Anställningsvillkor: Tjänsten är på 70% (ferietjänst, tillsvidare) Tjänsten börjar snarast möjligt. För att kunna bli erbjuden tjänsten behöver du ett giltigt utdrag ur belastningsregistret för arbete i skola. Intervjuer sker löpande under ansökningsperioden och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan ansökningsperioden gått ut, så ansök redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att läsa din ansökan. Viktigt! Vi tar inte emot ansökan via e-post! Ansök här på IES Careers: https://apply.engelska.se/

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

title: IS Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions and enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive at every stage of your career. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

Job Description

The IS Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist is responsible for oversees the implementation of security controls and technologies to protect the organization's information assets, including data encryption, access controls, and intrusion detection and prevention systems.

The IS Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist supports the governance, development, maintenance, validation, and ongoing oversight of the Information Security Services (ISS) control environment. The position partners with Control Owners, Business Process Owners, risk partners, technology and cybersecurity teams, auditors, and other stakeholders to help ensure business processes and controls are appropriately designed, accurately documented, effectively maintained, and supported by sufficient evidence.

The IS Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist serves as a subject-matter resource throughout the control lifecycle, assisting stakeholders with the development of new controls and business processes, modification of existing controls, control ownership changes, control documentation, change-management activities, annual attestations, data-quality reviews, audit and regulatory requests, and control validation activities.

The role is expected to exercise independent judgment when evaluating control documentation, proposed changes, supporting evidence, and alignment between documented control requirements and actual execution. The IS Governance Risk & Compliance Specialist also works directly with Control Owners and Process Owners to identify documentation and/or control-environment gaps and facilitate appropriate corrective action.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
  • 2+ years of relevant experience
  • Good understanding of Information Security Governance, Risk and Compliance

Required Skills/Experience:

  • Experience within Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), cybersecurity controls,
  • technology risk, internal controls, or related discipline.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, maintaining, and validating controls and supporting
  • control documentation.
  • Experience evaluating control design, execution, evidence, and alignment between
  • documented requirements and operational practices.
  • Experience with business-process governance and analyzing relationships among
  • processes, risks, controls, systems, and accountable owners.
  • Experience facilitating control walkthroughs, readiness reviews, quality reviews, or similar control-validation activities.
  • Experience supporting internal audit, control testing, quality assurance, regulatory reviews, issue remediation, or corrective-action activities.
  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with demonstrated ability to identify documentation, execution, ownership, data-quality, or control-environment gaps.

Preferred Skills/Experience:

  • Excellent communication, both written and verbal
