title: Penetration Tester
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Cybersecurity Penetration Tester


We advance science so that we all have more time with the people we love. ​



Who We Are


At Roche, we are passionate about transforming patients’ lives through innovation.
We act boldly — because we believe that good business means a better world. Every day, we commit to scientific rigor, unshakable ethics, and broad access to medical breakthroughs. Together, we’re building a better tomorrow, today.

We’re also deeply committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. By bringing together people with a wide range of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills, we create an environment where innovation thrives, creativity flourishes, and everyone belongs.



The Opportunity


We’re looking for a Penetration Tester to join our Product Security & Privacy Organization (PSPO) — a dynamic global team ensuring the resilience and trustworthiness of Roche’s products and digital solutions.


In this hands-on role, you’ll execute vulnerability assessments and penetration testing activities across our physical and cloud-based products under the guidance of senior team members. You’ll collaborate with engineering, product, and architecture teams to strengthen Roche’s cyber defenses and ensure that innovation in diagnostics goes hand in hand with security and patient safety.


Your work will directly influence the security of next-generation healthcare technologies used worldwide.



What You’ll Do


  • Conduct and participate in penetration testing activities across our diverse product portfolio, including digital solutions, cloud applications, and medical devices.
  • Proactively identify and assess vulnerabilities, and collaborate with product teams to prioritize and fix them throughout the product lifecycle.
  • Provide technical support and security knowledge to product teams during the design and development phases to ensure security by design.
  • Collaborate with the team to contribute to, utilize, and help maintain the central repository of testing methods and tools, supporting our goal of reusability across the business.
  • Support the Incident Response team with technical analysis and forensics during security incidents.
  • Execute red team exercises to assess product and solution resilience.
  • Prepare and present clear security reports with risk assessments and actionable recommendations.
  • Contribute to integrating defense and security-by-design principles across product lines.
  • Continuously optimize processes, playbooks, and tools for scalable product security.
  • Leverage AI-assisted security tools and emerging technologies to enhance the efficiency, scope, and coverage of vulnerability assessments.



Who You Are (Required)


You are a technically strong, curious, and impact-driven professional who thrives in complex, fast-moving environments. You enjoy uncovering vulnerabilities and turning insights into stronger, safer products.


Your profile includes:

  • Proven experience (2+ years) leading and executing penetration testing across web applications, APIs, cloud environments, and/or embedded devices; or demonstrated expert-level offensive skills acquired in a highly specialized security domain.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
  • Solid Background in vulnerability assessment and penetration testing.
  • Solid knowledge of common attack vectors, security best practices (e.g., OWASP Top 10), and Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC) methodologies.
  • Experience automating security controls (e.g., shell scripting, Python).
  • In-depth understanding of information security and privacy risks.
  • Experience with incident response and forensics (a plus).
  • Strong ability to communicate complex vulnerabilities, their impact, and required mitigation steps clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem-solving, communication, teamwork, and leadership skills.
  • Proactive, collaborative, and self-driven, focused on continuous learning and sharing knowledge within a diverse global team.
  • Proactive, self-driven, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Relevant industry certifications such as SANS GIAC (GCIH, GPEN, GCIA, GCFA), OSCP, OSEP, CEH, eJPT, CISSP, CISA, CISM, or ISO27001 Lead Auditor are highly valued.
  • Knowledge of or keen interest in emerging AI technologies, including Large Language Models (LLMs) vulnerabilities and the basic concepts of offensive agentic AI.
  • You share Roche’s core values: Customer Empathy, Trust, Ownership, Bias for Action, Curiosity, Optimism, Collaboration, and Data-driven Decision-Making.



Why Join Us?


This is more than a job — it’s an opportunity to shape the future of healthcare technology, strengthen the security of life-saving solutions, and directly protect patient trust.


At Roche, your expertise matters every day. You’ll collaborate with world-class teams, tackle meaningful challenges, and grow in a global environment that values learning, integrity, and innovation.


Together, we make technology safe for better health — everywhere.


🧭 Ready to Secure What’s Next?


Join us and help redefine how security powers trust in healthcare.


👉 Apply now and be part of the team protecting the future of diagnostics.



There is a preferred candidate identified.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Socialsekreterare och socionomer söks för konsultuppdrag i Kalmar län
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet där den gör störst skillnad – med förutsättningar som gör det möjligt att göra ett gott arbete över tid? Benvia Bemanning söker socionomer och socialsekreterare till konsultuppdrag i socialtjänsten i Kalmar län.


Vi söker dig som arbetar inom barn och unga, vuxen och beroende, ekonomiskt bistånd, LSS, familjerätt, familjehemsvård eller biståndshandläggning. Är du redan konsult, eller funderar du på att för första gången pröva konsultrollen efter flera år i kommunal tjänst? Oavsett var du befinner dig vill vi gärna höra från dig.


Hos oss är du inte ett namn i en lista. Vi tar oss tid att lära känna dig, din erfarenhet och vad du söker, och vi hör av oss personligen när vi har ett uppdrag som passar dig. Kan du inte börja direkt? Hör av dig ändå, så pratar vi om vad som passar dig och när.


Om konsultuppdragen


Som socionomkonsult hos Benvia blir du anställd av oss och arbetar på plats hos kommunen under uppdragsperioden. Uppdragen varierar från kortare insatser till längre uppdrag, oftast på heltid och med möjlighet till förlängning. Du arbetar nära kommunens medarbetare och bidrar med stabilitet och kontinuitet i en period då verksamheten behöver förstärkning.


Vi söker dig som har

– Socionomexamen

– Erfarenhet av myndighetsutövning inom socialtjänsten

– Trygghet i yrkesrollen och förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya verksamheter

– Mycket god svenska i tal och skrift


B-körkort är meriterande, eftersom många uppdrag finns utanför de större städerna.


Det här erbjuder Benvia


Vår ambition är att göra konsultrollen hållbar, så att erfarna socionomer kan stanna kvar i yrket och göra det de är bäst på. Därför arbetar vi aktivt med företagskultur, hälsa och nära uppföljning. Som anställd socionomkonsult hos oss erbjuds du bland annat:

– Anställningsvillkor enligt kollektivavtal med Akademikerförbundet SSR

– Tjänstepension och försäkringar enligt kollektivavtalet

– Tydlig information om lön, villkor och uppdragets innehåll innan du tackar ja

– Uppdrag som matchar din erfarenhet och kompetens

– En personlig kontakt före, under och efter uppdraget

– Regelbunden uppföljning av uppdrag och arbetsmiljö

– Tidigt stöd om arbetsbelastningen eller förutsättningarna förändras

– Möjlighet till intern eller extern handledning

– Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling

– Friskvårdsbidrag


Ansökan


Ansök via vår webbplats: https://benvia.se/spontanansokan


Berätta gärna vilka verksamhetsområden och orter som intresserar dig och när du kan börja. Se också våra aktuella uppdrag på https://benvia.se/uppdrag


Vill du hellre börja med ett samtal är du varmt välkommen att kontakta Robert Klawatsch på 031-88 38 18 eller hej@benvia.se. Urval sker löpande.


Om Benvia Bemanning


Benvia Bemanning är specialiserat på socionomkonsulter till socialtjänsten och skolans elevhälsa. Bolaget är grundat av en socionom med femton års erfarenhet av socialt arbete, varav flera år som konsult i kommuner runt om i landet. Vi vet därför hur vardagen i socialtjänsten ser ut, både för kommunens medarbetare och för konsulten som kliver in i ett nytt sammanhang.


Vi vill inte bara fylla vakanser. Vi vill bidra till välfärdsutvecklingen genom erfarna konsulter som skapar värde för verksamheten och gör verklig skillnad för de medborgare som socialtjänsten finns till för – och som arbetar sida vid sida med kommunens egna medarbetare.


Benvia Bemanning – en god väg framåt, med människan i centrum.

description:

Arbetsuppgifter

Vi söker lärarvikarie i matematik och kemi till Torsbergsgymnasiet. Undervisningen sker på våra nationella program (matematik) och IB (matematik och kemi), det senare med engelska som undervisningsspråk. Kvalifikationer

Vi söker främst dig som är legitimerad lärare med behörighet att undervisa i matematik och kemi på gymnasiet, men i och med att tjänsten gäller ett korttidsvikariat kan även du utan behörighet bli aktuell så länge du har tillräckliga ämneskunskaper. Då delar av undervisningen ges på engelska behöver du även ha tillräckliga kunskaper i engelska. Sammantaget lägger vi stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Villkor

Vi kommer att starta upp intervjuer under ansökningstiden så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Alla dina uppgifter sparas på ditt CV-konto och du kan enkelt logga in och uppdatera dina uppgifter när du vill. Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: ENGR TECH III (MATERIALS)
description:
Department

Department of Transportation

Division

Engineering/Planning

Salary

$57,873.00 - $66,296.00

Job Profile

JC-02770802-65 - Engineering Technician III (Materials) (IFPTE Local 400 DOT)

Scheduled Work Days & Work Hours

Job Requisition Number

JR104213 ENGR TECH III (MATERIALS) (Open)

Pay Grade

C00023 A

Classification

Engineering Technician III (Materials)

Class Definition

GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES: To perform moderately complex engineering work in the area of specialization indicated by the title of the class of position; to assist a civil engineer or engineering technician of a higher rank in the supervision of a subordinate staff of engineering technicians in the area of specialization indicated by the title of the class of position; and, to do related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Works under the supervision of a civil engineer or engineering technician of a higher rank, involving the exercise of independent judgment in the application of the basic principles of engineering; work is reviewed in process and upon completion for results obtained.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Assists a superior in the supervision of a staff of subordinate engineering technicians and/or other personnel assigned to assist.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • Under supervision, in the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position:

Construction and Maintenance:

  • On a construction or highway maintenance assignment, to oversee and perform inspections and document all materials and workmanship going into the project; to make daily, weekly, and monthly estimates of work accomplished as required; to submit detailed reports as to progress of work and manner of performance in accordance with current policies and procedures; to submit final estimates for contract items; to assist in and oversee inspections of the workmanship and practices of the contractors and/or state crews engaged in highway construction or maintenance projects; to coordinate appropriate materials tests during the construction or maintenance phase of projects; to check the work of contractors or crews against plans and specifications and to immediately report findings contrary to such plans and specifications; to study and evaluate requests by contractors for changes in plans during construction; to approve minor changes in plans on projects when authority has been delegated, and to submit all other requests for changes in plans to a superior for approval; to assist a superior in the supervision of subordinate engineering technicians’ workmanship, inspections and materials testing activities; or to act as a Construction Resident Engineer on simple to moderately complex construction projects.

Materials:

  • To assist a civil engineer or an engineering technician of higher rank in the supervision of a staff of subordinate Engineering Technicians engaged in materials testing activities; to take and test samples of aggregates, mixes, asphalt, steel and other materials used in highway or bridge construction; to prepare materials test reports; to assist in reviewing the work of Engineering Technicians of lower rank, stationed at materials plants, construction projects and the central laboratory, or to perform such work as assigned; to assist in conducting materials research.

Surveyor-In-Training:

  • As a Surveyor-In-Training, to assist in the coordination and supervision of the work of a field survey party performing comprehensive civil engineering field surveys and related duties for the location, construction and reconstruction of state highways and bridges; and to perform complex technical survey work.

Final Acceptance:

  • To assist in supervising the preparation of contract documents and specifications for engineering, construction, reconstruction and maintenance of state highways and bridges; to assure compliance with all federal and state regulations; to monitor all preliminary engineering contracts, and to assist in the instruction of personnel in construction procedures; to prepare quantity computations and cost estimates for all contracts, and to assist in the updating of the Secondary Road Plan; to review and verify final quantities used in various construction projects in the transportation area, ensuring that all work accomplished is in conformance with state specifications and federal requirements.

Natural Resources:

  • To perform moderately complex engineering functions and to assist in the planning and supervision of technical engineering work related to the development, construction and maintenance of state parks, recreation areas, structures and grounds, and/or stormwater management; to assist an engineer, or an engineering technician of a higher classification, in planning and constructing of roadways, water systems, building and related structures; to assist in the conduct of surveys and in the preparation of surveys and in the preparation of topographical maps and wetlands project evaluations.

Construction Records:

  • To provide technical computer support and perform record keeping tasks within the state’s road and bridge construction program; to render assistance in the resolution of general record keeping problems as they relate to individual projects; to provide computer orientation and training to new employees, and update existing employees on revisions and/or the implementation of new procedures and practices; to monitor problems and recommend possible program corrective actions; to be accountable for ensuring that computerized records are maintained consistent with the Procedures of Uniform Record Keeping (PURK); to maintain both electronic and/or paper based daily engineers’ documentation for work performed by contractors; to consolidate vital specific project data and prepare reports thereon related to item ledger sheets, other project worksheets, materials reports, and time sheets for projects; to input project specific data utilizing approved methods as it relates to the appropriate category; to assist in the preparation of and to enter Reports of Change, contract status, biweekly contractor invoices and progress payment, correspondence updates and other information related to the project; contract agenda, bi-weekly progress payments, correspondence, updates, and other information related to the project; to maintain the approved computerized construction record keeping system throughout all phases of construction activity; to facilitate the final acceptance of the project documentation upon project completion utilizing established practices and procedures.
  • To do related work as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT:

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND CAPACITIES: A working knowledge of, and the ability to apply the basic principles of civil engineering applicable to the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge in the use of current computer software, such as Microsoft Office; a working knowledge of the basic materials, elements or products commonly used in the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge of, and the ability to apply the basic principles of the systems of measurement applicable to the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge of the field equipment, instruments, techniques and procedures applicable to the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; a working knowledge of the procedures, rules, guidelines and standards used in the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position; the ability to read and interpret technical specifications and engineering plans, maps and drawings; the ability to supervise the work of engineering technicians and others engaged in either design and/or construction or maintenance, or materials testing; and related capacities and abilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Graduation from a community college or technical institute, or completion of two years of study in an accredited college including the successful completion of courses in mathematics, construction management, computer-aided drafting, civil engineering technology, and/or structural drafting; and

Experience: At least three (3) years of employment as an engineering technician in a public agency or in private industry which has provided responsible experience in an area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position.

Or, any combination of education and experience that shall be substantially equivalent to the above education and experience.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENTS:

1. Must possess and maintain a valid motor vehicle operator’s license as a condition of employment.

2. Must be physically fit to perform assigned duties as evidenced by a physician’s certificate.

3. At the time of appointment and continually thereafter, employees in the Surveyor-In-Training classification must possess a valid certificate from the R.I. Board of Registration for Land Surveyors.

title: Business Admin (Academic Part Time Intern)
description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

Responsibilities

The Cybersecurity, Enterprise Information and Protective Services Business Administration Section is seeking an Academic Part Time Intern to work with the Business Administration team in supporting a range of administrative functions within three Divisions: Cybersecurity Governance, Engineering and Operations, Enterprise Information Management and Protective Services. These organizations are part of the Lab Operations Directorate, which is dedicated to sustaining JPL’s enterprise operations and infrastructure by continuously improving processes and optimizing our resources.

The Intern will be a member of the Division Business Administration Office and will report directly to the Manager. The selected candidate will gain hands-on experience with many of JPL’s business processes, including asset and facilities management, human resources, workforce planning and forecasting, financial planning and reporting tools and processes, and other ad hoc assignments. Additionally, this intern will help translate business needs into practical, user-focused solutions—leveraging JPL’s collaborative and data platforms to build dashboards, automate workflows, and develop internal tools and sites that enable more efficient and informed decision-making across the portfolio (e.g., Microsoft Teams, Power BI, Power Automate/Power Apps, and SharePoint-based environments).

This internship reinforces a student’s academic foundations in business, data analytics, information systems, and technology through real-world applications while enabling them to build a portfolio of tangible work products such as dashboards, tools, sites, and automated workflows that demonstrate applied learning and can be showcased in future coursework or capstone projects. It strengthens technical proficiency with industry-standard enterprise tools, enhances analytical thinking through projects involving opportunity evaluation, data organization, and decision support, and develops collaboration skills by immersing the student in real business development workflows alongside professionals across multiple teams.

Tasks include but are not limited to:

  • Working alongside team members to understand business development workflows, data needs, and opportunity lifecycle processes
  • Applying classroom knowledge to design and develop dashboards, trackers, and lightweight applications
  • Gaining experience in process improvement by supporting the automation of manual workflows using appropriate tools
  • Learning how to organize and structure data from multiple sources to enable consistent reporting and analysis
  • Assisting in the development of internal team sites or knowledge-sharing platforms to improve information accessibility and usability
  • Collaborate with Business Administration Section team members and Division technical personnel on assigned tasks
  • Provide backup support to the Section business teams during periods of high demand

Qualifications:

  • Must be currently enrolled at least half-time at an accredited college or university pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or a related field
  • Must be available to work 20 hours per week
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite – Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work with and interpret data Demonstrated interest in both business strategy and technical implementation (e.g., coursework, projects, or prior experience) Ability to work in a team environment
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to clearly present ideas, findings, and recommendations
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment
  • Must have a Minimum GPA of 3.0/4.0.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with data analysis, visualization, or dashboard development (e.g., Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools)
  • Familiarity with workflow automation or low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Power Automate, Power Apps, or similar)
  • Experience working with structured and unstructured data (e.g., Excel, databases, or basic scripting such as Python)
  • Interest in business development, strategy, or project/program support within an organization focused on operations
  • Experience preparing presentations, reports, or briefing materials for stakeholders
  • Familiarity with collaboration and content platforms (e.g., Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, or similar environments)

title: Head of PT R&D China Biologics Node
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position Overview

As Head of PTR&D Biologics China, you will serve as a strategic leader and global citizen, establishing Roche's technical development capabilities for biologics in China. This is a highly visible, enterprise-impact role that bridges global portfolio strategy with on-the-ground execution. You will lead the buildout and optimization of PTR&Dbiologics capabilities to support up to 20 early-phase development projects by 2030. Functioning as a local expert and global ambassador, you will champion portfolio-centric thinking and drive operational excellence.You are responsible to impact portfolios using a combination of their technical, business, and biologic drug development expertise in project teams, as well as drive for technical innovation, training and standardization, and development/management of analytics tools supporting the overall PTR&D Biologics/Cell Gene therapy mission.


As a member of the PD China Leadership Team, you will collaborate closely with regulatory, quality, CDMO, and SHE partners to establish integrated, end-to-end CMC strategies that accelerate time-to-clinic while maintaining Roche's quality and innovation standards.



Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Leadership & Strategy

  • Establish Portfolio Strategy & Vision: Partner with global PTDA leadership and China PT stakeholders to define the CMC development strategy for early-phase biologics/CGT projects in China, ensuring alignment with One Pharma Strategy and R&D Excellence objectives.
  • Optimize Portfolio Performance: Design and implement performance management tools and KPIs (e.g., CMC pipeline delivery, project timelines, capability maturity) to track critical milestones, drive productivity, and ensure right-first-time outcomes across the growing portfolio.
  • Enable Executive Decision-Making: Deliver actionable portfolio insights to China PT leadership and global Biologics executives, supporting strategic trade-offs and optimal resource allocation aligned with business priorities.

Team Development & Empowerment

  • Build High-Performing Leadership Team: Recruit, onboard, coach, and develop the Bioprocess Lead, Analytical Development Lead, and Formulation Lead—ensuring each brings both strong technical expertise and demonstrated people leadership capability to run early-phase projects independently.
  • Foster a Culture of Excellence: Create an environment where team members actively influence decisions, take ownership of projects, and grow as strategic thought partners to biologics leadership. Champion professional development through stretch assignments, peer coaching, and clear succession planning.
  • Strengthen Capabilities: Identify capability gaps and drive continuous improvement in project management, CMC governance, risk management, and innovation—leveraging global best practices and tailoring to China's regulatory and operational context.

Global Collaboration & Citizenship

  • Bridge Global and Local: Translate global CMC strategies, governance frameworks, and innovations into actionable China-specific execution plans. Serve as the trusted link between global PTDM initiatives (AI/digital innovation, strategic roadmaps, governance enhancement) and on-the-ground China implementation.
  • Champion Global Initiatives Locally: Actively participate in global PTDM strategy forums and strategic initiatives. Identify opportunities to pilot, adapt, and scale global innovations in China, becoming a thought leader across the enterprise.
  • Integrate with China PT Leadership: Work closely with regulatory, quality, CDMO, and SHE partners to ensure CMC strategies are fully integrated with broader PT China objectives, lifecycle management, and patient value creation.
  • Navigate Matrixed Relationships: Effectively collaborate across global and local functional structures, managing dependencies, fostering transparency, and driving aligned execution despite geographic and organizational complexity.

Operational Excellence

  • Champion Disciplined Execution: Establish and institutionalize rigorous project management disciplines, proactive risk mitigation, and optimal resource utilization to ensure successful project delivery and accelerated speed-to-clinic.
  • Sponsor Strategic Innovation: Lead or sponsor strategic initiatives—such as AI-driven portfolio analytics, digital project management tools, and enhanced CMC governance frameworks—to advance PTD capabilities and decision-making in China.
  • Build for the Future: Develop robust talent pipelines and succession plans to ensure sustained organizational capability and readiness for growth to 15 FTEs by 2030.

Stakeholder Integration

  • Drive Integration: Actively participate as a core member of the PT China Leadership Team (including P&C, regulatory, quality, CDMO, SHE representatives) to co-create integrated solutions and break functional silos.
  • Manage Key Partnerships: Establish and maintain strong relationships with global biologics heads, China PT leadership, gRED/pRED project and lifecycle teams, and external partners (e.g., CDMOs, regulatory consultants).
  • Support Lifecycle Management: Ensure CMC activities are fully integrated with project and lifecycle team strategies, serving as a technical partner in the full drug development lifecycle.


Who You Are

Education & Experience

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in biologic science, engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree (PhD, MS, MBA) strongly preferred.
  • Industry Background: 15+ years in biotech/pharma with 8+ years of direct biologics CMC project leadership and development experience (covering process development, analytical, formulation, or integrated portfolio roles).
  • Leadership: 5+ years leading biologics technical or project management functions with proven ability to establish and scale capabilities across functions and geographies.
  • Global Experience: Demonstrated experience working in or leading teams across multiple geographies with successful track record of bridging global and local contexts.

Core Competencies & Attributes

  • Strategic & Enterprise Mindset
    • Ability to link strategy to operational execution.
    • End-to-end CMC development knowledge.
  • Strategic portfolio and project management expertise with ability to link strategy to operational execution
  • End-to-end CMC development knowledge (from discovery through early clinical development)
  • Strong understanding of drug development, biologics process development, and competitive landscape
  • Experience with portfolio analytics, governance frameworks, and lifecycle management
  • Global Citizen & Cultural Bridge
  • Proven ability to function as both a global expert and local operator—translating enterprise initiatives into local context while driving global excellence standards
  • Cross-cultural competence with ability to navigate complex organizational structures, build trust across geographies, and foster aligned execution
  • Curiosity about diverse perspectives and proven ability to learn and adapt in new markets
  • Language capability: Fluent in English; Mandarin Chinese strongly preferred
  • Leadership & Collaboration
  • Cross-functional leadership capability with demonstrated success navigating matrixed organizations
  • Strong coaching and people development skills; track record of elevating talent and fostering career growth
  • Collaborative mindset with proven ability to build partnerships, foster open dialogue, and break functional silos
  • Transparent, strategic communicator with demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders
  • Analytical & Data-Driven
  • Strong analytical acumen with ability to transform complex data into actionable insights
  • Experience with project management tools, portfolio analytics platforms, and process optimization
  • Disciplined, process-oriented approach to operational excellence and risk management
  • Learning Orientation & Innovation
  • Intentional learner who actively seeks feedback and continuously upgrades expertise
  • Passion for innovation and improvement; comfortable championing new approaches (e.g., agile methodologies, digital tools, AI-driven analytics)
  • Growth-oriented mindset with commitment to developing organizational capabilities
  • Domain Expertise - Biologics
  • Deep understanding of biologics CMC development (e.g., cell culture, purification, analytical characterization, formulation, manufacturing processes)
  • Experience with regulatory requirements for biologics in China and other regulated markets
  • Familiarity with CDMOs, manufacturing partners, and outsourced development models

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Metabolism & Multi-omics Integration)
description:
• IDEA Bio based at the Australian Institute for Bioengineering and Nanotechnology (AIBN)
  • Full-time (100%), fixed-term position for up to 2 years
  • Base salary will be in the range $85,373 - $113,660 + 17% super (Academic Level A)
  • Based at our St Lucia Campus

About This Opportunity

Contribute to a supportive and collaborative research culture and environment where multi-omics data is transformed into practical insights for advanced biomanufacturing. Working within the IDEA Bio LEARN team, as the Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Metabolism & Multi-omics Integration), you will lead the biological interpretation and integration of fermentation, proteomics, metabolomics and ¹³C-labelling data to understand microbial metabolism, identify metabolic bottlenecks and inform rational strain design and bioprocess optimisation. You will collaborate with systems biologists, software engineers, fermentation scientists and analytical chemists, combining rigorous research with a strong service focus and the opportunity to help develop analytical capability with real-world impact.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Research: Integrate proteomics, metabolomics, fermentation and metabolic modelling data to interpret phenotypes, identify metabolic bottlenecks and regulatory changes, develop testable hypotheses, and translate findings into rational strain design and bioprocess optimisation strategies; Contribute to genome-scale metabolic model curation and ¹³C metabolic flux analysis, develop innovative analytical workflows, produce quality research outputs and contribute to competitive research funding opportunities.
  • Supervision and Researcher Development: Contribute to the effective supervision and development of Honours and Higher Degree by Research students, as appropriate, through constructive feedback, coaching and collaborative research practice.

  • Citizenship and Service: Deliver rigorous phenotypic and metabolic analyses and reports for research and industry clients, contribute to IDEA Bio's service activities and strengthen partnerships across research, government, industry and the wider community; Demonstrate leadership through mentoring, perform administrative functions, provide support to colleagues, and uphold university values.

This is a research focused position. Further information can be found by viewing UQ’s Criteria for Academic Performance.

For further details and full position description, please click here to view the information booklet.

About You

  • Completion or near completion of a PhD in biochemistry, metabolic engineering, systems biology or a related field, with a strong focus on microbial metabolism.
  • Demonstrated experience integrating at least two omics data types, such as proteomics and metabolomics, to develop mechanistic explanations of metabolic phenotypes beyond enrichment-based analysis.
  • An in-depth understanding of microbial metabolism, including central carbon metabolism, energy and redox balancing, and metabolic regulation, with the ability to reason about cause and effect within metabolic networks.
  • Sound knowledge of statistical analysis of omics data, including differential abundance testing, multiple-testing correction, replication, batch effects and experimental design.
  • Familiarity with constraint-based metabolic modelling, such as flux balance analysis, with the capability to interpret, critique and refine model predictions using experimental data.
  • Demonstrated research capability evidenced by peer-reviewed publications, together with proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and visualisation.
  • Strong organisational, problem-solving, interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team while independently developing solutions to complex analytical challenges.
  • Experience in fermentation, metabolic engineering, metabolomics, multivariate analysis, stable-isotope labelling, ¹³C metabolic flux analysis, genome-scale model curation, or enzyme-constrained or kinetic models will be highly regarded.

About UQ

As part of the UQ community, you will have the opportunity to work alongside the brightest minds, who have joined us from all over the world, and within an environment where interdisciplinary collaborations are encouraged. As part of our commitment to excellence in research and professional practice in academic contexts, we are proud to provide our staff with access to world-class facilities and equipment, grant writing support, greater research funding opportunities, and other forms of staff support and development.

The greater benefits of joining the UQ community are broad: from being part of a Group of Eight university, to recognition of prior service with other Australian universities, up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave, 17.5% annual leave loading, flexible working arrangements, access to exclusive internal-only vacancies, and genuine career progression opportunities via the academic promotions process.


Interested?

For more information about this opportunity, please contact Dr Timothy McCubbin, Senior Data Scientist and Team Leader, at t.mccubbin@uq.edu.au.

For application inquiries, please reach out to the Talent Acquisition team at talent@uq.edu.au, stating the job reference number (below) in the subject line.

When you apply, please ensure you upload a resume, cover letter, and responses to the ‘About You’ section. Please note that applications received via email will not be accepted.

Other Information

Pre-employment checks may include: verification of the right to work in Australia, qualifications, mandatory immunisations. This may also include checks relating to gender-based violence matters or other integrity and conduct requirements.

Relocating from interstate or overseas? We may support you with obtaining employer-sponsored work rights and a relocation support package, however upfront costs will still be expected to be covered. You can find out more about life in Australia’s Sunshine State here.

Lomma kommun erbjuder kustnära livskvalitet med närhet till Malmö och Lund. Vi värnar om invånarna, miljön och havet. Lomma kommun står för utveckling, hållbarhet och hög kvalitet.

Vi befinner oss mitt i Öresundsregionen och har goda kommunikationsmöjligheter med buss, tåg och cykelvägar till närliggande orter.

Bjärred erbjuder en attraktiv och trygg livsmiljö mitt i Öresundsregionen. Här vill människor leva, verka och utvecklas. Vi värnar om invånarna, miljön och havet. Bjärred och Lomma kommun står för utveckling och hög kvalitet. I Bjärred arbetar vi med en värdegrund som utgår från orden öppenhet, respekt och ansvar. Vår värdegrund ger uttryck för ett synsätt som guidar våra medarbetare i vardagen. Engagerade medarbetare driver utvecklingen framåt och gör Lomma kommun till en arbetsgivare som stimulerar glädje och engagemang. Välkommen att arbeta tillsammans med oss! Hemtjänstens verksamheter är fördelad på enheterna Centrum och Omkretsen i Bjärred. Hemtjänsten ansvarar för vård och omsorg till vårdtagare som bor i eget hem. Du utgår från hemtjänstens lokaler och tar dig runt till största del med cykel och ibland med bil.

3 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vill du ha världens viktigaste jobb i en kommun med närhet till vackra stränder och hav?

Just nu söker vi dig som är undersköterska, vårdbiträde eller på väg att bli! 
Vi söker också dig som är nyfiken på att arbeta inom vårdande yrke och har erfarenhet från andra yrken där man är van att arbeta med service och att möta människor. Arbetet handlar i stort om att skapa trygghet. Inom hemtjänsten arbetar du med personliga omvårdnadsinsatser, medicinska arbetsuppgifter, dokumentation och uppföljning. 
Vissa praktiska serviceinsatser kan också förekomma.

Det finns möjlighet till både timanställning och månadsanställning. Om du är utbildad till undersköterska finns möjlighet till tillsvidareanställning. Tillsammans gör vi skillnad!

KVALIFIKATIONER
Tycker du om att arbeta med människor och speciellt äldre människor? Har du lätt att förstå och bry dig om andra? Är du van och tycker om att arbeta tillsammans med andra? Är du uppmärksam på hur andra mår? Är du bra på att kommunicera och lyssna in andra och bemöta människor på ett trevligt sätt? Är du noggrann? 
Då är du den vi söker!

Det är meriterande om du har utbildning eller erfarenhet inom vården, men vi söker även dig med annan utbildning eller erfarenhet. Det är också en fördel om du är van vid att arbeta med digitala arbetsverktyg. Inom hemtjänsten kommer du främst att förflytta dig med hjälp av cykel, på vissa enheter krävs det även körkort. För att arbeta hos oss, behöver du ha fyllt 18 år. Det är även av stor vikt att du har en god förmåga att uttrycka dig i svenska språket, såväl skriftligt som muntligt.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Ange gärna dina referenser i din ansökan.

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.

Det du kan göra redan nu för att skynda på processen är att beställa ett utdrag från belastningsregistret: https://polisen.se/tjanster-tillstand/belastningsregistret/kontrollera-dina-uppgifter-i-belastningsregistret/

Beställ det utdraget som heter Utdrag för arbete i hemmet med äldre eller personer med funktionsnedsättning. Utdraget får inte var äldre än 6 månader.

I Lomma kommun har du tillgång till förmåner enligt vårt kollektivavtal. Förutom försäkring erbjuder vi dig även till exempel friskvårdsbidrag och förmånscykel.

Om du har skyddade personuppgifter och vill söka ett arbete hos Lomma kommun hänvisar vi dig till vår hemsida under lediga jobb. Där erbjuder vi dig olika alternativ att välja bland för att lämna in din jobbansökan.

Vi undanber oss alla kontakter med annonssäljare, rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag.

Vill du veta mer om Lomma kommun är du välkommen att besöka lomma.se

title: Undersköterska till specialiserad palliativ sjukvård Kungsholmen
description:
Vill du arbeta nära patienten och bidra till trygghet, värdighet och livskvalitet?Vi söker nu undersköterskor för vikariat eller timanställning till vårt team inom specialiserad palliativ slutenvård (SPSV) på Kungsholmen.

Stockholms Sjukhem är en av Sveriges största idéburna vårdgivare. Vi arbetar för att erbjuda personcentrerad vård av hög kvalitet, där patientens behov, önskemål och livssituation står i centrum.

Hos oss vårdar vi vuxna patienter med komplexa sjukdomstillstånd. Inom specialiserad palliativ vård fokuserar vi på att lindra symtom, främja livskvalitet och skapa trygghet för patienter och närstående. Vården utgår från varje människas behov och önskemål, med målet att ge bästa möjliga livskvalitet.

Din roll som undersköterska:

Som undersköterska arbetar du patientnära med omvårdnad och ett personcentrerat bemötande. Du uppmärksammar förändringar i patientens tillstånd och bidrar till trygghet för både patienter och närstående. Arbetet kan även innefatta medicintekniska moment utifrån individuell delegering, exempelvis provtagning och sårbehandling.

Du arbetar i ett tvärprofessionellt team där samarbete, kommunikation och självständighet är viktiga delar av vardagen. Vi dokumenterar i journalsystemet Take Care.

Hos oss får du

  • En individuellt anpassad introduktion.
  • Ett engagerat och kompetent team där vi hjälps åt och lär av varandra.
  • En inkluderande arbetsplats med fokus på gott bemötande och god arbetsmiljö.
  • Möjlighet till kompetensutveckling genom interna och externa utbildningar.
  • Närvarande chefer som värnar om medarbetarnas delaktighet och utveckling.
  • Ett meningsfullt arbete där du får göra skillnad.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska med skyddad yrkestitel, trygg i din yrkesroll och har ett genuint intresse för personcentrerad vård. Du är ansvarstagande, lyhörd och har lätt för att samarbeta. Erfarenhet av palliativ vård eller annan avancerad vård är meriterande.

Vill du vara en del av ett team som arbetar för att ge patienter trygghet, lindring och god livskvalitet? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig.Välkommen till Stockholms Sjukhem – där kunskap, engagemang och omsorg gör skillnad.

Mer information och ansökan

Tjänsten är ett längre vikariat eller timanställning. Lön och tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Urvalet hanteras löpande.

Vi arbetar för en trygg och säker hälso- och sjukvård. Därför genomför vi bakgrundskontroller som en del i vår rekryteringsprocess och innan anställning. Kontrollerna kan variera beroende på roll. På vår informationssida kan du läsa mer om vilka kontroller som ingår.

Stockholms Sjukhem arbetar med kompetensbaserad rekrytering som syftar till att se till varje persons kompetens för att främja att vi är en arbetsplats för alla. i har tagit ställning till annonsering, vilket gör att vi inte önskar säljsamtal för ytterligare frågor kring annonsering, rekrytering eller bemanning.

Stockholms Sjukhem är en av Sveriges största idéburna vårdgivare. Vi erbjuder ett brett vårdutbud inom palliativ vård, äldreomsorg, rehabilitering, och geriatrik. Att bedriva sjukvård och äldreomsorg är ett stort samhällsansvar och som godkänd universitetssjukvårdsenhet arbetar vi ständigt med forskning, utveckling och utbildning. Hos oss arbetar du i en varm miljö som värdesätter det personliga bemötandet och kännetecknas av värdeorden engagemang, kunskap och omtanke.

title: Sr Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.


Meet the team:

Quality is more than monitoring calls. Our team uses insights from customer interactions to help improve processes, strengthen agent skills, and create better customer experiences. From introducing new hires to Quality expectations to identifying process, behavior, and skill gaps, we partner across teams to turn what we learn into opportunities for continuous improvement.

Where you come in:

  • You conduct call monitoring and quality audits to assess adherence to established quality standards, processes, and customer experience expectations.
  • You analyze quality results and generate actionable performance insights to identify trends, recurring opportunities, and areas requiring focused improvement.
  • You identify process, behavior, and skill gaps and recommend solutions to improve quality performance and customer experience.
  • You collaborate with Operations and other key stakeholders to develop targeted action plans addressing identified quality opportunities.
  • You support the development and implementation of Corrective and Preventive Actions (CAPA) to address quality gaps and help prevent recurrence.
  • You participate in calibration sessions, identify opportunities based on calibration outcomes, and help drive consistent interpretation and application of QA standards.
  • You review, audit, and manage disputes related to quality audit results to support scoring accuracy, consistency, and alignment with established QA guidelines.
  • You evaluate, improve, and implement QA processes to strengthen quality practices, address identified gaps, and support continuous improvement.

What makes you successful:

  • You have strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to interpret quality results, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable insights.
  • You demonstrate strong attention to detail and sound judgment, enabling you to accurately evaluate customer interactions and consistently apply established QA standards.
  • You have strong root-cause analysis and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify process, behavior, and skill gaps and recommend practical solutions.
  • You communicate clearly and effectively, both verbally and in writing, and can explain quality findings, opportunities, and recommendations to different audiences.
  • You collaborate effectively across teams, particularly with Operations, Training, and other stakeholders, to develop targeted actions and drive quality improvements.
  • You can interpret and apply QA guidelines consistently, including participating in calibrations, reviewing audit results, and objectively managing quality disputes.
  • You are skilled in data analysis and reporting, with the ability to organize quality data, identify meaningful performance patterns, and present insights that support decision-making.
  • You demonstrate a continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to evaluate existing QA processes, recommend enhancements, and support the implementation of new or improved quality practices.
  • Nice to Have: Lean Six Sigma, COPC or ISO-related certification or training/experience.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 0-5%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 5 – 8 years of related experience.

Class Definition

GENERAL STATEMENT OF DUTIES: To perform difficult technical or supervisory work in professional civil engineering in the area of specialization indicated by the title in the class of position; and to do related work as required.

SUPERVISION RECEIVED: Works under the general supervision of a superior from whom are received general directions which afford the opportunity for the use of independent judgement and making of technical decisions of moderate difficulty; work is reviewed through the examination of reports, through conferences and by inspections.

SUPERVISION EXERCISED: Plans, assigns, supervises and reviews the work of professional, subprofessional, labor and clerical employees.

ILLUSTRATIVE EXAMPLES OF WORK PERFORMED:

  • In the area of specialization indicated by the title in the class of position:
  • To supervise the contract construction of roads or bridges, related highway projects in reviewing plans, specifications and designs submitted by the contractor, architect or engineer and make recommendations thereon; in the field: to be responsible for interpreting provisions of contracts, plans, specifications and designs; to assure that construction work schedules are maintained and to supervise the continuous inspection of workmanship, materials and methods; to be responsible for the technical supervision of a staff engaged in the operation and maintenance of state bridges; or, to assist an engineer of higher rank in the administrative and technical supervision of all activities of the state road construction or maintenance program; to assist in inspecting all state-maintained highways and to estimate the amount of maintenance necessary on each road; to assist in planning, organizing, coordinating and supervising the work program of the construction or maintenance section, and to assist in enforcing contract plans and specifications of contract or maintenance.
  • To lay out, oversee and check the work of subordinate engineers performing moderately complex civil engineering work in the design of all types of bridges, grade crossing structures and approaches; and to design difficult and important major structures of advanced design; or, to layout, oversee and check the work of subordinate engineers performing moderately complex civil engineering work in the design of all types of roads and road structures; and to design and make improvements to major roads and related structures of advanced design; or, to perform professional engineering work involved in traffic control program; to plan, supervise and review the work of a crew engaged in traffic sign painting and installation, pavement striping and traffic signal light installation and maintenance; and to prepare reports relating to the failure of traffic devices.
  • To plan, supervise and review the testing, inspection and approval or rejection of all materials used in highway construction and maintenance; to prepare materials specifications; and to originate and supervise materials research projects; to initiate and supervise the development of new methods and techniques in soils and foundations engineering and their application to highway work; and to perform the field and laboratory work related to soil sampling and analysis.
  • For proposed new or existing highways, to prepare, preliminary geometric designs, charts and graphs and preliminary reports on speed, no passing zones, parking, traffic signs, accidents, one-way streets, merging and through routes and related matters; and to conduct traffic movement studies, road improvement studies, road improvement priorities and related matters.
  • To be responsible for the supervision of the engineering activities relating to the development and protection of the state’s natural resources; to supervise contract construction at the state's parks, beaches, and other conservation areas involving such construction as dams, sewers, small buildings, secondary roads, breakwaters, piers, docks, fish ladders, historical restorations and erosion prevention; to be responsible for the preparation of cost estimates, specifications and plans; to coordinate and review plans and specifications prepared by subordinates and/or contractors; and to be responsible for enforcing contract plans and specifications for natural resource projects.
  • To review architectural and engineering plans related to the electrical, structural or mechanical field of engineering to insure compliance and conformance to the building code.
  • To do related work as required.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS FOR APPOINTMENT:

KNOWLEDGES, SKILLS AND CAPACITIES: A thorough knowledge of the principles and practices of the area of specialization indicated in the title of the class of position and the ability to apply such principles and practices; considerable skill in the use of all standard surveying and other engineering instruments and in making all algebraic and trigonometric computations applied to highway, bridge or airport design or construction operations, or building construction projects; the ability to read and interpret all types of civil engineering plans and specifications and obtain compliance by the contractor in all details, as well as to approve or reject all proposed minor changes therein; the ability to plan, assign, supervise and review the work of a group of professional, sub-professional, labor and clerical employees; the ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with contractors, supervisors, and subordinates; and related capacities and abilities.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

Education: Such as may have been gained through: graduation from a college of recognized standing with specialization in Civil Engineering; and

Experience: Such as may have been gained through: employment at the level of Senior Civil Engineer in a public agency or in private industry in the area of specialization indicated in the title of this class of position.

Or, any combination of education and experience that shall be substantially equivalent to the above education and experience.

SPECIAL REQUIREMENT: At the time of appointment must possess, at least, an Engineer-in-Training certificate of registration issued by the Rhode Island State Board of Registration for Professional Engineers and must maintain such registration as a condition of employment.

description:
Please note, this site is only for external candidate applications. If you currently work for Lloyds Banking Group please apply via the internal career site.

Please note: In order to complete an apprenticeship there needs to be a significant learning need. You need to consider your previous qualifications or significant relevant work experience which may mean you cannot proceed with this application.

End Date

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Job Description Summary

.Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the programmes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Our apprenticeship programmes may close early if we receive a high number of applications, so it’s best to apply as soon as you can.

If you have any questions, please do contact the team at lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com


Job Description

Duration: 2 years

Salary: £32,000

Location: London

Start: September 2027

Qualification: Level 3 Compliance & Risk apprenticeship with Kaplan.


Be our safety net
At Lloyds Banking Group, protecting our 28 million customers isn’t just important. It’s essential. From everyday payments to big business deals, people count on us to keep their money and data safe.


That’s where you come in. As a Risk Apprentice, you’ll learn how to spot problems before they happen, help teams stay on the right side of complex regulations, and keep our bank (and our customers) protected. Think of it as being the safety net for Britain’s biggest digital bank.


Two years. Real risks. Real impact
This two-year apprenticeship combines classroom learning with hands-on experience. You’ll rotate through projects that show you just how wide-ranging risk management can be - from fraud prevention to regulatory compliance.


You’ll cover topics like:

  • Understanding legal and regulatory frameworks (yes, the rules of the game)
  • Presenting complex information clearly (because jargon doesn’t help anyone)
  • Reporting and analysing risk situations
  • How to build evidence-based reports leaders can act on

And you won’t just learn theory. You’ll apply it in real life, every day


The work you could be doing

  • Helping colleagues apply legal and regulatory frameworks
  • Spotting and reducing potential risks before they grow
  • Writing clear reports that help decision-makers take action
  • Communicating risks in ways that everyone can understand

Your skills toolkit

You’ll master:

  • Risk and compliance basics (the “must-haves” in financial services).
  • Analytical thinking and evidence-based reporting
  • Communication skills that make complex stuff simple
  • How to keep customers, colleagues and the business safe

Support in your corner
We’ll back you all the way with:

  • Blended learning: real projects + tutor-led study
  • Time dedicated to your development
  • A mentor, a manager and a buddy who’ll share their experience
  • A network of colleagues who’ve got your back (and your career)

Your future. Fully funded
We’ll pay your salary and cover the cost of your studies, giving you the opportunity to complete a fully funded level 3 apprenticeship in Compliance & Risk. Alongside this, you’ll build transferable skills that can open doors across the financial services sector, and gain valuable experience at the heart of a bank that supports millions of businesses and customers.


Requirements
What you’ll need


  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old on 1st September 2027
  • 5 GCSEs at grade 4 – 9 including Maths and English (Achieved)

Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to two years.


Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.


Location

This apprenticeship is based in London and you will be expected to work from the local office throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.


About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.


We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 24th November 2026.


Our roles generate a lot of interest and occasionally we need to close for applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!


If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days.

What happens next?

Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in January → Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: mRNA Analytical Development Senior Scientist
description:
Job title: mRNA Analytical Development Senior Scientist

  • Location: Waltham, MA



About the job

In order to strengthen the Biochemical and Biophysical group in R&D Analytical Sciences Department, Sanofi Pasteur is looking for a skilled and highly motivated individual to develop novel methods and improve characterization of mRNA vaccines in development by working closely with the bioprocess development group.

Analytical Sciences Department has the overall responsibility to develop, qualify and validate robust analytical methods to support release and characterization testing of mRNA Drug Substances and Drug Products candidates in development.

Join the team protecting half a billion lives every year with next-gen science, mRNA innovation, and AI-driven breakthroughs. In Vaccines, you’ll help advance prevention on a global scale - and shape the future of immunization.​


About Sanofi:


We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world and are supported and enhanced through our diverse portfolio of medical device and diagnostic products. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.


Main Responsibilities:


  • Develop advanced technology for biochemical, biophysical, and bioassay assay development in support of mRNA vaccine process and product development, product release, stability, and comparability study.
  • Work with analytical leads supporting CMC activities.
  • Write and review method documentation and characterization reports in support of regulatory filings.
  • Ensure timely completion of assignments and deliverables. Independently design and execute complex experiments. Author method development and investigation reports.
  • Manage assay testing at CROs if required, support investigation, deviation, and change control.
  • Participate internal non-GMP and GMP lab set up and product release and stability testing.
  • Supervise and train junior scientists.
  • Compliant to Sanofi Quality standards and HSE policy. Participate in continuous improvement of laboratory safety and quality compliance.

About you

Basic Qualifications

  • PhD or Master's Degree in Biochemistry, Biology, Cell Biology, Analytical Chemistry, Biotechnology or related sciences.
  • Ph.D. with a minimum of 3 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, or a Master's degree with a minimum of 6 years of experience in the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.
  • Previous CMC analytical development experience.
  • Expertise in LC (RP, IEX, SEC, HILIC) and one or more of the following techniques but not limited to CGE, spectroscopy, particle analysis.
  • Ability to perform complex method development and propose appropriate method improvement suitable for CMC space.

Preferred

  • Knowledge of nucleic acid/oligonucleotides chemistry and standard analytical methods of these molecules.
  • LC-MS experience.
  • Hands on experience in quality control laboratory environment is a plus.


Why choose us?


  • Bring the miracles of science to life alongside a supportive, future-focused team.
  • Discover endless opportunities to grow your talent and drive your career, whether it’s through a promotion or lateral move, at home or internationally.
  • Enjoy a thoughtful, well-crafted rewards package that recognizes your contribution and amplifies your impact.
  • Take good care of yourself and your family, with a wide range of health and wellbeing benefits including high-quality healthcare, prevention and wellness programs and at least 14 weeks’ gender-neutral parental leave.
  • Be part of a pioneering biopharma company that engages patients early in drug development and uses their insights to design studies that reflect real-world needs.
  • Help improve the lives of millions of people globally by making drug development quicker and more effective.
  • Work at the forefront of drug discovery, harnessing cutting-edge AI, data, and digital platforms to push the boundaries of science.

title: Program Director
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Program Director

About your role:

This role suits a seasoned programme delivery leader (15–20+ years' experience) who can own the client relationship at executive level, shape programme direction where clarity is lacking, and drive teams toward outcomes in complex multi-stakeholder environments. The ideal candidate will combine deep payments domain expertise with a forward-thinking approach to AI-enabled delivery — leveraging automation, agentic AI, and data-driven decision-making to transform programme execution.


What you’ll do:

Strategic Client Leadership

  • Own and develop the client relationship at executive level — acting as a trusted strategic partner, not just a delivery manager.
  • Lead governance forums, steering committees, and executive reviews with authority and credibility.
  • Anticipate client needs, proactively shape engagement strategy, and identify opportunities to deepen the relationship and expand scope.
  • Navigate complex client politics and competing priorities, building consensus and driving alignment at senior levels.
  • Use AI-supported insights to strengthen client communications, forecasting, and strategic decision-making.
  • Manage escalations with composure and judgement, maintaining trust even under pressure.

Programme Delivery & Governance

  • Lead multiple concurrent BAU, change, and transformation programmes with varied scope and complexity — taking full accountability for outcomes.
  • Own the full delivery lifecycle from initiation through closure, with particular expertise in large-scale card issuing data migration programmes.
  • Drive migration strategy, rehearsals, cutovers, and rollback planning with rigour and attention to operational risk.
  • Operate confidently in ambiguous environments — structuring unclear programmes, making decisions with incomplete information, and adapting approach as understanding evolves.
  • Drive adoption of AI-enabled delivery approaches including automated status reporting, predictive risk and dependency analysis, and data-driven capacity planning.
  • Ensure all deliveries meet Fiserv quality standards, contractual commitments, and regulatory obligations.

Team Leadership & Capability Building

  • Build, lead, and motivate cross-functional delivery teams — setting clear expectations and fostering a culture of ownership and accountability.
  • Mentor and develop project managers and delivery leads within the team.
  • Champion consistent use of automation and AI tooling across delivery teams to reduce manual effort and improve quality.
  • Lead by example in adopting modern delivery practices and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Orchestrate delivery across global, onshore, and offshore teams — ensuring alignment and removing blockers at pace.
  • Coordinate effectively across Product, Technology, Architecture, Operations, Compliance, and Integration functions.
  • Work with payment schemes (Visa, Mastercard), third-party vendors, and regulators where required.
  • Drive cross-programme dependency management and resource optimisation across the portfolio.

Risk, Issue & Change Management

  • Proactively identify and manage delivery, regulatory, operational, and migration-specific risks — with strong judgement on escalation vs resolution.
  • Apply AI-assisted risk identification and trend analysis to stay ahead of emerging issues.
  • Manage scope changes, CRs, and client expectations through robust governance and clear communication.
  • Ensure compliance with Fiserv standards and regional regulatory frameworks (CBUAE, SAMA, etc.).

Financial & Commercial Accountability

  • Own programme P&L — tracking budgets, resource utilisation, margin, and commercial exposure.
  • Use automation and AI-driven analysis to improve forecasting accuracy and cost transparency.
  • Lead SOW development, effort estimation, and contract negotiations.
  • Partner with sales and commercial teams to identify growth opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Manage commercial risk and ensure programmes remain within agreed financial parameters.

Experience you’ll need to have:

  • 15–20+ years of experience in programme or project management within payments, card processing, or financial services technology.
  • Deep expertise in payments processing, particularly credit card issuing and platform migrations.
  • Proven leadership of large-scale, multi-stream data migration programmes in the card issuing domain, including card portfolios, customer/account data, transaction and balance migration, cutover planning, parallel runs, and post-migration stabilisation.
  • Extensive experience managing enterprise clients at C-suite and VP level, with a consultative, trusted-adviser approach.
  • Strong delivery track record in credit card issuing and large-scale data migration programmes — multiple successful migrations delivered.
  • Practical experience using AI and automation to streamline delivery, governance, and reporting — beyond assistive tooling into embedded and agentic AI.
  • Strong understanding of card issuing platforms (VisionPLUS / FirstVision), data flows, and migration risks.
  • PMP, PRINCE2 Practitioner, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience across multiple card processing platforms (FirstVision, CMS, TSYS, Cortex).
  • Knowledge of ISO 8583 messaging, card scheme certification, and service-based integrations.
  • Prior experience in management consultancy or professional services delivery.
  • Experience managing programmes with budgets exceeding $5M.
  • Familiarity with portfolio management and PMO leadership.

Thank you for considering employment with Fiserv. Please:

  • Apply using your legal name
  • Complete the step-by-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).

Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
