Any communications from a Fiserv representative will come from a legitimate Fiserv email address.

title: Mechanical Systems Engineer IV
description:
Job Details

New ideas are all around us, but only a few will change the world. That’s our focus at JPL. We ask the biggest questions, then search the universe for answers—literally. We build upon ideas that have guided generations, then share our discoveries to inspire generations to come. Your mission—your opportunity—is to seek out the answers that bring us one step closer. If you’re driven to discover, create, and inspire something that lasts a lifetime and beyond, you’re ready for JPL.

Located in Pasadena, California, JPL has a campus-like environment situated on 177 acres in the foothills of the San Gabriel Mountains and offers a work environment unlike any other: we inspire passion, foster innovation, build collaboration, and reward excellence.

This senior-level opportunity is part of the Mechanical and Control Systems Division (35), which creates advanced mechanical, robotics, thermal, propulsion, onboard GNC, and electronic packaging systems. Division 35 develops hardware and systems from early architecture through design, fabrication, subsystem and system-level integration, and test.


You will be working as a Mechanical Systems Engineer within the Mechanical Engineering, Integration, and Test Section (352), which leads the design, analysis, development, integration, and test of flight mechanical and robotic systems for spacecraft, payloads, and ground-based systems. In this role, you will:

  • Lead mechanical hardware development and mechanical systems engineering activities for payloads, instruments, and spacecraft across all mission phases including proposal, concept/system architecture development, detailed design, integration and test (I&T), and flight operations.
  • Approve requirements, interfaces, verification and validation (V&V) plans, and key engineering products to ensure technical integrity and mission success.
  • Lead and guide the generation and maintenance of engineering documentation, design artifacts, and technical data packages.
  • Direct complex trade studies, oversee development of highly complex technical models, and drive major technical decisions with significant mission and organizational impact.
  • Lead the definition, documentation, and management of technical requirements, interfaces, and mechanical systems engineering products for spaceflight missions.
  • Ensure delivered products meet all technical requirements and programmatic commitments by exercising broad judgment and authority over technical direction.
  • Advise and contribute significantly to cost and schedule estimation and implementation planning of mechanical engineering components.
  • Present technical work to line, project, and management audiences, representing system status and major decisions.
  • Provide mentorship, coaching, technical guidance, and oversight for engineers, designers, analysts, and cross-disciplinary team members.
  • Work independently with wide latitude while forming and leading multidisciplinary teams to address high-impact technical challenges.

Note: As a temporary position, this assignment may last up to 36 months in duration with approvals based on 6 to 12-month assignments. However, please note that you are not under any employment contract and your temporary employment status can be terminated at any time, with or without notice.


Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related technical discipline with typically a minimum of 9 years of related experience; Master’s degree with a minimum of 7 years of related experience; or PhD with a minimum of years of related experience.
  • Extensive experience with research, development, design, analysis, assembly, integration, test, or verification of mechanical systems for spaceflight or similarly complex environments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate mission-level needs into system architectures, technical requirements, and implementation strategies.
  • Experience exercising technical authority, approving engineering products, and leading critical reviews.
  • Proven ability to plan tasks, lead projects, manage schedules, and deliver on commitments in complex multi-organizational environments.
  • Candidate must be a U.S. Citizen with an active Top Secret (TS) clearance based upon Single Scope Background Investigation (SSBI) within a 5-year scope and must be able to be approved for Sensitive Compartmented Information (SCI) accesses.

Desired Skills

  • Experience leading development and delivery of spaceflight hardware or other complex mechanical systems.
  • Demonstrated success defining and approving requirements, interfaces, V&V plans, and risk mitigation strategies at subsystem or system levels.
  • Expertise in CAD modeling tools (NX, SolidWorks, Teamcenter) and advanced analysis methods (classical and FEA).
  • Deep knowledge of GD&T per ASME Y14.5.
  • Strong ability to innovate, solve unprecedented engineering challenges, and lead multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to present complex information to management, partners, and external organizations.
  • Experience representing organizations in technical reviews and coordinating across multiple teams and partners.
  • Aerospace fabrication processes, specifically composite structures
  • Aerospace material selection and implementation, specifically composite structures
  • Experience with Mass Properties
  • Engineering CAD (Computer-Aided Design)
  • Understanding of JPL, NASA, and Aerospace Corporation policies and procedures
  • Experience JAMA
  • Experience with Opto-Mechanical Hardware Design, Implementation, and Test

This includes a variety of health, dental, vision, wellbeing, and retirement plans, paid time off, learning, rideshare, childcare, flexible schedule, parental leave and many more. description:

Position: Senior Leasing Law Clerk

About Us:

Pet Valu is Canada’s leading pet specialty retailer, dedicated to strengthening the bond between dedicated pet lovers and their pets. With 50 years of animal care expertise, we operate over 800 stores across Canada under several banners, including Pet Valu, Bosley’s, Total Pet, Paulmac's Pet, Tisol & Chico. Guided by our mission to deliver products, care, expertise, and memorable moments, Pet Valu is a place where people build meaningful careers while making a positive impact on pets and communities.

Our employees are the key to our success! As a growing organization, our employees apply their creativity and innovative ideas as they take ownership of their projects and growth. We pride ourselves in providing an open environment by managing with approachability and providing support to allow for career development.


Job Summary:

The Senior Leasing Law Clerk is responsible for managing Pet Valu’s high-volume lease renewal portfolio. This role involves overseeing lease renewals, negotiating lease extensions, preparing and presenting proposals, and assisting with various leasing transactions. The Senior Leasing Law Clerk collaborates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with business objectives and compliance with legal requirements.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review, negotiate, draft and finalize a broad range of commercial leasing documents, including leases, offers to lease, letters of intent, amending and extension agreements, surrender agreements, estoppels, easements, restrictive covenants, licence agreements and related documentation.
  • Manage lease renewal transactions, including tracking key dates, preparing renewal and extension documentation, negotiating fair market rent and other business terms with landlords, and coordinating timely execution.
  • Prepare and present leasing proposals and supporting materials to an internal real estate review committee and other stakeholders for approval.
  • Liaise and negotiate directly with landlords, brokers and other external parties, and collaborate with internal business partners to advance leasing transactions and achieve business objectives.
  • Review and interpret leases and related agreements, and provide practical guidance to business partners regarding lease rights, obligations and other leasing matters.
  • Assist with landlord and tenant disputes, including reviewing applicable lease provisions and drafting related correspondence.
  • Assist with other real estate transactions, projects and initiatives as required.
  • Other duties as assigned from time to time by the Vice President, Legal.
  • undefined This position is often privy to confidential and sensitive information and, as such, requires diplomacy, discretion, and a high level of professionalism.


Qualifications:

  • College Law Clerk diploma or equivalent legal training.
  • 5–7 years of experience as a leasing clerk in a reputable company or law firm, with a focus on commercial leasing.
  • Tenant-side leasing experience in retail sector is considered a strong asset.
  • High level of proficiency in Microsoft Office programs including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Familiarity with lease administration systems such as CoStar is an asset.


Additional Skills:

  • Excellent drafting, analytical, and negotiation skills.
  • Strong understanding of commercial leasing principles and documentation.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex lease provisions and business issues clearly and practically.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to identify practical and creative solutions to legal and business issues.
  • Self-motivated and able to work both independently and collaboratively.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to interact effectively with all levels of the organization and external stakeholders.

The targeted salary for this position is $110,000 annually. The final offer will be based on factors such as market location, relevant skills, experience and internal equity.

Ready to join the team?

We’re looking for passionate people who bring strong skills and live our core values of safety, compassion, expertise, and efficiency every day. If you’re energized by doing meaningful work, taking pride in what you deliver, and making a real impact for pets, people, and communities, you’ll feel right at home here. Join us and build a career where purpose, care, and excellence come together - because love lives here™.

title: Thailändsk talande försäljare sökes till asiatisk livsmedelsgrossist
description:

title: Systems Administration
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Your role

Experienced UNIX Infrastructure Engineer with extensive expertise in HP-UX administration, Serviceguard clustering, OS patching, performance tuning, storage management, and production support. Proven track record of managing critical incidents, implementing complex infrastructure changes, conducting root cause analysis, and maintaining high availability of enterprise systems. Skilled in automation, shell scripting, change management, and cross-functional collaboration within large-scale enterprise environments.



What you will do

The HP-UX Tier 3 Engineer is responsible for providing advanced technical support, administration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization of HP-UX servers in enterprise environments. The role involves handling complex incidents, implementing infrastructure changes, ensuring system availability, and supporting critical business applications running on HP-UX platforms.


Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.



Key Responsibilities


HP-UX Administration

  • Administer and maintain HP-UX servers in production, UAT, and DR environments.
  • Perform OS installation, configuration, patching, upgrades, and migrations.
  • Manage HP Integrity servers, Serviceguard clusters, and virtualized environments.
  • Monitor system health, capacity, and performance.

Incident & Problem Management

  • Provide Tier 3 support for critical and complex HP-UX issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring incidents.
  • Support Sev1/Sev2 incidents and participate in on-call rotations.
  • Coordinate with application, storage, network, and database teams for issue resolution.

Change & Release Management

  • Plan and implement OS patches, firmware upgrades, and infrastructure changes.
  • Execute maintenance activities during scheduled change windows.
  • Prepare implementation plans, backout plans, and post-change validation reports.
  • Ensure compliance with ITIL change management processes.

Performance & Capacity Management

  • Analyze CPU, memory, disk, filesystem, and network performance.
  • Tune HP-UX kernel parameters and optimize system performance.
  • Monitor system utilization and recommend capacity enhancements.

Storage & Backup Administration

  • Manage LVM/VxVM, disk provisioning, and filesystem administration.
  • Perform storage expansion and SAN connectivity troubleshooting.
  • Support backup and recovery solutions.

High Availability & Disaster Recovery

  • Administer HP Serviceguard clusters.
  • Participate in DR drills and failover testing activities.
  • Ensure business continuity and high system availability.

Security & Compliance

  • Implement security hardening and vulnerability remediation.
  • Manage user accounts, permissions, and sudo access.
  • Support audit and compliance requirements.

Automation & Documentation

  • Develop shell scripts for routine operational tasks.
  • Automate health checks, reporting, and monitoring activities.
  • Create and maintain SOPs, build documents, and technical knowledge articles.



Required Technical Skills


Operating Systems

  • HP-UX 11i v2 / v3
  • UNIX administration concepts

Core Technologies

  • HP Serviceguard Clustering
  • LVM, VxVM
  • NFS, AutoFS
  • SAN Storage Administration
  • Ignite-UX
  • OA (Onboard Administrator)
  • HP Integrated Lights-Out (iLO)

Scripting

  • Shell Scripting (Korn Shell, Bash)
  • Perl/Python (preferred)

Monitoring Tools

  • OpenView Operations
  • Nagios
  • Splunk
  • SiteScope

ITSM Tools

  • ServiceNow
  • Remedy
  • BMC



Preferred Qualifications

  • 8+ years of working experience in System Administration
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, or related field.
  • HP-UX Administration certification (preferred).
  • ITIL Foundation certification.
  • SuperDOM experience is must
  • Experience in enterprise data center environments.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical applications.

Key Competencies

  • Advanced UNIX troubleshooting skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience handling production-critical incidents.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to work independently and lead technical troubleshooting efforts.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Design Standard Lead
description:
At JBT Marel, what we do matters, we know that the contribution of our employees leads to the success of our business.



Our purpose is to transform the future of food; this guides our vision of being the global leader in food and beverage technology, by harnessing the full power of JBT Marel to partner with our customers and pioneer sustainable innovation.



Our values show who we are at our best. As we Create with Collaboration, Serve with Integrity, Grow with Excellence, and Advance with Innovation.


You will report to the Innovation Excellence Director and work closely with central innovation teams, divisions, category management, product owners, engineering communities, and Supply Chain.


Opportunity

At JBT Marel, we are seeking a visionary Design Standards Lead to define and drive our global design standards strategy across the organization. This role is responsible for establishing the governance, frameworks, and collaborative ways of working that transform design standards from technical requirements into strategic business enablers. By creating alignment across products, platforms, and solutions, the Design Standards Lead will help reduce complexity, improve scalability, enhance the customer experience, and strengthen JBT Marel's position as a leading full-line solutions provider.

Success in this role requires building strong cross-functional partnerships and leading a global community of stakeholders across Innovation, Product Management, Supply Chain, Service, Software, Engineering, and other key functions. The scope spans hardware, mechanical and electrical design, automation, software platforms, human-machine interfaces, user experience, and customer-facing product solutions. The Design Standards Lead will drive consistency where it delivers value while ensuring strategic differentiation remains a competitive advantage where appropriate.


Responsibilities:

  • Build and govern the direction for category management, where technical direction, preferred solutions and design boundaries are set in collaboration with Innovation and Supply Chain. Alignment should be a conscious choice, not a default assumption.
  • Act as a key collaborator across divisions to align design standards with broader innovation roadmaps, platform strategies, modularization principles and integrated solution offerings.
  • Champion design clarity as a strategic enabler by establishing transparent guidelines that help teams understand when to align for a cohesive cross-portfolio experience, and when differentiation serves the customer or product better.

Main tasks

  • Own, develop and maintain the global design standards framework for JBT Marel.
  • Define and facilitate the governance model for design standards, including roles, responsibilities, decision rights, review cadence, ownership and approval processes.
  • Drive alignment across divisions on common design principles, platforms, modules, interfaces and technical direction.
  • Establish clear guidelines for when standardization is required, when harmonization is beneficial and when differentiation is justified.
  • Collaborate closely with Innovation and Supply Chain to set direction and boundaries for category management, preferred components and platform principles.
  • Align design standards with product roadmaps, innovation priorities, modularization strategies and full-line solution development.
  • Facilitate cross-functional design standard forums, key user groups, expert communities and regular alignment meetings throughout the year.
  • Build and strengthen a global design standards community across Innovation and supply chain.
  • Ensure relevant standards cover hardware, electrical architecture, automation, software platforms, user interfaces, hygienic design, safety, serviceability, manufacturability, sustainability, and compliance.
  • Identify areas where lack of standardization creates unnecessary cost, risk, complexity, inefficiency or inconsistent customer experience.
  • Support the development of common design libraries, templates, guidelines and decision tools.
  • Create a clear process for maintaining, updating, communicating and retiring design standards.
  • Support integration between legacy JBT and legacy Marel ways of working by identifying best practices and scaling them where relevant.
  • Provide recommendations to leadership on design standard priorities, risks, gaps and opportunities.
  • Track progress of design standards initiatives and secure momentum across functions and divisions.

Skills and Abilities

  • Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect technical standards to business value.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence across functions, divisions and professional disciplines without relying only on formal authority.
  • Strong understanding of product development, engineering processes, platform thinking, modularization and portfolio complexity.
  • Ability to balance standardization and flexibility pragmatically.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Structured, persistent and capable of driving progress in a global matrix organization.
  • Comfortable working with both technical detail and executive-level direction.
  • Strong sense of customer value, usability, operational impact and lifecycle thinking.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to create trust, shared ownership and an active community around design standards.

Education, Knowledge and Experience

  • A relevant university degree, preferably at Master's level, within engineering, industrial engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, product development, innovation management or a related field.
  • Minimum five years of experience in product development, engineering, design standards, platform development, product architecture, modularization, category management or a related technical or strategic role.
  • Experience from equipment manufacturing, food processing machinery, industrial automation or another complex B2B manufacturing environment is an advantage.
  • Experience working across hardware, electrical, automation, software or user interface domains is an advantage.
  • Strong understanding of how design standards influence product complexity, supply chain efficiency, serviceability, compliance, manufacturability and customer experience.
  • Experience working in a global, multi-site and multi-cultural organization.
  • Proven ability to partner effectively with a wide variety of stakeholder groups in a corporate context.
  • Knowledge of compliance, safety, hygienic design, sustainability or regulatory requirements in machinery design is an advantage.
  • Excellent English skills, both written and verbal.

Why join JBT Marel?


Travel & Location

  • This position is fully onsite at Boxmeer Netherlands, and we ask that you travel approximately 25% of the time.

title: Produktutvecklare inom mjukvara till Mycronic Pattern Generator
description:
Mycronic är ett globalt högteknologiskt företag som i över 50 år har varit med och drivit elektronikindustrin framåt. Vi fortsätter att växa och stötta kunder inom allt fler branscher och det vi gör formar teknologier som präglar framtidens samhälle, hur vi lever våra liv idag – och imorgon. Nu söker vi fler som vill vara med och stärka våra engagerade och drivna team, som befinner sig i teknikens framkant. Hos oss arbetar du i en öppen, flexibel och samarbetande miljö där du får jobba nära ledande experter och ta dig an utmanande projekt som gör idéer till verklighet och får morgondagens elektronik att komma till liv.

Om tjänsten

Mycronic fortsätter att växa inom ett växande utbud av branscher. Divisionen Pattern Generator (PG) som du kommer att tillhöra i denna roll, har idag en unik position på marknaden som världens främsta leverantör av laser-baserade maskritare för tillverkning av fotomasker, vilka i sin tur används vid tillverkning av högupplösta skärmar och mikroprocessorer. Alla skärmar med hög upplösning producerad i större volymer som du ser, oavsett om det är TV, mobil, surfplatta, Apple Watch etc. så är Mycronic:s maskiner en kritisk del av tillverkningsprocessen.

I rollen tillhör du ett större team om 18 personer som ansvarar för den mjukvara och databehandling som gör det möjligt för maskinerna att utföra sitt arbete. Teamet arbetar med allt från applikationer och datakonvertering till operativsystem, datorhårdvara och interna nätverk. En central del är att förbereda och bearbeta stora datamängder med höga krav på prestanda och tillförlitlighet. Här får du en bred förståelse för hur mjukvara och hårdvara samverkar i ett komplext system. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – nyfikenhet, vilja att lära och förmåga att samarbeta med andra kompetenser är minst lika viktigt.

Arbetsuppgifter

I rollen som produktutvecklare får du kombinera nyutveckling med problemlösning och förbättring av befintliga system. Du arbetar främst med utveckling i Java och får vara med och vidareutveckla befintliga funktioner, modernisera system och lösa tekniska utmaningar som uppstår i en avancerad produktmiljö. Arbetet omfattar även felsökning av problem som rapporteras från kunder, testning på fysiska testsystem och optimering av kod där prestanda är avgörande.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

  • Utveckla och vidareutveckla produktmjukvara, främst i Java.
  • Implementera nya funktioner och bidra till att modernisera befintliga lösningar utan att äventyra kompatibiliteten med äldre produktversioner.
  • Skriva tester och verifiera funktionalitet på fysiska testsystem i olika dator- och systemkonfigurationer.
  • Hantera kundsupport-ärenden med analys och felsökning
  • Utveckla programvara för användarinteraktion och generera körbara program för systemet.
  • Samarbeta med kollegor inom olika teknikområden för att förstå problem, hitta lösningar och säkerställa att förändringar fungerar i hela systemet.
  • Bidra med idéer och förbättringsförslag i en kontinuerlig produktutvecklingsprocess där kundfeedback och teknisk utveckling driver arbetet framåt.

Vi söker dig som

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen är du nyfiken och vill förstå hur tekniken fungerar som helhet. Du tar initiativ, arbetar självständigt och tar ansvar för dina uppgifter hela vägen från analys till färdig lösning. Samtidigt är du en lagspelare som gärna delar med dig av din kunskap och samarbetar med andra för att nå bästa möjliga resultat. Du har också förmåga att anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras och trivs i ett högt utvecklingstempo.

Vi ser att du har:

  • En högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom exempelvis datateknik, elektronik, mekatronik eller liknande.
  • Minst några års erfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling där du arbetat med produkter innehållande både hård- och mjukvara.
  • Goda kunskaper i Java eller erfarenhet av ett annat objektorienterat programmeringsspråk, exempelvis C++.
  • Erfarenhet av utveckling i Linuxmiljö.
  • Mycket goda kunskaper i engelska, såväl i tal som skrift.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenhet av utveckling av användargränssnitt, gärna med ramverk såsom React eller liknande.
  • Kunskap om agila arbetsmetoder.

Övrig information

  • Start: Enligt överenskommelse
  • Placering: Täby
  • Omfattning: Heltid
  • Kontaktuppgifter: Ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Johanna Sörell, johanna.sorell@academicwork.se
  • Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och Mycronic´s önskan är att alla frågor kring tjänsten går till Academic Work.

Vår rekryteringsprocess

  • Personlighet- och problemlösningstest
  • Telefonintervju med Academic Work
  • Djupintervju med Academic Work
  • Intervjuer med Mycronic
  • Referenstagning + beslut

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Networking Software
description:
​​Job Summary:

We are looking for an experienced embedded software leader to help build the next generation of high-performance cellular routers and gateways. In this role, you will architect and deliver reliable, secure, and scalable embedded solutions across Linux and embedded platforms, integrating advanced 4G/5G, Wi-Fi, and Bluetooth technologies. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless hardware-software integration and world-class product quality. This is a unique opportunity to drive innovation in wireless connectivity and shape the future of mission-critical networking solutions.

​The ideal candidate brings deep C/C++ expertise and is a domain expert in at least two of the following areas:

  • ​Routing software and router feature development (e.g., OpenWRT)

  • ​Cellular software stack (4G/5G/NB-IoT, modem integration)

  • ​Wi-Fi software stack and protocol implementation

  • ​Linux platform engineering (Yocto, OpenWRT build systems)

  • ​Embedded network security (VPNs, secure boot, CVEs).​

Responsibilities:

  • ​​Architect and develop complex embedded software systems for cellular routers, with a focus on security, reliability, performance, and scalability (30%).

  • ​Lead the design and integration of wireless (4G/5G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth) and wired connectivity features across Linux-based systems (25%).

  • ​Collaborate with cross-functional teams including hardware, QA, and product to drive system-level solutions and resolve technical challenges (20%).

  • ​Mentor junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to technical reviews, design decisions, and continuous team improvement (15%).

  • ​Drive innovation by researching and integrating modern embedded technologies, development practices, and performance optimizations (10%). ​​

Minimum Qualifications:

  • ​​Bachelor's or Master's in Computer Science, Electronics, or a related field.

  • ​12+ years of experience in embedded systems software development.

  • ​Strong proficiency in C++ with good understanding of Linux-based software distributions.

  • ​Hands-on expertise in at least two of the following domains:

  • ​Routing software and router feature development (e.g., OpenWRT)

  • ​​Cellular software stack (4G/5G/NB-IoT, modem integration, SIM/eSIM)

  • ​Wi-Fi software stack and protocol layers & protocol implementation

  • ​Linux platform engineering (Yocto, OpenWRT build systems)

  • ​Embedded network security (VPNs, secure boot, CVEs)

  • ​Hands-on experience with modem integration and embedded networking stacks.

  • ​Proven ability to lead complex technical efforts across product cycles.

​​

Desired Qualifications

​​Strong candidates will typically bring depth in 2 or more of the areas below:

  • ​Expertise in cellular technologies (5G/4G/NB-IoT), modem interfacing, and SIM/eSIM management.

  • ​Expertise in Wi-Fi technologies.

  • ​Experience architecting router features using OpenWRT or equivalent platforms.

  • ​Proficiency with Linux Yocto build systems.

  • ​Solid understanding of network security (VPNs, secure boot, encryption).

  • ​Experience with security patches and CVEs.

  • ​Demonstrated impact in technical strategy, performance tuning, and cross-functional collaboration.

  • ​Track record of mentorship and peer development within engineering teams.

  • ​Patents/Publications in the related area.

title: Senior Technical Program Manager
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Technical Program Manager

Overview
The Mastercard Authentication Program powers consumer authentication experiences across e-commerce and in-store payment ecosystems. As part of this mission, the engineering team ensures our authentication platforms remain highly available, performant, scalable, resilient, and operationally efficient while supporting rapid product innovation and growth.
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to drive reliability-focused programs across our authentication products. This role sits at the intersection of Engineering, SRE, Product, Business Operations, and Platform teams and is responsible for leading strategic initiatives that improve platform health, operational maturity, release excellence, and customer experience. The ideal candidate combines deep technical program management expertise with strong understanding of cloud-scale distributed systems, operational excellence, resiliency engineering, performance management, capacity planning, and large-scale release coordination.

If you are passionate about building highly reliable systems that power billions of secure transactions globally, this role is for you.


Responsibilities:
• Facilitate and oversee team Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and release planning.
• Coordinate resource planning and capacity allocation across the SRE and engineering team to balance operational commitments, incident response, technical debt reduction, and strategic initiatives.
• Drive backlog prioritization and dependency management across multiple Scrum teams to ensure delivery commitments are met.
• Own end-to-end release governance across the broader authentication program. Identify opportunities to improve release processes, planning accuracy, dependency management, and overall delivery efficiency across teams.
• Understand the needs of the engineers and teams who have to build, maintain, and operate the system.
• Identify dependencies, remove execution blockers, and ensure alignment across stakeholders.
• Drive strategic programs focused on improving platform availability, resiliency, reliability, and operational maturity.
• Partner with SRE and Engineering teams to identify reliability risks and develop mitigation strategies.
• Establish structured review mechanisms for reliability, resiliency, performance, scalability, and operational readiness.
• Champion engineering best practices including observability, automation, self-healing, disaster recovery, and operational excellence.
• Coordinate major releases, platform upgrades, migrations, and production rollouts involving multiple engineering teams.
• Manage release risks, dependencies, issue resolution, rollback planning, and stakeholder communication.
• Drive automation initiatives that improve reliability and reduce operational overhead.
• Influence technical and business stakeholders without direct authority.
• Foster a culture of continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.


Experience
• Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, microservices, APIs, and modern platform engineering practices.
• Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
• Experience driving capacity planning, performance engineering, disaster recovery, and operational readiness initiatives.
• Proven experience managing large cross-functional release programs across multiple teams.
• Enjoys diving deep to understand of the platforms capabilities and underlying technologies.
• Proven track record of data driven decision-making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams.
• Can debate the delivery strategy with business teams, architects, engineers, and designers

title: Senior AI Engineer
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior AI Engineer

The Capabilities and Data team within Mastercard Services builds the foundational infrastructure that powers hundreds of customer-facing products. Some of the strongest and most useful capabilities are proprietary large language model ensembles that power the fundamental data operations of our analytics and insights solutions. In this role, you will develop and scale shared AI capabilities that support products and teams across Mastercard.

Our LLM-based entity resolution system is already in production, supporting multiple teams across Mastercard. We are now expanding it into an enterprise-level capability and need your help to improve its scalability, performance, and cost efficiency while making it easier to adopt and integrate across products.

We are looking for a hands-on AI engineer who combines strong software engineering skills with experience bringing AI solutions into production. You should be comfortable tackling open-ended technical challenges, evaluating alternative approaches, and working independently. Working with platform, product, and operations teams, you will take solutions from design through deployment and ongoing operation.


Roles & Responsibilities:

Design and own the architecture for deploying and operating AI capabilities at scale, including APIs and MCP servers that enable integration with products, agents, and applications.

Develop high-performance Python backend services for LLM inference orchestration, async job handling, streaming responses, and distributed data workflows supporting high-throughput operations.

Establish robust LLMOps and MLOps pipelines on Databricks (AWS) using MLflow, feature stores, prompt evaluation frameworks, model lineage tracking, and continuous retraining workflows to ensure reliable AI delivery.

Apply traditional ML and statistical modeling (regression, clustering, forecasting, ensemble methods) in hybrid architectures alongside LLMs for interpretable, explainability-first decision systems.

Translate R&D outcomes into scalable, reliable production solutions, collaborating with researchers to integrate and validate new models and techniques while optimizing inference latency, throughput, and cost without compromising output quality.

Continuously research, evaluate, and productionize advancements in generative modeling, agentic AI, multimodal transformers, and frontier foundation models

Lead solutions through security and architecture reviews, production approvals, and deployment.

Collaborate with platform, product, and consumer teams to support integration, adoption, and engineering standards.


All About You:

Master's or Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or Engineering, with significant hands-on experience leading and delivering complex Gen AI or ML engineering programs in production environments.

Expert-level, hands-on experience designing, building, and deploying LLM applications, agentic systems, and RAG pipelines — from prototype to production.

Experience building MCP servers, or equivalent depth in building and exposing tool interfaces for LLM and agent consumption, with a clear grasp of how an agent actually consumes what you publish.

Deep proficiency with LLM ecosystems: OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Hugging Face, and open-source foundation models (LLaMA, Mistral, Falcon, etc.).

Strong command of Gen AI engineering patterns: prompt engineering, chain-of-thought reasoning, tool/function calling, vector embeddings, semantic search, and agent memory architectures.

Excellent Python engineering skills including async programming, API development and building inference-ready microservices; SQL proficiency required.

Hands-on experience with cloud AI infrastructure (Databricks, AWS SageMaker, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or GCP Vertex AI) and familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps tooling (MLflow, Weights & Biases, etc.).

Readiness to work inside enterprise production implementation procedures such as security and architecture reviews, change management, and controlled pipeline promotion, and to treat those gates as part of the engineering work.

A genuine experimentation habit, meaning you can take an open-ended goal, design a fair test, run it, read the result honestly even when it contradicts what you expected, and decide what to do next.

Ability to work independently on open-ended problems, defining clear approaches and driving solutions through to completion.

Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain a cost or architecture trade-off to engineers and to non-technical stakeholders in the same conversation.

Experience with tools such as Git, Jira, Visual Studio Code, Github Copilot.

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

Key responsibilities include:

Develop, deploy, and optimize machine learning models for fraud detection, risk scoring, anomaly detection, and related security applications.

Build scalable AI and ML pipelines supporting model training, validation, deployment, monitoring, and retraining.

Design and implement Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), reasoning and planning workflows, Chain-of-Thought-style prompting techniques, tool/function calling, LLM-based modular systems, and multi-agent orchestration.

Contribute to the design of reusable AI platforms, libraries, and engineering frameworks that accelerate AI development across teams.

Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify opportunities to apply them to fraud prevention and security challenges.

Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities with a passion for solving complex real-world challenges.
