Reporting to Chief Administrative Officer or designee, the Director of CHMG Hospital Based Practices is accountable for the operational performance of assigned provider groups, including Adult Hospitalists, Emergency Medicine, Pediatric Hospitalists, and Palliative Care. The Director partners with appropriate provider leaders within the dyad structure to achieve performance goals. Collaborates with other hospital and health system leaders to support optimal patient flow throughout the system, with particular attention on access, throughput, quality of care, and patient experience.


Education and Experience:

Bachelors Degree and a minimum of 10 years of related experience or Masters degree and minimum of 5 years of related experience.


Other qualifications:

  • Experience in nursing, hospital, or practice operations, including schedule management, registration, use of electronic medical record, patient flow, billing and referrals and authorizations. Experience with Lean and/or Operational Excellence preferred.
  • Computer proficiency, including knowledge of Word, Excel and in-depth knowledge of electronic medical record and/or billing software applications.
  • Excellent written and oral communications skills necessary. Must have superb interpersonal skills and be able to handle difficult conversations effectively. Demonstrate ability to listen well and gain consensus.
  • Experience in planning and execution.
  • Knowledge of negotiations and change management.
  • Must have excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills. Able to express opinions openly and honestly and provide feedback in a timely and productive manner. Ability to examine and re-engineer operations and procedures.
  • Strong budget, financial and statistical analysis skills and ability to interpret information to staff and providers.
  • Demonstrates flexibility to accommodate changes in workload assignments and react calmly and effectively in stressful situations.
  • Ability to work within the defined values, mission and vision of the organization.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

Clinical Managerial Operations: Advance clinical and operational efficiencies without compromising quality or patient safety.

  • Leads strategic planning to improve access, flow, and care delivery.
  • Partners effectively with nursing leadership, care management, hospital operations leadership and provider leadership to ensure optimal patient flow and throughput within and across our facilities.
  • Leads short and long term planning including facility, physician manpower, operating and financial performance.
  • Responsible for accountability of assigned CHMG practice operations & staff performance.
  • Partner with providers and administrators to define clinical metrics, develop processes to monitor routinely, and develop action plans to meet targeted performance goals.
  • In partnership with physician leaders, oversee the business and clinical operations for assigned provider groups, and/or specialties/sub-specialties.
  • Continually create opportunities to improve processes that support system-wide workflows and standardized operations.
  • Ensure adherence to CHMG and Concord Hospital policies and procedures.
  • Participate in hospital-based quality improvement projects by collaborating with physician leaders, nursing leaders, and ancillary department leaders to improve flow, delivery, patient experience, and quality.
  • Aspire to attain high levels of service rendered to patients, providers and staffs, by proactively addressing concerns through meaningful conversations, reviewing performance expectations, and conducting appropriate interventions.
  • Promote patient centered care, including shared ownership for patient outcomes and satisfaction.
  • Provide necessary support for successful implementation and on-going EMR adoption.
  • Accountable for compliance with regulatory agencies and third parties, including Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services, DNV, Occupational Safety & Health Administration, ACGME (Accreditation Council for Graduate Medical Education) and insurance companies.

Financial Management: Maintain a fiscally sustainable operation by performing to or exceeding budget.

  • Participates in the development of operational and capital budget, capital approval process, and budget targets.
  • Investigates and develops action plans to mitigate variances.
  • Initiate operational improvements.
  • Ensures revenue targets are achieved, including both visit volumes and Work Relative Value Units, by monitoring, analyzing and resolving potential issues that may impede reaching the goals.
  • Monitors expenses to remain within budget, taking steps to reduce expenditures through effective expense management techniques.
  • Develop action plans and communicates practice performance with providers and staff on a monthly basis.
  • Collaborates with leadership regarding revenue cycle management. functions. Ensures accurate and timely billing functions are handled within the practice.

Human Resources: Sustain a work environment that attracts providers and employees to CH as the health system of choice.

  • Ensure optimal professional standards. Directly supervises and establishes clear accountabilities for assigned managers.
  • Performs evaluation process for subordinate staff; compiles information for human resource department in a timely manner. Ensures that subordinate staff maintains necessary competency level and coordinates training activity for practice managers in assigned division. Provides on-going feedback to staff of performance throughout the year.
  • Counsels subordinate staff in disciplinary matters and obtain assistance from human resources appropriately for disciplinary actions and/or employee termination process.
  • Recruits, interviews and hires personnel, including providers, as necessary.
  • Participates in provider hiring, firing and contract negotiations; participates in provider benchmark development & analytics, including productivity, quality metrics & compensation; establishes staffing ratios.
  • Assists with the development of employment agreements and other practice contracts. Presents contracts to internal committees for approval, as necessary.
  • Coaches and mentors all levels of CHMG staff, and holds managers accountable for staff development.

title: Floor Manager - (Service Coach) - West London
location: Westfield White City, Shepherds Bush, London
description:
In our NIKE Retail Stores we use special job names for our positions: a Store Manager is called "Head Coach", an Assistant Store Manager is called "Assistant Head Coach", a department manager is called "Coach", a team leader is called “Lead“ and a Sales Associates is called "Athlete".


As a Coach you are:

  • Using your expertise in the field of exceptional consumer service to serve and deliver a premium brand experience to our consumers
  • Leading, coaching and motivating the employees in your department and ensuring an excellent work atmosphere
  • Managing the daily business in your department to reach sales targets (incl. digital services, visual merchandising, salesfloor)
  • Identifying and improving areas based on feedback given by consumers
  • Being a brand ambassador for NIKE’s initiatives including training your team
  • Ensuring that the store complies with all NIKE standards and guidelines
  • Cooperating with your business partners across stores and HQ

More specifically, our store structure consists of the 3 Coach roles below:


COMMERCIAL

  • Leading a team who can deliver efficient receiving of product, inventory accuracy to visual presentation standards
  • Ensuring the smooth process of all inventories warranting our sales floor is always full, presentable and achieve brand standards
  • Working alongside departments leads who will oversee the individual components (product receiving and visual presentation) whilst you will be responsible for the overall product journey in store.
  • Being responsible for monthly initiative launches
  • Using our reporting tools to make the best commercial decisions
  • Achieving accurate inventory to fulfill digital orders

ATHLETE EXPERIENCE

  • Ensuring the team is equipped to deliver the highest quality athlete experience (Purpose)
  • Leading team Engagement on NIKE Community Ambassador activities
  • Partnering with senior store leadership, you will oversee the hiring processes including onboarding
  • Being responsible for store scheduling
  • Working collaboratively with store team to implement & maintain a positive NIKE culture

CONSUMER EXPERIENCE

  • Leading by example and the delivery of our sales floor service and bring the consumer journey to life
  • Ensuring the team is equipped with brand knowledge regarding all aspects consumer service including digital service enablers
  • Completing specific training and share completion with athlete services
  • Using data and analytics to provide insights and partner to achieve continuous improvement with senior store leadership

What you get:

  • Attractive salary that evolves with the market and experience
  • Opportunity on receiving monthly bonus payments
  • Attractive online and in-store employee discounts
  • Attractive Benefits Package, Pension & Share scheme
  • Exciting development and career opportunities
  • Regular training on leadership, sales and products
  • A dynamic and motivating environment which values Diversity, Equity & Inclusion (DE&I)
  • Staff dress to represent NIKE and foster our team spirit
  • Access to sports activities
  • Opportunities to participate in unique NIKE moments

What you bring:

  • A passion for NIKE and/or love of sport
  • Experience in retail and/or leadership positions
  • Very good command of English language (written and spoken)
  • Experience and competency in serving exceptional consumer service
  • Ability to coach and develop a strong team
  • Strong focus on communication
  • Flexibility to work in shifts and on weekends

Watch this video to find out about the atmosphere in our stores and learn more about our store traditions.


Did we arouse your interest and do you want to support us on our mission “To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete in the world.”? Apply now, easy way online. We are waiting for you!

title: Research Administration Analyst (Part-Time, Seasonal)
description:
Company: Bickham Services Unlimited LLC
Talent Pool: 2–4 candidates
Employment Type: Part-Time Seasonal, W-2 or 1099
Work Arrangement: Remote – United States
Expected Work Period: February–May each year
Expected Weekly Hours: Approximately 15–25 hours per week (subject to confirmation)
Initial Expected Start: February 2027

About the Opportunity

Bickham Services Unlimited LLC is building a seasonal talent pool of Research Administration Analysts to support research administration, sponsored programs, contracts, grants, and research compliance activities.

This opportunity is suitable for experienced research administration professionals who can provide analytical, interview, documentation, and writing support during the annual seasonal workload.


The initial seasonal assignment is expected to begin in February 2027 and run through May 2027, subject to contract award and program requirements.


Key Responsibilities

  • Support research administration and sponsored programs activities.
  • Review and analyze research-related documentation.
  • Assist with contracts, grants, and research compliance-related tasks.
  • Conduct interviews and gather relevant information when required.
  • Prepare analytical summaries, reports, and written documentation.
  • Review information for accuracy and completeness.
  • Support program-related research administration workflows.
  • Ensure written deliverables meet applicable Section 508 accessibility requirements.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in research administration, sponsored programs, contracts, grants, or research compliance.
  • Experience working at a university, research institution, or similar organization.
  • Strong analytical, interviewing, and writing skills.
  • Ability to review and interpret research-related documentation.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Ability to work independently and meet seasonal deadlines.

Working Conditions

  • Remote position within the United States.

Apply through this posting with a current resume. Qualified candidates will be contacted for a phone screen.

title: Lead, Cybersecurity Risk management & Security Standard
description:
Grow your career with us

Here at Averis, our common purpose is to improve lives by developing resources sustainably. Our people are crucial in helping us to realise our vision to be one of the best Global Business Solution (GBS) organization to support our customers in creating value for the Community, Country, Climate, Customer and Company.

Responsibilities:

Lead and continuously enhance the enterprise-wide Technology Risk Management function, providing independent oversight and governance over all technology-related risks including Cybersecurity, Information Security, Artificial Intelligence (AI), Cloud, On-Premise Infrastructure, Operational Technology (OT), Data Protection, Third-Party/Vendor, Digital Transformation, and Emerging Technology risks.

The role ensures technology risks are identified, assessed, prioritized, reported, and managed within the organization's risk appetite while supporting business growth, innovation, operational resilience, regulatory compliance, and digital transformation initiatives.

Act as a strategic advisor to executive management, technology leadership, risk committees, and board-level governance forums on technology risk matters.


Key Responsibilities

Technology Risk Governance

· Establish and maintain the Enterprise Technology Risk Management Framework.

· Define technology risk policies, standards, methodologies, risk appetite, and governance processes.

· Ensure alignment with Enterprise Risk Management (ERM) and Group Risk requirements.


Enterprise Technology Risk Oversight

· Lead identification, assessment, monitoring, and reporting of risks across:

o Cybersecurity & Information Security

o Cloud & Hybrid Infrastructure

o On-Premise Infrastructure

o Artificial Intelligence (AI) & Generative AI

o Operational Technology (OT), ICS & IoT

o Applications & Digital Platforms

o Data Protection & Privacy

o Third-Party & Supply Chain Technology Risk

o Technology Projects & Digital Transformation

o Business Continuity & Operational Resilience

· Oversee risk treatment plans and ensure timely remediation of control gaps.

· Work with OT lead/team on risk assessment and treatment


Risk Advisory & Business Partnership

· Provide independent technology risk advisory services to business and IT stakeholders.

· Support strategic initiatives, digital transformation, cloud adoption, AI implementation, and technology modernization programs.

· Challenge risk decisions and ensure alignment with organizational risk appetite.

Regulatory Compliance & Assurance

· Ensure compliance with applicable regulatory, legal, and industry requirements.

· Coordinate technology risk assessments, audits, certifications, and regulatory reviews.

· Monitor remediation of audit findings and compliance gaps.

Risk Reporting & Executive Engagement

· Develop and maintain technology risk dashboards, KRIs, KPIs, and executive reporting.

· Present technology risk posture, emerging threats, and key issues to management committees and senior leadership.

· Provide insights and recommendations to support risk-based decision-making.

Leadership & Risk Culture

· Promote a strong risk-aware culture across business and technology functions.

· Mentor and guide risk owners, control owners, and technology teams.

· Lead and develop a high-performing Technology Risk Management capability.


Cybersecurity Standard

· Develop, maintain, and continuously improve cybersecurity standards and security baselines for applications and IT infrastructure, aligned with industry best practices and organizational risk requirements.


· Develop, review, and maintain IT policies and governance frameworks to ensure security requirements are clearly defined, consistently implemented, and aligned with business and regulatory requirements.








Qualifications & Experience

Education

· Bachelor's Degree in Information Technology, Cyber Security, Risk Management, Computer Science, or related discipline.

· Master's Degree is an advantage.

Experience

· 8 - 10+ years of experience in Technology Risk, Cybersecurity, Information Security, IT Governance, IT Audit, or Enterprise Risk Management.

· Minimum 5 years in a leadership or management role.

· Experience in, shared services, manufacturing, industrial, or highly regulated environments is preferred.

Preferred Certifications

· CRISC

· CISSP

· CISM

· CISA

· CGEIT

· ISO 27001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer

· CCSP or equivalent Cloud Security certification

Technical Knowledge

Strong understanding of:

· ISO 27001

· NIST Cybersecurity Framework

· COBIT

· ISO 31000 / COSO ERM

· Cloud Security ( AWS, Aliyun, Google Cloud (Optional))

· AI & Generative AI Governance

· OT/ICS Security

· Third-Party Risk Management

· Data Protection & Privacy Regulations

· Business Continuity & Operational Resilience

· OT knowledge (added advantage)

title: Technical Support Specialist – Spare Parts | Beroun
description:
Overview

Do you have a technical background or experience in technical support? Enjoy solving problems and working with technical drawings? Join our international team at CCR Commercial Refrigeration!

We are looking for a Technical Support Specialist to support our CCR teams across different countries with spare parts identification and technical requests related to commercial refrigeration equipment.

Whether you are a fresh technical graduate or an experienced technical support professional, this could be a great opportunity to develop your expertise in an international environment.

And the good news? Czech language skills are not required!

Responsibilities

  • Handle technical support tickets submitted by CCR entities across different countries.

  • Identify the correct spare parts using 2D technical drawings and product documentation.

  • Support technical requests related to refrigeration cabinet refurbishment and rebuilding.

  • Help define spare parts kits and assembly groups.

  • Cooperate with R&D teams to clarify technical questions and identify suitable replacement parts.

  • Contribute to improvements in technical support processes, documentation, and quality.

  • Participate in ongoing technical projects and collaborate with international colleagues.

Qualifications

We welcome candidates from either of these backgrounds:

  • Technical graduates: A completed technical education (secondary school, vocational qualification, or university degree) in a relevant field, such as mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or manufacturing technology. Fresh graduates are welcome!

OR

  • Experienced professionals: At least 3 years of relevant technical support experience, ideally in manufacturing, industrial equipment, machinery, or a similar technical environment.

In addition, you should have:

  • The ability to read and interpret 2D technical drawings.

  • Good written English for communication with international colleagues and handling technical tickets.

  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

  • Attention to detail, good organizational skills, and a customer-oriented mindset.

  • A proactive attitude and willingness to learn.

Czech language skills are not required.

Experience with spare parts identification, technical documentation, or refrigeration equipment is an advantage, but not essential.

What can you expect from us?

  • An opportunity to develop your technical career within an international company.

  • Exposure to commercial refrigeration technology and international technical support processes.

  • Collaboration with experienced technical specialists and R&D teams.

  • Opportunities to expand your technical knowledge and contribute to process improvements.

  • Hybrid working arrangement

Important: During the first 3 months, you will work 5 days per week on-site in Beroun for training and onboarding. After that, you can follow the hybrid arrangement from Prague. Beroun or Mýto.

Ready to join us?

If you have a technical education or relevant technical support experience, enjoy solving technical challenges, and want to work in an international environment, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now and join CCR Commercial Refrigeration!

title: Frontend Developer – B2B Digital Banking & App Development 80-100% (f/m/d)
description:
LGT is the largest Private Banking and Asset Management group in the world to be owned by an entrepreneurial family. As the family office of the Princely House of Liechtenstein, we have years of experience in the management of sizeable sums of assets.

Job Description

Shape digital experiences for our intermediary business.


As part of an interdisciplinary agile team at LGT, you will help shape the digital experience we offer our stakeholders in the intermediary business. We are looking for a Frontend Developer who enjoys building intuitive, reliable and accessible applications and turning complex banking processes into seamless user journeys.


You will work closely with our Senior Full Stack Developer, as well as product, UI/UX, business analysis, testing and banking specialists. Together, you will develop digital B2B services and applications that connect a compelling user experience with the processes and systems behind it, including our core banking system Avaloq.


  • Design, develop and maintain responsive frontend applications and digital B2B apps.
  • Translate business, client and UX requirements into clear, accessible user journeys.
  • Collaborate with backend developers and other specialists to integrate applications with APIs and banking services.
  • Contribute to the further development of B2B processes and their digital interfaces, including processes connected to Avaloq.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools thoughtfully to support implementation, testing, documentation and problem-solving, while safeguarding code quality and data protection.
  • Ensure high standards of code quality, testing, security, performance and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting and continuous improvement of our development practices.
  • Work closely with stakeholders across the agile team to deliver solutions from concept through implementation.

Requirements

  • Higher technical education or equivalent practical experience in software or application development.
  • Practical experience in frontend and application development, with an interest in building intuitive, high-quality digital products.
  • A sound understanding of modern frontend development practices, API integration, testing and accessibility.
  • DevOps skills, particularly experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation, would be an advantage.
  • Interest in AI-assisted software development and the ability to assess and validate AI-generated results critically.
  • Conceptual and analytical skills, with a structured and solution-oriented approach to your work.
  • Knowledge of Avaloq, Avaloq Script, Oracle SQL or banking processes is an advantage, not a requirement.
  • Experience working in an agile development team is an advantage.
  • Good written and spoken English; German language skills are a plus, but not required.
  • A collaborative, communicative and self-driven personality who takes ownership and enjoys learning from others.

At LGT, we foster a constructive and collaborative working environment with long-term development opportunities. You will have the chance to take responsibility, share your expertise and contribute ideas as we continue to develop our digital services and agile ways of working.


Please note that we cannot consider applications submitted through recruitment agencies for this position.

Contact Information

We are looking forward to receiving your online application.

For any further information please do not hesitate to contact us.

LGT Financial Services AG

Human Resources

title: Serviceledare EL Höganäs
description:
Är du affärsdriven och vill vara med och skapa trygga och effektiva serviceleveranser? Trivs du med att koordinera, ha många kontaktytor och bidra till att tekniker och kunder får en smidig vardag? På Bravida Prenad är vi teknikproffs som gör jobbet ordentligt – med smarta system, hög servicegrad och ett starkt team i ryggen. Nu söker vi en Serviceledare till vårt team i Helsingborg. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Ditt nya jobb

Tjänsten som Serviceledare innebär ett koordinerande, ansvarsfullt och varierat arbete där du har en nyckelroll i vår serviceorganisation. Du arbetar nära teknikerna och ansvarar för att planera, följa upp och kvalitetssäkra våra serviceuppdrag. Rollen innebär daglig dialog med både kunder och medarbetare samt ansvar för att skapa god struktur i verksamheten. Som serviceledare ansvarar du också för att sätta ihop kompletta offerter till våra kunder.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden:

  • Att bevara och utveckla kundrelationer
  • Att organisera, leda och engagera medarbetare
  • Att arbeta med kalkyl samt sammanställa offerter
  • Arbete med bland annat inköp, resursplanering och kvalitets- och arbetsmiljöarbete
  • Planering och koordinering av serviceuppdrag
  • Uppföljning av tid, material och ekonomi

Precis som dina framtida kollegor kommer du att vara en viktig del i att våra leveranser sker enligt Bravidas höga krav på kvalitet och säkerhet. Arbetet innebär både problemlösning, kommunikation och struktur.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har erfarenhet av serviceledning eller en liknande samordnande eller ledande roll
  • Erfarenhet av serviceledning
  • Pratar flytande svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
  • Innehar B-körkort
  • Bakgrund som tekniker inom säkerhet, el, VS eller bygg ses som meriterande
  • Erfarenhet av ekonomi & administration ses som meriterande

Som person är du ödmjuk, trygg och kommunikativ. Du trivs i en roll där du får kombinera administration, kundkontakt och koordination. Du är serviceinriktad, relationsbyggande och van vid att hantera flera saker samtidigt.

Bravida som arbetsgivare

På Bravida ser vi till att det som måste fungera, fungerar. Våra medarbetare har byggt förtroende hos våra kunder sedan 1922 och är hjärtat i vår organisation. Tillsammans levererar vi de mest energieffektiva tekniska lösningarna. Hos oss har du möjlighet att göra skillnad för en mer hållbar framtid. Vi värdesätter mångfald och strävar efter att skapa en säker och inkluderande arbetsplats där alla känner sig välkomna och uppskattade. Din säkerhet kommer först, alltid.

Genom våra interna utbildningar erbjuder vi utvecklingsmöjligheter, och i vår starka gemenskap hjälper vi varandra att lyckas. Som en del av vårt team får du chansen att utvecklas både personligt och professionellt. Vi är stolta över att vara ett av Nordens ledande företag inom vår bransch, vilket ger oss möjlighet att erbjuda förmåner som exempelvis förmånliga pensionsavtal, friskvårdsbidrag och vidareutbildning. Läs mer om hur det är att arbeta på Bravida https://www.bravida.se/jobba-hos-oss/varfor-valja-bravida/

title: Recreation Specialist
description:
SUMMARY:

Elmcor is looking for a Recreation Specialist that plans, coordinates, and facilitates engaging recreational, social, educational, cultural, and wellness activities for our older adult services. You will work collaboratively with program staff and community partners, the specialist develops inclusive activities that promote physical health, personal growth, social connection, and overall well-being. Responsibilities include maintaining activity schedules and records, connecting participants with community support resources, monitoring participation and safety, and helping ensure programs are organized, accessible, and responsive to participants' needs. The ideal candidate is energetic, dependable, creative, and experienced in leading group activities for diverse populations.


Schedule: Monday–Friday (based on department needs)

Location: Corona, NY

Position Type: Full-Time, non-exempt


ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure activity sign in sheets are accurately completed and submitted to the Data Specialist for inputting in the Department for the Aging’s, Senior Tracking Accounting Recording System (STARS) daily.
  • Ensures senior safety during recreational activities.
  • Maintains and complies with the standards set by Department for the Aging (DFTA) and Department of Health & Mental Hygiene including, city, state, federal governing guidelines.
  • Reports potential unsafe conditions to the Activities Coordinator immediately.
  • Keeps accurate and up-to-date records in a neat and organized manner.
  • Maintains up-to-date activity flyers on bulletin boards and social media.
  • Conducts Outreach for program services at center.
  • Familiarity with picture/video taking for Social Media platforms.
  • Meets all deadlines of the assigned duties:
  • Maintains and meet all unit targets and goals.
  • Plans and coordinates, recreational, social, educational, and health activities for In-Home services.
  • Maintains an accurate list of support linkage groups.
  • Refers seniors to social services support linkages by providing case assistance, and- information and referral.
  • Identifies and resolves problems in a timely manner.
  • Develops alternative solutions with the In-Home Coordinator.
  • Works with Leadership in program planning and development.
  • Performs virtual activity services to homebound older adults.
  • Assist older adults with set-up of zoom link and encourage them to attend virtual activities for social engagement.


QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Must receive/obtain First Aid, CPR, AED training.
  • Must have a valid Driver’s License with a clean Abstract.


Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • Directly supervise all volunteers and/or consultants in the activity services.
  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and applicable laws.


BENEFITS:

  • 15 Vacation days annually
  • 12 Sick Days (3 per quarter)
  • Floating Holiday 1 annually
  • 401K retirement plan with 3% match after 90 days of employment
  • Medical Benefits after 30 days of employment with Cigna
  • Dental/Vision eligible after 90 days of employment
  • Access to Gym/Weight Room
  • Access to Boxing Ring
  • Short Term Disability
  • Life, Accidental Insurance available through Aflac
  • Transit Check for commuting expenses
  • Legal Shield for legal services
  • Public Service Loan Forgiveness (PSLF) participant


Join Elmcor Youth & Adult Activities as a Recreation Specialist and be part of a dedicated team committed to empowering individuals and families. This is more than just a job — it’s an opportunity to use your skills, compassion, and expertise to create lasting change.

title: Training Delivery Senior Specialist - WebOps - Core Maintenance
description:
Join Us!

At Google Operations Center we help Google users and customers solve problems and achieve their goals—all while enjoying a culture focused on improving continuously and being better together. We work hard, we play hard, and we want you to join us!

We are looking for a Training Delivery Specialist who combines deep hands-on software development expertise with a passion for capability building and adult learning. In this role, you will bridge the gap between engineering and learning operations by assessing capability gaps, designing real-world technical curricula, and delivering high-impact training programs to our engineering and operations teams.


Responsibilities:

1. Technical Training Delivery & Enablement

  • Deliver engaging, hands-on technical training sessions, live coding bootcamps, workshops, and lab environments across classroom and virtual formats.
  • Demystify complex front-end and web networking concepts (e.g., state management, bundle optimization, DNS resolution workflows, SSL/TLS, 301/302 redirects, canonicalization, and edge caching).
  • Facilitate code walkthroughs, debug clinics, and architectural design reviews for learners.

2. Curriculum Design & Content Creation

  • Design, build, and continuously update end-to-end technical learning paths, hands-on lab exercises, and evaluation rubrics based on adult learning principles.
  • Create production-aligned coding exercises adhering to modern standards, clean code principles, testability, and responsive UI performance.
  • Partner with engineering leads to convert operational post-mortems and emerging tech updates into digestible training modules.

3. Capability Assessment & Learning Impact

  • Proactively assess current-state skills across teams within the Organization and build proactive development roadmaps.
  • Implement pre- and post-training assessments, practical coding benchmarks, and capstone project reviews to measure tangible skill acquisition.
  • Leverage data and metrics to track learner progress, evaluate business impact, and optimize learning interventions.

4. Stakeholder & Domain Collaboration

  • Partner with Senior Engineering Managers, Technical Leads, UX Designers, and training partners to keep training curricula aligned with current architecture and business needs.
  • Serve as the resident Subject Matter Expert on front-end best practices, browser performance, and web delivery ecosystems.

Technical Scope & Requirements

  • Front-End Architecture: Deep hands-on experience in HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, Modern JavaScript (ES6+), and TypeScript. Strong working expertise in Angular (components, services, RxJS, lifecycle hooks, state management).
  • Web Networking & Traffic Routing: Strong practical understanding of DNS management (A/AAAA records, CNAME, ALIAS, MX, TXT), domain mapping, HTTP/HTTPS protocols, reverse proxies, and URL redirect handling (301, 302, server vs. client routing, regex rewrite rules, canonical tags).
  • Modern Tooling & Build Pipelines: Experience with build systems and bundlers (Webpack, Vite), package managers (npm/yarn), and version control (Git branching, code review workflows, and CI/CD basics).
  • CMS & Content Delivery: Practical understanding of traditional and Headless CMS architectures (e.g., Contentful, Adobe Experience Manager, Brightspot, or Drupal) and how front-end layers consume headless APIs.
  • Performance & Quality: Expertise in web performance optimization (Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code-splitting, caching strategies) and clean code standards.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience: 7–10+ years of total experience, including:
  • At least 4–5 years of hands-on software development experience with front-end / full-stack web applications.
  • At least 2–3 years in a role involving technical training delivery, bootcamps, developer enablement, or structured technical mentoring.
  • Instructional Competence: Demonstrated ability to translate complex technical concepts into structured, learner-friendly modules and hands-on coding labs.
  • Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with comfort leading live code sessions and presenting to senior stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with Cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and serverless hosting/edge computing (Cloudflare, CloudFront, or Firebase Hosting).
  • Familiarity with backend integration patterns (RESTful APIs, GraphQL, Node.js).
  • Experience utilizing data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, or Looker Studio) to present learning analytics.
  • LMS & Tools: Familiarity with modern Learning Management Systems (LMS), digital learning platforms, and lab sandboxes
  • Certifications in Project Management (PMP, Agile/Scrum) or Process Improvement (Six Sigma Green/Black Belt).

Benefits

  • We support you with competitive wages and with comprehensive health care including medical, dental and vision coverage

  • We support your family with gender-neutral baby bonding leave, 26 week birth-parent maternity leave, and generous life, accident and disability insurance minimums

  • Employees who work onsite can enjoy free meals and snacks, and fun onsite experiences

description:

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

Principal - Cloud Architecture, SRE & DevOps

About your role:

As Principal - Cloud Architecture, SRE & DevOps, you will define and build cloud infrastructure patterns that support scalable, resilient, and cost-efficient platforms across the enterprise. You will work with engineering, platform, and architecture teams to design high-availability environments, strengthen reliability practices, and accelerate delivery through modern DevOps automation. Your work will help improve infrastructure resilience, optimize cloud performance and cost, and establish strong operational foundations for new and existing cloud initiatives.

What you'll do:

  • Design and implement cloud architecture solutions across Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft Azure that support secure, scalable, and resilient application delivery.
  • Build and establish cloud infrastructure from the ground up for new projects, applying architecture standards, automation, and platform best practices.
  • Lead infrastructure design for high availability, scalability, fault tolerance, and low-latency performance across distributed systems and business-critical environments.
  • Develop and maintain infrastructure as code (IaC) using Terraform and related automation practices to enable repeatable, consistent, and auditable cloud deployments.
  • Design, implement, and optimize continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines that improve deployment speed, quality, and operational control.
  • Partner with engineering teams to support Kubernetes-based platforms, event-driven systems such as Kafka, caching services such as Redis, and relational or NoSQL databases and storage platforms.
  • Define and improve site reliability engineering (SRE) and observability practices including monitoring, alerting, incident readiness, service resilience, and operational performance reviews.
  • Design and optimize cloud infrastructure capabilities such as landing zone architecture, application gateways, load balancers, infrastructure observability, AIOps capabilities, and traffic management configurations.
  • Drive continuous cloud cost optimization by improving architecture efficiency, resource utilization, scaling patterns, and operational governance.
  • Provide technical leadership and hands-on guidance for platform modernization, infrastructure hardening, and operational best practices across cloud environments.

Experience you'll need to have:

  • 13+ years of experience in cloud architecture, infrastructure engineering, DevOps engineering, site reliability engineering (SRE), or related technical disciplines supporting enterprise environments.
  • 13+ years of experience designing and implementing cloud infrastructure across AWS, Azure, or similar cloud platforms.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or similar tools to build and manage scalable cloud environments.
  • Experience designing and supporting CI/CD pipelines, container platforms such as Kubernetes, and automation practices that improve engineering delivery and reliability.
  • Experience with distributed infrastructure components including Kafka, Redis or similar caching platforms, relational databases, NoSQL databases, and cloud storage services.
  • Experience designing high-availability, high-scalability, and resilient infrastructure patterns with strong observability, low-latency performance, and operational readiness.
  • Experience improving cloud cost efficiency through architecture optimization, capacity planning, and usage governance.
  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related field or equivalent combination of education, related experience and/or military experience.

Experience that would be great to have:

  • Experience with AIOps capabilities, platform observability frameworks, and intelligent infrastructure operations.
  • Experience designing landing zone architectures, application gateways, and enterprise network traffic management in cloud environments.
  • Experience building greenfield cloud environments and establishing platform standards from initial project setup.
  • Experience in financial services, payments, or other regulated technology environments.

How you'll work:

  • This role is on-site Monday through Friday. Fiserv considers in-person collaboration to be an essential part of this role as in-person office experiences help you with your overall onboarding experience and leads to stronger productivity.

Qualifications

title: Sr. Product Security Response Engineer
description:
Sr. Product Security Response Engineer

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

About our cybersecurity team

Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading tech companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that! We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced GRC specialist to join our Cybersecurity team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.


As a Cybersecurity GRC Platform Architect, you will design, configure, integrate, and enhance the technology capabilities supporting cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, and third-party risk management. You will translate complex requirements into scalable workflows, reliable data, actionable reporting, and practical automation.

You will independently deliver complex platform solutions, recommend technical approaches, and partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, policy, and IT teams. You will also establish reusable technical patterns and provide guidance to platform users and less-experienced contributors.


What You’ll Do

Responsibilities:

Product Security Response

  • Owning and driving complex product vulnerability cases from initial intake through technical resolution and disclosure readiness, maintaining clear status, evidence, decisions, ownership, and next actions.
  • Triaging vulnerability reports for credibility, scope, affected products or versions, exploitability, potential customer impact, duplication, and completeness of supporting evidence.
  • Reproducing reported vulnerabilities and validating proofs of concept in collaboration with product engineering, penetration testing, security research, and other technical specialists.
  • Coordinating technical investigations with product teams, resolving information gaps, aligning on responsibilities, and keeping cases moving toward remediation and disclosure milestones.
  • Assessing vulnerability severity using applicable scoring methods and available technical evidence while documenting assumptions, rationale, and unresolved questions.
  • Supporting the development, review, and technical quality of customer-facing security advisories, vulnerability disclosures, remediation guidance, and related content.
  • Engaging internal stakeholders and external vulnerability reporters or coordination partners to clarify findings, gather evidence, communicate status, and support coordinated disclosure.
  • Applying knowledge of CVE, CWE, CVSS, MITRE, NVD, FIRST, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices to support accurate classification and reporting.
  • Monitoring case queues and emerging demand, identifying cases at risk of delay, and helping maintain consistent execution across PSRT operating areas.
  • Contributing across diverse product environments and adapting to differences in architecture, development practices, and organizational ownership.

Vulnerability Investigation and Security Validation

  • Performing hands-on technical analysis to reproduce vulnerabilities, validate exploitability, determine affected configurations or versions, and assess potential impact.
  • Reviewing proof-of-concept code, logs, source code, configurations, system behavior, product architecture, and other evidence relevant to vulnerability investigations.
  • Developing or adapting scripts, test harnesses, proofs of concept, and technical methods needed to validate findings and support remediation decisions.
  • Conducting targeted security testing when vulnerability reports require deeper technical analysis or independent validation beyond the information submitted.
  • Partnering directly with product engineering teams to understand product design, validate findings, support remediation, and perform retesting as appropriate.
  • Producing clear technical findings that describe evidence, affected components, reproduction steps, security impact, and actionable remediation guidance.
  • Defining investigation and testing approaches based on product architecture, threat models, reported vulnerabilities, known attack techniques, and areas of highest security risk.
  • Distinguishing confirmed vulnerabilities from false positives, unsupported claims, configuration issues, or findings that require additional evidence.
  • Escalating investigations to appropriate specialists when cases require expertise beyond the role’s technical domain.

PSRT Process and Capability Improvement

  • Identifying recurring vulnerability patterns, operational friction, process gaps, and opportunities to improve PSRT guidance, playbooks, templates, and technical practices.
  • Contributing reusable scripts, tooling, integrations, and automation that reduce repetitive work and improve the consistency or quality of vulnerability response.
  • Helping improve case documentation, evidence requirements, review practices, and quality checks across the response lifecycle.
  • Supporting improvements to vulnerability intake, triage, reproduction, severity assessment, remediation coordination, advisory preparation, and case closure.
  • Capturing reusable techniques and lessons learned so future investigations can be completed more efficiently and consistently.
  • Using approved automation or AI-assisted capabilities where they provide practical value while validating outputs and preserving accountable human judgment.
  • Measuring the effectiveness of process or tooling improvements and adjusting approaches based on operational results and team feedback.

Technical Collaboration and Leadership

  • Leading significant vulnerability investigations or focused technical workstreams while remaining directly involved in hands-on execution.
  • Providing technical guidance to engineers, case managers, and product teams on vulnerability analysis, evidence quality, severity assessment, remediation, and disclosure readiness.
  • Reviewing technical findings, investigation approaches, and security communications for accuracy, completeness, and actionable guidance.
  • Communicating complex findings, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, security specialists, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Building productive working relationships across product engineering, PSRT, penetration testing, security research, and adjacent security teams.
  • Mentoring less-experienced team members and sharing practical knowledge that strengthens the broader team’s vulnerability-response capability.
  • Representing PSRT in cross-functional discussions and helping stakeholders reach evidence-based technical decisions.

What you need to bring:

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 6 to 10 years of relevant experience in product security response, application security, vulnerability management, penetration testing, incident response, security engineering, or closely related technical work.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex vulnerability investigations across multiple products, platforms, or technical environments.
  • Strong ability to analyze vulnerability reports, proof-of-concept code, logs, source code, configurations, system architectures, and other technical evidence.
  • Hands-on experience reproducing vulnerabilities, validating exploitability, assessing impact, and supporting remediation or retesting.
  • Working knowledge of CVE, CWE, CVSS, MITRE, NVD, FIRST, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices.
  • Experience authoring or reviewing security advisories, vulnerability disclosures, technical findings, or remediation guidance.
  • Experience with Python or another scripting or programming language used to support security analysis, testing, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with APIs, source control, CI/CD pipelines, containers, cloud environments, or modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong knowledge of common software weaknesses, secure coding practices, threat modeling, and secure development lifecycle principles.
  • Ability to lead significant technical work, exercise independent judgment, coordinate across teams, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills across engineering, security, product, and leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a PSIRT or PSRT supporting enterprise technology products or services.
  • Experience engaging vulnerability reporters, product engineering teams, disclosure partners, or vulnerability-coordination communities.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and performing targeted penetration tests or security assessments in support of vulnerability investigations.
  • Experience investigating vulnerabilities affecting applications, services, APIs, cloud environments, firmware, operating systems, networking products, or supporting infrastructure.
  • Experience developing scripts, test harnesses, proofs of concept, integrations, or workflow automation for security operations.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms, case-management systems, security-advisory publishing processes, or machine-readable advisory formats.
  • Experience supporting high-impact or broadly disclosed vulnerabilities involving complex product ownership or cross-organizational coordination.
  • Relevant security, cloud, application security, or software engineering certifications are valued but not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • Complex vulnerability cases are technically sound, well documented, and moved forward with clear ownership, timely stakeholder engagement, and evidence-based decisions.
  • Product teams receive actionable findings, credible severity and impact assessments, and practical support through remediation and retesting.
  • Security advisories and vulnerability disclosures are accurate, consistent, complete, and ready for customer communication.
  • Investigations distinguish genuine product risk from false positives, incomplete reports, unsupported claims, and configuration-specific issues.
  • PSRT casework becomes more consistent and efficient through improved playbooks, templates, technical methods, tooling, and knowledge sharing.
  • Automation reduces repetitive work and improves response quality without weakening technical validation, traceability, or accountability.
  • Cross-functional investigations remain coordinated, risks and delays are identified early, and cases continue progressing toward resolution.
  • Less-experienced team members grow through practical mentoring, technical review, and shared investigation experience.

Job Summary

The Care Management Transition of Care Team Manager is a pivotal leadership role within the Denver Health Medical Plan driving excellence in the seamless transition of members from acute care settings (hospitals, emergency departments, skilled nursing facilities) to home, outpatient, or post-acute care. This role ensures coordinated, evidence-based care during high-risk transitions to reduce readmissions, improve outcomes, and align with value-based care models. As a leader, you will mentor clinical staff, optimize TOC protocols, and collaborate with providers to create a member-centered continuum of care. Core responsibilities include development, implementation and continuous refinement of TOC workflow. This role with lead a team of nurse care managers specializing in TOC providing coaching, performance feedback and quality assurance. Key metric monitoring includes timely post-discharge follow up and enrollment in the TOC program. Workflows are outcomes oriented, and work will prioritize identification of high-risk members, proactive coordination of care with inpatient teams and health plan utilization management to meet member needs.

  • Transition of Care Leadership & Strategy:

    - Oversee proactive identification of high-risk members (e.g., chronic conditions, frequent ED utilizers, at risk for readmissions) and implement mitigation strategies
    - Ensure timely post-discharge follow-up which may include appointment scheduling, program enrollment, coordination with home health, rehabilitation or social services and provide member education related to self-management and warning signs
    - Assist with root-cause analysis of readmissions and adverse events related to TOC failures
    - Monitor and report key metrics including: 30-day readmission rates, time-to-first follow up, member satisfaction and provider satisfaction (30%)
  • Compliance & Regulatory Alignment:
    - Ensure all TOC activities comply with CMS requirements, MAC guidelines and plan-specific policies
    - Stay current with evolving TOC regulations and innovations to ensure compliance and enhance team practices
    - Support audits (internal/external) related to TOC processes and documentation (30%)
  • Stakeholder Engagement:
    - Build and maintain strategic relationships with hospital discharge planners, care managers, emergency department leadership and post-acute care facilities
    - Be a spokesperson for TOC best practices and socialize health plan TOC and other care management programs and resources
    - Collaborate with utilization management, pharmacy and health outcomes teams to address barriers to care (25%)

  • Bachelor's Degree Nursing preferred


Work Experience:

title: Cyber Security Senior Analyst/Engineer
description:
Position Summary

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer – Network Security will lead the design, engineering, implementation, and continuous improvement of network security controls across a globally distributed industrial manufacturing environment. The role will secure enterprise networks, cloud connectivity, remote access, and IT/OT boundaries while ensuring resilient, scalable, and compliant security architecture across regions.

Work this position does

  • Design, implement, and maintain global network security architecture, standards, and engineering baselines.
  • Administer and optimize next-generation firewalls, network segmentation, secure remote access, VPN, SASE/SSE, IDS/IPS, and related security controls.
  • Strengthen IT/OT segmentation and secure connectivity to manufacturing sites, plants, data centers, and industrial systems in coordination with OT and plant engineering teams.
  • Lead firewall rule reviews, access-control assessments, network security hardening, configuration reviews, and remediation of identified weaknesses.
  • Support security incident response by investigating network-based threats, analyzing traffic and logs, implementing containment measures, and coordinating with the SOC and incident response teams.
  • Manage network security changes, upgrades, lifecycle management, high availability, disaster recovery, and configuration backups.
  • Establish global network security standards while accommodating regional regulatory requirements, data residency constraints, and operational needs.
  • Evaluate new technologies, identify architectural gaps, and develop roadmaps for network security modernization.
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, workplace technology, identity, vulnerability management, and third-party service providers.
  • Maintain technical documentation, network security diagrams, operational procedures, audit evidence, and risk exceptions.
  • Provide technical inputs during complex implementations, outages, incidents, and security improvement initiatives.

Specific Objective of this role

Establish and continuously improve a consistent, resilient, and risk-based network security posture across all global locations, with particular emphasis on secure IT/OT connectivity, effective network segmentation, controlled privileged and third-party access, and rapid containment of network-based threats—without disrupting critical manufacturing operations.

Basic Educational Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.
  • 13–15 years of relevant experience in network engineering and network security, including substantial hands-on experience in enterprise-scale environments.
  • Strong experience designing, implementing, troubleshooting, and operating enterprise network security solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience working across geographically distributed environments and coordinating with global IT and infrastructure teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCNP Security, CCIE Security or equivalent vendor certifications. Current certification names and availability should be validated during recruitment.
  • Hands-on experience with next-generation firewalls, firewall policy management, IDS/IPS, VPN, secure remote access, network access control, and network segmentation.
  • Experience with SASE/SSE platforms, cloud network security, zero-trust network access, and hybrid enterprise connectivity.
  • Knowledge of industrial cybersecurity and OT environments, including Purdue-model concepts, industrial DMZs, secure remote vendor access, and segmentation of manufacturing networks.
  • Familiarity with IEC 62443, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, NIST SP 800-82, and relevant regional regulatory requirements.
  • Experience integrating network security telemetry with SIEM/SOC platforms and supporting threat detection, investigation, and incident containment.
  • Experience in global manufacturing, industrial machinery, engineering, automotive, chemicals, food processing, or other environments with operationally critical sites.
  • Strong troubleshooting, architecture documentation, vendor management, risk assessment, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Ability to lead technical initiatives across time zones and provide technical guidance to internal teams and service providers.

Who we are:

Mold-Masters () is a leading global supplier of hot runners, controllers, auxiliary injection and co-injection systems. We design, manufacture, distribute, sell and service highly engineered and customized plastic processing equipment that caters to every market. Mold-Masters is a business unit of Hillenbrand.

title: Munitions Technician
description:
The Munitions Technician receives, stores, inspects, tests, transports and maintains U.S. Air Force (USAF) Munitions, Munitions Material Handling Equipment (MMHE) and supporting resources as applicable to the Site. Operates Theater Integrated Combat Munitions System (TICMS). May supervise Other Country National (OCN) Munitions Workforce. Ensures compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) and Amentum ISO 9001 Quality Management System (QMS).


Principal Accountabilities

  • Consistently observes and enforces all USAF and host nation explosives safety, AFOSH and security standards during all explosives and non-explosives operations in assigned sites and temporary duty locations.
  • In the event of an emergency, takes necessary control and timely response actions.
  • Conducts all munitions work according to established quality processes, identifying potential problems and recommending solutions.
  • Reconditions, repairs and replaces defective or missing parts of munitions and containers.
  • Performs munitions storage actions according to the stringent explosives standards.
  • Conducts warehouse inventories and corrects any discrepancies.
  • Works closely with operations personnel to resolve any serviceability and accountability issues noted during warehouse operations.
  • Prepares and configures munitions shipments for air, sea and surface transportation.
  • Uploads/downloads trucks with incoming and outgoing munitions shipments.
  • Assists inspecting munitions in accordance with 11A-1-10 and applicable technical orders.
  • Assists inspecting munitions brass, residue and containers in accordance with 11A-1-60.
  • Operates assigned TICMS as is applicable to Site's processes.
  • Inspects, operates and performs maintenance on light vehicles and handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks and manual hoists.
  • Inspects and operates metal strapping equipment, stencil machines, heat sealers, pneumatic paint guns, air compressors and power tools.
  • Inspects and perform minor maintenance on facilities and installed equipment. Cleans vehicles, equipment facilities.
  • Crew Chiefs operations, provide clear instructions about the work to assigned crew members.
  • Prepares and delivers general and explosive safety briefings.
  • If qualified, uploads/downloads trucks with incoming and outgoing munitions shipments and transports them to/from flightline holding areas, along with transporting munitions to support daily operations within the department.
  • Works necessary hours, to include stand-by duties, to support mission requirements during peacetime and combat contingencies.
  • Perform required actions in TICMS utilizing the "Receiver" role.
  • Perform entry-controller duties as required.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Works in normal office and maintenance shop or warehouse environment and may be required to work outdoors for extended periods.

Minimum Requirements

  • Must have basic knowledge of the USAF Supply and Tech Order systems or US service equivalent.
  • Must be proficient in the use of personal computers and Windows Operating System and Microsoft Office to include as a minimum Power Point, Excel and Word programs.
  • Will be required to operate material handling equipment.
  • Must possess a valid home country driver's license and ability to obtain host nation driver's license.
  • High School diploma or equivalent required.
  • Must have completed formal USAF Munitions Systems training or US Service equivalent.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret US Government Clearance. Note: US Citizenship is required to obtain Secret Clearance.
  • Will be required to wear proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) according to prescribed procedures and as required for task being performed.
  • Physically capable of performing all required duties; capable of lifting/pushing/pulling minimum of 50 lbs.
  • Ability to travel domestically and internationally.
  • Must have normal color perception and depth of vision.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Preferred to have a minimum of four years of experience with USAF Military Munitions.
  • Preferred Associate's Degree in Munitions Management.

  • Leading the effort in building a productive Team both within Hargrove and with the client. Utilize rewards where applicable to recognize outstanding contributions.
  • Coordinating resource requirements with other ongoing project work and insure all parties’ expectations are aligned.
  • Planning and organizing the work of your team. Communicating the plan to your team, the project leadership team and the client. Aligning the expectations of all parties. Conduct weekly coordination meetings with the Team.
  • Maintaining timely and accurate reporting including weekly and monthly reports utilizing a comprehensive action item list.
  • Reviewing engineering documents, vendor submittals, fabrication drawings and other construction submittals for compliance with engineering drawings, specifications, good engineering practice, and project objectives. Project Manager is responsible for ensuring all documentation is reviewed and checked against vendor submittals, specifications, interdiscipline, etc. regardless of resource location.
  • Ensuring that standard project work processes are followed by all team members through all phases of engineering, procurement, and construction.
  • Interviewing discipline leads to maintain up-to-date progress against man hour expended analysis. Project Manager is responsible for overall financial health of each project with the respective discipline leads being responsible for producing the required deliverables within the given budget.
  • Assessing the performance of the project team members through the course of the project, and work with resource leadership to organize a qualified and motivated project team.
  • Ensuring project documentation is properly reviewed and approved by the client.
  • Providing Construction Phase Support, start-up assistance, and response to Requests for Information, as needed.
  • Managing timeliness of client team decision making and package approval.
  • Promoting continuing positive relations with the client building on long term relationships that continue to add additional services.
  • Completing project closeout as required by the client.
  • Effectively and proactively managing the client needs at all stages of the project.

Ideal Background

Education: Bachelor or Master of Science degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical or Civil Engineering from an accredited university is preferred.


Certification: Professional Engineering and/or Project Management Professional (PMP) registration is highly preferred.


Experience: This position requires up to 10 years of relevant experience in engineering and project management.


Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of the Hargrove project execution procedures.
  • Knowledge and application of company business standards and good practices.
  • Knowledge and application of company engineering standards and project controls tools.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in complex project management.
  • Ability to lead a team to deliver on commitments.
  • A comprehensive understanding of the function of all engineering disciplines, procurement, and construction processes.

title: Embedded Software Engineer Intern
description:
Are you a problem solver looking for a hands-on internship position with a market-leading company that will help develop your career and reward you intellectually and professionally?


About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.


At ADI, you will learn from the brightest minds who are here to help you grow and succeed. During your internship, you will make an impact through work on meaningful projects alongside a team of experts. Collaborating with colleagues in an environment of respect and responsibility, you will create connections that will become a part of your professional network.


ADI’s culture values aligned goals, work-life balance, continuous and life-long learning opportunities, and shared rewards. The internship program features various lunch-and-learn topics and social events with other interns and full-time employees.


At ADI, our goal is to develop our interns so they are the first to be considered for full-time roles.


Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.


Leading Edge Technology; From digital healthcare to 5G connectivity, from autonomous and electric vehicles to the digitised factory, Analog Devices is passionate about turning tomorrow's possibilities into reality, making the world smarter, safer, healthier and greener. Wherever digital meets physical we’re there. Virtually every wireless call, text, and download today passes through an Analog Devices IC. Our automotive battery monitoring technology is used in the majority of petrol and diesel engine cars with engine start-stop functionality. This helped prevent 33 million metric tonnes of carbon vehicle emissions last year globally, which is more than half of all the carbon emissions the whole of Ireland produces in a single year. In digital xray imaging our technology enables delivery of increasingly high image fidelity at lower radiation dosages. Because we are dedicated to solving the toughest engineering challenges, Analog Devices is one of the top 10 semiconductor companies in the world.

We don’t just talk about innovation, we live it; At ADI, we believe that work should be exciting and meaningful. We encourage initiative and creativity, and we actively support the free exchange of ideas. A career with ADI means taking part in innovation and being challenged to achieve, and it offers the opportunity to work with other talented people, using state-of-the art processes and equipment. We run an annual Innovation Award for our Co-ops, a Global Early Employee Challenge for recent grads, and Hackathons for our wider community of employees. At ADI we strive to be Ahead of What’s Possible.

Silicon Meets Software; Software development at ADI spans from edge nodes to generating insights in the cloud – and everything in between. Working with hardware teams, your software skills in planning, systems architecture, designing, developing, troubleshooting, debugging, and testing can help to unlock the potential of our algorithms, technology platforms, and systems to make a real-world impact. Areas where our hardware and software technologies combine to offer real-world, system solutions include; IoT smart building applications, automotive radar systems for autonomous driving and collision avoidance, vital signs monitoring in the healthcare space, and 5G communications infrastructure. As ADI continues to grow its software capability we’re also focussed on building expertise in the area of Machine Learning and AI. We’re looking to hire people who want to make science fiction real.

One Company, Unlimited Opportunity; The scale of Analog Devices and the range of technologies we develop, markets we serve, countries we operate in, and skills that we utilise, makes for an exciting opportunity for you to find your direction. The opportunities for you at ADI are endless and we actively encourage you to explore those opportunities. From our Graduate Rotation Program, to our Continuing Education policies, to how we actively encourage internal mobility, ADI helps you to plot your path to success.

What's the secret to our success? It's very simple –

we treat our employees as our greatest asset.

Role Description

Analog Devices offers full-time paid placement opportunities to 70+ students each year across a wide range of functions and disciplines. As a placement student, you will have the opportunity to work with our talented teams of engineers on very challenging work assignments. You will play an integral part in the development of our products.

To be eligible for the placement program, you must be currently enrolled in 3rd level education. We hire predominantly from Electronics, Software, and Computer Science disciplines but also from Physics, Maths, Chemistry, Business, Economics, Environmental Science etc. into many different roles which include: IC Design, Product Applications, Test Development, Design Evaluation, Reliability, Failure Analysis, Process Development, Finance, Purchasing, Environmental Health and Safety etc. As a valued team member, students at ADI are assigned real work projects that are both meaningful and exciting. Our experienced engineers take their roles as mentors seriously as they want to see you succeed.

Your short-term experience at ADI just might be the launch of a long-term career. At ADI we view your time on placement student as an extended interview. You have the opportunity to demonstrate your abilities and learn more about ADI, while we have an opportunity to assess your potential and consider you for full-time opportunities after graduation. At the conclusion of your placement we will have a much better understanding of that potential and we hope that you will have decided that ADI is the place for you to start your career.

About the role

Have a passion for end-to-end supply chain integration and data-driven decision-making? Are you seeking an exciting new challenge?

We have a fabulous opportunity for an analytical and proactive professional to join our Paper Sourcing team as an IBP Senior Specialist. Reporting directly to the IBP Manager, this is a pivotal role where you will drive the tactical planning cycles and facilitate cross-functional alignment across our global footprint.


This is a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (paternity cover) with the potential to extend, as per business needs.


In this role, you will lead the monthly 1–3 month tactical Integrated Business Planning (IBP) cycles while supporting longer-term strategic horizons. You will act as a trusted business partner bridging Sourcing, Sales, Finance, Supply Planning, Manufacturing, and Logistics to ensure harmony between commercial demand, operational supply, inventory targets, and financial objectives. By delivering robust scenario modeling and high-impact analytics, you will highlight supply risks, resolve operational gaps, and optimize working capital.


A successful candidate must be a confident communicator and problem-solver who can challenge assumptions constructively, drive process standardization, and turn complex data into clear strategic direction.

​Key responsibilities include:

  • ​ IBP Cycle Leadership: Coordinate and lead monthly tactical IBP meetings (1–3 month horizon), preparing analysis and driving cross-functional alignment across demand, supply, inventory, and finance
  • Scenario Modeling & Risk Mitigation: Proactively identify and resolve supply/demand gaps and manufacturing capacity constraints through scenario modeling and decision-grade insights
  • Business Partnering & Stakeholder Alignment: Collaborate with cross-functional teams across multiple geographies, challenging planning assumptions to protect customer service and profitability
  • Analytics & Performance Tracking: Develop dashboards and KPI analytics to evaluate planning accuracy, inventory health, and operational performance.
  • Strategic & Long-Term Planning: Support strategic planning cycles (1+ year horizon) and help transition tactical insights into long-term business strategy
  • Process & Systems Improvement: Drive standardization, continuous improvement, and the implementation of advanced IBP planning tools and technologies

So, if you are an experienced IBP or S&OP professional looking for a new challenge in a business which prioritises operational excellence and encourages you to make a difference — then we might be looking for you!

About you

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or equivalent; APICS/ASCM (or similar) planning certification preferred

· 5+ years of progressive experience in Integrated Business Planning, Demand/Supply Planning, or S&OP within a multinational, cross-functional environment

· Proven experience within process manufacturing or industrial sectors; paper, packaging, or recycling experience is a distinct advantage

· Advanced Excel and financial/commercial modeling skills; hands-on experience with visualization tools (Power BI, Tableau) and enterprise planning systems (SAP IBP, OMP, Oracle, or equivalent)

· Strong understanding of financial planning integration within IBP, balancing cost, service, inventory, and working capital optimization

· Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and senior leaders.

Benefits

· Competitive salary

· 25 days holiday plus bank holidays

· Employee Assistance Programme

· Employee Discounts

· Cycle to work scheme

Location: This is a hybrid role, based in Amsterdam/London/Viana do Castelo with occasional business travel within EMEA as required.

About us

We are DS Smith, together with International Paper, we are a global leader in sustainable packaging solutions and other fibre-based products. We believe a better, more sustainable tomorrow is possible with the right people, who challenge and support one another to enact positive change. We employ more than 65,000 colleagues in North America and Europe, Middle East, and Africa (EMEA), who are experts in innovation, manufacturing, design, sales, sustainability, supply chain, and much more. Together with our customers, we make the world safer and more productive, one sustainable packaging solution at a time. Become part of a world-leading organisation and do your best work with us!

Fair recruitment at DS Smith

To fulfil our purpose of redefining packaging for a changing world, we aim to build a diverse, motivated, and engaged workforce. Our goal is to create a culture of inclusion where everyone is treated fairly, differences are valued, and everyone has an equal opportunity to succeed.


Our people come from diverse backgrounds, bring different perspectives, ideas, and experiences to generate unique solutions focused on present and future sustainability challenges. We welcome all candidates to apply, even those not meeting all criteria.
