The Customer Solutions Center is a new structure which enables Mastercard to develop better solutions & bundles for prioritized customer segments in markets. It is basically the housing for all Mastercard capabilities, and it aims to drive Mastercard growth, influence and revenue by creating and selling compelling data-driven, scalable needs-based solutions to new and existing customers by tapping Mastercard’s extensive toolbox of product and service offerings.
The Customer Solutions Lead is both a strategic and execution driven role that understands market, segments and customer needs, translates market strategy to solutions for frontline, coordinates efficient resourcing against priorities, and enables knowledge sharing.
The role will be responsible for a broad range of functions and capabilities including Solutions Architects, Technical Architects, Digital & Consumer Solutions, Services. Responsibility for Australia, New Zealand and Pacific Islands

The SVP – Customer Solutions Lead will report to the Australasia Division President.

Key Responsibilities
• Understands overall market strategy, industry trends, and customer needs for all segments in a given geography
• Works with market president to prioritize opportunities
• Responsible for compiling of solutions to deliver meaningful value for MA customer base
• Empowers AMs and BDs to farm and hunt. Supports account planning, opportunity identification, and solutioning for frontline sales
• Meets customers to support important pitches and understand their needs
• Manages the capacity and focus of the solution architects (SA) and product specialists within the customer solutions center to ensure that each prioritized opportunity gets the right level of support it requires
• Builds agile 'squads' for high or moderately complex opportunities/RFPs requiring multiple MA capabilities by staffing with the right resources
o Identifies the right solutions architects, product specialists and technical architects
o Request resources from other customer solutions centers in case of missing expertise for a specific opportunity
o Invites all enabling functions for support in solutioning in collaboration with AM / BD e.g. legal, finance etc.
o Drives the approach for enterprise level pricing and supports the SAs in developing the commercial propositions for complex solutions
• Tracks performance of agile 'squads' as well as resources in the Customer Solutions Center. Takes necessary actions to improve performance
• Provides market intelligence and requirements to regional Product Management and Product Development teams along with their associated product specialists
• Drives Mastercard strategic solutions / products in a holistic way to advance local payment ecosystem to ensure the current Mastercard strategic focus is executed at the market level
• Understands new products & capabilities working together with product specialists to ensure that information is shared and utilized across all customer solutions center resources
• Owns the agentic payments strategy
• Helps market development / segment heads with market intelligence and insights on demand for specific solutions across their segments
• Supports the integration of acquired capabilities into the customer solutions center and supports the responsible parties with rollout planning of the acquired capabilities into the given geography
• Shares best practices with other CSCs within and across the region to drive better customer experience and more relevant solutions
• Identifies gaps and requires additional investment in the customer solutions center based on evolving market needs – in collaboration with the relevant market heads
• Travel required in the role

Required Skills
• Strong understanding of industry trends and market intelligence
• Good understanding of regionally relevant MA products, services, and solutions
• Solid product management knowledge and experience
• Knowledge of new technologies and methodologies and how they are being applied today - AI, agile
• Detailed payments experience in issuing, acquiring, fintech
• Ability to link market developments to implications on MA products and services
• Solid Leadership and cross functional team management experience
• A proven ability to influence and motivate others to achieve objectives
• High energy, strong people leadership, experience in leading diverse teams
• Strong analytical and financial understanding
• Good understanding of product technology and APIs
• Strong interpersonal skills - the ability to build rapport and credibility quickly across functions
• Strong negotiation skills with a proven track record in delivering commercial performance
• Exceptional stakeholder management skills

Corporate Security Responsibility


All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

  • Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;

  • Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;

  • Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and

  • Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: DevOps Engineer Lead - Harness, Ansible and GitHub
description:
DevOps Engineer Lead - Harness, Ansible and GitHub – 10 to13 Yrs of experience – Ready to work in 2 PM to 11 PM shift


About the Role


You will join the ACBS/CLS Commercial Loan System team, supporting an enterprise lending platform across commercial, corporate, syndicated and specialty lending. You will lead DevOps engineering initiatives focused on CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, deployment automation, DevSecOps and production reliability. You will use Harness, GitHub, Ansible and Microsoft Azure to build secure, scalable and repeatable delivery capabilities. Your success will improve deployment efficiency, platform reliability, operational consistency and developer experience.


What You Will Be Doing


  • Design, develop and enhance CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation using Harness and GitHub.
  • Build reusable infrastructure and configuration automation using Ansible and Infrastructure as Code practices.
  • Establish effective GitHub practices covering source control, pull requests, branching, code reviews and CI/CD integrations.
  • Drive automation across infrastructure provisioning, application deployments, configuration management, testing, monitoring and operational processes.
  • Strengthen DevSecOps through security scanning, vulnerability management, access controls, secrets management and automated quality controls.
  • Troubleshoot complex issues across applications, infrastructure, networking, databases, cloud services and deployment pipelines.
  • Improve platform reliability, deployment efficiency and operational resilience through automation, standardization and continuous improvement.
  • Develop deep product knowledge and understand complex technical dependencies across interconnected enterprise systems.
  • Collaborate with engineering and business teams to resolve technical challenges and improve software delivery practices.
  • Mentor engineers, share technical knowledge and influence consistent DevOps and automation practices across the team.

What you bring


  • 10–13 years of experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, automation and production support within enterprise environments.
  • Hands-on experience with Harness for CI/CD pipeline development, deployment orchestration and automated software delivery.
  • Strong experience with Ansible for configuration management, infrastructure automation and repeatable environment configuration.
  • Strong GitHub expertise, including Git, pull requests, branching strategies, code reviews and CI/CD integrations.
  • Strong experience with Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code, scripting, configuration management, artifact management and deployment automation.
  • Strong knowledge of DevSecOps, security scanning, vulnerability management, access controls, secrets management and automated quality controls.
  • Proven troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across applications, infrastructure, networking, databases and cloud services.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems or an equivalent combination of education, training and relevant experience.

Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience designing reusable automation frameworks and standardized cloud deployment patterns.
  • Knowledge of application monitoring, release management, production support and platform reliability practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive automation, standardization, simplification and continuous improvement across technology environments.
  • Strong ownership, mentoring and collaboration skills, with the ability to influence technical practices across engineering teams.

What We Offer you


At FIS, we are as committed to growing our employees’ careers as our own business. We offer:

  • Opportunities to innovate in fintech
  • Inclusive and diverse team atmosphere
  • Professional and personal development
  • Competitive salary and benefits

Privacy Statement

FIS is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all personal information that we process in order to provide services to our clients. For specific information on how FIS protects personal information online, please see the Online Privacy Notice.

Sourcing Model

Recruitment at FIS works primarily on a direct sourcing model; a relatively small portion of our hiring is through recruitment agencies. FIS does not accept resumes from recruitment agencies which are not on the preferred supplier list and is not responsible for any related fees for resumes submitted to job postings, our employees, or any other part of our company.

title: Production Expert (befristet)
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Die Position Production Expert ist eine zentrale Rolle in der Rocephin Manufacturing KAU Abteilung in Kaiseraugst. Als Production Expert stellst du sicher, dass Produktionsprozesse reibungslos ablaufen, die hohen Qualitätsstandards eingehalten werden und alle Tätigkeiten gemäß den geltenden GMP-Vorschriften ausgeführt werden. Du bist verantwortlich für die Überwachung und Funktionssicherheit von Produktions- und Inspektionsanlagen, die Dokumentation der Produktionsschritte sowie die Unterstützung bei Optimierungen und Schulungen. Diese Position verbindet technisches Fachwissen, organisatorisches Talent und ein hohes Maß an Verantwortung, um die kontinuierliche Herstellung hochwertiger Produkte zu gewährleisten.


Die Möglichkeit:

  • Sicherstellung der Produktionsqualität und Überwachung der Betriebs- und Funktionssicherheit von Produktionsanlagen
  • Koordination und Durchführung von Tätigkeiten gemäß GMP-Vorschriften, einschließlich In-Prozess-Kontrollen, Dokumentation und Bedienung der Anlagen sowie den zugehörigen Produktionssystemen (MES/elektronisches Lagerverwaltungssystem)
  • Identifikation, Abrechnung und Verfügbarkeit von Materialien, Packmitteln und Verbrauchsmaterialien sicherstellen
  • Meldung und Bearbeitung von Alarmen, Störungen oder fehlerhaften Zuständen sowie Unterstützung bei der Fehlerbehebung
  • Mitarbeit bei der Optimierung von Produktionsprozessen
  • Unterstützung bei der Ausbildung neuer Mitarbeitender und der Umsetzung von Verbesserungsprojekten
  • Durchführung von Umrüstaktivitäten und Zusammenarbeit mit Schnittstellen wie Technik, Logistik oder Compliance-Teams

Wer Du Bist:

  • Du bringst eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung mit.
  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
  • Du besitzt mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der pharmazeutischen oder industriellen Produktion mit GMP-Kenntnissen.
  • Du zeichnest dich durch ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein und ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeiten aus.
  • Du bist eine teamorientierte Persönlichkeit mit hoher Eigeninitiative und Verantwortungsbewusstsein.
  • Du bist bereit zur Schichtarbeit und flexibel im Arbeitsalltag.
  • Du verfügst über ein hohes Mass an Selbstorganisation sowie gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten, auch im Umgang mit Schnittstellen (z.B. QA oder Support Funktionen wie MES-Support).

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world’s largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.

That’s why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower’ you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.

Take the lead and we’ll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

Functional Title: Project Manager

Corporate Title: Assistant Vice President

About Apex

The Apex Group is a global financial services provider with 10,000 staff across 50+ offices globally. We look to recruit bright, articulate and numerate employees who are not afraid of a challenge and are prepared to work hard and love what they do.

Every employee plays a part in making Apex who we are today and the more that we grow, the more important that becomes. Whatever your career path or specialism Apex provides a global platform to allow you to thrive.

As APEX FUND SERVICES is expanding, we are opening an exciting new opportunity.

We are currently looking for suitable, motivated and team-oriented professional for the position of Release Train Engineer

Purpose of the Role

The primary purpose of the Project Manager role is to lead and develop one or more project teams to deliver value effectively and predictably. The PM is an accountable delivery leader, not just a coach or facilitator, who actively shapes team culture, fosters collective ownership, and drives continuous improvement. They take clear responsibility for team effectiveness, delivery success, and reliability. A core part of the role is leading the team to meet stakeholder expectations consistently by protecting their ability to forecast realistically, maintaining sustainable delivery pace, and driving measurable improvement in flow, collaboration, and outcomes.

The role leads the planning and scheduling of projects, change management, project metrics production and analysis within the team working with colleagues across Technology and Product to prioritorise delivery in line with strategic, regulatory and growth objectives.

The position reports into the Portfolio Lead and helps plan annual portfolios based on business needs, manage portfolio health, risks, dependencies, and compliance, and support the development and advocacy of Portfolio Operations delivery framework, develop standard project/program delivery methodologies to be used across all technology change delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Alignment & Value Delivery

  • Own alignment between work and value: ensure team goals and priorities are visible and connected to business objectives.
  • Coach the “why” of delivery: help the team stay focused on valuable business outcomes, not just tickets or tasks.
  • Model outcome-focused planning: ensure the team understands what they’re delivering and why it matters to stakeholders, leveraging strategic artifacts and partnering with product and product aligned roles (e.g. Tower leads, BAs).

Planning, Scheduling & Flow Optimisation

  • Lead sustainable planning: ensure the team only commits to work they can realistically deliver, based on past velocity and current context.
  • Actively protect team capacity: buffer the team from external demands that would lead to overcommitment or churn.
  • Support reliable forecasting: track and communicate metrics such as throughput, velocity, and predictability to aid team effectiveness and stakeholder confidence.
  • Use flow data to drive improvement: use of data to surface WIP issues, blockers, and overcommitment patterns, and lead the team in resolving them.

Delivery Governance, Quality & Compliance

  • Champion readiness and discipline: ensure stories and features are well defined and understood before commitment. Holds themselves and others accountable to policies and escalate upwards where necessary.
  • Own impediment management: proactively resolve delivery blockers and escalate when needed to protect and improve delivery.
  • Balance assurance and autonomy: help the team meet governance requirements efficiently, preserving delivery focus.

People Leadership & Capability Growth

  • Lead team effectiveness efforts: assess team health, facilitate improvement conversations, and take ownership of follow-through.
  • Create space for collaboration and learning: protect the team’s time and mental bandwidth so they can reflect and prioritise improve activity.
  • Coach Lean Agile behaviours: embed focus on value, flow, collaboration and quality within the team’s daily ways of working.
  • Promote sustainable delivery: be a voice for saying “no” or “not yet” when team bandwidth and commitments are at risk.

Stakeholder Communication & Reporting

  • Own team-level visibility: communicate progress, risks, and trade-offs clearly, constructively, and timely.
  • Manage upward expectations: ensure stakeholders understand what the team can deliver and when, based on evidence, not hope.
  • Advocate for responsible planning: push back on unrealistic expectations when needed to build trust and preserve credibility and delivery integrity.

Experience required

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager in both agile and waterfall environments.
  • Track record of contributing to PI Planning and other large-scale Agile events.
  • Deep understanding of Agile and Lean principles, with hands-on experience in frameworks such as SAFe, Scrum, and Kanban.
  • Strong experience leading high-performing Agile delivery teams
  • Ability to identify, manage, and resolve delivery-level risks, dependencies, and conflicts.
  • Skilled in stakeholder communication and negotiation at senior leadership level.
  • Excellent command of verbal and written communication (English). Effective presentation style for all levels of stakeholders.
  • Proficiency with tools such as Azure DevOps and MS Office.
  • Relevant certifications preferred.
  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience); advanced degree in IT/management a plus.
  • Background in complex, large-scale business or financial services environments desirable.

Disclaimer: Unsolicited CVs sent to Apex (Talent Acquisition Team or Hiring Managers) by recruitment agencies will not be accepted for this position. Apex operates a direct sourcing model and where agency assistance is required, the Talent Acquisition team will engage directly with our exclusive recruitment partners.

title: Retail Store Management - New Store
description:
Position Overview

If you are interested in growing your retail management career with one of the largest and fastest growing off-price retailers in the nation, join the Burlington Stores team as a Store Manager! Are you a proven leader with strong communication and organization skills? Can you lead a team in driving results while building strong teams and partnerships and cultivating an environment based on trust, respect, and integrity? Can you bring innovative ideas to help drive results as you take on the challenge of running all aspects of a multi-million-dollar store operation? If you answer yes, then this may be the right opportunity for you.

As a Store Manager, you’ll be responsible for successfully managing all store operations tasks to maximize sales results while bringing “Our Burlington” values to life in your store. You will be a mentor, role model, and coach for your team members, as well as a partner to associates in other branches of the organization. You will lead your team by example, demonstrating how to deliver excellent customer service with a high degree of professionalism and provide a world-class shopping experience to customers. You will take ownership for the successful execution of all day-to-day merchandising, operations and service management tasks. You are ultimately responsible for the overall success of your store location and the associates on your team.

A Day in the Life

  • Direct management and oversight of Assistant Managers, Supervisors, and Store Associates to ensure implementation of established company policies, standards, expectations and initiatives.
  • Ensure Assistant Managers and store team members are fulfilling their individual responsibilities.
  • Partner with Assistant Store Manager, Merchandising to coordinate merchandise placement, sales promotions and pricing.
  • Partner with Assistant Store Manager, Operations to review receiving, transfers, debits/damages, returns-to-vendor (RTV's), and chargeback paperwork to ensure accuracy of inventory.
  • Act as Manager on Duty (MOD); lead by example, set the standard, and create a strong leadership presence by following and modeling the Burlington SOPs.
  • Manage multi-million-dollar sales volume and expense budget including review of all associated reporting and record-keeping.
  • Recruitment, screening and hiring of associates in order to meet store staffing needs.
  • Facilitate onboarding and training for new associates, provide ongoing coaching in the moment, and implement structured learning and development activities for all team members.
  • Handle personnel and associate relations issues.
  • Payroll budget management, workforce management and scheduling.
  • Facilitate effective communication and partnerships among the store team, district and regional management teams, and other partners within the company.

You'll Come With

  • 5+ years of Retail Management experience in a Big Box or Specialty environment
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule; including early mornings, nights, weekends, and holidays as required.
  • Ability to lift and move boxes weighing up to 40 lbs.
  • Experience utilizing scheduling and reporting computer software
  • Travel may be required from time to time.

Pay Range

  • Store Manager: $74,420 - $93.025 / annual
  • Operations/Service Manager: $23.20 - $30.95 / hour

Come join our team. You’re going to like it here!

You will enjoy a competitive wage, flexible hours, and an associate discount. Burlington’s benefits package includes medical, dental and vision coverage including life and disability insurance. Full time associates may also be eligible for up to 12 days of paid time off annually, up to 8 paid holidays, paid sick time in accordance with applicable law, and a 401(k) plan. We are a rapidly growing brand and provide a variety of training and development opportunities so our associates can grow with us.

Our store teams work hard and have fun together! Burlington associates make a difference in the lives of customers, colleagues, and the communities where we live and work every day. Burlington Stores, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer committed to workplace diversity.

Individual pay decisions will be based on a variety of factors, such as but not limited to, qualifications, education, job-related skills, relevant experience, and geographic location.

title: Sr. Product Manager
description:
KOKI Group is one of the world's leading manufacturers of power tools and accessories. Our group of brands includes HiKOKI, Metabo, Metabo HPT, Carat and Sankyo.
As an employer, KOKI awakens the skills that are in you. Whether you have a passion for sales, design, technology or marketing - at KOKI we offer you a variety of different areas and professions. Become part of our global team. Become a machine maker, set your impulses and start your career with us.

Senior Product Manager

Metabo HPT | North America

Position Summary

The Senior Product Manager is responsible for driving the strategic direction, growth, profitability, and market success of assigned Metabo HPT product categories. This role serves as the business owner for the portfolio, leading category strategy, product roadmaps, lifecycle management, and new product development initiatives based on deep customer understanding and market insights.

Working closely with global product development, engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, and customer-facing teams, the Senior Product Manager identifies unmet user needs, develops differentiated solutions, and ensures successful commercialization of products throughout their lifecycle. The role requires strong leadership through influence and collaboration, with no direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership & Business Performance

  • Own assigned product categories and deliver revenue, profitability, margin, and market share objectives.
  • Develop and execute category strategies and multi-year product roadmaps aligned with business goals and customer needs.
  • Optimize portfolio performance through pricing strategy, SKU productivity analysis, product rationalization, and lifecycle management.
  • Monitor category performance and recommend actions to maximize growth and profitability.
  • Build business cases and forecast opportunities for new product investments and portfolio expansion.

Product Development & Innovation

  • Lead new product initiatives from concept through commercialization, translating customer insights into compelling product solutions.
  • Identify unmet customer needs through market research, jobsite visits, distributor engagement, and end-user feedback.
  • Partner with global engineering and development teams to define product requirements, prioritize investments, and support successful product execution.
  • Drive innovation and differentiation across assigned categories while ensuring alignment with Metabo HPT brand positioning.
  • Participate as a key member of global product development and launch teams.

Market Intelligence & Strategic Planning

  • Conduct market research and competitive analysis to identify trends, growth opportunities, and emerging technologies.
  • Develop actionable insights from market data, customer feedback, and competitive intelligence.
  • Evaluate business opportunities across channels, segments, and customer groups to support strategic decision-making.
  • Align product strategies across Koki Holdings brands and global business initiatives where appropriate.

Commercialization & Launch Excellence

  • Lead launch planning and commercialization activities for new products across North America.
  • Monitor launch performance and implement corrective actions to achieve business objectives.
  • Collaborate with Marketing Communications to develop go-to-market strategies, positioning, product messaging, and sales enablement programs.
  • Partner with Supply Chain Management and channel teams to develop forecasts, inventory plans, and promotional programs.

Sales & Customer Engagement

  • Partner with Sales leadership and key customers to identify growth opportunities and support strategic account initiatives.
  • Participate in customer meetings, channel reviews, trade shows, and field activities.
  • Deliver product training and provide subject matter expertise to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support "train-the-trainer" initiatives to ensure organizational readiness and product knowledge.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Lead cross-functional project teams without formal authority to achieve business objectives.
  • Influence stakeholders across engineering, operations, sourcing, finance, marketing, and sales.
  • Drive alignment between global and regional teams on product priorities, timelines, and strategic initiatives.
  • Present business recommendations, portfolio strategies, and performance updates to senior leadership.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, Product Management, or related field required.
  • MBA preferred.

Experience

  • 4+ years of progressive product management, category management, or related commercial leadership experience.
  • Demonstrated success managing products throughout the full lifecycle from concept to launch and end-of-life.
  • Experience in power tools, accessories, construction products, industrial equipment, or consumer durable goods strongly preferred.
  • Experience managing large SKU portfolios and high-complexity product categories strongly preferred.
  • Proven record of developing product strategies that drive profitable growth.

Travel Requirements

  • Ability to travel up to 25%, including customer visits, trade shows, distributor meetings, manufacturing facilities, and collaboration with global teams.

Core Competencies

Business Acumen

  • Strong financial and analytical skills.
  • Expertise in forecasting, category management, pricing, and portfolio planning.
  • Ability to translate market opportunities into profitable business results.

Customer-Centric Leadership

  • Deep commitment to understanding customer needs and jobsite challenges.
  • Uses customer insights to drive product innovation and business decisions.

Strategic Thinking

  • Develops long-term product strategies aligned with organizational objectives.
  • Identifies future trends and emerging opportunities through data-driven analysis.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Successfully leads through influence without direct authority.
  • Builds productive partnerships across functions, regions, and stakeholder groups.

Product & Technical Expertise

  • Strong understanding of product lifecycle management and new product development processes.
  • Balances customer requirements, technical feasibility, and commercial objectives.

Results Orientation & Problem Solving

  • Demonstrates strong analytical capabilities and sound business judgment.
  • Effectively manages complexity and drives solutions in a fast-paced environment.

Communication & Influence

  • Excellent presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and business reporting tools.

Sounds like what you are looking for?
Then we look forward to receiving your online application, via our online career portal. We look forward to meeting you soon.

title: SDE
description:
Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.

We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.

Job Title

SDE

title: Vill du jobba med flytt? - Montrab söker extrapersonal
description:
Vill du ha ett aktivt jobb där ingen dag är den andra lik? Montrab Flytt söker nu extrapersonal som vill vara med och skapa smidiga flyttar och nöjda kunder – varje gång. Hos oss arbetar du i ett sammansvetsat team där tempo, samarbete och servicekänsla står i fokus. Arbetet är fysiskt och varierande – du hjälper privatpersoner och företag att ta nästa steg, oavsett om det handlar om en ny bostad eller en ny arbetsplats. Arbetet består av flyttuppdrag av olika slag, såsom packning, bärhjälp, transport och kontakt med kunder. Du jobbar tillsammans med kollegor där ni stöttar varandra och ser till att varje uppdrag genomförs på ett professionellt sätt. Vi söker dig som har:
  • B-körkort
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska i tal
  • God fysik och trivs med att arbeta fysiskt
C-körkort är meriterande. Som person är du ansvarstagande, punktlig och flexibel. Eftersom behovet kan uppstå med kort varsel är det viktigt att du har möjlighet att hoppa in när det behövs. Du har en positiv inställning, gillar att arbeta tillsammans med andra och bidrar till ett bra bemötande av våra kunder. Vi erbjuder ett fartfyllt och varierande arbete med bra kollegor och en härlig sammanhållning. Intervjuer sker löpande så vänta in med din ansökan! Montrab grundades 2010 med visionen om att bygga Sveriges främsta och bästa servicebolag inom flytt, städ, montering och förråd. Idag är vi väletablerade på marknaden med tusentals nöjda kunder över hela landet. Montrab har 70 medarbetare med kontor i Falun, Borlänge, Leksand och Sundsvall. Vi utför våra flyttjänster över hela Sverige – naturligtvis med fossilfria transporter. Idén bakom Montrab som arbetsplats är och har alltid varit schysta villkor och trygga anställningar. Det gör att vi kan behålla kompetent personal, leverera våra tjänster med högsta kvalitet och hela tiden jobba aktivt för att överträffa våra kunders förväntningar.

Team Global Express is seeking a Freight Investigator to join our Operations team at our Melbourne Airport location and play a vital role in investigating freight issues and ensuring customer enquiries are resolved promptly.

As a Freight Investigator, you will be responsible for locating and investigating freight discrepancies, resolving customer enquiries, and ensuring freight issues are addressed efficiently. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, utilise Salesforce to track and update enquiries, and contribute to process improvements to prevent recurring issues.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Conduct physical depot searches to locate freight and resolve customer enquiries.
  • Manage Salesforce activities, ensuring accurate updates and timely resolution.
  • Investigate issues involving re-delivery, re-direction, damaged freight, unidentified freight, and customer depot collections.
  • Collaborate with other depots and internal teams to investigate and resolve freight issues.
  • Maintain scanning compliance and ensure freight is processed efficiently.
  • Provide excellent customer service, demonstrating empathy and urgency in resolving enquiries.
  • Identify opportunities for process improvement and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement.

  • Technical Skills: Good computer literacy, proficiency in Microsoft Excel, and the ability to learn and navigate freight management, tracking and customer relationship systems. An understanding of freight processes and delivery operations is highly regarded.
  • Business Skills: Strong organizational skills, ability to work in a time-sensitive environment, and knowledge of freight flow and depot operations.
  • Human Relations Skills: Excellent communication skills, customer-centric mindset, ability to build effective relationships, and resolve conflicts quickly.

title: Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Bioinformatics & Research Software Engineering)

About This Opportunity

Join a focused, collaborative research environment at the forefront of synthetic biology and advanced biomanufacturing. As a Postdoctoral Research Fellow (Bioinformatics & Research Software Engineering) with the Integrated Design Environment for Advanced Biomanufacturing (IDEA Bio), you will build and lead computational infrastructure for the LEARN team, transforming fermentation, proteomics, metabolomics and ¹³C-labelling data into reproducible workflows, metabolic models and meaningful visualisations. Working alongside systems biologists, fermentation scientists and analytical chemists, you will help create open-source tools that support data-driven bioprocess optimisation and rational strain design, while contributing to research with direct academic and industry impact.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Research: Design, develop and maintain reproducible computational workflows for fermentation and multi-omics data, including pipelines for genome-scale metabolic reconstruction, curation, quality control, metabolic pathway visualisation and integration with constraint-based models, while contributing to high-quality publications, open-source software and research funding activities.
  • Research translation and collaboration: Work across disciplines and with academic and industry clients to translate complex fermentation and ‘omics data into robust analytical capability, supporting commercially relevant biomanufacturing and synthetic biology applications.
  • Supervision and Researcher Development: Contribute to the effective supervision and development of Honours and Higher Degree by Research students, as appropriate, and support capability-building through feedback, coaching and knowledge sharing.
  • Citizenship and Service: Develop and deploy computational pipelines that support in-depth phenotypic characterisation and timely client reporting, while contributing to partnerships, internal service activities and a collaborative culture aligned with UQ values.

This is a research focused position. Further information can be found by viewing UQ’s Criteria for Academic Performance.

For further details and full position description, please click here to view the information booklet.

About You

  • Completion or near completion of a PhD in bioinformatics, computational biology, systems biology, metabolic engineering or a related field, with a substantial software development component.
  • A working understanding of metabolism and metabolic pathways, with the capability to build, test and validate metabolic reconstruction and visualisation tools.
  • Demonstrated experience developing software tools for biological data analysis, supported by evidence such as public code repositories, released packages or software publications.
  • Proficiency in Python or a comparable language, together with sound software engineering practices including git version control, automated testing, packaging and documentation.
  • Demonstrated experience building automated and reproducible computational pipelines that can be maintained and used by others, using approaches such as Snakemake, Nextflow, containerisation or equivalent technologies.
  • Evidence of peer-reviewed research publications, together with strong organisational and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively in multidisciplinary environments, supported by strong interpersonal and communication skills.
  • An agile and adaptable approach, with the ability to independently identify challenges in ‘omics data analysis and develop bespoke solutions. Experience with constraint-based modelling, genome-scale reconstruction, metabolic pathway visualisation, biological databases, cloud or HPC environments, research data systems or ¹³C metabolic flux analysis would be highly regarded.

About UQ

As part of the UQ community, you will have the opportunity to work alongside the brightest minds, who have joined us from all over the world, and within an environment where interdisciplinary collaborations are encouraged. As part of our commitment to excellence in research and professional practice in academic contexts, we are proud to provide our staff with access to world-class facilities and equipment, grant writing support, greater research funding opportunities, and other forms of staff support and development.

The greater benefits of joining the UQ community are broad: from being part of a Group of Eight university, to recognition of prior service with other Australian universities, up to 26 weeks of paid parental leave, 17.5% annual leave loading, flexible working arrangements, access to exclusive internal-only vacancies, and genuine career progression opportunities via the academic promotions process.

title: Public Programs Assistant-On Call
description:
About Us

At The Huntington, we believe that having a team of diverse backgrounds and voices working together will enable us to support and promote the appreciation of the humanities, the arts, and botanical science. The Huntington is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing employment opportunities regardless of race, religious creed, color, national origin, disability, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other characteristic protected by local, state or federal law.

The Huntington

Founded in 1919, The Huntington is a collections-based research and educational institution open to the public, housing world-class library, art, and botanical collections. Its mission is to support research and promote education in the arts, humanities, and botanical science and to display and interpret its extraordinary resources for diverse audiences.

The Culture

Here we are committed to the highest of standards in all that we do – from preserving and protecting the collections, to exhibitions, educational and scholarly programming, visitor and reader services, and beyond. Achieving excellence across these pursuits requires a diversity of perspectives, expertise, experience, and methodologies.

At The Huntington, our organizational Culture is shaped by the following core values: Intellectual curiosity, Collaboration, Stewardship, Belonging, and Integrity.

  • Intellectual Curiosity: Knowledge, lifelong learning, and a spirit of inquiry are at the core of our mission and organizational culture.

  • Collaboration: Teamwork and a collaborative attitude are important at all levels of The Huntington. We foster relationships internally among our departments and externally with organizations throughout the community.

  • Stewardship: We are committed to the care and development of our collections, our financial and physical resources, our staff, and our community.

  • Belonging: We strive to attract and maintain a workforce of individuals with diverse talents, backgrounds, and perspectives. Our organizational culture promotes a sense of welcome, inclusion, and connection.

  • Integrity: We value respect and honesty, working to fulfill our mission with honor and ethical principles.

Job Description

About the Role

Working under the direction of the Associate Director of Public and Community Engagement, the Public Programs Assistant will join a team of educators committed to sharing The Huntington’s wide range of programming with multi-generational audiences.

Throughout the year, the assistant will support various public programs on weekends and evenings as needed.

In the summer, the Public Programs Assistant supports all aspects of The Huntington's annual Explorers Camp, including the logistics of classes, classroom setup and breakdown, and assisting with program registration and check-in. They will also be tasked with various administrative duties related to the club program. Explorers Camp runs for three weeks: July 12-16, July 19-23, and July 26-30. Hours are 7:30 a.m. – 1:30 p.m. or approximately 30 hours per week, with additional hours for staff training and camp breakdown.

S/he/they will demonstrate a background of working directly with people from diverse racial, ethnic, geographic, and socioeconomic backgrounds, using a welcoming, inclusive, and accessible approach.

Essential Duties – Regular

  • Prepare supplies for programs, set up and break down programs, and organize supplies post-program.
  • Check-in participants for classes and workshops.
  • Facilitate in-person activities at drop-in programs.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Essential Duties – Explorers Camp

  • Help with Explorers Camp daily set up and check-in.
  • Participate in daily evaluation of campers’ needs, classroom supplies, and teachers’ needs.
  • Help with daily restocking of classroom materials.
  • Assist with daily clean-up.
  • Communicate with Security team and other Huntington departments as needed.
  • Supports teachers in classroom instruction.
  • Accompany students and teachers to various galleries and gardens.
  • Assists with administrative duties.
  • May assist in the supervision of volunteers.

Candidate Requirements and Experience

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Excellent oral communication, customer service and organizational skills required.
  • Ability to be flexible required.
  • Interest in gardens, art, literature and history strongly desired.
  • Interest in hands-on learning with a range of children’s ages and abilities strongly desired.

Experience:

  • Experience working with children and families strongly preferred.
  • Must be highly organized and attentive to detail while remaining flexible.

Working Conditions

  • Many programs occur outdoors in all types of weather.
  • Considerable standing and sitting outdoors.

Compensation & Benefits

We provide competitive compensation, generous benefits and perks for all eligible employees including:

  • Pay Rate: $19.25/hr. Increases to $19.50/hr. after successful completion of the introductory period.
  • Medical, Dental, Vision
  • 403(b) retirement plan and matching retirement plan with an outstanding employer match
  • Hybrid remote work schedule available for applicable positions
  • Considerable paid time off, including annual leave, sick leave, and holidays
  • Discounts for staff in The Huntington Store and restaurants
  • Free admission to various museums and cultural institutions
  • Free passes each month to welcome family and friends to visit the grounds

The Application Process

Please submit a cover letter and CV/resume as a single PDF attachment.

You will have the opportunity to submit additional documents on the “My Experience” section of the application.

Lead the India execution of the annual compensation cycle, including modelling, calibration, risk adjustment, and communication. Oversee data integrity and reporting for the region, and collaborate with global teams on system enhancements and process automation to improve efficiency and accuracy.

Executive Compensation & Governance

Implement executive pay frameworks across India, tailoring them to local compliance and cultural nuances. Provide strategic input for Committee and Board reporting (as applicable), ensuring accurate India disclosures and alignment with global governance standards.

Benefit Strategy & Administration

Leads the delivery and governance of employee benefits programmes in India, ensuring they remain competitive, compliant, and aligned with the organisation's Total Rewards strategy. The role provides leadership and direction to the team responsible for the administration of medical, life, accident, wellness, retirement, gratuity, and statutory benefits, while overseeing vendor relationships, annual renewals, employee communications, and service delivery standards. Working closely with HR, Finance, Payroll, and external providers, the role monitors market developments, programme effectiveness, and cost trends to support continuous improvement and enhance the overall employee value proposition.

Payroll Governance

Leads the delivery and governance of payroll operations in India, ensuring accurate, timely, and compliant payroll processing through effective oversight of internal teams and third-party service providers. The role is responsible for establishing and maintaining robust payroll governance, controls, and operational standards, while partnering closely with Finance, HR, Tax, and external vendors to ensure compliance with applicable employment, tax, and statutory requirements. The role oversees payroll-related projects, process improvements, and vendor performance, while monitoring service delivery, regulatory developments, and operational risks to support a high-quality employee experience and the efficient operation of the organisation's Total Rewards framework.

Financial Management

Partner with Finance to ensure that the annual compensation expense remains within plan and annual forecasting incorporates compensation planning.

Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management

Partner with the HR Compliance Officer to ensure the accuracy of any reports or disclosures requiring compensation, benefit and payroll data. Maintain audit-ready documentation and lead responses to internal or external reviews, embedding robust governance and risk controls into all compensation processes.

Stakeholder Engagement & Advisory

Serve as the India subject matter expert for compensation, advising HR Talent Consultants and senior leaders on pay decisions and market trends, and act as a point of contact for compensation escalations, ensuring that escalations are handled in a timely and efficient manner. Influence stakeholders with clear insights on regulatory risks, competitive positioning, and pay-for-performance alignment to support strategic business objectives.

Team Leadership

Manage and develop the India compensation, benefit and payroll team, building expertise in compensation, executive pay, regulatory compliance, and analytics. Foster a culture of continuous improvement, development and capability building across compensation, benefit and payroll practices.

2. Competencies for Your Role – How Are You Expected to Behave?

1. Drive for Results

Pursues goals with energy and perseverance; rarely gives up before succeeding; works to overcome barriers and challenges to produce desired results; can be counted on to achieve or surpass goals; consistently a top performer among peer group; holds self and others accountable to consistently achieve meaningful results.

2. Collaboration

Develops good working relationships with others; recognizes and values differences; encourages an inclusive collaborative environment and open dialogue; puts team goals ahead of personal agendas; shares information openly and transparently; openly supports team members and their efforts.

3. Agility & Innovation

Demonstrates flexibility in dealing with fast-changing priorities and different or challenging situations. Helps others to continuously improve and achieve results. Explores multiple solutions to overcome obstacles. Anticipates future needs that may affect the team or the bank.

4. Talent Development & Engagement

Provides others with a clear direction; sets appropriate standards of behaviour; motivates and empowers others.

5. Risk Management

Appropriately identifies and manages risks, in compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, and with bank policies.

6. Ethics and Trust

Maintains high ethical standards; gains the confidence and trust of others through honesty, integrity and authenticity. Conducts themselves honestly and ethically; adheres to a core set of values and standards appropriate to the situation and acts accordingly; is consistent in own words and actions; inspires trust and respect by dealing openly with people; keeps confidences and admits mistakes.

7. Communication and Relationships

Excellent communication skills required to manage intra-company and external relationships. Ability to use insights and relationships to influence and deliver. The ability to build connections and partnerships within HR and beyond, through formal and informal channels, using considerable tact, diplomacy and people skills.

8. Inclusion

Sustain a culture of equity and inclusion in which diverse ideas, talent and perspectives are welcomed and encouraged.

9. Leadership

Management and leadership skills, with the ability to adapt and make things happen.

3. Qualifications and Experience Required to Perform Your Role

  • Generally, the role requires a degree or equivalent, but candidates with exceptional experience without a qualification to degree level will be considered.
  • Minimum of 12 years' experience in compensation, benefits and payroll management, preferably within financial services.
  • Demonstrable proven success in the design, operation and management of sales incentive plans.
  • Practical knowledge and understanding of key European compensation legal and regulatory topics applicable to credit institutions and investment firms.
  • Experience in developing, implementing, and managing risk and compliance associated with frameworks, policies, and procedures.
  • Proven track record of designing communications to senior executives and broader employee communications.
  • Demonstrable experience of interaction, influencing and reaching agreed-upon solutions at management and executive levels.
  • Proven track record of working independently on own initiative and delivering practical outcomes to a professional standard.
  • Proven resilience and ability to handle multiple priorities, meet deadlines whilst maintaining high work standards, with impeccable attention to detail in performance of all tasks.
  • Experience in managing different stakeholders including second and third lines of defense.
  • Collaborative approach with strong emphasis on delivery and execution.
  • Proven analytical skills.
  • Intermediate computer skills are needed, including experience with Microsoft Office applications.

title: Undersköterskor till avdelning 45/MOA
description:
Om oss

Vill du bli del av en stimulerande och utvecklande arbetsplats som genomsyras av arbetsglädje, stolthet och lojalitet? Då har du kommit rätt! Avdelning 45/MOA befinner sig just nu i ett utvecklingsskede och välkomnar dig som vill vara med i vår framtida utveckling. Vår enhet har många möjligheter!

Här arbetar fantastisk personal som har ett genuint intresse för patienternas välmående och som alltid behandlar patienterna med respekt. Vi behöver nya kolleger p g a pensionsavgångar.

Avdelning 45/MOA tillhör medicinkliniken och består av 2 delar med totalt 24 vårdplatser.

MOA är en medicinsk observationsavdelning, där patienter läggs in för observation. På MOA träffar du patienter med olika diagnoser. Vårdtiden är 24 timmar, därefter går patienterna antingen hem eller vidare till andra vårdavdelningar utifrån patientens behov.

Avdelning 45, bestående av hematologi som specialitet. Avdelning 45 har ett länsövergripande ansvar för dessa patienter. Avdelning 45/MOA befinner sig just nu i ett utvecklingsskede för framtidens specialiserade vård och uppdraget kan förändras utifrån patienternas behov.

Bemanningen på avdelningen består av sjuksköterskor och undersköterskor samt kökspersonal. Vi arbetar som team med fördelning att ha huvudansvar för några patienter, samt delansvar för övriga genom att arbeta som ett team tillsammans.

Om jobbet

Vi söker undersköterskor till tillsvidaretjänster.

Hos oss får du ett utvecklande arbete och trevliga kollegor. En avdelning där du har stor möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer framför allt att handla om omvårdnad av patienter, provtagning, assistera läkare/sjuksköterska, samt dokumentation. På avdelningen arbetar vi som ett team med stöd av avdelningschef. Avdelningen arbetar med att skapa en god arbetsmiljö så att du som undersköterska skall ha tid och möjlighet att fokusera på och planera dina arbetsuppgifter.

Tjänsterna är rotation, där ingår även nattjänstgöring.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som är utbildad undersköterska och extra meriterade är om du har akutsjukvårdsutbildning. För oss är det en självklarhet att du är noggrann i din undersköterskeroll och tar hand om patienterna utifrån deras olika behov och ger dem ett gott bemötande. Som person är du engagerad, initiativrik, stresstålig, flexibel, öppen för nya utmaningar och möjligheter samt har en förmåga att prioritera mellan olika arbetsuppgifter. Vi vill även att du precis som oss värdesätter ett arbete som präglas av det egna ansvaret, delaktighet och ett gott samarbete mellan kollegor och närmaste chef.

För att trivas hos oss är du en utvecklingsbenägen person som har intresse av att delta i olika förbättringsarbete och vill vara med och bidra till vårt goda arbetsklimat.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Om Region Blekinge

I Region Blekinge är vi 5 000 medarbetare som ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, folkhälsa, regional tillväxt, infrastruktur, kollektivtrafik, kultur och bildning. title: Inspector
description:
Position Summary:

The Inspector position will perform construction inspection services on various types of construction projects to ensure project compliance with contract documents and applicable regulations/codes. Inspection projects involve various types of construction including site civil land developments, roadways, bridges, airport infrastructure, grading, asphalt/concrete paving, underground utilities, water/wastewater treatment plants, storm drainage, intersection improvements, sidewalks, multi-use pathways, traffic signals, etc. Inspection projects may include other components within the disciplines of architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, environmental, and/or industrial, etc. Inspection projects may include new construction work, maintenance work, rehab work, renovation work, and/or repair work for various types of clients including municipalities, State DOTs, airports, turnpike associations, private developers, private corporations, etc.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review project plans, specifications, contract documents, approved submittals and shop drawings, geo-tech reports and any other applicable project reporting prior to start of construction to gain clear understanding of project
  • Ensure all materials and equipment being incorporated into the project have an approved submittal or shop drawing prior to being installed on project
  • Monitor and ensure that project construction activities being performed, and materials/equipment being incorporated into the project are compliant with the project plans, specifications, contract documents, approved submittals & shop drawings, geo-tech reports, and applicable regulations/codes
  • Notify the contractor and Project Engineer or Project Manager of non-conforming work
  • Prepare and maintain daily inspection reports, utilizing established reporting format, for the construction activities inspected
  • Prepare and maintain weekly inspection summary reports, utilizing established reporting formats, for the week’s construction progress on the project
  • Measure and track completed quantities and installed pay items, utilizing established tracking methods (including Excel spreadsheet templates) or creating quantity tracking methods or Excel spreadsheets as necessary. Perform computations with formulas, plot data and draw simple curves/graphs as necessary. Verifies plan quantities
  • Track and document contractor contract time through established reporting format
  • Take photographs (pre-construction, during construction, post-construction) of the project construction progress, site conditions, installed materials/equipment to create a chronological documented visual history of the project
  • Ensure onsite materials testing is scheduled, observe onsite materials testing, ensure onsite materials testing is compliant with the project specifications, and ensure material testing results/reports are distributed to the applicable project team members, as determined by the Project Engineer or Project Manager. Perform field material testing and sample collection when necessary
  • Produce redline drawings by tracking/logging redline changes on electronic set of plans
  • Review Contractor pay estimates to verify quantities match Inspector’s summary of quantities log
  • Attend construction project meetings including but not limited to pre-construction meeting, progress meetings, safety meetings, substantial/final completion walk-through meetings, other meetings as determined by the Project Engineer or Project Manager
  • Produce and maintain punch lists of remaining and/or deficient work on the project
  • Utilize an established electronic filing system and project folder tree to save and maintain all inspection project records and reports
  • Ensure that Inspection Quality Control Checks are completed on each project per the established Inspection Quality Procedures
  • Drive to assigned project sites and project related meetings daily
  • May assist other PEC Team Members in the field, while performing project-related services such surveying, geotechnical soil and materials investigations, etc.
  • Other projects and responsibilities may be added at the company’s discretion

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

  • Knowledge of methods, practices, principles and techniques of engineering disciplines (civil, architectural, structural, mechanical, electrical, environmental, industrial, etc.) and field engineering services (inspection, field/lab materials testing, survey, geotechnical engineering, construction management) pertaining to construction inspection projects
  • Knowledge of city/state/federal codes, ordinances, and regulations pertaining to construction inspection projects
  • Proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams) and PDF Editor (Bluebeam)
  • Proficiency in using computers, tablets, and cell phones
  • Proficiency in using construction inspection tools (measuring wheel, measuring tape, levels, etc.); Knowledge of GPS data collectors, laser levels, range finders preferred
  • Skill in developing/maintaining cooperative and professional working relationships with team members, managers, clients, public, etc.
  • Skill in performing quality control initiatives and taking prompt action for problem resolution
  • Communication (written & oral): Ability to communicate clearly and effectively; Ability to listen and understand directions, information, and ideas when presented by others; Ability to handle a variety of issues with tact, diplomacy and in a confidential manner
  • Ability to plan/organize daily work routine and to establish priorities for the completion of required work within required timeframes
  • Ability to work 50+ hours per week, including nights and weekends when necessary
  • Ability and willingness to accept occasional out-of-town projects if needed

Education and Experience:

  • Current/Valid Driver’s License required
  • KDOT inspection experience preferred
  • High School Diploma or General Education Degree or higher required
  • An A.S., B.S. or B.A. degree in an appropriate construction-related, technical, or engineering field, preferred
  • Experience in field construction inspection or demonstrated equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience in a related construction, technical, or engineering field, preferred

License and Certification:

  • The following KDOT CIT certifications are preferred: Basic Inspection (BI), Asphalt Paving Inspection (API), Concrete Paving Inspection (CPI), Structures Inspection (STR), Nuclear Gauge (NUC), American Concrete Institute Concrete Field Tester (ACI CF), and Construction Storm Water (CSW)


Work Location

  • Remote (Western Kansas) - Candidates preferred to be based in or around the Garden City or Hays areas.

Work Environment:

PEC values a healthy work-life balance, and we focus on working efficiently and collaboratively to ensure quality and productive work. The work environment is business casual, friendly, respectful, and team oriented with daily peer interactions regarding work progress, client needs and project-specific technical issues. We strive to create an enjoyable work environment with support and opportunities for positive career growth. Much of the work will be conducted primarily outdoors and occasionally inside buildings or other structures that may include exposure to inclement weather, heat, humidity, noise, hazard, atmospheric conditions, bodies of water, moving mechanical parts, electrical equipment, fumes or airborne particles, toxic or caustic waste depending on project requirements. The position requires mobility. Duties involved require moving materials that weigh up to 10-35 pounds on a regular basis, occasionally moving materials that weigh up to 50-75 pounds, and carrying up to 25 pounds over rough terrain for 100 yards. Manual dexterity and coordination are required over 50% of the work period while operating equipment such as computer keyboard, mouse, calculator and similar machines. There will be frequent, talking, hearing, standing, moving, walking, stooping, kneeling, crouching, crawling, reaching, handling, grasping, feeling, balancing, coordination, sitting, and operating a company vehicle.

Supervisory Responsibilities (if there are no supervisor responsibilities, put N/A):

  • N/A

title: Material Planner
description:
Job Description:

Waarom kiezen voor ons

Neem je carrière in eigen hand bij Trouw Nutrition, een Nutreco-bedrijf. Ons doel, Feeding the Future, verenigt ons in één team dat samenwerkt om een betekenisvolle, wereldwijde impact te realiseren voor toekomstige generaties. Het versterken van en investeren in onze mensen en onze planeet staat centraal in alles wat we doen. Daarom word je, wanneer je bij ons komt werken als Material Planner, begeleid en toegerust om een waardevolle carrière vol mogelijkheden op te bouwen.


Wat ga je doen

  • Jij bent de onmisbare schakel tussen planning, productie en supply chain.
  • Je analyseert en plant grondstoffenbehoeften en vertaalt productieplannen naar concrete orders.
  • Je optimaliseert voorraden en bewaakt beschikbaarheid, zodat productie altijd kan doorgaan.
  • Je neemt deel aan het S&OP-proces en speelt in op veranderingen in vraag en aanbod.
  • Je komt proactief met verbetervoorstellen voor processen en voorraadbeheer.

Wie zoeken wij

  • Minimaal 1 jaar ervaring in een vergelijkbare functie.
  • Sterke analytische vaardigheden en passie voor cijfers.
  • Goede beheersing van Excel (bijvoorbeeld draaitabellen en formules).
  • Vloeiend in Nederlands én Engels.
  • Eigenschappen: zelfstandig, stressbestendig, oplossingsgericht, nauwkeurig.

Wat bieden wij

Bij Trouw Nutrition maak je deel uit van een internationale organisatie met een sterke lokale aanwezigheid en een duidelijke missie. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waar samenwerking, ontwikkeling en innovatie centraal staan.


Daarnaast bieden wij:

  • Een uitdagende functie op onze locatie in Gent.
  • Een fulltime dienstverband van 39 uur per week.
  • 20 vakantiedagen aangevuld met 6 ADV-dagen.
  • Een werkomgeving waarin jouw ideeën en verbetervoorstellen gewaardeerd worden.
  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerk gedurende enkele dagen per week, volgens de geldende bedrijfsrichtlijnen.
  • Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie.

Als onderdeel van Nutreco word je lid van de SHV-familie, een diverse groep bedrijven met een wereldwijde voetafdruk. Je krijgt toegang tot een breed netwerk van expertise, kennisdeling en internationale carrièremogelijkheden binnen een organisatie die bekendstaat om haar stabiliteit en langetermijnvisie.

Hoe en waarom meer te weten te komen

Wil jij deel uitmaken van een team waar klantgerichtheid, samenwerking en innovatie hand in hand gaan? Zoek je een functie waarin je niet alleen klanten ondersteunt, maar ook actief kunt bijdragen aan procesverbeteringen en de verdere digitalisering van onze organisatie? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.


#OwnIt

Our organisation:

Trouw Nutrition is the global leader in innovative feed specialties, premixes and nutritional services for the animal nutrition industry. Trouw Nutrition provides species-specific nutritional solutions consisting of feed concepts, products and nutritional know-how. The unique combination of products, models and services Trouw Nutrition offers, boosts productivity and supports animal health through all life stages, contributing to our customers' peace of mind. Trouw Nutrition's nutrition solutions have met the need of farmers and home-mixers, feed producers, integrators and distributors. Trouw Nutrition has locations in 25 countries and around 5000 employees. Our mission is Feeding the Future.

title: Clinical Data Programmer
description:
Clinical Data Programmer (SAS Programmer)

ICON is a global healthcare intelligence and clinical research organisation united by a mission to bring new medicines and treatments to patients faster.


As a values-driven organisation, integrity, collaboration, agility, and inclusion are at the heart of how we work and interact with each other, customers, patients and suppliers.


.

The Clinical Data Programmer is responsible for the development, delivery, and support of data integration solutions that transform clinical trial data collected in Electronic Data Capture (EDC) systems into standardized formats for consumption by downstream systems, including ICON's Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS), investigator payments platform, and other operational applications within the ARCADES ecosystem.


This role is primarily focused on Patient Data Integration (PDI), a core component of ICON's ARCADES platform. ARCADES leverages standardized programming frameworks, templates, and coding methodologies to transform and consolidate clinical trial data into reusable formats that support multiple downstream systems and business processes.


The Clinical Data Programmer works closely with project teams, Data Management, CTMS analysts, and other stakeholders to develop mapping specifications, build integration solutions, validate deliverables, and ensure the accurate and timely delivery of subject data for full-service clinical trials.


Key Responsibilities

Data Integration Programming & Delivery

  • Develop, maintain, validate, and support Patient Data Integration (PDI) solutions for assigned studies.
  • Utilize standardized SAS programming templates and frameworks to transform raw EDC data into machine-readable XML outputs.
  • Review and interpret clinical trial data structures, specifications, and study documentation to ensure accurate data integration.
  • Perform the setup, maintenance, monitoring, and support of programming deliverables, automated schedules, and related systems.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve programming issues, data discrepancies, and system integration failures.
  • Conduct validation and quality control activities to ensure deliverables meet established standards and business requirements.

Specification Development & Collaboration

  • Participate in the development and review of data mapping specifications for clinical trial integrations.
  • Collaborate with project teams, CTMS analysts, Data Management, and other stakeholders to define study-specific integration requirements.
  • Translate approved mapping specifications and business rules into programming solutions.
  • Review visit mappings, attribute mappings, and integration logic to ensure alignment between source and target systems.
  • Provide input on integration design, feasibility, and implementation approaches during study startup and maintenance activities.

Team Support & Quality

  • Participate in peer review and quality control activities to ensure high-quality programming deliverables.
  • Share technical knowledge and best practices with other Clinical Data Programmers.
  • Provide support and guidance to less experienced team members as appropriate.
  • Work collaboratively with team members to meet departmental objectives and project timelines.
  • Support the Clinical Data Programming Lead and contribute to team initiatives as required.

Required Experience & Qualifications

Experience

  • 2+ years of experience in clinical data programming, clinical data integration, or a related clinical systems role.
  • SAS programming experience, including development, testing, validation, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience working with raw clinical trial data, including SAS datasets and EDC exports.
  • Experience developing, reviewing, or implementing data mapping specifications.
  • Understanding of data transformation, data integration, and system-to-system interfaces.
  • Ability to manage multiple studies, priorities, and timelines simultaneously.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex data issues.
  • Experience participating in quality review, validation, and testing activities.
  • Experience contributing to process improvement, standardization, or automation initiatives.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with Medidata Rave and/or other leading EDC systems.
  • Experience supporting integrations between clinical systems.
  • Familiarity with XML generation and structured data exchange methodologies.

Key Competencies

  • Strong technical and analytical skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate across multiple functional groups and stakeholders.
  • Strong learning agility and willingness to adopt new technologies and processes.
  • Commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Education

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Life Sciences, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.


Employment with ICON is contingent upon having the legal right to work in the country where the role is based.


Rewards & Benefits

ICON offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and career development.


Benefits may include:

  • Competitive base salary and performance related incentives
  • Health and wellbeing programmes including medical, dental, and vision coverage where applicable
  • Retirement and pension plans
  • Life assurance and disability coverage
  • Employee assistance programmes and wellbeing resources
  • Learning and development opportunities through structured training and career pathways

Benefits may vary depending on role and location.


Visit our careers site to read more about the benefits ICON offers.


Inclusion and Accessibility

ICON is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive and accessible workplace where everyone feels valued and supported.
