title: Partner Technical Architect - Agentforce
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

The Experience

Salesforce is hiring a hands-on Partner Technical Architect to help top SI partners build and ship production-grade Agentforce solutions at scale.

In this builder role you will work directly with Partner FDEs to turn ambiguous enterprise AI problems into working solutions, reference implementations, and evaluation harnesses, then use what you learn to raise quality and partner-led outcomes.

The best candidate is someone who can build, debug, explain trade-offs, and then package what they learned so many partner teams learn from it.

Salesforce and Agentforce experience are valuable, but they are not the whole profile. We are looking first for strong engineering judgment, applied AI fluency, builder instincts, and the ability to ramp quickly into the Salesforce platform.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

  • Prototype quickly to validate ideas, expose platform gaps, and unblock first-of-kind implementation risks.
  • Build reference implementations, starter kits, demos, field kits, and evaluation harnesses that partners can fork, extend, and deploy.
  • Convert field lessons into durable reusable assets: code, diagrams, checklists, decision trees, implementation notes, and architecture guidance.
  • Review partner Agentforce architectures for agent design, retrieval strategy, tooling, guardrails, observability, cost, security, and production readiness.
  • Coach Partner FDEs and architects through design clinics, office hours, portfolio reviews, and targeted technical walkthroughs.
  • Translate recurring field blockers into clear product and engineering feedback.
  • Help partners connect technical architecture choices to delivery quality, customer outcomes, and consumption economics.



You're Our Person If...

  • You have shipped or seriously prototyped real software, agents, automations, internal tools, or technical demos.
  • You can show your work: GitHub repos, demo apps, notebooks, architecture docs, eval harnesses, demo orgs, open-source contributions, or equivalent artifacts.
  • You learn new platforms by building with them, not by waiting for perfect documentation.
  • You can move fast without losing production instincts around safety, reliability, observability, and maintainability.
  • You naturally extract patterns from one-off work and turn them into reusable assets for others.
  • Experience building with LLMs, agents, RAG, tool use, workflow orchestration, or automation systems.
  • Ability to reason about multi-agent, human-in-the-loop, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Comfort debugging agent behavior: traces, logs, failure modes, tool calls, bad context, bad data, latency, and user experience gaps.
  • Practical understanding of prompt design, retrieval quality, evaluation, hallucination risk, guardrails, and cost/performance trade-offs.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with engineers, architects, product teams, partner leaders, and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong systems thinking across APIs, data flows, identity, security, integration, observability, and operational handoff.
  • Strong product sense: you can distinguish a platform gap, a configuration issue, a partner delivery issue, and a pattern worth codifying.
  • Comfort operating in regulated or complex enterprise environments where governance, trust, and delivery risk matter.



Even Better If...

  • Hands-on Salesforce, Agentforce, Data Cloud, Apex, Flow, LWC, MuleSoft, or multi-cloud architecture experience is preferred.
  • Salesforce certifications are helpful, but not required if you can demonstrate strong builder evidence and rapid platform learning.
  • We value candidates who can learn the Salesforce stack quickly and translate broader engineering/AI experience into partner-ready Agentforce patterns.
  • Experience working with system integrators, partner delivery teams, or complex enterprise implementation programs.
  • Published technical work: open-source projects, internal platform docs, talks, blog posts, or reusable architecture patterns.
  • Experience creating maturity models, readiness checks, production-readiness scorecards, or technical review frameworks.
  • Familiarity with consumption economics, agent cost modeling, TCO, or outcome-based delivery models.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

title: Senior Professional, Communications, CEMEA
description:
The NIKE, Inc. Communications team builds authentic connections with diverse audiences through the lens of sport and innovation. We create premium brand stories, strengthen Nike’s reputation and brand equity, and engage employees, media, athletes, partners and consumers.

We’re looking for an experienced communications professional to join our CEMEA (Central Europe, Middle East & Africa) Communications team, helping shape how Nike shows up across this diverse and dynamic region.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You’ll be part of the Nike CEMEA Communications team, based across EHQ and Dubai, reporting to the Director of Communications, CEMEA.

You’ll work closely with EMEA and Global Communications, Brand Marketing and Sports Marketing, as well as external communications agencies across key CEMEA markets including Türkiye, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, South Africa and Nigeria.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

We’re looking for a communications professional who combines strategic thinking, creativity and strong execution. You understand how to build relevant, engaging stories for different audiences and can navigate a complex, fast-moving region with confidence.

A strong connection to and cultural understanding of the CEMEA region is important, helping you shape communications that are locally relevant and resonate with audiences across different markets and cultures. You bring fresh thinking to how Nike stories and experiences come to life across different platforms and channels. A passion for sport and a strong understanding of sport culture is a plus.

YOU’LL BRING:

  • Strong experience developing and executing communications strategies and seasonal plans.
  • Experience working across CEMEA and a strong understanding of the region is highly preferred.
  • Strong writing and storytelling skills, with the ability to create relevant, audience-led communications.
  • Experience working with internal stakeholders, media, athletes and external communications agencies.
  • The ability to influence and build relationships across a complex, matrixed organization.
  • Strong project management skills across planning, execution, budgets and agency management.
  • A creative, solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to bring new approaches to storytelling.
  • The ability to navigate complex and sensitive topics with sound judgement.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

You’ll develop and execute communications strategies and seasonal plans across CEMEA markets and sports, including Training, Football, Running and Nike Sportswear, working closely with local communications agencies to bring the work to life.

You’ll act as a regional communications expert, partnering with the CEMEA Brand team on key projects and helping shape communications approaches that are relevant to local audiences and cultures. You’ll manage multiple agency partners across the region, from briefing and planning through to execution and recap.


You’ll also partner with EMEA and Global Communications to connect CEMEA into relevant Geo and Global stories and moments, while advocating for the region and highlighting its importance to Nike’s brand and business.

Applications will be accepted until 10th November. We encourage external candidates to apply as soon as possible, as the posting may close earlier if we receive a sufficient number of applications.

Job Description:

The opportunity


As an IT Cybersecurity Engineer, you will play a key role in designing, implementing, and maintaining secure industrial network infrastructures. Working within SCADA and critical infrastructure environments, you will help protect systems, networks, and connected assets from cybersecurity threats while ensuring operational reliability and compliance with industry best practices.


How you'll make an impact:


  • Design and develop secure network architectures for SCADA systems, incorporating advanced cybersecurity controls and best practices.
  • Evaluate, assess, and strengthen the security of all connections to the SCADA network.
  • Monitor, validate, and manage third-party security patches while ensuring system reliability and operational continuity.
  • Implement cybersecurity features and controls provided by device and system vendors.
  • Establish and maintain robust security controls over any medium that may provide backdoor access to the SCADA network.
  • Deploy and manage internal and external intrusion detection and protection systems across the SCADA environment.
  • Perform Vulnerability Assessment and Penetration Testing (VAPT), as well as technical security audits of SCADA devices, networks, and interconnected systems to identify and mitigate security risks.
  • Conduct physical security assessments of remote sites and connected infrastructure to evaluate and enhance overall security posture.
  • Maintain and continuously improve test environments, ensuring software and hardware remain up to date and aligned with current and future operational requirements.
  • Manage backup and image handling activities for servers and workstations, including patch management and system recovery processes.

Your Background:


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, network security, or industrial control system (ICS/SCADA) environments.
  • Basic knowledge of C/C++ programming is considered an advantage.
  • Previous experience working on SCADA or industrial automation projects is a plus.
  • Solid understanding of wireless networks, web application security, SQL injection, cryptography, penetration testing, vulnerability management, security risk assessment, risk identification and mitigation techniques.
  • Knowledge of encryption standards and security technologies, including firewalls, intrusion detection and intrusion prevention systems.
  • Willingness to travel up to 10% of the time.
  • Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.

title: Elkonstruktör till AFRY i Piteå – starta din karriär med talangprogram
description:
Elkonstruktör till AFRY i Piteå – starta din karriär med talangprogram Är du nyexaminerad inom elteknik, elkraft eller automation och vill kickstarta karriären på ett av Sveriges mest populära teknikkkonsultbolag bland ingenjörer? Nu söker vi en elkonstruktör till AFRY i Piteå som vill utvecklas inom industri, elkraft och automation tillsammans med erfarna kollegor. Talangprogrammet: den bästa starten på din ingenjörskarriär Du blir en del av Framtidens talangprogram i samarbete med AFRY, ett program som är utvecklat för att ge dig mer än ett jobb. Redan från dag ett arbetar du i riktiga projekt tillsammans med några av branschens mest erfarna specialister. Under det första året kombinerar du konsultuppdrag med ett skräddarsytt utvecklingsprogram med:
  • Utbildning och kontinuerligt stöd i takt med att du tar större ansvar
  • Mentorskap och coachning
  • Ett nätverk av andra nyutexaminerade talanger från hela Sverige
Målet är att du ska växa till en självständig konsult och specialist. Oavsett om du siktar mot att bli teknisk expert, projektledare eller framtida ledare får du en stark grund att bygga vidare på. Om rollen Som elkonstruktör blir du en del av AFRYs division för el och automation och arbetar i projekt mot både mindre och större industrikunder. I början jobbar du nära erfarna kollegor på kontoret i Piteå, så att du får en trygg introduktion. Rollen passar dig som vill kombinera teknik, problemlösning och samarbete. Det här kommer du att göra
  • Konstruera ställverk och styrskåp för industriella verksamheter
  • Ta fram elkonstruktioner för apparater och instrument
  • Arbeta i AutoCAD och Eplan
  • Delta i projektering av industriella elanläggningar
  • Samarbeta med kunder, leverantörer och kollegor
  • Bidra till tekniska lösningar som stödjer industrins utveckling och hållbarhet
Det här söker vi hos dig
  • Relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom elkonstruktion, elteknik, elkraft, elektroteknik eller automation
  • Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, i tal och skrift
  • B-körkort
Meriterande: erfarenhet från processindustri eller annan industriverksamhet. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och kvalitetsmedveten. Du trivs i samarbete, är nyfiken på att lära dig nytt och uppskattar en miljö där kunskapsutbyte är en naturlig del av vardagen. Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, eftersom mångfald bidrar till bättre lösningar och starkare team. Teamet du kommer in i Du blir en del av ett team på cirka tio konsulter inom el och automation på AFRYs kontor i Piteå. Teamet är hjälpsamt, öppet och prestigelöst, med stort fokus på samarbete, kunskapsdelning och trivsel. Ni arbetar med både interna och kundnära projekt. Om AFRY AFRY är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag och är rankat som en av Sveriges mest populära arbetsgivare bland ingenjörer. AFRY har över 19 000 medarbetare och kontor i 50 länder. De är experter inom inom områdena infrastruktur, industri och energi. De arbetar över hela världen för att skapa hållbara lösningar för kommande generationer där de har en uttalad strategi inom just hållbarhet och transformativa segment. Om Framtiden Framtiden är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor på åtta orter i Sverige. Vi finns för att fler ska älska måndagar! Inom Tech People är vi experter på ingenjörer, med roller för både juniora och seniora profiler inom IT och teknik. Inom Business People är vi experter på ekonomer på alla erfarenhetsnivåer, från specialister, chefer och interimsledare till juniora talanger inom ekonomi/finans, HR, lön och administration. Vår rekrytering bygger på evidensbaserade metoder för en rättvis och träffsäker matchning. Vi gör skillnad genom att hjälpa människor att hitta rätt jobb och rätt kollega. I denna tjänst påbörjar du din resa som anställd hos Framtiden, vilket innebär att du får fullt stöd och resurser från vårt team. Sedan har du möjlighet att gå över och bli anställd direkt hos AFRY. Rekryteringsprocessen: CV-granskning → telefonavstämning → kompetensbaserad intervju → referenstagning → slutintervjuer Villkor Start: mars 2027 · Heltid, vardagar · Placeringsort: Piteå Vi arbetar löpande med urval, och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum – vänta inte! Skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

MUFG is seeking an Associate for Business Management and Planning (First Line Controls) to join its esteemed Transaction Banking team in London. This position situates you at the heart of a highly regarded organisation, where your proficiency in risk management, governance, and operational controls will be both recognised and cultivated. You will operate within an environment that prioritises collegiality, knowledge exchange, and personal advancement. The role affords exposure to international banking operations, complemented by flexible working arrangements and continuous professional development. For those aspiring to combine responsibility with teamwork and contribute meaningfully to the integrity of business operations, this opportunity is unparalleled.

What you'll do:

In the capacity of Associate, Business Management and Planning (First Line Controls), you will assume a pivotal role in upholding the integrity of Transaction Banking operations. Your daily activities will encompass close collaboration with colleagues across departments such as Risk, Compliance, Audit, Finance, and other support functions. You will ensure that internal controls remain robust through meticulous first line control testing across various jurisdictions. By preparing comprehensive reports for senior management on control effectiveness and operational risks, you will contribute significantly to ongoing improvements in business processes. Participation in key projects and audits will allow you to influence the future direction of Transaction Banking. Through regular engagement with stakeholders across all lines of defence, you will foster enhanced business practices that mitigate operational risk.

* Serve as a valued member of the Business Management and Planning team, providing assurance to senior management regarding the effective operation of internal controls in accordance with established policies and procedures.

* Oversee and review first line control testing across multiple teams with diligence, identifying findings from control assurance activities and assisting in educating the business on internal controls.

* Support the team head by preparing materials for senior management reporting on control effectiveness, including risks or issues.

* Assist in the delivery of initiatives, and audits for Transaction Banking as required, collaborating with broader business teams to facilitate change.

*Provide guidance, oversight and challenge to ensure adherence to internal operational risk and governance frameworks.

* Update and maintain first line control reports, management information, and dashboards so that accurate information is captured, monitored, and reported as necessary.

* Develop a comprehensive understanding of core systems and procedures within Transaction Banking to assess control robustness effectively.

* Engage with internal stakeholders across all three lines of defence to enhance business practices and mitigate operational risk.

* Act as a central contact point for stakeholders across Transaction Banking including Risk, Compliance, Internal Audit, Finance, and other support functions.

What you bring:

Your established experience in governance, risk management or compliance will be fundamental for excelling as an Associate Business Management and Planning (First Line Controls). You bring a dependable approach to supporting first line defence activities within regulated environments. Your ability to coordinate cross-functional reviews reflects your commitment to communal achievement. With comprehensive knowledge of banking products across multiple jurisdictions and familiarity with intricate regulatory frameworks, you are well-prepared for this position. Your interpersonal skills foster harmonious relationships among diverse teams while your structured methodology ensures precision in reporting. You excel when managing substantial workloads under pressure due to your composed demeanour. Your educational background underpins your technical competencies while your proficiency in Microsoft Office tools enhances your efficiency. Above all else, your empathy towards colleagues combined with attention to detail renders you an invaluable asset who contributes positively towards nurturing robust internal controls.

*Degree level or equivalent work experience.

* Demonstrable experience in governance, risk management, compliance, audit or operational risk disciplines is indispensable for success in this role.

* Proven ability supporting or representing the first line of defence in risk and control matters within a regulated financial services environment.

* Established experience coordinating cross-functional reviews, assessments or oversight processes that enhance organisational effectiveness.

* Comprehensive knowledge of banking products with experience operating across multiple jurisdictions is required.

* Thorough understanding of governance frameworks including risk management, internal controls, issue management and oversight processes.

* Business acumen combined with market insight enables you to comprehend complex financial environments.

* Exceptional communication skills enable you to engage effectively with colleagues at all levels.

* Structured problem-solving skills coupled with meticulous attention to detail enable you to deliver reliable outputs consistently.

The inclusive environment ensures everyone feels connected—whether through communal projects or inter-personal networks—making it effortless for you to build enduring relationships while advancing your career. The focus on nurturing talent means you will always have access to resources that facilitate both professional and personal growth. This is more than merely a workplace; it is a community dedicated to shared success where kindness and loyalty underpin every interaction.

What's next:

If you are prepared to advance your career within a supportive team environment where your expertise is genuinely valued—submit your application now!

Apply today by clicking on the link provided.

description:
Are you ready to bring your innovative perspective and creative skills to ASSA ABLOY Opening Solutions? Join our team in Stockholm, Sweden and enjoy a collaborative culture that empowers you to build a career you can be proud of.

What would you do as our Strategic Purchaser

As Strategic Purchaser, you will be responsible for indirect procurement at Nordic level, ensuring we source the goods and services we need from the right suppliers, at the right price and on the right terms. A key part of the role will be managing IT sourcing and procurement activities, including the sourcing of IT-related products, services, software, hardware, and technology solutions that support the business. You will own relationships with key suppliers and take full responsibility for selected purchasing categories, working closely with internal stakeholders and our EMEIA procurement team. Your work will have a direct impact on profitability, operational efficiency, and the smooth running of our business.

You will report to the to the Indirect Materials and Procurement Excellence Manager.

You would also:

  • Assess, select and develop suppliers in line with local, EMEIA and ASSA ABLOY Group requirements, including supplier segmentation and risk management.
  • Lead tendering processes and negotiations, and create, maintain and update supplier contracts.
  • Follow up on supplier performance through KPIs and regular supplier meetings.
  • Plan and implement procurement strategy for indirect categories, monitor prices and market changes, find new suppliers and deliver on targets for savings, supplier reduction and payment terms.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, EMEIA Category Managers and other divisions, and step in for colleagues when needed.

The skills and experience you need

We are looking for someone who:

  • Holds a university degree in business, engineering or a related field; training or education in procurement or logistics is a strong advantage.
  • Has solid experience in procurement, supplier cooperation and negotiations, ideally from a manufacturing environment with exposure to production and product development.
  • Possesses good knowledge of sourcing, manufacturing and order-to-delivery processes, as well as an in-depth understanding of suppliers' cost structures.
  • Has strong skills in MS Office, especially Excel and handling large data sets.
  • Possesses knowledge of ISO 9001, 14001, 18001 and 27001 standards and how they apply to supplier decisions.

You are a confident negotiator with a strong commercial mindset, and you know how to influence and present your ideas to both suppliers and internal stakeholders. You are independent and structured, able to plan and prioritise your own work, and you take ownership of your decisions and the risks that come with them. Building good relationships comes naturally to you, and you enjoy working with people across functions, divisions and countries. As you will be working closely with international suppliers and colleagues across Europe, you are fluent in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.

What we offer

We’re passionate about providing great opportunities and benefits, so you can continue and progress a lifelong career with us – here’s what we have to offer:

  • Learning and career development opportunities, whether it’s online learning, management training or enhancing your skills
  • A competitive salary and incentive schemes

Let’s create a safer and more open world - together!

description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote position. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Germany

About the team

The Business Consultant is a key contributor to the success of our sales objectives, providing market domain expertise and product knowledge during all pre-sales engagements.

Works in tandem with the sales organization focusing on all activities that will ensure target sales achievement and total customer satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Assist in identifying the customer’s needs and key stakeholders in the purchase decision.
  • Qualifying prospects according to Kinaxis’ capabilities and applicability.
  • Construct and deliver custom demos, utilizing customer provided data that addresses the customer’s urgent needs. This may involve the configuration of unique Maestro resources (workbooks, task flows, scorecards, etc.).
  • Where necessary create and deliver supplementary presentation materials in support of customer specific demonstrations.
  • Consistently follow the sales process which includes ensuring that key deliverables are delivered.
  • Proactively provide effective feedback to product management on product gaps and improvement areas.
  • Produce sales transition documentation for Professional Services, and participate in “Sales to Services” transition meetings to ensure proper handoff of newly won accounts to the deployment team.
  • Communicating product improvements and recommendations that originate in the field.

What we are looking for

  • Minimum 8 years of supply chain management, implementation or enterprise pre-sales experience and domain expertise in one or more of the 5 key industries served (Automotive, High-Tech, Pharma/Lifesciences, Aerospace and Defense, CPG)
  • Knowledge of supply chain fundamentals, industry best practices, and available solutions in the SCM / ERP space.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, facilitation, and time management skills
  • Adaptable with strong initiative
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and perform well in a fast paced environment
  • Ability to work independently within a team environment
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com.

Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Sr. Product Security Response Engineer
description:
Sr. Product Security Response Engineer

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

About our cybersecurity team

Are you ready to make an impact at one of the world’s leading tech companies? HPE’s Cybersecurity team is where you can do just that! We’re looking for a dynamic and experienced GRC specialist to join our Cybersecurity team. If you’re passionate about shaping the future of cybersecurity and ready for your next challenge, we’d love to hear from you.


As a Cybersecurity GRC Platform Architect, you will design, configure, integrate, and enhance the technology capabilities supporting cybersecurity governance, risk, compliance, and third-party risk management. You will translate complex requirements into scalable workflows, reliable data, actionable reporting, and practical automation.

You will independently deliver complex platform solutions, recommend technical approaches, and partner with cybersecurity, risk, compliance, policy, and IT teams. You will also establish reusable technical patterns and provide guidance to platform users and less-experienced contributors.


What You’ll Do

Responsibilities:

Product Security Response

  • Owning and driving complex product vulnerability cases from initial intake through technical resolution and disclosure readiness, maintaining clear status, evidence, decisions, ownership, and next actions.
  • Triaging vulnerability reports for credibility, scope, affected products or versions, exploitability, potential customer impact, duplication, and completeness of supporting evidence.
  • Reproducing reported vulnerabilities and validating proofs of concept in collaboration with product engineering, penetration testing, security research, and other technical specialists.
  • Coordinating technical investigations with product teams, resolving information gaps, aligning on responsibilities, and keeping cases moving toward remediation and disclosure milestones.
  • Assessing vulnerability severity using applicable scoring methods and available technical evidence while documenting assumptions, rationale, and unresolved questions.
  • Supporting the development, review, and technical quality of customer-facing security advisories, vulnerability disclosures, remediation guidance, and related content.
  • Engaging internal stakeholders and external vulnerability reporters or coordination partners to clarify findings, gather evidence, communicate status, and support coordinated disclosure.
  • Applying knowledge of CVE, CWE, CVSS, MITRE, NVD, FIRST, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices to support accurate classification and reporting.
  • Monitoring case queues and emerging demand, identifying cases at risk of delay, and helping maintain consistent execution across PSRT operating areas.
  • Contributing across diverse product environments and adapting to differences in architecture, development practices, and organizational ownership.

Vulnerability Investigation and Security Validation

  • Performing hands-on technical analysis to reproduce vulnerabilities, validate exploitability, determine affected configurations or versions, and assess potential impact.
  • Reviewing proof-of-concept code, logs, source code, configurations, system behavior, product architecture, and other evidence relevant to vulnerability investigations.
  • Developing or adapting scripts, test harnesses, proofs of concept, and technical methods needed to validate findings and support remediation decisions.
  • Conducting targeted security testing when vulnerability reports require deeper technical analysis or independent validation beyond the information submitted.
  • Partnering directly with product engineering teams to understand product design, validate findings, support remediation, and perform retesting as appropriate.
  • Producing clear technical findings that describe evidence, affected components, reproduction steps, security impact, and actionable remediation guidance.
  • Defining investigation and testing approaches based on product architecture, threat models, reported vulnerabilities, known attack techniques, and areas of highest security risk.
  • Distinguishing confirmed vulnerabilities from false positives, unsupported claims, configuration issues, or findings that require additional evidence.
  • Escalating investigations to appropriate specialists when cases require expertise beyond the role’s technical domain.

PSRT Process and Capability Improvement

  • Identifying recurring vulnerability patterns, operational friction, process gaps, and opportunities to improve PSRT guidance, playbooks, templates, and technical practices.
  • Contributing reusable scripts, tooling, integrations, and automation that reduce repetitive work and improve the consistency or quality of vulnerability response.
  • Helping improve case documentation, evidence requirements, review practices, and quality checks across the response lifecycle.
  • Supporting improvements to vulnerability intake, triage, reproduction, severity assessment, remediation coordination, advisory preparation, and case closure.
  • Capturing reusable techniques and lessons learned so future investigations can be completed more efficiently and consistently.
  • Using approved automation or AI-assisted capabilities where they provide practical value while validating outputs and preserving accountable human judgment.
  • Measuring the effectiveness of process or tooling improvements and adjusting approaches based on operational results and team feedback.

Technical Collaboration and Leadership

  • Leading significant vulnerability investigations or focused technical workstreams while remaining directly involved in hands-on execution.
  • Providing technical guidance to engineers, case managers, and product teams on vulnerability analysis, evidence quality, severity assessment, remediation, and disclosure readiness.
  • Reviewing technical findings, investigation approaches, and security communications for accuracy, completeness, and actionable guidance.
  • Communicating complex findings, risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations clearly to engineering teams, security specialists, product leaders, and other stakeholders.
  • Building productive working relationships across product engineering, PSRT, penetration testing, security research, and adjacent security teams.
  • Mentoring less-experienced team members and sharing practical knowledge that strengthens the broader team’s vulnerability-response capability.
  • Representing PSRT in cross-functional discussions and helping stakeholders reach evidence-based technical decisions.

What you need to bring:

Education and Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, cybersecurity, information systems, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Typically 8 to 10 years of relevant experience in product security response, application security, vulnerability management, penetration testing, incident response, security engineering, or closely related technical work.
  • Demonstrated experience independently managing complex vulnerability investigations across multiple products, platforms, or technical environments.
  • Strong ability to analyze vulnerability reports, proof-of-concept code, logs, source code, configurations, system architectures, and other technical evidence.
  • Hands-on experience reproducing vulnerabilities, validating exploitability, assessing impact, and supporting remediation or retesting.
  • Working knowledge of CVE, CWE, CVSS, MITRE, NVD, FIRST, and coordinated vulnerability disclosure practices.
  • Experience authoring or reviewing security advisories, vulnerability disclosures, technical findings, or remediation guidance.
  • Experience with Python or another scripting or programming language used to support security analysis, testing, or workflow automation.
  • Familiarity with APIs, source control, CI/CD pipelines, containers, cloud environments, or modern software delivery practices.
  • Strong knowledge of common software weaknesses, secure coding practices, threat modeling, and secure development lifecycle principles.
  • Ability to lead significant technical work, exercise independent judgment, coordinate across teams, and influence decisions without relying on formal authority.
  • Strong analytical, technical writing, and communication skills across engineering, security, product, and leadership audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working in a PSIRT or PSRT supporting enterprise technology products or services.
  • Experience engaging vulnerability reporters, product engineering teams, disclosure partners, or vulnerability-coordination communities.
  • Demonstrated experience planning and performing targeted penetration tests or security assessments in support of vulnerability investigations.
  • Experience investigating vulnerabilities affecting applications, services, APIs, cloud environments, firmware, operating systems, networking products, or supporting infrastructure.
  • Experience developing scripts, test harnesses, proofs of concept, integrations, or workflow automation for security operations.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability management platforms, case-management systems, security-advisory publishing processes, or machine-readable advisory formats.
  • Experience supporting high-impact or broadly disclosed vulnerabilities involving complex product ownership or cross-organizational coordination.
  • Relevant security, cloud, application security, or software engineering certifications are valued but not required.
  • Complex vulnerability cases are technically sound, well documented, and moved forward with clear ownership, timely stakeholder engagement, and evidence-based decisions.
  • Product teams receive actionable findings, credible severity and impact assessments, and practical support through remediation and retesting.
  • Security advisories and vulnerability disclosures are accurate, consistent, complete, and ready for customer communication.
  • Investigations distinguish genuine product risk from false positives, incomplete reports, unsupported claims, and configuration-specific issues.
  • PSRT casework becomes more consistent and efficient through improved playbooks, templates, technical methods, tooling, and knowledge sharing.
  • Automation reduces repetitive work and improves response quality without weakening technical validation, traceability, or accountability.
  • Cross-functional investigations remain coordinated, risks and delays are identified early, and cases continue progressing toward resolution.
  • Less-experienced team members grow through practical mentoring, technical review, and shared investigation experience.

Accessibility


HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.


Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

title: Senior Associate – Enterprise Strategy – Healthcare
description:
We Do Consulting Differently


The Integrated Health Solutions (IHS) practice at Berkeley Research Group (BRG) provides end-to-end advisory support to healthcare providers, payers, investors, and other stakeholders navigating complex strategic, operational, financial, and clinical challenges. Led by seasoned healthcare executives, operators, and clinicians, IHS partners with organizations to drive sustainable performance improvement and long-term growth through strategic growth design, operating model transformation, AI and digital enablement, clinical quality and patient care optimization, and revenue strategy—helping clients build resilient, future-ready healthcare enterprises in an increasingly complex environment.

Our four core service offerings include:

  • Business Transformation Advisory
  • Margin & Operational Improvement
  • Clinical & Quality Transformation
  • AI & Digital Solutions

Business Transformation Advisory partners with healthcare organizations to define enterprise-wide strategy and align financial, clinical, and operational priorities to long-term objectives. This work spans enterprise and service line strategy, population health and value-based care models, long-range financial forecasting, and regulatory and alternative payment methodologies—helping leaders make informed decisions that drive sustainable growth, resilience, and system-wide performance improvement.


Position Summary:

The Senior Associate will play an integral role on project workstreams, serve as a key analytical engine for client engagements, and help shape strategic insights and recommendations. This role requires strong analytical capability, structured thinking, and comfort interacting with client stakeholders. The Senior Associate will support enterprise-level strategy across both payer and provider clients, including growth strategy, partnership design, and integration models.


Candidates should bring experience in healthcare consulting or a similar strategic environment, with enough maturity to independently drive workstreams while still operating within a team-based model.


Travel Requirements:

Willing to travel consistently (50%), depending on project requirements and client expectations, is required for this position.


Location:

Associates, Senior Associates, and Consultants within the IHS practice must be based in Baltimore, MD; Chicago, IL; New York, NY; or Washington, DC. When client or project requirements do not require travel, they will work with colleagues from their designated office on a hybrid basis.


Responsibilities:


  • Assess enterprise-level payer and provider strategies, including market positioning, growth opportunities, product portfolio strategy, and organizational prioritization.
  • Conduct robust market, financial, and competitive analyses across health plans, health systems, CINs, ACOs, and emerging care delivery models.
  • Translate complex data, trends, and regulatory dynamics into actionable insights that inform strategic recommendations.
  • Evaluate, design, and support the implementation of strategic partnerships between payers and providers, such as:
  • ACOs and risk-bearing entities
  • Clinically integrated networks
  • Joint ventures, delegated arrangements, and provider enablement models
  • Narrow networks and performance-aligned partnerships
  • Conduct readiness assessments, capability evaluations, and synergy identification for integration or partnership opportunities.
  • Frame ambiguous strategic problems, develop hypotheses, build analytical plans, and test insights through structured analysis.
  • Support development of enterprise strategies such as:
  • Market entry or expansion
  • Health plan and provider growth strategy
  • Enterprise partnership roadmaps
  • Value-based care strategy
  • Contribute to practice area development in enterprise strategy, payer–provider integration, and partnership models.
  • Support proposal development, thought leadership, and business development activities.
  • Mentor Associates and Senior Associates in project delivery and analytic approaches.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree (MBA, MHA, MPH, MPP) preferred.
  • 3-5 years of relevant experience in healthcare consulting, strategy, enterprise planning, or payer/provider operations.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare markets, including payer and provider economics, value-based care, regulatory dynamics, and competitive positioning.
  • Demonstrated experience leading workstreams or major analytic components of strategy engagements.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, and structured problem-solving.
  • Excellent communication skills, with ability to translate complex analytical findings into compelling narratives.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and comfort engaging with client stakeholders at multiple levels.
  • Ability to operate independently with sound judgment while contributing to a collaborative team environment.

Consultant Salary Range: $85,000 – $115,000 per year

Job title and compensation to be determined based on qualifications and experience.


Candidate must be able to submit verification of his/her legal right to work in the U.S., without company sponsorship.



About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

description:
Please note, this site is only for external candidate applications. If you currently work for Lloyds Banking Group please apply via the internal career site.

Please note: In order to complete an apprenticeship there needs to be a significant learning need. You need to consider your previous qualifications or significant relevant work experience which may mean you cannot proceed with this application.

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Job Description Summary

Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the programmes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Our apprenticeship programmes may close early if we receive a high number of applications, so it’s best to apply as soon as you can.

If you have any questions, please do contact the team at lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com


Job Description

Duration: 5 years

Salary: £27,400

Location: Bristol

Start: September 2027

Qualifications: You’ll work towards the Level 4 Internal Audit Practitioner qualification.


See the small stuff? Shape the big stuff

If you’re big on small details and love solving problems, welcome to your happy place.

At Lloyds Banking Group, Audit is about keeping our business secure, fair and future‑ready. We protect the Group’s assets, reputation and sustainability. And as an apprentice you’ll be part of it from the moment you join.

Making a real impact

Audit’s job is to make sure our risk management, governance and internal controls are rock‑solid. We’re here to keep the business and 28 million customers safe.

That means spotting risks before they become problems, making recommendations that matter, and helping keep the Group fair, trusted and future‑proof.

And here’s something that might surprise you. Our Audit team has its own industry‑leading Data Science unit. We’re experimenting with AI and embedding it into daily audit life. And as an apprentice, you’ll get hands‑on time with these tools, learning how tech is transforming the profession.

Learn it. Do it. Own it

Audit isn’t about sitting on the side lines. We don’t give you a clipboard. Instead, within three months you’ll be working on live audits - observing, contributing, and taking on cases of your own.

As you progress, you’ll spend time in areas like:

  • Business Banking
  • Insurance
  • Technology

Plus, a 6‑month placement outside Audit, an opportunity to work alongside teams like Finance, Tech, Risk, and Customer Services - giving you a 360° view of how we get things done. These will be defined during your programme.

Your licence to ask “Why?”

This is a 5-year apprenticeship programme based in Bristol or Edinburgh. You’ll start by working towards the Level 4 Internal Audit Practitioner qualification. Once completed, you’ll have the opportunity to progress to higher-level professional study, building your expertise and working towards becoming a Chartered Auditor.

In your first 18–24 months, you’ll work towards your Level 4 Internal Audit Practitioner qualification, supported through a mix of structured learning and workshops covering areas such as:


  • Corporate Governance and Risk Management
  • Internal Audit Planning
  • Interpersonal Skills

Your future, fully funded

You’ll earn a competitive salary from day one. Your learning - all of it - tuition, exams, study materials, professional memberships - is covered.

With a team of around 300 audit pros working across a Group of 70,000+ colleagues, the career opportunities are endless.

By the end, you won’t just understand Audit - you’ll be ready to shape it. You’ll have the skills, qualifications and confidence to take your career anywhere. And you’ll have played a key role in Helping Britain Prosper.

Requirements

What you’ll need

  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old on 1st September 2027
  • GCSEs at grade 4 – 9 in both Maths and English (achieved)
  • 3 A levels at grade BCC (these grades can be predicted, but any offer made to you will be conditional upon successful achievement of these qualifications)

These grades can be predicted, but any offer made to you will be conditional upon successful achievement of these qualifications

Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to five years.

Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.

Location

This apprenticeship is based in Bristol, and you will be expected to work from your main office location throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.

About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 15th December.

Our roles generate a lot of interest and occasionally we need to close for applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!


If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days (Monday – Friday).


What happens next?
Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in February→ Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

Fresh Start Foods Canada Ltd.

Join one of the BEST teams in the Industry

Join one of the BEST teams in the Industry

title: Applied Data and AI Apprentice - Edinburgh
description:
Please note, this site is only for external candidate applications. If you currently work for Lloyds Banking Group please apply via the internal career site.

End Date

We support flexible working – click here for more information on flexible working options

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working

Prior to submitting your application, please visit our early careers website to find out more about the programmes we offer and the recruitment journey: www.lloydsbankinggrouptalent.com.

Job Description

Duration: 18 months

Salary: £27,400
Location: Edinburgh

Start: September 2027
Qualification: Level 4 Data Analyst Apprenticeship with BPP.

Your data journey starts here. Show us what you’re made of

At Lloyds Banking Group, data isn’t just numbers on a screen. It’s the fuel for every decision we make, every problem we solve, every idea that takes us forward.

We’re the UK’s biggest digital bank, with 23 million customers logging in, tapping and scrolling every day. And with £3bn a year going into cloud, AI and analytics, we’re serious about data shaping the future.

As a Data Apprentice, you’ll learn how to tame big, messy datasets, spot patterns no one else can see, and turn them into insights that make banking smarter, safer and simpler.

Along the way, you’ll dive into:

  • SQL and advanced data joins (yes, the fun kind)
  • Predictive modelling & forecasting (basically, time travel with stats)
  • Data visualisation & storytelling (making numbers talk)
  • Analytics lifecycles & data democratisation
  • Statistical programming languages
  • Building data products people actually use

By the end, you won’t just know data. You’ll live and breathe data.

The impact you could make

  • Spot patterns that stop fraud before it happens
  • Help millions of customers make smarter money choices
  • Build dashboards that leaders can’t live without
  • Make data accessible, ethical and useful for everyone

Your skills toolkit

You’ll master:

  • SQL, Python and other stats superpowers
  • Visualisation that makes people go “ohhh, now I get it”
  • Forecasting and modelling
  • AI literacy and applied analytics
  • Turning complexity into clarity

Support in your corner

We’ll set you up to shine with:

  • Blended learning: real projects + classroom theory
  • Time carved out just for your development
  • A mentor, a manager and a buddy (because no one should debug alone)
  • A community that shares your passion and goals

Your future. Fully funded

We’ll cover your salary and fully fund your qualifications, setting you up for success with a level 4 apprenticeship in Data and AI. You’ll gain hands-on experience working with some of the UK’s largest and most complex datasets and develop versatile skills that open doors across analytics and AI.

Requirements

What you need to apply

  • You’ll need to be at least 18 years old by the end of February 2028
  • Nat 5 Maths & English at grades A-C (achieved)
  • 4 Highers BBCC (these grades can be predicted, but any offer made to you will be conditional upon successful achievement of these qualifications)

These grades can be predicted, but any offer made to you will be conditional upon successful achievement of these qualifications

Important information

An additional requirement for the apprenticeship position is that you must currently possess a valid Right to Work in the UK. Your visa end date must extend beyond the duration of the apprenticeship programme, which will last up to five years.

Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.

Location

This apprenticeship is based in Edinburgh, and you will be expected to work from your primary office location throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.

About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We offer reasonable workplace adjustments for colleagues with disabilities, including flexibility in office attendance, location and working patterns. And, as a Disability Confident Leader, we guarantee interviews for a fair and proportionate number of applicants who meet the minimum criteria for the role with a disability, long-term health or neurodivergent condition through the Disability Confident Scheme.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 12th January.

Our roles generate a lot of interest, and occasionally we need to close applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!

If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days (Monday – Friday).

What happens next?
Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in March → Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. With us you'll have a key role to play in shaping the financial services of the future, whilst the scale and reach of our Group means you'll have many opportunities to learn, grow and develop.

We're focused on creating a values-led culture and are committed to building a workforce which reflects the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Together we’re building a truly inclusive workplace where all of our colleagues have the opportunity to make a real difference.

title: Principal Engineer, Product Security
description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. With revenue of more than $11 billion in FY25, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible. Learn more at and on LinkedIn and X.

Principal Engineer, Product Security


The Role

Analog Devices is seeking a Principal Engineer, Product Security Champion to drive product security through the full product lifecycle, from early definition through release and post-release support. This role sits inside the core security enablement team and owns day-to-day product security leadership for programs. The Security Champion serves as the central point of accountability for product security decisions, ensures the required security assurance evidence is created, works with the Product Security Assurance team and the assigned security architect, and acts as the product contact for post-release security incident response activities. The role also helps align product security goals with customer expectations, applicable standards, implementation feasibility, and long-term product support needs in alignment with the program owner.


Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Own the product security workstream for the program and serve as the primary point of accountability for security across the product lifecycle. Products in scope are: digital and mixed signal chips, modules, subsystems and software.
  • Define and maintain the product security posture, including product-level security requirements, objectives, and supporting assumptions.
  • Ensure the evidence is created to demonstrate that security assurance practices are followed during development.
  • Act as the main point of contact with the Product Security Assurance team and the assigned Security Advisor for development-phase security questions and assurance activities.
  • Shape security requirements, architecture decisions, threat analysis inputs, and security IP selection.
  • Align with the product owner, product architect, software teams, and engineering stakeholders so security decisions fit the product scope, architecture, cost, schedule, and intended use.
  • Engage key customers when needed to validate security objectives, threat assumptions, and expected security posture for the target application.
  • Drive compliance planning and execution for applicable standards, regulations, certifications, and Secure Development Life Cycle deliverables.
  • Oversee security implementation, secure development practices, verification activities, provisioning-related security actions, and product security continuity after release.
  • Act as the product point of contact for post-release security incident response activities and organize response actions when vulnerabilities or incidents arise.
  • Maintain continuity of security through product lifetime, including support for remediation, maintenance obligations, and end-of-life security activities.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Completion of security training or certification
  • Demonstrated ~10 year experience to secure development processes, product security implementation, and security assurance practices in product programs following established standards.
  • Working knowledge of relevant standards, regulatory frameworks, and industry security practices applicable to the target market (e.g. IEC62443, ISO21434, US FDA, EU CRA).
  • Strong understanding of security requirements and how they apply at the product level: hardware System-on-Chip architectures, Secure Boot, Hardware cryptography, Embedded Software security. 3+ years of experience in silicon SoC security architecture and design preferred.
  • Solid technical background spanning software, hardware, network and cloud security attached to embedded or connected products.
  • Ability to work effectively across product, architecture, software, hardware, quality, and assurance teams.

Additional Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • Ability to explain security decisions clearly and build trust with internal stakeholders and customers.
  • Ability to translate market, customer, and regulatory inputs into actionable product security requirements and plans.
  • Ability to manage long-lived security ownership, including compliance evidence, certifications, and post-release maintenance expectations or products.
  • Comfort operating in cross-functional product teams where security cuts across architecture, implementation, verification, manufacturing, and operational support.

Location: Hartselle, AL - METCO

From a small family business to a multi-billion dollar global company, Sonoco has been changing the face of products and packaging since 1899 — all while keeping the heart of “People Build Businesses” alive. Our talented people are at the core of our growth, constantly reinventing the Sonoco wheel with brilliant solutions every year. Today we are a world leader in global packaging solutions with diversified operations in over 34 countries. We're extremely proud of our portfolio of brands, our achievements in sustainability and industrialization and the groundbreaking work accomplished by our people.


Reporting to the Plant Engineer, the Industrial Maintenance Reliability Technician (IMRT) is responsible for supporting the achievement of maximum plant reliability by performing maintenance tasks and activities as an owner of Sonoco’s Maintenance Excellence Process. Maintenance and reliability best practices will be utilized to maintain equipment in optimum condition, maximize availability, and support technological advancement. The IMRT will use advanced multi-craft training and knowledge to perform proactive equipment/process/system maintenance; troubleshoot failures, perform highly effective root cause analysis, and make repairs in a manner that minimizes the potential for repeat failures; and actively participate in Sonoco’s continuous improvement effort.


Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Understand and comply with safety policies and procedures. Perform all tasks in a safe manner. Set the standard for safe behavior. Look out for your co-workers’ safety. Be an active owner of the safety improvement process by identifying and reducing safety risks and hazards in behavior, equipment, and processes.
  • Proactively maintain, improve, install, and troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, robotic/automation, hydraulic, pneumatic, and steam (location specific) systems/processes/equipment.
  • Install/troubleshoot/maintain AC and DC drives/motors.
  • Effectively perform troubleshooting activities on PLC programs. As required by location, modify and/or write PLC programs.
  • Weld as required by location.
  • Fabricate and install various electrical, piping, pneumatic, and mechanical equipment as required by location.
  • Perform shop work using machining and shop equipment (lathes, drills, milling machines, etc) as required by location.
  • Safely and effectively troubleshoot and situationally assess equipment issues/failures. Implement the most applicable, effective corrective action based on circumstances.
  • Conduct thorough root cause analysis and follow up to ensure the optimum corrective action has been taken. Ensure corrective actions minimize the risk of repeat failures. Assist in the development / modification and implementation of procedures / activities to drive to zero failure.
  • Drive the proactive maintenance process in the effort to eliminate unplanned failures. Effectively perform Preventive / Predictive Maintenance tasks / procedures. Participate in the development / improvement / optimization of Preventive / Predictive Maintenance procedures and tasks.
  • Communicate effectively with operations personnel to identify and resolve abnormal or degraded equipment conditions that could negatively impact safety, quality, or productivity. Includes helping develop operator skill sets to a level that allow for asset ownership and care at the operator level.
  • Effectively document all maintenance activity in the Computerized Maintenance Management System to build an accurate database of asset history.
  • Assist in identifying opportunities to improve equipment inspection, lubrication and hard to access areas for new equipment installs and for current equipment.
  • Identify and utilize the proper tools for each individual job.
  • Meet or exceed housekeeping and 5S standards in all areas where maintenance work is performed, personal ownership areas, and all areas owned by the Maintenance Department.
  • The IMRT Senior role will be responsible for serving in a Lead or Maintenance Planner role as required by the location.

Skills/Knowledge/Abilities:

  • Demonstrated competency in the skills laid out in the competency matrix for each of the IMRT classifications (I,II,III, & Sr).
  • Technical skills and knowledge to Proactively maintain, improve, install, and troubleshoot and repair mechanical, electrical, robotic/automation, hydraulic, pneumatic, and steam (location specific) systems/processes/equipment.
  • Ability to read and understand mechanical, pneumatic, hydraulic, and electrical (including PLC program logic) schematics.
  • Working knowledge of and experience in performing electrical work in compliance with NFPA 70E – Standard for Electrical Safety in the Workplace
  • Welding (Skill level to be determined by specific Sonoco location)
  • Machining / Fabrication (Skill level to be determined by specific Sonoco location)
  • Proficiency with standard computer programs (Microsoft Office Suite)
  • Proficiency in using a CMMS
  • Ability to adapt to and help lead change
  • Ability to master and employ new skills as required by the introduction of new processes, technology, etc and/or as part of the required skill development progression within the maintenance organization and / or advancement opportunities
  • Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively in a team environment
  • Strong troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills
  • Strong proactive maintenance and reliability thought process

Minimum education required:

  • High school diploma (preferably with a vocational focus)

Preferred Education:

  • Associate’s degree in Mechatronics, Industrial Maintenance, or related technical field

Minimum Experience (Preferred)

  • IMRT I – 4+ years
  • II – 6+ years
