title: Network Technical Lead
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

The Role

Infrastructure Architects are the key link between Kyndryl and our clients. You’re in a technical leadership role, uniting and guiding stakeholders from clients, governance, and project executives to delivery and sometimes even the vendors who work with the client. You’ll be there from the start of a project — understanding what’s needed and figuring out the best technical solution. And you’ll be there at the finish, delivering the right product on time and within budget.

As an Infrastructure Architect, you’ll draw upon the full breadth of your talent and experience. This is a technical leadership role, so we want you to bring your vision, knowledge, and leadership to each project. To the client, you’re the subject matter expert – consulting early, gathering inputs, understanding what they need from our solution. You define what Kyndryl can do to meet this solution. You design the best solution for the job. And finally, you’re the tech leader for implementation.

At Kyndryl we support all major cloud platforms, so you’ll get the chance to use everything you know – and then some. You’ll also become expert at knowing when and how to call on other SMEs outside your wheelhouse. Thinking your way around pre-existing limitations will grow your creativity and flexibility. You’ll learn a lot here, and if you want to work toward certifications there are plenty of opportunities.The rewards for all this are many. You’ll get to influence, create, and deliver something from start to finish. You will have the power to delight our clients.

Your future at Kyndryl
This role opens the door to many career paths, both vertical and horizontal, and there may be opportunity to travel. It’s a great chance for database administrators or other techs to break into the cloud. It’s also a solid path to become enterprise or chief architect or a distinguished engineer! Whatever you see for yourself, you’ll find the opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Experience

  • Solid understanding of Data Center mainly Systems, Storage, Networking & Security, Application & Databases
  • Understanding of Systems and Solutions Architecture
  • Hands-on experience & learning with Data Center technologies, Cloud Software, and interoperability

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

  • MS Project or other Project Management software
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to interact confidently with stakeholders of all levels


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Warranty Team Leader with German
description:
Job Description

Why join Rolls‑Royce?

At Rolls‑Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls‑Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.


Role Purpose

The Warranty Manager leads a warranty claims team within GBS Poland, accountable for the accurate, timely and compliant processing of warranty claims and for the service provided to claimants and stakeholders. The role combines team leadership with hands-on operational delivery, ensuring consistent quality, adherence to warranty policies and controls, and sound decisioning within delegated authority. The role is designed to take on additional warranty activity and to lead the team through that expansion with an initial focus on Corrections in Field (CiF).


Role Description

The role leads the day-to-day running of the team, balancing workload, monitoring performance against service levels and quality standards, and acting as the senior point of judgement and escalation. The Warranty team lead reviews, validates and approves claims and engaging the relevant retained and technical team where needed.

The Warranty team lead manages team performance and governance with the retained warranty organisation, workforce allocation, identifies and escalates blockers, builds capability, and drives continuous improvement (including automation and AI). A light element of transition enablement is expected as activity and scope move into the team, but the role is fundamentally a team leadership role.


Key Duties & Responsibilities

Team leadership & development

  • Lead, develop and support the team, setting objectives, allocating workload and managing day-to-day performance
  • Manage team performance and workforce allocation across the claims workload, balancing capacity, absence and priority
  • Coach and build capability; cross-train team members for resilience and cover
  • Foster a customer-focused culture that protects the company's reputation through responsive, high-quality claim handling

Operational delivery, judgement & intervention

  • Review and validate incoming claims for completeness, coverage and claimant eligibility
  • Exercise delegated authority to approve, partially approve or decline claims within agreed limits, and refer technical or higher-value claims to the retained reviewer or approval authority
  • Apply judgement on the right channel and level of intervention for each issue (resolve in the system, contact the partner, involve the retained lead, or handle directly) and escalate appropriately
  • Intervene to drive consistent decisioning across the team, addressing over-lenient or over-strict handling
  • Act as first point of escalation for complex or contested claims

Service performance, governance & controls

  • Own team service, quality, throughput and backlog performance; manage team performance and governance to the retained warranty organisation
  • Identify and escalate blockers promptly, proposing solutions
  • Ensure internal controls, segregation of duties and data-safeguarding / export-control requirements are consistently applied
  • Identify and implement continuous-improvement, automation and AI opportunities to improve accuracy, efficiency and cost

Stakeholder management & reporting

  • Act as the primary point of contact for warranty claim matters, liaising with claimants, Finance, technical and engineering teams
  • Provide regular reporting on team performance, governance, blockers and initiatives to the retained warranty organisation
  • Manage internal and external stakeholder relationships, including escalations

Qualifications & Experience

Education

  • Higher education; ideally, this would be a degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Supply Chain or a comparable field is preferred; equivalent relevant experience, including a strong hands-on or technical background, is equally valued

Experience

  • Prior warranty / claims experience (able to perform the work, not only manage it)
  • Minimum 2–3 years' leadership or supervisory experience and 7+ years' overall working experience
  • Warranty, claims, after-sales service or comparable transactional processing experience, including review, decisioning and case management
  • Experience of managing service levels, quality and performance
  • Must be familiar with SAP; experience working with an SAP-driven system is required with specific warranty / claims tools a nice-to-have
  • Experience of working in international or multinational teams within a matrix organisation
  • Experience in a service-delivery or GBS / shared-services environment is a bonus, not a requirement

Language

  • English fluent and German (business conversational B2/C1) mandatory.

Skills & Competencies

  • Operational leadership: planning, workload allocation, performance management and team development
  • Strong at team reporting and governance, performance management, workforce allocation, and identifying and escalating blockers
  • Sound commercial and technical judgement to assess and decision claims within delegated limits
  • Strong knowledge of warranty policies, processes and controls
  • Judgement on channel and level of intervention, distinguishing self-serve, partner contact, escalation or direct handling
  • Structured, detail-oriented execution of recurring, controlled processes
  • Confident use of warranty / claims-management and reporting tools, with strong Excel and PowerPoint
  • Problem solving root-cause analysis of quality, service-level or backlog issues, with consistent, defensible decisions
  • Accountability and ownership of team performance and claim outcomes
  • Strong collaboration and communication with claimants, Finance and technical teams in an international environment
  • Openness to occasional travel, approximately once or twice a year

What do we offer:
• Private healthcare and group life insurance
• Annual bonus
• myBenefit platform/subsidy for Multisport cards
• Internet and electricity allowance for remote work
• Increased funding for the Employee Capital Plans (PPK) program; Rolls Royce Sp. z o.o. contributes 3% to this program
• Additional vacation days based on length of service with the employer
• Hybrid work model (2 days in the office / 3 days from home)
• Work in a modern office located in the Krakow centre – the Unity Tower (ul. Lubomirskiego 20)


The Kraków Rolls Royce Global Capability Centre represents an exciting new chapter in the growth of Rolls Royce Group Business Services. Designed to support global operations and employee services, the Centre is a key hub for enabling operational efficiency and strengthening global business processes. It delivers exceptional services across finance, procurement, HR, Data Analytics and Service Management.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.
Rolls Royce are committed to being a respectful, inclusive, and non-discriminatory workplace where individuality is valued, diverse perspectives fuel innovation, and everyone can thrive.

About this opportunity
Big ambitions? Bigger impact. At Lloyds Banking Group, our digital products are used by millions every day. As a Digital Product Manager Apprentice, you’ll help design and deliver tools that make banking smarter, simpler and more human.

This isn’t about “shadowing”. It’s about shaping real products from day one.

Due to Home Office requirements regarding Skilled Workers, we’re unable to accept applications for visa sponsorship for our apprenticeship roles as the proposed salary for the role does not meet the minimum threshold – if this situation applies to you, please consider looking for other vacancies which may be more suitable.

Location

This apprenticeship is based in Edinburgh, and you will be expected to work from the Edinburgh office throughout the programme. While our hybrid working policy requires office attendance at least two days per week (40% for full-time colleagues), apprentices are expected to be in the office most days during the initial settling-in period.

If your commute exceeds 1.5 hours, we strongly recommend relocating closer to the office to ensure consistent attendance in line with contractual and hybrid working expectations.

About working for us
Our ambition is to be the leading UK business for diversity, equity and inclusion supporting our customers, colleagues and communities and we’re committed to creating an environment in which everyone can thrive, learn and develop.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer Initiative.

We provide reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process to reduce or remove barriers. Just let us know what you need.

Salary

You will join us on a fixed apprenticeship salary. Upon successful completion of the apprenticeship, you will be re-graded, with your pay range consistent with the job family for your business area.

We also offer a wide-ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%
  • An annual performance-related bonus
  • Share schemes including free shares
  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping
  • 22 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top
  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

The closing date to apply for this opportunity is 15th December 2026

Our roles generate a lot of interest and occasionally we need to close for applications earlier than originally advertised. If you think working with us could be right for you, please apply now and see where an apprenticeship with us can take you!

If you have any queries regarding the recruitment process, please email lloydsbankinggroup@cappfinity.com and a member of our team will be happy to help and will reply within 3 working days (Monday – Friday).

What happens next?

Submit your application → Complete the online assessments → If successful, attend the Assessment Centre in February → Receive your outcome.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. title: Vi söker en lagermedarbetare/montör till Airolit!
description:
Om företaget

Airolit är ett snabbväxande bolag inom drönarteknik med kunder inom försvar och säkerhet. Här arbetar du nära både produkt, utveckling och produktion i en organisation med korta beslutsvägar och högt tempo. Det här är en miljö för dig som: • Vill vara nära tekniken och produkten. • Vill arbeta praktiskt med avancerade system. • Vill vara med och bygga struktur i en växande produktion. • Vill ta ansvar och påverka kvaliteten i det som levereras. • Vill vara en del av ett tekniskt starkt team där ditt arbete gör skillnad.

Tjänstebeskrivning

Gillar du när teknik, montering och logistik möts i samma arbetsdag? Då kan det här vara rätt roll för dig. Som lagerarbetare/montör får du en omväxlande vardag där du ena stunden arbetar praktiskt med montering och testning och nästa tar emot en leverans, kontrollerar material eller ser till att produktionen har rätt komponenter på rätt plats. Rollen är fördelad på cirka 50 % montering och 50 % lager och logistik. Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat: • Förmontage, kittning och testning av produkter • Godsmottagning, leveranskontroll, lagerhantering och registrering • Materialförsörjning till produktionen • Inventering samt arbete med ordning och spårbarhet • Packning och förberedelse av leveranser • Förbättring av lager- och produktionsflöden Här får du möjlighet att komma in i en produktion som utvecklas, och vara med och påverka arbetssätt och struktur. Teamet arbetar tätt tillsammans, hjälps åt vid behov och samarbetar över funktionerna. Arbetet är förlagt dagtid måndag till fredag i Mölndal. Tjänsten har start så snart som möjligt, enligt överenskommelse.

Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen tror vi att du har en praktisk och teknisk ådra samt erfarenhet av såväl montering och testning som lager och logistik. Vi ser att du: • Har erfarenhet av affärs- eller lagersystem • Arbetar strukturerat och noggrant • Är flexibel och kan växla mellan olika arbetsuppgifter • Tar egna initiativ och driver ditt arbete framåt • Är prestigelös och tycker om att samarbeta Har du ADR-certifikat för farligt gods eller erfarenhet av lödning är detta meriterande. För denna tjänst krävs vidare: • Svenskt medborgarskap, alternativt nordiskt medborgarskap eller dubbelt medborgarskap efter särskild bedömning • Godkänd säkerhetsprövning enligt gällande regelverk

Vad erbjuder vi dig?

Det här är möjligheten för dig som vill följa med på en tillväxtresa och samtidigt arbeta nära modern och avancerad teknik. På Airolit får du inte bara en varierad roll, utan också chansen att växa med bolaget. Du blir en del av ett engagerat team med nära samarbete, och goda möjligheter att bidra med egna idéer.

Låter detta intressant?

Vår samarbetspartner i den här rekryteringen är rekryteringsföretaget NearYou. Har du några frågor är du välkommen att kontakta rekryteringskonsult Olivia King på telefon 073-342 43 55 eller e-post olivia.king@nearyou.se Din ansökan skickar du in via NearYous hemsida, www.nearyou.se, senast 26/11. Urval sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan redan idag. Med anledning av dataskyddsförordningen GDPR, ber vi dig att utesluta de sista fyra siffrorna i ditt personnummer samt eventuella referenskontakter i din ansökan/CV. Vi tar ej emot ansökningar via e-post. Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om NearYou

NearYou är ett rekryterings- och bemanningsföretag med kontor i 19 städer. Vi har gått från att vara ett bolag bland andra i branschen till att också bli en samhällsaktör. Med oss som partner och arbetsgivare lovar vi att ge mer av det vi är bäst på. Vi är bäst på att vara nära, mänskliga och en motpol till stress, människor som statistik och en alltför opersonlig digitalisering. Vi är hos dig, ett handslag, ett löfte. Vi vet vad en bra arbetsmarknad behöver. För dig som kandidat innebär det en aktör som backar dig, oavsett var i karriären du är och vill vara. Vi vill vara tryggheten i en snabb värld. Vi stöttar, utmanar och frågar hur det går. Helt naturligt, tycker vi. Läs gärna mer om oss på www.nearyou.se

title: Finance Enterprise Partner
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

About the Role / Purpose

The Finance Enterprise Partner (FEP) serves as key strategic business partner to the commercial organization.


As an FEP you leverage your in-depth business understanding combined with financial expertise in autonomously driving initiatives forward that are critical to delivering our strategy. The FEP builds networks across the organisation (including the Finance Excellence Chapters), to share best practices and co-create solutions that generate value for the affiliate, the enterprise and the customer. As FEP, you are a trusted thought partner to business stakeholders and have close contact with customers, where you will ensure efficient resource allocation and maximum impact along the customer journey.


Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with the business and support or co-lead touchpoints throughout the whole customer journey with an enterprise mindset.
  • Autonomously balance resource allocation across competing priorities and provide advice on financial implications of proposed business activities
  • Key partner for developing a coherent affiliate commercial strategy as well as commercial business related processes such as business planning, opportunity prioritization and creative strategies for revenue generation.
  • Ensure financials are on track to achieve targeted business results and metrics, or advise on deviations and corrective actions
  • Participate in FEP communities to learn, share and implement best practices across markets
  • Support the business and customers in co-creating new business models, quantifying value, and providing pricing transparency
  • Stimulate behaviors across the organization aligned with financial objectives.

title: Field Service Site Supervisor
description:
Field Service Site Supervisor – Spain


At JBT Marel, we are looking for a Field Service Site Supervisor based in Spain to oversee equipment installations, start-up activities and preventive maintenance agreements at customer sites around the world.

This is an international, hands-on role for someone with a strong electrical background, a practical mindset and the confidence to work independently. You will coordinate local contractors and customer crews, take ownership of complex site challenges and ensure projects are delivered safely, efficiently and to the required standards.

The role involves global travel for approximately 160–210 days per year, with assignments typically lasting between 2 and 8 weeks away from home.


What You'll Be Doing


  • Supervising equipment installations, start-up activities and preventive maintenance agreements at customer sites worldwide.
  • Coordinating and overseeing field service engineers, local contractors and customer crews to ensure work is completed safely and efficiently.
  • Ensuring compliance with safety, quality and regulatory standards throughout project execution.
  • Conducting pre-installation site visits to verify site layouts, technical requirements and customer readiness.
  • Managing schedules, resources and priorities while independently resolving complex technical and logistical challenges.
  • Communicating project progress, issues and requirements to customers, project management and internal stakeholders, preparing reports and documenting lessons learned.
  • Providing technical guidance to less experienced colleagues, supporting their development and contributing to continuous improvement and customer satisfaction.

Experience & Education


  • A strong electrical background is essential, supported by in-depth knowledge of electrical systems and a basic understanding of related technical disciplines.
  • Experience in field service, site supervision, equipment installation, commissioning, maintenance engineering or a similar technical role.
  • Experience coordinating contractors, customer teams or technical personnel on-site.
  • The ability to troubleshoot complex problems, make sound decisions and work independently with minimal guidance.
  • Experience leading project activities, supporting less experienced colleagues and contributing to process improvements.
  • Excellent written and verbal English is mandatory.
  • Willingness and ability to travel globally for 160–210 days per year, including assignments of 2–8 weeks away from home.
  • Previous experience in the food processing or industrial machinery sector would be advantageous.

Working Style


Your mentality is the most important factor. We are looking for someone who is proactive, resilient, dependable and solution-focused. You should be comfortable working alone for extended periods, taking ownership of challenges and adapting to different customers, cultures and working environments.


Who Are We?


We are the kind of people who find purpose in creating things. Our mission is to transform the future of food by creating a world where quality food is produced sustainably and affordably.

At JBT Marel, we are uniquely positioned to make this happen. By combining technology, innovation and expertise, we help food producers around the world improve efficiency, productivity and sustainability.

If you are passionate about Excellence, Innovation and Unity, we invite you to join our global team and help us shape the future of food.


Interested?


If you have the electrical expertise, independent mindset and willingness to travel internationally, we'd love to hear from you.

Visit to learn more about us and explore your future with JBT Marel.

title: Seasonal Brand Specialist, Tommy Hilfiger - Fenwick Colchester
description:
Be part of an iconic story.

TOMMY HILFIGER is one of the world’s most recognized global lifestyle brands, confidently welcoming and inspiring consumers since 1985. Originally established in New York City and infused with the vibrant spirit of Americana, to create the modern uniform of accessible luxury. The TOMMY HILFIGER brands consist of TOMMY HILFIGER and TOMMY JEANS, complemented by a range of licensed product categories that extend the brand lifestyle across generations, geographies, activities and occasions. With a history going back over 130 years, PVH has excelled at growing brands and businesses with rich American heritages, becoming one of the largest global apparel companies. We have over 30,000 associates operating in over 40 countries with over $8 billion in revenues.

We are brand builders who focus our passion and creativity to build Calvin Klein and TOMMY HILFIGER into the most desirable lifestyle brands in the world and at the same time position PVH as one of the best-performing brand groups in our sector. Guided by our values and enabled by our scale and global reach, we are driving fashion forward for good, as one team with one vision and one plan. That’s the Power of Us, that’s the Power of PVH+.

One of PVH’s greatest strengths is our people. title: Client Engagement Partner
description:
Reed is the most recognised recruitment brand in the UK, with a rich history and reputation for improving lives through work, for over 60 years. Job Description

Be the driving force behind our client growth strategy

At Reed, we're passionate about helping organisations solve their talent challenges while building long-term partnerships that deliver real value. We're looking for a commercially minded Client Engagement Partner to play a pivotal role in ensuring our newly acquired clients reach their full potential and experience the very best of Reed.


Please note that this is a 12-month fixed term contract/secondment.


About the Role

As a Client Engagement Partner, you will act as the bridge between our Business Development teams and operational recruitment teams, ensuring a seamless transition for new clients and laying the foundations for long-term success.


Location

This role supports Reed's Core North region and can be based from any Reed office within Core North, with regular travel across the region as required.


Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the first point of contact in Reed's "land and expand" journey for newly won clients.
  • Support the successful handover of new business opportunities from sales to operational teams.
  • Build strong relationships with key stakeholders to establish Reed as the client's preferred recruitment partner.
  • Create and maintain detailed organisational charts, identifying hiring managers, decision-makers, and reporting structures.
  • Map and engage senior stakeholders across client organisations, ensuring contact information is accurately maintained in HubSpot and X3.
  • Understand clients' recruitment, HR, procurement, and onboarding processes to maximise service delivery.
  • Proactively identify recruitment opportunities by monitoring client activity and uncovering live vacancies.
  • Ensure opportunities are shared with the appropriate Reed specialists and followed through to conversion.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce additional Reed services, including screening solutions, C+, MSP, RPO, and other value-added offerings.
  • Coordinate and attend service reviews alongside relevant Reed stakeholders.
  • Gather client feedback, testimonials, and case studies to support future business development.
  • Support sales and marketing initiatives by promoting client engagement through webinars, events, and hospitality opportunities.
  • Build awareness of future contract renewals, re-tenders, and strategic growth opportunities.
  • Ensure accurate reporting and tracking of client engagement activity through Power BI and internal systems.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is naturally relationship-focused, commercially driven, and passionate about delivering outstanding client experiences.


You'll likely have:

  • Experience in recruitment, account management, client success, business development, or a related commercial role.
  • A proven ability to build and maintain senior stakeholder relationships.
  • Strong business development and consultative selling skills.
  • Excellent networking, influencing, and communication abilities.
  • The ability to identify opportunities and translate them into revenue growth.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Experience using CRM systems and reporting tools.
  • A collaborative approach and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.

Why Reed?

Joining Reed means becoming part of the UK's largest family-owned recruitment business, where people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do.


You'll benefit from:

  • Extensive learning and development opportunities
  • Career progression across the Reed Group
  • Hybrid and flexible working
  • Reed Reward Hub with discounts and wellbeing benefits
  • Enhanced family-friendly policies
  • Pension scheme
  • Paid volunteering opportunities
  • Access to industry-leading technology and support networks

Interested?

If you're passionate about building lasting client relationships, spotting growth opportunities, and helping organisations unlock the full value of partnering with Reed, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help shape the future growth of Reed's most valuable client partnerships. Please note that the closing date is Tuesday 17th November.

Feel what it’s like to truly belong…
All job offers are subject to satisfactory references and compliance with vetting requirements applicable to the job role. Reed is an equal opportunities employer. We aim to ensure that no candidate or employee receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, race, disability, sexual orientation, religion or belief, age, gender identity, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity. title: Lärare i slöjd
description:
Vårgårda kommun – här lyckas vi tillsammans!

Välkommen till Vårgårda kommun och en arbetsplats där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag. Med respektfullt bemötande och hög tillgänglighet gör vi allt för att leverera välfärdstjänster som överträffar invånarnas förväntningar. Med utgångspunkt i vår vision, vår gemensamma värdegrund och tydliga politiska mål bygger vi för stark tillväxt och ett attraktivt arbetsgivarvarumärke.

I Vårgårda kommun arbetar vi tillsammans med fokus på verksamhetens syfte och invånarnas behov. Vi vill vara en plats där drömmar kan bli verklighet, där trygghet och aktivitet går hand i hand och där alla kan känna sig hemma. Tillsammans fortsätter vi att utveckla en kommun där det är gott att leva, bo och verka!

Varmt välkomna till Asklanda och Nårunga skolor. Skolorna är Vårgårda kommuns minsta byskolor med enheter som rymmer både förskola, fritidshem och grundskola åk F-6, Gott samarbete, samsyn och nära kommunikation råder på enheten. Skolorna är omgivna av vacker landsbygd med varierande natur.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker nu lärare till lärarteamet för Asklanda och Nårunga skolor. Vi söker dig som är behörig och intresserad av att hålla i undervisning i slöjdämnet och kompletterar lärarteamet och tillsammans med dem ge eleverna nyfikenhet, lust att lära, och arbeta aktivt med att skapa trivsel och studiero. Som lärare på våra enheter utvecklar och bedriver du pedagogiskt arbete tillsammans med övriga pedagoger i arbetslaget. Du är flexibel, har en förmåga att se möjligheter och lösningar och är inte rädd för att komma med egna idéer. Uppdraget är att med tätt samarbete med klasslärare och specialpedagog för att ge elever möjlighet, anpassad undervisning och god arbetsmiljö under delar av skoldagen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Vi söker lärare med kompetens att hålla i slöjdundervisningen på Asklanda respektive Nårunga skola i Vårgårda kommun. Vi är särskilt intresserade av dig som har lärarlegitimation. Som person är du intresserad av att arbeta med människor och har en god förmåga att lyssna in och kommunicera med både elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Du har en positiv inställning och ser alla elevers möjligheter och styrkor. Du ser samarbete med dina kollegor kring planering, bedömning och utveckling av verksamheten som ett bärande inslag i din lärarvardag samtidigt som du också kan driva ditt eget arbete framåt. Du har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och är skicklig på att inspirera och motivera eleverna till att lära. Vi söker dig som är stabil, engagerad och som tillsammans med kollegor kan skapa en god lärmiljö för våra elever.

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning.
Varaktighet:, tillträde: 2027-01-07  .
Omfattning: 70 %

För att kvalitetssäkra rekryteringsprocessen i Vårgårda kommun samt möjliggöra god kommunikation med våra sökande ber vi dig skicka in din ansökan digitalt och inte via e-post eller pappersformat.

Till vissa av kommunens tjänster krävs det ett utdrag från misstanke- och belastningsregister innan anställning kan ske. Vi kommer därför efterfråga detta av dig som erbjuds anställning hos oss i Vårgårda Kommun. Utdraget får inte vara äldre än 6 månader.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som säljare: 

Vårgårda kommun har gjort sitt medieval för rekrytering och undanber oss alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

Om tjänsten

Vi söker dig som är engagerad och pålitlig, och som vill arbeta på ett tryggt och stort bolag som CE-chaufför hos vår samarbetspartner. Här får du chansen att arbeta med bekväma arbetstider på dagtid, där alla körningar sker inom staden med utgångspunkt i Umeå eller Luleå.

Du kommer att bli anställd som konsult hos Academic Work och jobba hos vår samarbetspartner. Uppdraget startar enligt överenskommelse och erbjuder mycket goda möjligheter till långsiktighet, så länge alla parter är nöjda med samarbetet.

Som konsult för Academic Work erbjuder vi stora möjligheter för dig att växa professionellt, bygga ditt nätverk och skapa värdefulla kontakter för framtiden. Läs mer om vårt konsulterbjudande.

Vi söker dig som

  • Har CE-körkort
  • Har YKB-utbildning
  • Kan obehindrat kommunicera på svenska, då språket förekommer dagligen i arbetet för att kunna kommunicera med kunder.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har ADR-utbildning och truckkort för ledstaplare. Har du jobbat i liknande roll är även det positivt. Då du är ansiktet utåt mot kunderna ser vi att du har en positiv attityd och är självgående i ditt arbete.

Övrig information

Start: Enligt överenskommelse

Omfattning: Heltid

Placering: Umeå eller Luleå

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

title: UKIMEA Early Careers Program Manager
description:
UKIMEA Early Careers Program Manager

This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

The UKIMEA Early Careers Program Manager will provide strategic direction and operational leadership for the UKIMEA Early Careers portfolio, including interns, apprentices, graduates, T-Levels and other university talent programs. This role will shape the content, structure, experiences and deliverables that support early-career talent across the region, ensuring programs are scalable, inclusive, commercially relevant and aligned to business priorities. In addition to managing the day-to-day delivery of the program, this role will make strategic decisions that enhance the participant experience, improve business outcomes and increase conversion rates into full-time employment. The role will work closely with local-site leads, HR teams, hiring managers and senior leadership to create consistent regional experiences while enabling meaningful local contribution.


In a typical day in this role…

  • Provide leadership for the UKIMEA Early Careers Program, owning the design and evolution of program content, learning experiences, development activities and participant deliverables.
  • Ensure the program delivers measurable value and ROI for the business through effective planning, talent development, retention and conversion strategies.
  • Develop scalable program frameworks, resources and experiences that can be adopted across the region while allowing for appropriate local flexibility.
  • Establish effective ways for local-site leads to interact and contribute in a coordinated and efficient manner.
  • Manage program budgets, resources, suppliers, timelines, risks and performance reporting.
  • Oversee the onboarding, assimilation, development, engagement, progression and retention of early-career talent.
  • Coach and support participants, managers, mentors and local program leads to promote successful outcomes.
  • Design and deliver development sessions, training, community events and networking opportunities that strengthen culture, connection and belonging across UKIMEA.
  • Engage confidently with senior leaders and key decision-makers, demonstrating professional judgment, credibility and cultural leadership.
  • Partner with broader university and early-careers organizations to align regional priorities, share best practices and support enterprise-wide initiatives.
  • Lead the regional delivery of T-level, intern, apprentice and graduate programs, ensuring a consistent and high-quality experience across locations.
  • Develop and implement strategies to improve the conversion of interns, apprentices and graduates into full-time employees.
  • Oversee and support the EMEA Intern Site program

Skills and experience required…

  • Bachelor’s degree, ideally in Human Resources, Business, Education or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Typically 3–5 years of related experience in early careers, talent management, HR program management, university recruiting, learning and development or a related field.
  • Demonstrated experience managing or leading regional or multi-site programs.
  • Experience developing program strategies, content, deliverables and success measures.
  • Strong understanding of early-career talent programs, including internships, graduate programs, apprenticeships and/or T-Level pathways.
  • Ability to influence and partner with senior leaders, managers, HR teams and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Strong communication, presentation and stakeholder-management skills, with the confidence to engage at all levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, data, reporting, timelines, vendors, risks and multiple priorities.
  • Strong project and program management skills
  • Strong organization skills, attention to detail and the ability to balance strategic planning with operational execution.
  • Experience planning and delivering development programs, events and experiences for diverse early-career audiences.

Accessibility

If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.


Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

title: Forensic Consultant - IT Forensics, eDiscovery, Data Analytics & AI
description:
We Do Consulting Differently


Open to all genders (m/f/d)


About the role

We are seeking Forensic Consultants across all experience levels to join our Düsseldorf-based team. You will support investigations and disputes by combining digital evidence, data analytics and technology-enabled solutions to establish facts and deliver clear, actionable findings.

We welcome junior candidates with relevant internships and a genuine interest in these areas, as well as experienced professionals who can independently deliver workstreams or lead complex engagements.


Your areas of work


Depending on your experience and specialization, you will contribute to one or more of the following areas:


  • IT Forensics: Identify, preserve, collect and analyze digital evidence. Examples include creating forensic images of laptops, collecting email and cloud data, recovering deleted files, and analyzing metadata or user activity to reconstruct events, while maintaining evidence integrity and chain-of-custody documentation.
  • eDiscovery: Support the management of electronic information from collection and processing through document review and production. Examples include processing and deduplicating email collections, developing keyword searches, configuring review workflows, applying redactions and preparing document productions using platforms such as Relativity, Nuix or comparable solutions.
  • Structured Data Analytics: Analyze transactional and business data from SAP and other ERP systems to identify anomalies and support investigations. Examples include examining general-ledger entries, procurement transactions and vendor master data; identifying duplicate payments or unusual journal entries; and reconciling data across systems using tools such as SQL, Python, Alteryx, Power BI or advanced Excel.
  • AI Agents and AI Implementation: Develop, implement or evaluate AI-enabled solutions for investigative and analytical workflows. Examples include building assistants that search investigation documents and provide source-linked answers, automating document classification and information extraction, or developing agents that query approved transactional datasets and flag anomalies for human review. Solutions should incorporate appropriate confidentiality safeguards, access controls, accuracy testing and human oversight.

What you bring


Junior / entry-level candidates


  • You demonstrate a genuine interest in one or more of the areas above, supported by relevant internships, working-student roles or comparable practical experience.
  • For example, you may have assisted with digital-evidence collection, supported a document-review exercise, analysed transactional data or developed an AI prototype during an internship or university project.
  • You are keen to develop your technical expertise and learn how to apply it to investigations. Prior independent engagement delivery is not expected.

Experienced consultants


  • You bring demonstrable hands-on experience in one or more of the areas above and can independently deliver defined workstreams.
  • For example, you may have conducted forensic collections, managed eDiscovery processing, analyzed SAP transactions for potential irregularities or implemented an AI-supported review workflow.
  • You can document your methods, validate your results and explain findings clearly to colleagues and clients.

Senior candidates through SMC


  • You bring substantial relevant experience and can design approaches, lead engagements, supervise teams and oversee quality.
  • For example, you may have defined a digital-evidence collection strategy, led a large-scale eDiscovery engagement, designed a transactional analytics programme or overseen the implementation of an AI solution with appropriate governance.
  • You can manage client relationships, budgets and deadlines, and communicate complex findings to legal counsel, management and other stakeholders.

German-language proficiency


Native-level or equivalent fluency in written and spoken German is required—for example, to review German-language business records, discuss findings with clients and legal counsel, and prepare clear reports in German.


Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area or with every named tool. We will assess the breadth and depth of your expertise against the seniority and focus of the role.


About BRG

BRG combines world-leading academic credentials with world-tested business expertise and purpose-built emerging technologies. Our culture centers on agility and connectivity which sets us apart and gets you ahead.

At BRG, our professionals include specialist consultants, industry experts, renowned academics, and leading-edge data scientists. Together, they bring a diversity of real-world experience, data, and human and artificial intelligence, to economics, disputes, and investigations; corporate finance; and performance improvement services that address the most complex challenges facing organizations across the globe.

Our unique structure nurtures the interdisciplinary relationships that give us the edge, laying the groundwork for more informed insights and more original, incisive thinking. When paired with our global reach and resources, our diverse perspectives and technical capabilities make us uniquely capable to address our clients’ challenges. We get results because we know how to apply our thinking to your world.

At BRG, we don’t just show you what’s possible. We’re built to help you make it happen.

title: Footwear Materials Developer II, Jordan, Local Creation GC
description:
WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking a talented, passionate, and influential Footwear Materials Developer II with the technical expertise to elevate product excellence through materials. You combine strong material knowledge with creative problem-solving to translate design intent into scalable solutions. You thrive in fast-paced environments, build trust across cross-functional teams, and balance innovation, quality, aesthetics, cost, speed, and sustainability throughout the product creation process. In this role, you will help differentiate Nike’s products in the marketplace through materials excellence.

WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON

As a member of the GC Local Creation Footwear Product Development team, you will lead the development and commercialization of material solutions that deliver on quality, cost, speed, sustainability, and aesthetic objectives, helping bring premium products to market on time and at scale.

· Drive material development, testing, commercialization, and implementation from concept through production.

· Partner with Local Creation Product, Design, and Development teams to identify risks, resolve material challenges, and enable informed decision-making throughout the development process.

  • Lead vendor communication as the primary point of contact for material development, building a deep understanding of vendor capabilities and maintaining strong working partnerships.

· Evaluate material performance and manufacturing feedback to continuously improve product quality and execution.

title: Restaurangansvarig till Best Western Plus Park City Hammarby sjöstad
company: Gravis AB, Best Western Plus Park City Hammarby
description:
Med närhet till både Stockholm city, vatten och natur i den trendiga, men lugna och trygga stadsdelen Hammarby Sjöstad är Best Western Plus Park City Hammarby Sjöstad ett idealiskt hotell för både fritids- och affärsresenärer. Hotellet är beläget precis vid Hammarbybacken, (Stockholms enda skidbacke) och ligger en kort promenad från Lumabryggan där du kan ta båten till Södermalm, Djurgården och Nybroviken i Stockholm city. Vi erbjuder 178 ljusa och rymliga rum i flera rumskategorier. Trådlöst internet, frukostbuffé samt tillgång till gym och bastu ingår alltid i priset när man bor hos oss. Missa inte heller att åka upp till vår 15:e våning för att njuta av en av Stockholms bästa utsikter. Det är lätt och smidigt att ta sig till hotellet oavsett om du åker kollektivt eller har egen bil. Med kollektivtrafiken tar du dig enkelt till Avicii Arena och 3Arena på mindre än 10 minuter och till Stockholm City på 20 minuter. Best Western Plus Park City Hammarby ingår i Ligula Hospitality Group AB.

Beskrivning

Som ansvarig för vår restaurang och bar arbetar du dagligen i driften, samt ansvarar för schemaläggning, inköp, lager, rutiner, planering, personal och utveckling. Du är kommunikativ och ser vikten av att delge information till övriga avdelningar på hotellet, för att tillsammans med hotellets alla medarbetare kunna skapa den bästa tänkbara upplevelsen för våra gäster.

För oss är det viktigt att du känner stort ansvar för din avdelning, är professionell i mötet med gäster och kollegor samt är lojal och ordningsam. Du ansvarar för att planera och bemanna utifrån verksamhetens behov. Du har en passion för service och du inspirerar och motiverar dina kollegor så att vi tillsammans skapar enastående gästupplevelser och når våra försäljningsmål. Du har ett stort intresse för mat och dryck.

Arbetsuppgifter

  • Säkerställa restaurangens servicenivå
  • Schemalägga och styra arbetet för ditt team
  • Rekrytera personal och upplärning
  • Planera måltider för våra grupper och konferenser
  • Se till att arbets- och säkerhetsrutiner efterföljs
  • Ansvara för inköp till restaurangen
  • Vara behjälplig med lagerinventering månadsvis

Kvalifikationer

Vi ser gärna att du behärskar svenska och engelska i tal och skrift samt har erfarenhet av kassa och datorer. Vi ser gärna att du har ett par års erfarenhet från restaurang och arbetsledning.

Villkor

Anställningen är en tillsvidareanställning på 100% med 6 månaders provanställning med fokus på kvällar och helg. Vi arbetar med HRFs kollektivavtal, och lön enligt överenskommelse.

Intervjuer sker löpande och vi ser gärna att du kan börja jobba snarast.

Ligula Hospitality Group är moderbolag i en privatägd hotell- och restaurangkoncern i stark men långsiktig tillväxt. Vi äger, förvaltar och utvecklar välkända varumärken och koncept inom besöksnäringen och har sedan 2015 mer än fördubblat antalet hotell – med fortsatt expansion i fokus.

I dag består koncernen av 48 hotell i Sverige, Danmark och Tyskland som drivs under varumärkena ProfilHotels, Apartments by Ligula, Motel L, Good Morning Hotels och Collection by Ligula. Därutöver driver vi sex Best Western Plus-hotell genom avtal. Totalt sysselsätter vi cirka 800 årsanställda och omsätter över 1 500 MSEK.

Som arbetsgivare vill vi erbjuda trygga och schyssta villkor i en stabil organisation. Vi är anslutna till Visita genom kollektivavtal, vilket innebär ordnade arbetsvillkor, tjänstepension, försäkringar och andra viktiga förmåner.

Hos oss kombineras stabilitet och långsiktighet med möjligheten att utvecklas i en växande koncern. Vi strävar efter hållbara anställningar, tydliga strukturer och ett arbetsliv där du kan känna trygghet både idag och inför framtiden.

title: Scheduling Coordinator
description:

As a Scheduling Coordinator in the Health Care and Social Assistance industry, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that our patients receive the care they need in a timely and efficient manner.   • Knowledge of medical terminology and procedures

  • Communicate effectively with patients, medical staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure that scheduling needs are met
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all scheduling activities
  • Identify and resolve scheduling conflicts in a timely and efficient manner

Skills:

As a Scheduling Coordinator, you will use your strong organizational and time management skills to ensure that all scheduling needs are met and that patient care is never compromised. You will communicate effectively with patients, medical staff, and other healthcare professionals to ensure that scheduling needs are met. Your attention to detail and ability to prioritize tasks will be essential in ensuring that our patients receive the highest quality care possible. You will also use your excellent communication and interpersonal skills to build strong relationships with patients and other members of the healthcare team. Finally, your ability to work independently and as part of a team will be critical in ensuring that all scheduling activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

title: Biorisk Management Engineer
description:
Help us keep containment strong, from the first design sketch to daily operations


Vaccines protect people, and protecting the people who make them is just as important. At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Biorisk Management Engineer (BRM) to bridge biosafety, biosecurity, and engineering at our Kvistgaard site.


You will make sure containment is built into our facilities, utilities, equipment, and processes. That applies to the buildings we run today and to the expansions and projects that will shape our future.


About the role

You will be the go-to engineering expert on biorisk management, working closely with Engineering, Operations, Process Development, Quality, EHS, and project teams. Your job is to turn biosafety and biosecurity requirements into engineering solutions that are practical, maintainable, and verifiable.


Your responsibilities

Be the containment expert our projects and operations rely on

  • Drive biorisk management from the engineering side, as the link between BRM, facility and process engineering, utilities, security, and operations
  • Assess facilities, equipment, and processes, and turn risk assessments and regulations into robust, practical engineering controls
  • Advise on containment strategies, from pressure cascades, HVAC, and HEPA filtration to decontamination and waste inactivation

Shape the future of our Kvistgaard site

  • Define the BRM basis of design for new laboratories, production facilities, expansions, and BSL-3 projects
  • Join design reviews and risk assessments (FMEA, HAZOP, LOPA), and challenge solutions that could compromise containment
  • Make sure risk controls are tested, documented, and handed over smoothly to operations

Strengthen what we run today

  • Spot containment gaps and improvement opportunities in existing facilities, and support changes while balancing GMP, operability, and business continuity
  • Contribute your engineering expertise to investigations, deviations, CAPAs, audits, and inspections
  • Build containment awareness across the organization through advice and training

Get hands-on with qualification and testing

  • Support risk-based commissioning, qualification, and verification (FAT, SAT, IQ, OQ, PQ) and define acceptance criteria and test strategies for containment-critical systems
  • Step into hands-on testing and troubleshooting when it matters

Safeguard both biosafety and biosecurity

  • Work with Security, IT, and Automation to integrate access control, CCTV, intrusion detection, and zoning with our containment systems

Who you are

You have

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering, preferably Biochemical, Biotechnology, Biosafety, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical field
  • Experience from pharmaceutical or biomanufacturing environments, ideally vaccine production or high-containment operations
  • A strong understanding of biosafety risk assessment, containment strategies, and GMP-aligned engineering
  • Practical knowledge of bioprocess equipment, cleanrooms, HVAC, HEPA filtration, pressure cascades, decontamination, and waste inactivation
  • Experience with design reviews, technical risk assessments, facility or equipment changes, and CQV documentation
  • The ability to turn complex BRM requirements into workable solutions and to communicate clearly across functions and with external partners

It is an advantage if you have

  • Hands-on CQV experience from high-containment facilities, automated CIP/SIP, aseptic processing, building automation, or containment monitoring
  • Familiarity with FMEA, HAZOP, LOPA, applicable BRM legislation, ISO 35001, EU GMP, and WHO biosafety guidance
  • Knowledge of physical security systems and experience managing cross-functional technical projects
  • Additional training or certification in commissioning, qualification, validation, HVAC testing, building automation, containment engineering, or security systems

You are

  • A proactive advocate for containment integrity, with sound technical judgement and genuine curiosity
  • Comfortable working both independently and in close collaboration with others
  • Structured and dependable, able to manage priorities and keep documentation traceable
  • Someone who constructively challenges assumptions and drives continuous improvement

What we offer

  • A role with real impact on safety, compliance, and the facilities that produce vaccines for people around the world
  • A varied mix of strategic development work and hands-on operational support
  • Close collaboration with skilled colleagues across engineering, quality, operations, and projects
  • A professional, international environment where your expertise is valued and your development is supported

Salary Package

Annual base salary range: DKK 738.810 –902.990 gross


Flexible working conditions, pension scheme, health insurance, competitive compensation package and potential bonus opportunities.

At Bavarian Nordic, we are committed to fair and transparent pay. The final base salary within this range will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, and competencies, as well as internal pay equity.

Ready to help keep life-saving vaccines moving?

Apply through our designated application platform. Applications sent by email will not be considered.


We kindly request that headhunters or recruitment agencies refrain from contacting us regarding this position.


Bavarian Nordic is a global vaccine company with a mission to improve health and save lives through innovative vaccines. We are a preferred supplier of mpox and smallpox vaccines to governments to enhance public health preparedness and have a leading portfolio of travel vaccines. We are headquartered in Denmark and have manufacturing, research, and sales offices across Europe and North America.

title: Biomedical Engineer
description:
St John of God Health Care is one of Australia's largest and most respected private health care providers, employing over 15,000 caregivers across a diverse network of hospitals and community services. With 25 hospitals and services, more than 3,200 hospital beds, home nursing, disability support, and social outreach programs, we are committed to delivering exceptional care and supporting healthier communities.

About the role

As a Biomedical Engineer, you will play a crucial role in supporting the delivery of safe, high-quality patient care by ensuring the reliability, performance and compliance of critical medical equipment across the hospital.

In this Permanent Full-Time position, you will maintain and manage biomedical assets in line with Australian Standards and regulatory requirements, while providing responsive support and building strong relationships with clinicians, staff and stakeholders.

This is an excellent opportunity to grow your career within a supportive team environment where your skills make a meaningful difference every day.

The Position

  • Operational Support for biomedical assets.
  • troubleshooting, repairing performance verification / testing of medical and scientific equipment (Biomedical equipment).
  • Installation, commissioning (including safety test and asset tagging) for new equipment.
  • Implementation, scheduling and carrying out Planned Preventive Maintenance.
  • Corrective maintenance including breakdown and emergency maintenance.
  • Acceptance, safety and performance test analysis.
  • Patient Treatment Areas Body/Cardiac – perform annual compliance to the relevant standard
  • Gas Therapy Items – Test all Gas Therapy items in all departments.

You will bring a Diploma in Electronic Engineering, Biomedical Engineering or an equivalent qualification, together with at least five years of experience in the biomedical engineering field and demonstrate a strong commitment to continuous quality improvement, exceptional customer service and stakeholder engagement, along with a sound understanding of records management and compliance requirements within a healthcare environment.

To succeed in this role, you will possess excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling you to build effective relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. You will be flexible and responsive, with the ability to participate in after-hours support and attend call-outs when required. Strong computer literacy, particularly within a Windows-based environment, will also be essential to effectively manage systems, documentation and service requirements.

Above all, people will be at the core of everything you do committing to and supporting our Mission and Values.

We can offer you

  • Salary: $107,232 to $119,107 per annum, plus 12% superannuation
  • Permanent Full-Time role
  • Salary packaging up to $18,550 on a range of benefits such as mortgage, rent, meal entertainment, holiday accommodation or other everyday living expenses as well as options to salary package benefits above the FBT cap on items such as:
    • Novated leasing

    • self-education and
    • additional superannuation
  • A welcoming and supportive culture
  • A healthy work-life balance through flexible work options, additional purchased leave and well-being programs
  • Employee discount on St John of God Hospital & Medical Services and Private Health Insurance
  • Employee support through our dedicated free Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • Access to a range of Lifestyle, Health & Wellbeing rewards and discounts

All applicants are asked to submit a covering letter (of no more than two (2) pages) demonstrating how you meet the above position requirements


For enquiries, contact David Crook, Regional Manager, Biomedical Engineering, on 0491 830 689.


Position may be filled before closing date if a suitable candidate is identified

Please note: If suitable candidates are identified, shortlisting and interviews may begin before the advertisement closes.

title: Sustainability and Climate Change Principal Consultant
description:
Job Summary:

We are seeking an experienced professional to join our Sustainability and Climate Change Advisory team as a Principal Consultant.

This role involves leading ESG and climate-related projects, managing client relationships, mentoring teams, and contributing to strategic business development. You will work on high-impact projects that help organizations achieve sustainability goals and comply with global standards.

Why This Role Matter:

Driving Asia Pacific’s Net Zero Transformation
As Asia Pacific accelerates its energy transition, this role is pivotal in shaping strategies that turn climate ambition into action. ERM’s Sustainability & Climate Change team partners with leading organizations to design practical, defensible pathways to net zero, integrating ESG, circular economy, and portfolio innovation. Your expertise will help businesses reimagine models, enhance operational performance, and create long-term value without compromising commercial goals. With ERM scaling its impact regionally, this is your opportunity to influence decision-makers and shape a future where sustainability drives growth and resilience.


Key Responsibilities:

Primary focus on client account development, sales, and delivery of ERM’s consulting services to deliver strategic value to our clients. In particular, play a key role in growing ERM’s Sustainability & Climate Change business with a particular emphasis on biodiversity, sustainability-related disclosure, and climate change, Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) background is a plus, across the following service offerings:

  • Biodiversity impact assessment, including baseline surveys, critical habitat assessment, and No Net Loss / Net Gain planning
  • Nature-related risk assessment and disclosure (e.g., TNFD, GRI 101: Biodiversity)
  • Environmental Impact Assessment (EIA) and permitting for energy, infrastructure, mining, and industrial projects
  • Provide technical oversight of biodiversity impact assessments and EIAs, ensuring alignment with national regulatory requirements and international standards such as IFC Performance Standard, and advise clients on translating findings into credible nature-related disclosure.
  • Environmental & Social Governance frameworks and sustainability reporting in line with frameworks such as GRI and IFRS S1/S2
  • Climate change and greenhouse gas emissions management (supporting capability)
  • Drive business development by building client relationships, prioritizing high-potential opportunities, and shaping client needs for ERM services.
  • Leverage own and team’s technical understanding to develop proposals, including written content, pricing, and presentations.
  • Build, grow, and manage a high-performance team, serving as a leader and mentor to consultants.
  • Work in a collaborative, cross-functional team environment with colleagues across the globe/region to build ERM’s global/regional business, lead client and technical teams, and drive innovation that differentiates ERM in the market.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Degree in engineering, ecology, environmental science, environmental policy, or related discipline.
  • 6+ years’ experience in a consulting environment, including a track record of leading EIAs and biodiversity impact assessments.
  • Working knowledge of biodiversity and nature-related disclosure frameworks (e.g., TNFD, GRI 101: Biodiversity) and international standards such as IFC Performance Standard 6.
  • Experience managing EIA processes, including scoping, baseline studies, impact assessment, mitigation hierarchy, stakeholder engagement, and engagement with regulators
  • Business acumen to understand business risk and challenges, and recognize corporate opportunities.
  • Proficiency in using AI tools (e.g., generative AI assistants and AI-enabled data analytics) to support research, literature and regulatory reviews, data analysis, and report drafting, with sound judgment on verifying outputs, protecting client data confidentiality, and responsible use.
  • Familiarity with climate change topics (e.g., decarbonization or Net Zero planning) is an advantage but not required.
  • Offer recognized technical expertise and an established reputation in the local marketplace.

APAC Ready to Lead Way

At ERM, your work creates impact that matters, helping global organizations tackle the most pressing sustainability challenges while shaping a better future for communities and the environment. Our vision is to empower you to grow, lead, and innovate alongside world-class clients on transformative projects. We prioritize wellbeing, continuous learning, and an inclusive culture where collaboration, expertise, and purpose drive meaningful impact. At ERM, diverse perspectives are celebrated, and innovation thrives. If you’re ready to make sustainability your mission and build a career that creates lasting change, your journey starts here

You can apply for this role through Careers or through the internal careers portal if you are a current employee.
